title: Senior JavaScript Automation Test Engineer with AI & Agentic Testing
location: ca, de, fr, gb, in, jp, pl, sg, ua, us, global
description:
We are seeking a Senior JavaScript Automation Test Engineer to join our team and play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and accuracy of software systems, leading a team of testers, implementing and managing automated testing processes and contributing to the continuous improvement of the test automation framework.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable automation solutions, driving quality engineering practices, mentoring teams, and leveraging Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies to accelerate software testing and delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor a team of testers to provide guidance and support in testing activities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze system requirements
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases and test strategies
  • Coordinate and prioritize testing activities to ensure efficient and thorough testing coverage
  • Design, develop and execute automation scripts using advanced automation tools
  • Identify, report and track defects to ensure their thorough validation and resolution
  • Define and enforce quality standards to ensure adherence to best practices
  • Design and implement API automation solutions for REST and SOAP services
  • Validate XML and JSON payloads through serialization and deserialization techniques
  • Integrate automation suites with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions
  • Define test strategies, automation roadmaps, and quality metrics
  • Design and implement AI-driven solutions for automated test case generation, test script generation, code reviews and API-driven automation workflows

Requirements

  • 5-8 years of experience in software test automation and quality engineering
  • Proficiency in API test automation for REST and SOAP services, including authentication mechanisms such as Basic Authentication, Bearer Tokens, OAuth, and NTLM
  • Expertise in software design patterns including Singleton, Factory, Decorator, Page Object Model (POM), and Page Factory
  • Skills in CI/CD and DevOps integration using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and static code analysis tools
  • Knowledge of test strategy principles including Test Pyramid, Definition of Ready (DoR), and Definition of Done (DoD)
  • Familiarity with Confirmation Testing, Regression Testing, and Change Impact Testing
  • Hands-on experience with Large Language Models such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Cursor
  • Understanding of Prompt Engineering, Context Window Management, Tokenization, and Model Selection Strategies
  • Background in embeddings and vector databases for semantic search, similarity search, and retrieval mechanisms
  • Competency in designing AI-driven solutions using tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and OpenAI Assistants
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field

Nice to have

  • Experience building multi-agent workflows for end-to-end testing, automated reporting, and failure recovery and fallback handling
  • Knowledge of RAG architectures and integrating LLMs with enterprise knowledge sources
  • Understanding of Model Context Protocol concepts and frameworks for orchestrating agent interactions and workflow monitoring
  • Understanding of Attention Mechanisms and Transformer-based model architectures

Benefits

Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies

Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications

Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms

Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons

Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions

Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects

Focused individual development

Benefit package:

  • Health benefits
  • Retirement benefits

  • Flexible benefits

description:
Imagine a career at one of the nation's most advanced health networks.


Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.


LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.

***Qualified candidates are eligible to receive a sign on bonus***


Summary
Performs high quality ultrasound procedures in accordance with approved practices as outlined in departmental policy and procedure manuals on patients of varying ages. Performs clerical duties, as needed. Responds to the needs and expectations of customers. Participates in on-call, weekend, and holiday rotation.

Job Duties

  • Identifies patients using two patient identifiers; verifies patient orders.
  • Reviews and confirms orders. Consults with radiologist, as necessary.
  • Performs imaging examinations using established protocols.
  • Assists in non-routine specialized exams such as vascular studies and procedures utilizing imaging equipment and techniques.
  • Produces diagnostic images and processes; prepares images for interpretation by the radiologist.
  • Documents accurate history, signs, symptoms, and preliminary findings.
  • Verifies that measurements are accurately taken prior to completing the exam.
  • Verifies that all images are attached and exams are linked in PACS.
  • Assists physician in the performance of specialized procedures. Secures supplies and is knowledgeable of sterile techniques.
  • Cleans, checks, and maintains sonographic equipment submitting maintenance requests or performing minor repairs, as necessary.
  • Scans and handles patients with a high degree of professional ethics, care, tact, courtesy, patience, and safety.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate of approved CAHEA school of diagnostic medical sonography or certification program. In good standing with the ARDMS.
  • 3 years of ultrasound experience performing imaging examinations using established protocols with the level of knowledge acquired through completion of occupationally specific education and
  • 2 years of experience in vascular ultrasound.
  • Ability to use logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.
  • Ability to assess performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.
  • Ability to deal effectively and ethically with medical and confidential information relating to patients, families, physicians, and nursing personnel.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire
  • RDMS - Reg Diagnostic Medical Sonographer ARDMS - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire


Physical Demands
Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Data Quality Specialist
description:
About us

HammondCare provides expert aged care, home care, dementia care and palliative care for older people, regardless of circumstances, beliefs, background or financial situation. We are led by our not-for-profit, Christian foundations and backed by research and clinical expertise.

When it comes to our people - those we serve and those who serve - we are committed to inclusion across race, culture, ethnicity, gender, sex, sexuality, religion and ability. In our innovative residences, our hospitals, or in client homes, we aim to set the global standard of relationship-based care for older people with complex needs.

We've been caring for people for over 90 years - so, if you love to care, join us, and make a career move that matters.

It’s not just care. It’s HammondCare.

About the role

The Data Quality Specialist is HammondCare's subject matter expert for enterprise data quality, responsible for establishing and continuously improving our Data Quality Management Framework. The role provides assurance and oversight of critical data assets that support operational, regulatory, reporting, analytics and AI outcomes.

Combining technical expertise with governance, assurance and stakeholder engagement, the Data Quality Specialist leads initiatives that improve the quality, integrity and reliability of enterprise data. It will suit someone who is confident performing hands-on data quality engineering, analysis and problem solving, as well as engaging with stakeholders to identify and address data quality risks, implement effective controls, and drive sustainable improvements in data management practices.

By developing a deep understanding of HammondCare's business processes, systems and data flows, the Data Quality Specialist plays a key role in ensuring information remains accurate, trusted and fit for purpose throughout its lifecycle.

This role is critical to building confidence in HammondCare's data, enabling informed decision-making, supporting regulatory obligations, improving operational effectiveness, and helping the organisation safely realise the benefits of data, analytics and AI.

This is a fixed term contract for 12 months at St Leonards with hybrid opportunities.

What we can offer you

We care about your wellbeing at HammondCare and as a result offer a wide range of health and lifestyle benefits including:

  • NFP salary packaging ($15,900 tax free) plus meals and entertainment benefit (up to $2,650 tax free)

  • Additional leave purchase options and 14 weeks paid parental leave

  • Flexible working options

  • Discounts on everyday products and services

  • Discounted healthcare memberships - access to network of fitness centres and pools for employees and families

  • Free access to independent counselling support for employees and families

  • Health & Wellbeing programmes

  • Reward & Recognition programmes

  • Referral bonuses

  • Career and professional development opportunities

Key Responsibilities include

  • Establish and continuously improve HammondCare's enterprise data quality framework, standards and controls.

  • Design and implement automated data quality monitoring, validation and assurance processes across critical data assets.

  • Investigate complex data quality issues, perform root cause analysis and drive sustainable remediation outcomes.

  • Partner with business and technology teams to improve data quality, governance and accountability.

  • Develop data quality metrics, dashboards and reporting to provide visibility of risks, trends and performance.

  • Support trusted reporting, analytics and AI initiatives by improving the quality, integrity and reliability of enterprise data.

  • Drive continuous improvement in data management practices, data governance and organisational data maturity.

About You

  • Commitment to engage and align with HammondCare’s Christian Mission, Motivation and Mission in Action

  • At least 5 years demonstrated experience in a similar role

  • Comfortable balancing hands-on technical work with stakeholder engagement, translating complex data challenges into practical business outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability

  • Ability to influence without authority

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrated experience establishing and implementing enterprise data quality frameworks, controls, monitoring and assurance practices.

  • Strong experience in SQL, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines and modern cloud data platforms.

  • Experience leading investigation and remediation of complex data quality issues and driving continuous improvement outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, data lineage and information management principles.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology teams and communicate complex issues to technical and non-technical audiences.

To Apply

If you are ready to make a difference with HammondCare, Apply Now! For any specific queries please contact talent@hammond.com.au.

Pre- Employment Checks

All short-listed applicants for these positions will be asked to consent to a criminal record check and reference checks

HammondCare is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We strive on creating an equal employment environment where everyone from any background can be themselves.

title: Recruitment Business Partner
description:
Bij Odin Groep geloven we dat Recruitment een vak is. Heb jij al ervaring als recruiter en de drive om het beste IT-talent te vinden? Wil jij werken in een snelgroeiende IT-organisatie waar recruitment écht bijdraagt aan groei en waar je samenwerkt in een ambitieus team? Dan leren we je graag kennen.

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Odin Groep, een thuis voor IT-professionals. Dagelijks maken miljoenen mensen gebruik van online IT-diensten ​die door ons ontwikkeld, gemanaged of gehost worden. Wij geloven dat IT essentieel is voor het succes van organisaties. Samen met ruim 1100 gedreven collega’s adviseren, bouwen en beheren onze diensten en oplossingen vanuit diverse vestigingen in Nederland, België en Duitsland. Binnen de groep kennen we twee bedrijven met elk hun eigen expertise, Previder en Cloudwise. In deze functie ga jij je focussen op het vinden van het beste talent voor Previder vanaf onze locatie in Vianen.

Previder brengt organisaties verder met IT. We realiseren werkplekken om efficiënt en veilig samen te werken, we begeleiden organisaties met de transitie naar de cloud en bieden betrouwbare en flexibele IT-platformen vanuit onze eigen datacenters. Dit doen we o.a. voor onze klanten in de zorg, bedrijfsleven en woningcorporaties.

Voortdurend zoeken we nieuwe collega’s die dit mogelijk maken. Daarom breiden we ons recruitmentteam verder uit naar zeven Recruiters, verdeeld over de verschillende locaties door Nederland.

Wat ga je doen?

Durf jij buiten de lijntjes te kleuren en schroom je niet om je creatieve ideeën tot acties uit te voeren? Dan ben jij onze nieuwe Recruiter! In de rol van Recruiter ben je verantwoordelijk voor het werven en selecteren van talenten uit de regio. Dit doe je met een flinke dosis enthousiasme en doorzettingsvermogen.

De vacatures waar jij verantwoordelijk voor bent zijn heel divers; van IT-Specialist tot Accountmanager. Dit doe je binnen een organisatie waar groei en ontwikkeling centraal staan en in een markt waar voortdurend schaarste is. Het is onze strategie om recruitment op eigen kracht te realiseren. Zo krijg je veel vrijheid om samen met je collega’s het volledige recruitmentproces tot een succes te maken.

Naast het matchen van de juiste talenten voor onze vacatures, ga jij je focussen op Recruitmentprojecten die bijdragen aan Employer branding. Eén van je focusprojecten is Campus Recruitment. Omdat we het belangrijk vinden om zichtbaar te zijn onder studenten en talentontwikkeling stimuleren willen we campusrecruitment verder uitbouwen voor Previder midden-NL. Dit doe je o.a. door: stagiaires werven, deelname aan bedrijvendagen van scholen in de regio en rondleidingen organiseren.

Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden in het kort:

  • Als Recruitment Business Partner richt je je op het recruitmentproces van A tot Z: schrijven van wervende vacatureteksten (uiteraard samen met ChatGPT of Co-pilot) proactief benaderen van kandidaten op LinkedIn, telefonische intake met geschikte kandidaten, het voeren van sollicitatiegesprekken, adviseren van je hiring manager, het opstellen laten ondertekenen van de arbeidsovereenkomst;

  • Je focust op verschillende wervingsbronnen: interne doorstroom, referrals van collega’s, talentpools en proactieve sourcing op LinkedIn;

  • Uiteraard zorg je voor een perfecte Candidate Journey;

  • Campusrecruitment verder uitbouwen, contacten onderhouden met scholen in de regio, zodat we ook de juiste studenten en Young Professionals kunnen aantrekken;

  • Wekelijks contact met je hiring managers en teamgenoten om ervoor te zorgen dat het invullen van de vacature een gezamenlijk doel is;

  • Samen met onze collega die verantwoordelijk is voor Arbeidsmarktcommunicatie gave campagnes bedenken.

Werken bij Odin Groep betekent werken in een ambitieuze, professionele en ondernemende organisatie.

Met jouw enthousiasme weet je snel te schakelen, mee te denken en te anticiperen. Je bent flexibel en goed in prioriteiten stellen. Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in de volgende punten:

  • Je hebt ervaring als Recruiter of Intercedent;

  • Je beschikt over creativiteit om in deze markt buiten de gebaande paden tot goede resultaten te komen;

  • Met je Recruiterseat op LinkedIn weet jij veel kandidaten te bereiken;

  • Jij bent de gesprekspartner waar mensen blij van worden, die stevigheid biedt en krachtig het gehele proces kan begeleiden;

  • Je hebt een energieke, positieve en frisse persoonlijkheid;

  • Daarnaast ben je doelgericht, je gaat ervoor om de allerbeste nieuwe collega’s te vinden;

  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar vindt het ook leuk om onderdeel te zijn van een hecht team;

  • Je bent 32-40 uur per week beschikbaar;

  • Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Je bent woonachtig in de regio Utrecht.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Je komt te werken in een heel fijn recruitmentteam, waarin we elkaar verder helpen;

  • Alle mogelijke middelen staan tot je beschikking om jouw werk goed te kunnen uitvoeren;

  • Salaris tussen de €3.000,- en €5.000,- afhankelijk van je ervaring;

  • 31 vrije dagen;

  • Zelf je laptop en mobiel uitkiezen die later je eigendom wordt;

  • Premievrij pensioen;

  • Hele leuke teamfeestjes, zomer BBQ, sportevenementen etc.

title: CEO Office - AI Neobank App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for strong operators to join the CEO Office for BJAK's AI Neobank app expansion.

This role is for someone who can help turn CEO priorities into execution across product, hiring, licensing, partnerships, market launch and daily operating rhythm.

What You'll Own

  • Drive CEO-level priorities from problem definition to execution. 

  • Track OKRs, decisions, blockers, owners and deadlines across teams. 

  • Support licensing applications, country expansion, hiring, partnerships and strategic projects. 

  • Prepare clear briefs, updates, research notes, meeting follow-ups and action trackers.

  • Work across product, engineering, finance, legal, compliance, operations and country teams. 

  • Identify execution gaps and push teams to close them. 

  • Own urgent business problems that do not fit neatly into one department.


What We're Looking For 

  • High-ownership business generalist with strong execution discipline. 

  • Clear writer, structured thinker and strong follow-through operator. 

  • Able to work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. 

  • Comfortable handling ambiguity, urgent problems and shifting priorities. 

  • Strong judgement on what matters, what is blocked and what needs escalation. 

  • Able to keep teams moving without creating unnecessary process. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, operations, strategy, fintech or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Turns unclear priorities into clear actions. 

  • Can chase, unblock and execute without being chased. 

  • Writes updates that make decisions easier. 

  • Stays calm when many things are moving at once. 

  • Cares about outcomes more than visibility.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings. 

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 

title: Director of Product - Mortgage
description:
Come build at the intersection of AI and fintech. At Ocrolus, we’re on a mission to help lenders automate workflows with confidence—streamlining how financial institutions evaluate borrowers and enabling faster, more accurate lending decisions.

Our AI workflow and analytics platform for lenders is trusted at scale, processing nearly one million credit applications every month across small business, mortgage, and consumer lending. By integrating state-of-the-art open- and closed-source AI models with our human-in-the-loop verification engine, Ocrolus captures data from financial documents with over 99% accuracy. Thanks to our advanced fraud detection and comprehensive cash flow and income analytics, our customers achieve greater efficiency in risk management, and provide expanded access to credit—ultimately creating a more inclusive financial system.

Trusted by more than 400 customers—including industry leaders like Better Mortgage, Brex, Enova, Nova Credit, PayPal, Plaid, SoFi, and Square—Ocrolus stands at the forefront of AI innovation in fintech. Join us, and help redefine how the world’s most innovative lenders do business.

Help drive growth across our Mortgage BU, one of Ocrolus's largest and fastest-moving segments. You'll partner directly with the VP of Mortgage Product to accelerate execution across the portfolio, owning strategy and delivery for a significant set of products while ensuring customers experience one cohesive product vision. You'll push how AI automates the mortgage workflow while keeping humans in control of the decisions that matter and innovate to create and deliver value end-to-end in the mortgage manufacturing process. Beyond building great products, you’ll raise the bar for product thinking, customer discovery, prioritization, and execution across the Mortgage team.

Why this role?

Mortgage is being rebuilt around AI in real time, and Ocrolus sits at the center of it. This is the rare seat where genuine mortgage expertise meets frontier AI product work, and where the person in it gets to decide how one of the largest financial workflows in the country actually gets automated. You'll own a portfolio that moves the business, work alongside a team that ships at startup speed, and see your decisions reach millions of loans. If you want your fingerprints on the future of lending, not a slide about it, this is where that work happens.

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with the VP of Mortgage Product to coordinate priorities across the portfolio and present a unified product strategy to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Own strategy, roadmap, and delivery for a portfolio of mortgage products.
  • Drive AI-first automation, across and adjacent to the mortgage manufacturing process, with human-in-the-loop accuracy as the standard.
  • Work closely with engineering, AI/ML, and design teams to rapidly ship, measure, and iterate on new capabilities.
  • Translate agency guidelines (Fannie, Freddie, FHA, VA, USDA) and lender workflows into real requirements and intuitive product experiences. .
  • Partner with Sales, Account Management, Customer Enablement, Implementations, and Marketing to drive successful launches, adoption, and customer value
  • Establish strong product management practices, using customer insight, data, and clear success metrics to drive prioritization and decision-making. Own the metrics that matter, adoption, accuracy, ROI.

What You'll Bring:

  • 8+ years in product, much of it building mortgage or mortgage-tech products (POS, LOS, origination, underwriting automation, income/doc verification, or agency integrations).
  • Deep mortgage fluency: the loan manufacturing process, agency guidelines, underwriting and operations workflows, and what lenders and underwriters actually struggle with.
  • A builder who ships, fast and to a high bar. You prototype with engineers rather than write specs from a distance, and you move with urgency without cutting the corners that matter.
  • Hands-on AI/ML experience, ideally in lending, document processing, or underwriting.
  • A track record of products lenders use at scale, with measurable impact.
  • Grit and ownership: you push through ambiguity, take outcomes as yours, and drive them without being told.
  • Intellectual curiosity: you dig into how things work, question assumptions, and keep learning.
  • Cross-functional leadership: you align engineering, ML, ops, and GTM, and you've mentored or managed PMs (or are ready to).

Nice to Have:

  • Certified Mortgage Banker (CMB) or equivalent.
  • Encompass / ICE, Fannie Mae DU, Freddie Mac LPA, or ULDD experience.
  • Time at a modern mortgage-tech or AI-lending company.
  • Experience shipping to mortgage lenders as customers.

Note:

The full-time salary range for this role is $220,000 + variable + equity + benefits. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location.

Disclosure as required by N.Y.C. Admin. Code §§ 8-102 and 8-107(32) of the full time salary compensation range for this role when being hired into our offices in New York City.

Life at Ocrolus

We’re a team of builders, thinkers, and problem solvers who care deeply about our mission — and each other. As a fast-growing, remote-first company, we offer an environment where you can grow your skills, take ownership of your work, and make a meaningful impact.

Our culture is grounded in four core values:
 Empathy – Understand and serve with compassion
Curiosity – Explore new ideas and question the status quo
 Humility – Listen, be grounded, and remain open-minded
Ownership – Love what you do, work hard, and deliver excellence

We believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. That’s why we’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of race, gender, gender identity, age, disability, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

We look forward to building the future of lending together.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
IntellectEU is an international technology company focused on digital finance and emerging technologies. At IntellectEU we are on a mission to become the top-of-mind fintech company. We are committed to our people and believe in building a better future with the newest of the newest technologies. Giving young people and industry veterans a growing ground to play, launch ideas & work very closely with our clients. With our hands-on experience in both technical & capital markets, there’s no challenge that’s left untackled.

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Software Test Engineer to join our team.

Our collateral exchange platform is used by leading institutions in the financial sector. As a Software Test Engineer, you play a critical role in ensuring that the platform meets the functional, security, resilience, and confidentiality requirements of clients and partners operating in a regulated environment.

The platform is built on a modern technology stack that includes Kotlin, Spring Boot, ActiveMQ, Gradle, Ansible, Docker, and Canton. It comprises message-driven components, REST APIs, distributed ledger nodes, and relational databases.

Location: EU countries, remotely

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and execute comprehensive test strategies for complex, distributed software systems
  • Develop and maintain detailed test cases, test plans, and test evidence to support production releases, client integrations, and regulatory requirements
  • Perform functional and integration testing of internal services and external interfaces
  • Coordinate and execute end-to-end and cross-party testing, including collaboration with external stakeholders and counterparties
  • Conduct non-functional testing, including performance, resilience, failover, upgrade, and recovery scenarios
  • Perform security and negative testing, supporting vulnerability assessments and penetration testing activities
  • Analyze test results, identify defects, and ensure proper documentation and reproducibility of issues
  • Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of test frameworks, stubs, simulators, and supporting test infrastructure
  • Collaborate closely with development, DevOps, and product teams to ensure high-quality software delivery
  • Continuously improve testing processes, tools, and methodologies to enhance test coverage and efficiency.

Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, with a solid grounding in computer science fundamentals. Relevant areas include databases, concurrency, distributed systems, and security.
  • 7+ years of experience testing or building software in JVM-based environments, such as Kotlin, Java, or other JVM-targeting languages.
  • Demonstrable experience testing complex, distributed software systems, including components communicating via REST APIs, message queues, and asynchronous workflows.
  • Demonstrable experience with non-functional testing, including performance, resilience, and security testing.
  • Demonstrable experience using testing frameworks and tools (e.g. Cucumber or similar).
  • Demonstrable experience designing and developing non-trivial test infrastructure, such as stubs, simulators, test harnesses, or environment-level test tooling.

Soft skills:

  • Proactive mindset with strong critical-thinking skills, and the ability to identify and articulate quality risks early.
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, high-assurance environment and adapt to change.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in a professional, technical context.

We guarantee:

  • Excellent compensation and benefits package, including medical insurance and sports activities.
  • International experience in a stable company: the company has offices in Antwerp, Lisbon, Krakow, Kyiv, New York and operates on the market for over 15 years.
  • A passionate team in an innovative, casual, positive, and open work environment, ready to meet your new ideas.
  • Great opportunities for personal and professional development as well as the chance to change the way the business works in the financial world.

Join us to make an impact on the entire financial world!

title: Bid-Office Intern (Contract)
description:
About Sybrin:

Sybrin is a leading IT software development company specialising in innovative solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of businesses across various sectors. Our mission is to empower businesses with cutting edge technology solutions that drive efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and facilitate growth.

At Sybrin we pride ourselves on delivering high quality products and secure solutions, thanks in part to the combination of the ISO 9001 for Quality Management System and ISO/IEC 27001 for Information Security Management System certifications, and our commitment to data protection, demonstrated by our implementation of ISO/IEC 27701 Privacy Information Management System. As an employee of Sybrin, you will be expected to familiarise yourself with the contents of the Integrated Management System, as well as undergo periodic training to better understand your unique role in the security, quality, and privacy ecosystem within Sybrin, and uphold the principles in Sybrin’s Integrated Management System. The Integrated Management System is a significant business enabler and, as such, ensuring our customers receive quality, secure service at every touchpoint within the organisation is critical.

Role Overview:

The purpose of this temporary internship role is to provide administrative and coordination support to the Bid Office by assisting with the preparation, coordination and submission of proposals, maintaining bid documentation and supporting the day to day administration of active opportunities. The intern will work under the supervision of the Bid Coordinator/Pre Sales Executive and assist with ensuring proposals are compliant, professionally presented and delivered on time.

Role Details:

Employment Type: Internship, 6 Month Contract

Reporting Line: Bid Coordinator/Pre-Sales Executive

Key Responsibilities:

Proposal Coordination:

• Assist with the coordination and on time submission of proposals, RFIs, RFQs, RFPs and tender submissions.

• Maintain proposal schedules, action trackers and customer defined deadlines.

• Coordinate proposal input from stakeholders and follow up on outstanding information and actions.

• Consolidate proposal content into company templates and the required tender format.

• Apply company branding, formatting and quality standards to proposal documents.

• Proofread documents for grammar, spelling, accuracy and formatting consistency.

• Prepare proposal documents and packs for internal review.


Document Management:

• Maintain proposal templates, reusable content and master document sets.

• Update reusable proposal content where instructed and maintain document version control.

• Maintain organised proposal folders and file completed proposals in the central repository.

• Maintain a central repository of reference letters, case studies, compliance documentation, CVs and certifications.

• Archive completed submissions and support document management best practices.


Compliance Documentation:

• Maintain the compliance document library and ensure that mandatory submission documents are available.

• Monitor expiry dates for tax documents, the B BBEE certificate, ISO certificates, company registration documents, financial statements and the CSD Summary Report.

• Request updated compliance documents from the relevant departments where required.


Reporting:

• Update the bid register and win and loss register.

• Capture proposal statistics and maintain pipeline tracking spreadsheets.

• Prepare weekly reporting information and status reports.


Demonstration Support:

• Assist with coordinating customer demonstrations and presentations.

• Prepare presentation packs and ensure that attendees receive meeting details.

• Record and distribute action items from demonstration meetings.


Business Development Support:

• Monitor tender portals and notify the Sales and Pre Sales teams of new opportunities.

• Download tender documents and maintain the tender opportunity register.

• Assist with clarification question tracking and opportunity administration.

• Provide general administrative and coordination support to the Bid Office.

Critical Technical and Behavioural Skills Required:

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, including basic Word formatting, styles and templates.

• Familiarity with SharePoint, Microsoft Teams and document management principles.

• Good organisational and administrative skills with strong attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong proofreading and document formatting abilities.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast paced environment.

• Ability to coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders and follow up on outstanding actions.

• Strong problem solving skills and willingness to learn.

• Professional and customer focused attitude, with a high level of accuracy and confidentiality.

• Willingness to learn and uphold the principles of Sybrin’s Integrated Management System, including quality, information security and privacy requirements.

title: Putkiasentaja Vantaalle, vesihuollon verkko-osasto
description:
Hei, ja tervetuloa HSY:lle töihin!

Teemme työtä, jolla on yllättävän suuri merkitys. Huolehdimme siitä, että yli miljoonan pääkaupunkiseudun asukkaan elintärkeät peruspalvelut – vesi- ja jätehuolto – toimivat mahdollisimman kestävästi nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Tuotamme myös monipuolista ympäristötietoa, jonka avulla elinympäristöämme voidaan parantaa.

Liity joukkoomme ja hae meille hommiin!

Haemme vesihuollon verkko-osaston kaivutyöyksikköön vakituiseen tehtävään

PUTKIASENTAJAA

Me vesihuollon verkko-osastolla vastaamme pääkaupunkiseudun vesijohto- ja viemäriverkostojen elinkaarenhallinnasta sisältäen korkean palvelutason tarjoamisen yli miljoonalle asukkaalle ja pääkaupunkiseudun toiminnoille.

Pääasiallisia tehtäviäsi kaivutyöyksikössä ovat

- verkostojen korjaustyöt
- rakennettavien ja saneerattavien verkostojen liitostyöt
- omana työnä tehtävät pienimuotoiset verkostosaneeraukset
- häiriötilanteiden, kuten putkirikkojen hoitaminen.

Tehtävään sisältyy varallaolovelvoite.

Toivomme, että sinulla olisi tehtävään soveltuva koulutus sekä kokemusta vastaavista töistä.

Arvostamme asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä, pitkäjänteisyyttä ja yhteistyökykyä. Tehtävässä on eduksi, mikäli käytössäsi on BC-ajokortti.

Tarjoamme

- Olemme vakaa ja vastuullinen työnantaja, joka pyrkii aina parempaan. Meillä viihdytään usein pitkään, sillä isona toimijana työtehtäviemme kirjo ja työnkuvien monipuolisuus on valtaisa.
- Työturvallisuus on meille tärkeää ja panostamme perehdytykseen. Käytössäsi ovat laadukkaat työkalut ja laitteet. Teemme myös jatkuvasti työtä työolojen riskien kartoittamiseksi, koska huolella tehty riskien arviointi on yksi työturvallisuuden perusta.
- Tehtävässä tukenasi ovat asiantuntevat kollegat ja monialaisen työyhteisömme osaaminen.
- Huolehdimme ympäristön ohella myös työntekijöidemme hyvinvoinnista. Henkilöstöetuihimme kuuluvat muun muassa HSL:n työsuhdematkaetu, E-passin lounas-, liikunta-, kulttuuri-, hieronta- ja hammashoitoetu sekä henkilöstön harrastuskerhotoiminta. Tutustu tarkemmin henkilöstöetuihimme ja työskentelyyn HSY:llä [verkkosivuillamme.](https://www.hsy.fi/hsy/hsy-tyonantajana/)

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2755,34–2947,40 €/kk riippuen valittavan työkokemuksesta. Lisäksi saat olosuhdelisää 63,98 €/kk ja sinun on mahdollista saada myös työkokemuksen perusteella työehtosopimuksen mukainen ammattialalisä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa vastaava putkimestari Juha Manninen, juha.manninen@hsy.fi ja kaivutyöyksikön päällikkö Eeva Huhtanen, eeva.huhtanen@hsy.fi.

Tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä tehdään henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014). Turvallisuusmenettelystä ja selvityksen kohteen oikeuksista löytyy tarkempia tietoja osoitteessa [supo.fi.](https://supo.fi/etusivu)

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi hakulomakkeella viimeistään keskiviikkona 26.8.2026.

Käytämme tässä rekrytoinnissa anonyymiä hakumenettelyä edistääksemme tasa-arvoa ja yhdenvertaisuutta. Hakemusten käsittelyn aikana henkilötietosi ja CV:si ovat piilotettuina siihen asti, kunnes valitsemme haastatteluun kutsuttavat hakijat.
Täytäthän koulutus- ja työkokemustietosi huolellisesti suoraan hakulomakkeen kenttiin. Huomaathan, että hakemuskirjettä ei anonymisoida. Ethän lisää siihen tunnistettavia henkilötietoja, kuten nimeä, ikää tai sukupuolta.

Työpaikan osoite: Hosantie 5, 01360 Vantaalle

Työnantajalupauksemme jokaiselle työntekijällemme on:
Välitämme ympäristöstämme ja toisistamme. Kehitämme toimintaamme ja itseämme. Teemme yhdessä maailman kestävimmän kaupunkiseudun.

Tutustu työntekijöidemme uratarinoihin [verkkosivuillamme.](https://www.hsy.fi/hsy/tyontekijatarinat/tyontekijatarinat-listaus/)

  • Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Strong capability in SQL, data modelling, and tools such as DAX to support reporting performance and usability

  • Ability to translate complex data into clear and actionable insights

  • Experience working directly with stakeholders to understand reporting and analytics requirements

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

  • Experience applying user experience (UX) and visual design best practices in reporting solutions

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail in a reporting and analytics environment

  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to present insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

Desired

To Apply

If you are ready to make a difference with HammondCare, Apply Now!

All short-listed applicants for these positions will be asked to consent to a criminal record check and reference checks.

HammondCare is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We strive on creating an equal employment environment where everyone from any background can be themselves.

title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
Senior Product Engineer

Engineering

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

We’re looking for impact-focused Software Generalists to join our specialized team focused on serving frontier model creators and enterprise AI application developers. As a full-stack engineer, you will work across Prolific’s domains to solve customer and product problems.

This is an exciting opportunity to work directly with frontier AI companies, making critical technical decisions that balance scrappy startup execution with scalable, reliable engineering, as Prolific revolutionizes research for the AI community. You'll will have regular in person collaboration with customers and our US team, as well as collaborate closely with our UK-based tech teams.

This role is hybrid based out of our New York office, approx 1-2 days a week.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Over 4 years of experience in a product engineering role
  • Can translate business concepts into software models
  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt across the breadth of Prolific’s domains
  • Familiar working in both monoliths and distributed systems
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for direct customer interaction
  • Good understanding of modern web applications and architecture design patterns
  • Experience supporting applications in production environments
  • Judgment to balance scrappy startup execution with scalable, reliable engineering
  • Comfort with rapid iteration and responding to customer queries with urgency
  • Experience with some of our technology stack:
    • Python (we use Django & Fast API)
    • TypeScript and JavaScript (we use Vue.js)
    • SQL and NoSQL databases (we use MongoDB and PostgresSQL)
    • Building and deploying to the cloud (we use GCP, Kubernetees, Github Actions & CircleCI)
    • Instrumenting, monitoring & observability (we use Datadog)

What you’ll be doing in the role

This is a unique engineering role at Prolific.

In this role, you will operate with high ownership and a product mindset, at start-up pace, to solve customer problems and capture business opportunities irrespective of the technology required to do so.

You will be part of a cross-functional Product Engineering team, optimised for the success of a single customer group. You will collaborate directly with account managers, customer success specialists and customers to deeply understand their problem spaces. You will ideate and build with autonomy, supported by a high-performing team.

This role will see you work across Prolific domains to solve customer problems, needing you to get up to speed quickly and deliver across shared codebases to a high engineering standard. You will also help support our systems in production & respond to incidents when required.

Key Technologies

  • Cloud Platforms: Google Cloud Platform and AWS
  • Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript
  • Frameworks: Vue.js, Django Rest Framework, Container-based and Serverless architectures
  • Databases: MongoDB and DynamoDB
  • DevOps and Monitoring: CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, Celery, EventBridge and DataDog

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture. Many roles also include the opportunity to earn a cash variable element, such as a bonus or commission. You can check the job posting’s subtitle to see where the position is based. Your recruiter will also be happy to share the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

title: Graphics Specialist I/II
description:
Applications are accepted exclusively through the City of Ventura Career Site:
. Submissions through other websites or methods will not be accepted.

Applications and supplemental questions will be accepted until Monday, August 17, 2026, at 11:59 p.m.

Pay & Benefits

  • $32.56 - $43.51 Hourly (DOQ)

  • Benefits

    • Medical Insurance (HMO, PPO options)

    • City Paid Dental and Vision Insurance

    • Life Insurance

    • Vacation & Holiday Compensation

    • Deferred Compensation

    • CalPERS Retirement

    • Wellness Program (access to gym facility and fitness classes)

    • Tuition Reimbursement & Bilingual Pay

About the Opportunity

The City of Ventura is seeking a visually creative and collaborative Graphics Specialist I/II to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the City's visual communications by designing high-quality print and digital materials that support City programs, services, events, outreach, and initiatives.

From brochures and annual reports to social media graphics, signage, and marketing materials, you'll transform ideas and design engaging visual communications that inform, educate, and inspire.

Remote or hybrid work is not available for this position.

This position is flexibly staffed and may be filled at either level depending on the qualifications of the incumbent and the staffing needs of the City.

Key Responsibilities Include:

  • Design and produce brochures, flyers, posters, banners, reports, forms, maps, logos, and other print and digital communication materials.

  • Meet with City staff to understand project goals, develop creative concepts, and deliver designs that meet department needs.

  • Create layouts, illustrations, graphics, and visual content that align with City branding and design standards.

  • Prepare artwork and files for digital publication, commercial printing, and online distribution.

  • Coordinate graphic production from concept through final product, including working with outside vendors.

  • Manage multiple graphic design projects simultaneously while maintaining production schedules and meeting deadlines.

  • Photograph events, facilities, and projects for use in publications, presentations, websites, and promotional materials.

  • Organize, archive, and manage digital artwork, photographs, and graphic assets for future use.

  • Maintain and troubleshoot graphic design software and stay current with emerging design trends, technology, and industry best practices.

  • Review and proof all work to ensure accuracy, consistency, quality, and compliance with City standards before final production

The Ideal Candidate – Preferred Qualifications

The ideal candidate is an experienced graphic designer who creates engaging print and digital communications that are visually appealing, accurate, and aligned with organizational branding. They are creative, detail-oriented, and organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while consistently delivering high-quality work within established deadlines.

The successful candidate will have:

  • Experience and be proficient on the Mac platform designing professional print and digital communications using Adobe Creative Suite, including Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat Pro.

  • A strong understanding of graphic design principles, including typography, layout, color theory, branding, and print production.

  • Experience preparing files for commercial printing, digital publishing, and web applications.

  • The ability to coordinate projects from initial concept through final production while collaborating effectively with internal customers and stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain digital assets, prioritize competing assignments, and exercise sound judgment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • The ability to adapt to new technology, software, and evolving graphic design trends.

  • Experience with CivicPlus, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint is highly desirable.

  • A bachelor's degree in graphic design, art, or a related field is highly desirable.

Minimum Qualifications – Required

A combination of education, training and experience equivalent to completion of high school, supplemented by college-level courses in graphic design or computer graphics, and one year of computerized graphics design experience using Adobe Creative Suite, including Adobe InDesign, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Acrobat Pro is required.

In addition, Graphics Specialist II requires 18 months (2½ years total experience) of computerized graphics design experience equivalent to that of a Graphics Specialist I with the City of Ventura. A Bachelor's degree in art or graphics design is preferred.

Required knowledge: Mac Platform, Knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop.

License: Depending on assignment, possession of a valid California Class C driver's license may be required.

How to Apply

Submit an online City job application and supplemental questionnaire by the filing deadline.

  • Please submit three (3) digital samples of work that demonstrate your graphic design talents.Samples can be attached to your application or via links.

  • It is important that your city job application show all the relevant education, training, and experience you possess. Resumes, CVs, and cover letters may be attached to your application but will not be accepted in lieu of a completed job application or supplemental questionnaire. Submitting an incomplete application or supplemental questionnaire may disqualify you from further consideration in the recruitment process.

  • After you apply, all future correspondence from the city will be via E-Mail. Please check your messages regularly and keep your contact information up to date using your on-line application.

Selection Process

  • All applications and supplemental questionnaires submitted will be screened in relation to the criteria outlined in this job announcement. Candidates will be reviewed, and only those candidates determined to be most qualified based on experience, training, and education, as submitted, will be invited to participate further in the selection process. Candidates will be notified about their status after the filing deadline.

  • Those candidates whose qualifications most closely match the requirements of the position will be invited to a qualifying panel interview process. Candidates will be notified of specifics after the examination process has been completed. Initial panel interviews may be conducted in-person or via video teleconference. Candidates will be notified of specifics at the appropriate time.

The Eligibility List established for this classification may be used to fill other regular and temporary vacancies at the discretion of the City.

THE SCHEDULE

The timeline dates are subject to change. Candidates will be notified as necessary.

  • Monday, August 17, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. – Application Deadline. Applications and supplemental questionnaires must be submitted by this date to be considered for the position.

  • Week of August 24, 2026 - Candidates will be notified by email of their status by this date.

  • Week of August 31, 2026 - Panel Interviews are tentatively scheduled for this date. Qualifying candidates will be notified by email or phone if they are invited to the panel interview process.

  • Department Selection Interviews will be scheduled promptly after the oral panel interviews have been completed. Qualifying candidates will be notified by phone or email if they are invited to the department interview process.

  • September 2026 – Candidates will be notified of the outcome of the interview by this date.

Additional Information

For additional information on the duties and responsibilities of the position, refer to the job descriptions located on the City’s Career Page at City of Ventura Jobs or by viewing here Graphics Specialist I/II.

To learn more about the City’s hiring process, visit the City of Ventura Hiring Process page.

The Human Resources address is: 501 Poli Street, Room 210, Ventura, CA 93001, (805) 654-7853, e-mail: recruitment@cityofventura.ca.gov.

We aim to create an environment that celebrates and embraces the diversity of our workforce. We welcome you to join our team!

title: Vikarierande samordnare till Sommarsol
description:
Ängelholm gör det omöjliga möjligt – det är vår vision som ligger till grund för vår framtida utvecklingsresa. Vi vågar tänka och testa annorlunda, göra det unika och oväntade. Vi vet att vi är bäst tillsammans och att det är genom gränsöverskridande samarbete vi når längst. Vi vet också att Ängelholm är en plats med unika möjligheter för fortsatt utveckling.

Med utgångspunkt i vår agila organisationsstruktur siktar vi framåt och uppåt. Vill du vara med och bidra på vår resa? 

Tillsammans i teamet på Sommarsol ger vi god omvårdnad, trygghet och glädje till våra boende. Sommarsol är ett särskilt boende med 60 platser, uppdelat på fyra somatiska avdelningar och två demensavdelningar. Sommarsol är beläget vid havet i Vejbystrand, utanför Ängelholm.

Vi söker nu en vikarierande samordnare till vårt team. Förutom samordnare arbetar omvårdnadspersonal, två enhetschefer, sjuksköterskor samt rehabteam bestående av fysioterapeut och arbetsterapeut på plats.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som samordnare på Sommarsol är du en central knutpunkt, du arbetar serviceinriktat och skapar förutsättningar för att alla ska trivas. Du är ett administrativt stöd för enhetscheferna och dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat vara följande:

	• Lönehantering, administrering i löne- och anställningssystem, granskning av att frånvaro och ledigheter är inlagda i lönesystem och att utbetalda löner är korrekta.
	• Bemanningsplanering, frånvaro-, ledighets- och semesterplanering. Här ingår administration i boknings- och schemasystem samt kontakt med vikarier. Samordna tillsättningen av vikariat upp till 14 dagar samt längre vikariat i samråd med enhetschef.
	• Genomföra introduktion av nyanställda, genomgång av verksamhetssystem, boka utbildningar samt planera in bredvid gång.
	• Samordning av delegeringar till ny personal.
	• Inköp- och fakturahantering.

Som samordnare har du en social och varierande roll där du möter såväl medarbetare som brukare och anhöriga. Du arbetar nära Sommarsols två enhetschefer och finns där som ett uppskattat stöd för kollegorna när det dyker upp administrativa frågor. En stor del av ditt arbete handlar om att navigera i våra verksamhetssystem bland annat Time Care, Personec, Life Care och Proceedo.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har minst gymnasieutbildning, gärna inom administration eller ekonomi. Har du dessutom en eftergymnasial utbildning inom ledarskap, HR eller administration är det meriterande. Du har god datorvana och tar dig an nya digitala verktyg med lätthet. Tidigare erfarenhet av verksamhetssystem  särskilt de vi använder  är ett stort plus!

Viktigast av allt är dock vem du är som person. För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du strukturerad, noggrann och har ett balanserat tänk kring ekonomi. Eftersom din vardag fylls av möten med olika människor är ett lösningsfokuserat och varmt bemötande helt naturligt för dig.

Bemanningsarbetet kräver både flexibilitet och förmåga att ställa om när förutsättningarna ändras. Du driver självständigt ditt arbete framåt och tvekar inte att söka upp den information du behöver, samtidigt som du är en lyhörd lagspelare.

Hos oss får du ett stimulerande uppdrag med stort eget ansvar, i en gemenskap där vi lär av varandra och där skratten aldrig är långt borta. Vi kommer att kalla till intervju löpnade så varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet:, upphör: 2027-09-30  .

Ängelholms kommun ska vara en organisation där medarbetarna trivs, utvecklas och vill stanna kvar. Vi strävar efter att erbjuda heltid för ökad jämställdhet och attraktiva arbeten. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning beroende på erfarenhet och kompetens. För aktuell lönestatistik besök engelholm.se där du kan läsa mer.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen och kunna kommunicera snabbt och enkelt med dig som sökande, ber vi dig ansöka via länk i annonsen. 

Har du skyddade personuppgifter? Kontakta rekryterande chef via telefon för dialog om din ansökan.

I samband med intervju behöver du styrka ditt medborgarskap. Det kan du göra med pass alternativt personbevis tillsammans med ID-handling. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du uppvisa att du har ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller är undantagen från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd. Anställning kan ske först efter kontroll av arbetstillstånd, vilket krävs enligt utlänningsförordningen.

Vi har inför denna rekrytering tagit ställning till vilka rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda. Därför undanber vi oss att bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

title: Elkjøp Nordic | Afdelingsleder med fokus på salgsresultater og personaleansvar - Elgiganten A/S
description:
Elkjøp Nordic | Afdelingsleder med fokus på salgsresultater og personaleansvar - Elgiganten A/S
    


        

        
                    


    

        

        
        

        


    

                    
        
        Afdelingsleder med fokus på salgsresultater og personaleansvar - Elgiganten A/S    

    
Haderslev

        
        
    

        



        
Er du klar til en resultat- og kundeorienteret hverdag, hvor du samarbejder tæt med dine dygtige medarbejdere, mens I er fælles om at skabe væksten for Danmarks største elektronikkæde?


Elgiganten er en arbejdsplads for alle. Det er vi, fordi vi er forskellige sammen, og vi tror på, at vi kan tilbyde den bedste rådgivning, når vi afspejler vores kunders mangfoldighed. Vi mener, at det bør være sjovt at komme på arbejde uanset hvem du er, og hvor du kommer fra.


Hos Elgiganten er det gode sammenhold i centrum. Det bliver din opgave som leder at skabe motivation og engagement - vi ved at engagerede medarbejdere skaber glade kunder og flotte resultater. Det er vigtigt for os, at alle kunder bliver sendt ud af døren med et smil og de rigtige varer i posen. Derfor har vi kundernes behov og ønsker i fokus - hver eneste dag.


 





 


Du rådgiver kunderne og udvikler dine medarbejdere


Som Afdelingsleder i salgsafdelingen er du leder for dit team bestående af Sales Advisor-medarbejdere. I tæt samarbejde med varehuschefen og dine lederkollegaer sikrer du, at kundeservice, personalepleje og drift går op i en højere enhed.


For det er dig, der har det overordnede blik, samtidig med at du bruger størstedelen af din tid på gulvet sammen med dit team. Her går du forrest, når du coacher dine medarbejdere og sikrer dig, at de trives, samt at vi når vores salgsbudgetter og -mål - både individuelt og for hele huset.


I en hverdag med kunderådgivning og personaleudvikling i centrum kommer du til at:



træne dit hold i nye salgsteknikker, produktviden eller lignende samt briefe dem på gårsdagens salgstal, inden varehuset åbner


afholde ugentlige medarbejdersamtaler, hvor I taler om mål, udvikling, nye idéer osv.


lave vagtplaner og sikre, at de passer ift. bemanding, ferie og sygdom


deltage i udviklingen af strategiske tiltag sammen med den øvrige ledelse


rapportere til ledelsen om din afdelings resultater og nøgletal



 


Din udvikling og karriere er i højsædet


I Elgiganten har vi mange interne udviklingsmuligheder, såsom kurser, træninger og lederuddannelser. Vores medarbejdere er vores vigtigste ressourcer, og derfor tilbyder vi kompetenceudvikling og en karrierevej for dig, der har viljen og talentet.


 


Hvem er du?


Du har tidligere haft en lederrolle inden for detail, men du kan sagtens komme fra en anden kæde end Elgiganten - vi har nemlig et velstruktureret uddannelsesprogram for alle vores ledere og medarbejdere.


Helt konkret lægger vi vægt på, at du:



har arbejdet med engagement og personaleudvikling


er initiativrig og tager ansvar for din egen udvikling og dine resultater. Det kræver, at du kan træffe store beslutninger og holde hovedet koldt i vanskelige situationer


kan udvise handleevne, motivere og begejstre dit team


vil bidrage til et positivt og inkluderende arbejdsmiljø


kender salgshåndværket fra A til Z og ved, hvad det kræver at være en dygtig salgsassistent og leder inden for detail.



 


Nysgerrig? Så klik her og læs mere om dine muligheder i Elgiganten.


For at søge stillingen, skal du sende os dit CV via ansøg-knappen. I Elgiganten ønsker vi at være en inkluderende og mangfoldig arbejdsplads, derfor opfordrer vi dig til at undlade oplysninger som alder og billede i dit CV og evt. ansøgning.


Du skal være opmærksom på, at du kan modtage en mail med ønsket om, at du gennemfører tests for at komme videre i rekrutteringsforløbet.


Vi behandler løbende ansøgninger og afslutter rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet den rigtige kandidat.


 

        
Om Elgiganten

Elgiganten er Danmarks ledende varehuskæde inden for mærkevareprodukter i forbrugerelektronik og hårde hvidevarer, og vi står bag en af de mest populære internetbutikker. Elgiganten åbnede det første danske varehus i 1996, og har siden ekspanderet til 49 varehuse fordelt over hele landet. 



Elgiganten indgår i Elkjøp-koncernen, som er Nordens største handelsvirksomhed inden for forbrugerelektronik og elektroniske husholdningsapparater. Koncernen består af 13.000 ansatte, hvoraf ca. 2.400 er ansat i Elgiganten Danmark. I Norden har vi 425 varehuse fordelt i Danmark, Norge, Sverige, Finland, Grønland, Island samt på Færøerne. Alle nordiske varehuse forsynes fra vores egen distributionsvirksomhed - det knap 200.000 kvm store centrallager i Jönköping i Sverige. Elkjøp er ejet af den engelske elektronikgigant Currys.



Vores vision og værdier

Vores fælles mål er altid at sikre vores kunder den gode kundeoplevelse, og vores værdier WIN, PLAY, GROW og DIFFERENT vejleder os i alt, hvad vi gør. 



Vi har, som markedsleder, også et ansvar for at sikre et mere bæredygtigt samfund i vores branche. Derfor arbejder vi på at begrænse vores indvirkning på miljøet. Det kan du læse mere om her: ‘Vores arbejde med bæredygtighed’.

title: Danstherapeut
description:
Zorg met hoofd én hart. Dat is wat jij hier doet.

Care to Change zoekt een betrokken danstherapeut voor onze locatie in Utrecht.

Als danstherapeut bij Care to Change werk je met volwassenen binnen de SGGZ en behandel je cliënten met complexe en meervoudige problematiek. Je zet jouw expertise in op het gebied van dans- en bewegingstherapie, waarbij beweging en lichaamsbewustzijn worden ingezet als onderdeel van de behandeling, en werkt samen met verschillende disciplines aan samenhangende zorg. Verbinding, vakmanschap en inhoudelijke samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Vanuit onze holistische visie kijken we naar de cliënt als geheel en combineren we gesprekstherapie en vaktherapie bewust, waarbij denken, voelen en doen met elkaar verbonden zijn.

De functie van danstherapeut wordt ingevuld in loondienstverband.

Waarom jij hier energie van krijgt

  • Jij krijgt de ruimte om behandelvormen en interventies vanuit jouw vakinhoudelijke expertise vorm te geven.

  • Je zet dans en lichaamsgerichte werkvormen in om cliënten te helpen emoties, lichaamssignalen en gedrag beter te herkennen en hiermee te oefenen.

  • Jij werkt nauw samen in een multidisciplinair team waarin jouw expertise op het gebied van dans- en bewegingstherapie een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan de behandeling.

  • Jij denkt mee over de verdere ontwikkeling van vaktherapie binnen Care to Change.

  • Jij blijft je vakinhoudelijk ontwikkelen via intervisie, casuïstiekbesprekingen en scholing.

Hoe jouw werkdag eruit ziet

  • inzetten van dans- en bewegingsinterventies binnen het behandelproces

  • vertalen van behandeldoelen naar lichaamsgerichte en ervaringsgerichte oefeningen

  • observeren en duiden van bewegingspatronen als ingang voor bewustwording en verandering

  • voorbereiden, uitvoeren en evalueren van individuele behandelsessies en eventueel groepsinterventies

  • afstemmen van behandeldoelen en voortgang binnen het multidisciplinaire team

Waar jij gaat werken

Verbinding is de kern van hoe wij werken. Met cliënten, met elkaar en met het vak. Die overtuiging voel je vanaf de eerste dag.

Ons team bestaat uit regiebehandelaren, gesprekstherapeuten, vaktherapeuten, casemanagers en de medisch secretaresse die nauw samenwerken met korte lijnen en oprechte aandacht voor elkaar. De sfeer is warm en professioneel — er is ruimte voor inhoudelijk overleg, voor humor en voor de openheid die goede samenwerking vraagt.

Binnen onze locatie in Utrecht werken we samen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze behandelingen en de samenwerking binnen het team. We vinden het belangrijk dat ieders kennis en perspectief wordt benut en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken over de zorg die we bieden.

Zorg voor verbinding. Vanuit hoofd én hart.

Wat wij bieden

Op basis van 36 uur:

  • Inschaling in FWG 55 + 50% pensioenbijdrage.

  • 8,33% vakantiegeld + 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • €1.000 bruto balansbudget per jaar.

  • 166 vakantie-uren + 35 LFB-uren (extra uren bij te kopen).

  • Vergoeding lidmaatschap Kwaliteitsregister Vaktherapie.

  • Vergoeding van kosten voor herregistratie en vakinhoudelijke scholing.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding volgens CAO + extra regeling vanaf 30 km.

  • Deelname WGA-hiaatverzekering.

  • Dagelijkse gezamenlijke lunch, goede koffie en een team waar je je snel thuis voelt.

Bij Care to Change werk je met hoofd én hart.

Die overtuiging voel je elke dag; in de behandelkamer, in het team en in jezelf.

Herken jij je hierin? We leren je graag kennen.

Wat jij meebrengt

  • Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding tot danstherapeut.

  • Je beschikt over een geldige AGB-code en registratie bij het Register Vaktherapie.

  • Je communiceert helder en werkt zorgvuldig, zowel in de behandeling als in verslaglegging.

  • Je bent 24 uur per week beschikbaar op maandag, dinsdag en vrijdag.

Meer informatie

Wil je meer weten over wie wij zijn en hoe wij werken? Neem dan gerust een kijkje op onze website. Je kunt ook contact opnemen met onze collega's van recruitment; de telefoonnummers vind je op onze contactpagina of je kunt mailen naar wens@caretochange.nl.

Wil je eerst vrijblijvend kennismaken? Plan dan direct hier je digitale koffiemoment in.

Blijf in verbinding

Herken je je in wat Care to Change doet, maar is de timing nu niet goed?
Meld je dan vooral aan voor onze vacature-updates, dan blijf je op de hoogte van toekomstige mogelijkheden.

Direct solliciteren

Wél direct klaar voor een nieuwe stap?
Solliciteer direct via onderstaande button. Hopelijk mogen we jouw sollicitatie in ontvangst nemen.

Het opvragen van referenties maakt onderdeel uit van onze sollicitatieprocedure.

title: Senior Use Case Lead inom PLM
description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i en nyckelroll i ett omfattande PLM-program inom tillverkningsindustrin, där du fungerar som länken mellan verksamhet och leverans. Här handlar det om att fånga upp affärsbehov, skapa struktur och säkerställa att rätt use cases prioriteras och omsätts till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.

Du arbetar nära verksamheten, lösningsarkitekter och tvärfunktionella team och driver arbetet framåt inom ditt ansvarsområde genom hela leveransprocessen. Rollen passar dig som trivs med att kombinera verksamhetsförståelse, kravarbete och koordinering i en miljö där många intressenter behöver samlas kring samma mål. Det här är en spännande möjlighet för dig som vill påverka hur PLM-förmågor utvecklas i en komplex och tekniknära verksamhet.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Du leder insamling och dokumentation av verksamhetskrav.
  • Du skapar och underhåller User Stories och funktionella krav i Jira.
  • Du äger och prioriterar backloggen för tilldelade use cases eller komponenter och omsätter strategi till tydliga sprintmål.
  • Du samordnar experter, lösningsarkitekter och verksamhetsrepresentanter i tvärfunktionella samarbeten.
  • Du identifierar gap mellan nuvarande arbetssätt och föreslagna lösningar i samband med en PLM-uppgradering.
  • Du stöttar verksamheten i att etablera effektiva arbetssätt och förbereda inför förändring.
  • Du säkerställer att levererad funktionalitet möter verksamhetens behov genom validering, test och stöd i UAT.
  • Du representerar ditt ansvarsområde i designgranskningar, beroendediskussioner och samordningsmöten.
  • Du identifierar behov kopplade till datamigrering.
  • Du bidrar till verksamhetsförberedelser genom Show & Tell-sessioner, sandlådetester och utbildningsinsatser.
Krav
  • 9–12 års erfarenhet inom relevant område.
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att samordna tvärfunktionella intressenter inom exempelvis Engineering, Operations och Quality.
  • Erfarenhet av att definiera User Stories, funktionella krav och verksamhetsprocesser.
  • Förmåga att översätta komplex teknisk information till ett tydligt verksamhetsperspektiv.
  • Erfarenhet av att stödja test, validering och UAT.
  • Erfarenhet från industri-, teknik- eller tillverkningsverksamhet.
  • God erfarenhet av Jira och Confluence.
  • Förmåga att arbeta självständigt som verksamhetens representant.
  • Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga samt erfarenhet av facilitering och intressenthantering.
  • Erfarenhet av att stödja funktionell validering och införande av nya lösningar.
Meriterande
  • Erfarenhet av PLM-lösningar, särskilt Teamcenter.
  • Kunskap om digital thread-koncept.
Vi erbjuder
  • Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
  • Tjänstepension
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år
Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: HRM-Nordic
description:
HRM-Nordic




















Intern sælger til vores Nøglekontor i Ahlsell - Billund



















Vil du arbejde med kundeservice, ordrebehandling og administration i en specialistfunktion, hvor kvalitet og præcision er en vigtig del af hverdagen? Trives du med struktur og god dialog, så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!



Vi søger lige nu en intern sælger til vores Nøglekontor i Billund, som er en afdeling med tæt samarbejde og højt fagligt fokus. Afdelingen består af 8 kolleger - 4 på kontoret og 4 i produktionen - og er en del af sikringsafdelingen i Vallensbæk, som er eneforhandler i Danmark af låsesystemet EVVA. 



Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden. Der er mange detaljer at holde styr på, så det er vigtigt, at du kan arbejde struktureret og samtidig bevare overblikket, når der er flere opgaver i gang på samme tid.



Din hverdag hos os



Du får en varieret hverdag med både kundekontakt, administration og koordinering, hvor du besvarer henvendelser på mail og telefon. Samtidig kan du se frem til en grundig oplæring og gode kolleger, der står klar til at hjælpe dig godt ind i rollen.



Dine vigtigste opgaver



Sikre god kundeservice på mail og telefon



Udarbejde ordrer på cylindre og nøgler



Administrere nøgler og cylindre i låsesystemer



Bestille varer hos leverandører



Håndtere reklamationer og følge op på henvendelser



Løse diverse ad hoc-opgaver i samarbejde med teamet



Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med salg eller kundeservice - gerne fra låsebranchen, men det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde i en rolle, hvor struktur, detaljer og god service går hånd i hånd.



Vi leder efter dig, der:



Har gode IT-kompetencer - kendskab til SAP er en fordel



Har gode kommunikationsevner på dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale



Som person er du:



Ansvarsbevidst og tager ejerskab for dine opgaver



Løsningsorienteret og trives med at finde den bedste vej frem



Fleksibel og god til at håndtere ændringer og deadlines



God til at skabe relationer på tværs af afdelinger








Gode vilkår og udviklingsmuligheder



Du får et spændende job i en vækstorienteret virksomhed, hvor der er gode muligheder for personlig udvikling



Du får en lønpakke bestående af en fast løn, pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring og særlige personaleaftaler. Herudover bærbar pc og mobiltelefon



Den bedste tid i dit arbejdsliv



Mange af os har forskellige arbejdspladser gennem livet. Vi har en ambition om, at din tid i Ahlsell skal være den bedste tid i dit arbejdsliv, når du engang ser tilbage på dit arbejdsliv.



Det skal være trygt og sjovt at arbejde i Ahlsell, og vi skal føle, at vores arbejde giver mening. Vi tror på, at når vi har glade medarbejdere, så kan vores kunder mærke det, når de handler med os, og vi kan hjælpe dem endnu bedre.



Vores værdier Ansvarlighed, Åbenhed og Enkelhed guider os i hverdagen, som et slags moralsk kompas, og når vi alle gør os umage for hver dag at leve op til værdierne og bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø, så tror vi på, at vi kan lykkes med at skabe den bedste tid i dit arbejdsliv.



Skal vi arbejde sammen? Søg i dag



Send os din ansøgning senest den 1. september 2026. Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende og tager jobannoncen ned, når vi har fundet den rette. Ansættelsesstart er snarest muligt eller efter aftale.



For spørgsmål til rollen:







Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!








Vi gør det nemmere at være professionel



Ahlsell Danmark er for alle dem, der fremstiller, installerer, bygger, reparerer og vedligeholder i industrien og byggeriet. Som kundernes faglige allierede tager vi ansvar for at hjælpe vores kunder i en verden, hvor den eneste konstant er forandring. Med vores leverandører i ryggen er vi altid på forkant, så vi sammen med vores kunder kan reagere på ændrede krav og nye regler - og gøre smartere processer og bæredygtige muligheder til ny vækst. Hjertet i vores forretning er et enormt produktsortiment. Pulsen, der får kredsløbet til at fungere, er en lang række ydelser, så som smart levering, intelligente lagerløsninger, digital planlægning, personlig vejledning og her-og-nu reparation.



Ahlsell har koncernkontor i Stockholm, Sverige, og er til stede i otte lande med flere end 300 butikker og 7500 medarbejdere. Dermed er Ahlsell Nordens største distributør af installationsprodukter, værktøjer og forsyninger til professionelle. I Danmark har vi hovedkontor i Vallensbæk og butikker og selvbetjeningsbutikker på tværs af hele landet.
