title: Software Developer-Mid Career
description:
We have an opening for a Software Developer in the Computing Directorate, matrixed to the Security & Protection (S&P) Program. The S&P program is responsible for developing and maintaining the Argus security system and related physical security hardware and software. S&P also collaborates with other DOE laboratories in developing and sustaining cutting-edge security system solutions. You will work on a multi-disciplinary team in an environment that focuses on problems of interest to LLNL and Department of Energy (DOE) programs as a member of a dynamic, multidisciplinary team environment. This position will be within a group in the Computing Directorate.

This position oﬀers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the ﬂexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week.

This position will be filled at either the SES.3 or SES.4 level based on knowledge and related experience, as assessed by the responsibilities outlined below.

You will

  • Collaborate in the development and implementation of complex software engineering methods using industry standard software development practices and modern programming languages and operating systems.
  • Guide the completion of projects and contribute to the requirements definition, analysis, design, implementation, debugging, testing, and optimization of computer programs on workstations.
  • Contribute to the fulfillment of technical projects and organizational objectives functioning as an effective team member on multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Interact with fellow developers, management, and sponsors frequently to share relevant knowledge, opinions, and recommendations.
  • Provide swift, creative technical solutions to complex stakeholder requests and critical operational requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities, at the SES.4 level

  • Manage multiple highly complex, parallel tasks and priorities of customers and stakeholders, ensuring deadlines are met, while leveraging team member’s skills.
  • Develop the design, implementation, deployment, and maintenance for software systems using object-oriented analysis, design, and programming techniques.
  • Provide solutions to highly complex problems that require in-depth analysis of tangible and intangible factors.
  • This position requires an active Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance or active Top-Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at the time of hire.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
  • Advanced experience in object-oriented programming with high-level languages such as C++ or Java and interpreted languages such as Lua or Python.
  • Advanced experience developing software within Linux and Windows environments utilizing all aspects of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Advanced experience with Git source code control system and GitLab/GitHub.
  • Advanced experience providing innovative approaches and applying new technologies tasks and projects.
  • Experience approaching difficult problems with enthusiasm and creativity.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills necessary to effectively collaborate in a team environment and present and explain technical information and provide advice to management.

Additional qualifications at the SES.4 level

  • Subject matter expert knowledge and expert-level experience designing, implementing, deploying, and maintaining software systems using object-oriented analysis, design, and programming techniques.
  • Expert-level experience in object-oriented programming with high-level languages such as C++ or Java and interpreted languages such as Lua or Python.
  • Expert-level experience working ambiguous, complex projects under consultative direction, using innovative approaches, applying new technologies, and effective analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Expert-level experience creating technical direction and vision, writing research proposals, and/or securing sponsor funding.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience developing software for access control and intrusion detection systems.

Pay Range

$175,530 - $267,060 Annually

$175,530 - $222,564 Annually at the SES.3 level

$210,630 - $267,060 Annually at the SES.4 level

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

#LI-Hybrid

Position Information

This is a Flexible Term appointment, which is for a definite period not to exceed six years. If final candidate is a Career Indefinite employee, Career Indefinite status may be maintained (should funding allow).

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

  • Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
  • Flexible Benefits Package
  • 401(k)
  • Relocation Assistance
  • Education Reimbursement Program
  • Flexible schedules (*depending on project needs)
  • Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

This position requires an active Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance or active Top Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at time of hire.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How to identify fake job advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.

To learn more about recruitment scams:

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Reasonable Accommodation

Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.

California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

Mere end 30 års erfaring

Vi har base i Haslev - kun en kort køretur fra Taastrup - og det betyder, at vi er hurtigt fremme, når du har brug for en elektriker i Taastrup, Tølløse og omegn. Uanset om det handler om strømsvigt, akutte fejl eller planlagte el-opgaver, står vi klar til at rykke ud og hjælpe dig videre.

Mange års erfaring i branchen

Hos os er god service ikke bare noget, vi siger - det er noget, vi leverer. Fra første kontakt til sidste skrue i væggen sørger vi for, at du føler dig tryg og godt informeret. Hos Haslev El-Service har vi styr på både sikkerhed, regler og det praktiske håndværk, så du får el-installationer, der fungerer og holder. Vores team består af erfarne elektrikere med forskellige specialer, og med over 30 års samlet erfaring er der ikke mange udfordringer, vi ikke har set før.

Uanset om du har brug for fejlfinding, installation af nyt udstyr eller en større el-entreprise, står vi klar til at hjælpe. Vi holder os opdateret med den nyeste teknologi og de bedste løsninger, så du altid er i trygge hænder - også hvis du har brug for en elektriker i Taastrup eller omegn.
								























Vi leverer kvalitetsarbejde
				







Haslev El-Service
				








Hos Haslev El-Service tilbyder vi alle former for el-arbejde. Med sammenlagt over 30 år i branchen og adskillige tilfredse kunder, har vi kompetencer inden for alt fra el-renovering af ældre installationer til opsætning af nye solceller.

leasingaftaler

Inden vi går i gang, rådgiver vi dig grundigt, så du får mest muligt ud af dit anlæg - både økonomisk og energimæssigt. Det kan være svært at gennemskue, hvilken el-løsning der egentlig er den bedste. Derfor står vi klar med ærlig og erfaren rådgivning, så du trygt kan træffe den rigtige beslutning. Leder du efter en elektriker i Taastrup og omegn, der kan tage sig af både små og store el-opgaver? Så er du landet det rette sted. Vi har erfaring med det hele - fra opsætning af stikkontakter og montering af lamper til tilslutning af hårde hvidevarer og komplette el-installationer i nye boliger.

description:
Køkkenkonsulent med sans for godt salg

Vi søger en dygtig og erfaren køkkenkonsulent til AUBO Køkken og Bad i Helsingør.

Har du solid erfaring med salg, og trives du med ansvar for dine egne kunder? Har du sans for både rådgivning og indretning, det gode salg og evner du at føre kunderne trygt gennem hele processen fra første møde til færdig løsning? Så kan det meget vel være dig, vi leder efter.

Bliv en del af AUBO Køkken & Bad i Helsingør

Hos AUBO Køkken & Bad i Helsingør arbejder vi hver dag for at levere gennemarbejdede løsninger og en ordentlig kundeoplevelse. Vores kunder skal føle sig godt rådgivet hele vejen, og det ansvar ligger i høj grad hos vores konsulenter.

AUBO-kæden har ligget øverst på Trustpilot i 10 år i træk, og det forpligter. Derfor søger vi en kollega, der sætter en ære i sit arbejde og har fokus på både kvalitet, tillid og det gode salg.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Rådgivning og salg af køkken- og badeværelsesløsninger
  • Ansvar for hele salgsprocessen - fra behovsafdækning til afsluttet ordre
  • Udarbejdelse af tegninger og løsninger i køkkentegneprogram (fx Winner)
  • Opbygning af relationer med kunderne
  • Tæt dialog med kollegaer og samarbejdspartnere

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har solid erfaring med salg inden for køkken- og badeværelsesløsninger
  • Arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Har sans for indretning og funktionelle løsninger
  • Er selvkørende, imødekommende og professionel i din kundedialog
  • Bidrager positivt til hverdagen med engagement og godt humør

Vi tilbyder:

  • En attraktiv lønpakke, der matcher dine kvalifikationer
  • En hverdag med frihed under ansvar
  • Et uhøjtideligt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde og ordentlighed
  • Grundig oplæring samt mulighed for kurser og uddannelse gennem AUBO Academy

AUBO er en veletableret producent med mange års erfaring og en stærk position i Skandinavien. Som selvstændig AUBO-forhandler driver vi butikken lokalt med fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og gode relationer, både til kunder og medarbejdere.

title: Clinical Trial Research Assistant
description:
Job Description:

• Excellent benefits including salary packaging
• Challenging and rewarding work environment
• Part time (24 hours per week) position until 30th June 2027

About the Role
The Research Assistant provides research coordination and administrative support for clinical research undertaken within the Nephrology Research Unit.

The role supports participant recruitment, study coordination, ethics and governance activities, data collection, regulatory compliance, maintenance of essential documents and communication with investigators, sponsors and study participants.

  • Support recruitment, screening, enrolment and retention of research participants.
  • Coordinate participant visits, investigations and follow-up.
  • Assist investigators in day-to-day conduct of multiple concurrent studies.
  • Collect, verify and enter research data into approved databases.
  • Maintain source documents, Investigator Site Files and Trial Master Files.
  • Respond to data queries and ensure documentation is audit ready.


Classifications for this position range between HS3 - HS25 ($74,448.40 - $82,305.60 per annum, pro rata).

Your Contribution

  • Current ICH-GCP certification or willingness to obtain.
  • Bachelor’s degree in health science, Biomedical Science, Medical Science, Public Health, Clinical Research or related discipline.
  • Experience in healthcare, clinical research or research administration.
  • Knowledge of research ethics, governance and Good Clinical Practice.
  • Excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills.
  • High level of computer literacy and data management skills.


What we Offer
• A focus on wellbeing initiatives, with regular events and programs
• Confidential, solutions-focused employee counselling

About Nephrology

The Renal Service provides comprehensive care across the continuum of chronic kidney disease, from outpatient management through to haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, home dialysis and kidney transplantation. title: VSP MD Collaborator
description:
Become a part of our caring community

We are excited to offer the role of Virtual Physician Collaborator for CenterWell Medical Group, a new virtual care delivery group within CenterWell Senior Primary Care, Humana's Primary Care Organization.

This group will provide virtual wraparound services to support patients when they cannot get in with their own PCP – closing gaps in care, ensuring timeless access to important medications and solving urgent clinical needs.

This Virtual Physician Collaborator shares in our vision to improve primary care for the next generation of seniors and is eager to support excellent care every day! As the Physician Collaborator, you will focus on the collaborative relationship through our Nurse Practitioners. This is a fully remote role, which involves approximately 5 hours a month.

You will work in a remote role, reporting to our Associate Director.

Responsibilities

  • You will complete regular chart review and coordinate monthly meetings
  • You will be available as a resource for the advanced practice provider to ensure quality patient care.
  • You will collaborate with clinical leaders about quality of care, review of outcome data, procedure, and records issues.

Required Qualifications:

  • You will have a current and unrestricted medical license in the state of South Carolina
  • You must actively practice medicine in the state of South Carolina in a physical capacity
  • You will be a graduate of accredited MD or DO program of accredited university
  • You are Board certification or Board Eligible
  • You will have 2+ years telemedicine/telehealth experience
  • You will have 2+ years of experience as a Collaborating Physician


Use your skills to make an impact

Additional Information

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

1

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.


$310,000 - $368,500 per year


Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers benefits for limited term, variable schedule and per diem associates which are designed to support whole-person well-being. Among these benefits, Humana provides paid time off, 401(k) retirement savings plan, employee assistance program, business travel and accident.

Our integrated care teams, which include physicians, nurses, behavioral health specialists and more, spend up to 50 percent more time with patients, providing compassionate, personalized care that brings better health outcomes. We go beyond physical health by also addressing other factors that can impact a patient’s well-being.

The result is high-quality healthcare that is accessible, comprehensive and, most of all, personalized. As the largest provider of senior-focused primary care, a leading provider of home healthcare and a leading integrated home delivery, specialty, hospice and retail pharmacy, CenterWell is focused on whole health and addressing the physical, emotional and social wellness of our patients. CenterWell is part of Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM). Learn more about what we offer at CenterWell.com.

title: CEO Office - AI Neobank App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for strong operators to join the CEO Office for BJAK's AI Neobank app expansion.

This role is for someone who can help turn CEO priorities into execution across product, hiring, licensing, partnerships, market launch and daily operating rhythm.

What You'll Own

  • Drive CEO-level priorities from problem definition to execution. 

  • Track OKRs, decisions, blockers, owners and deadlines across teams. 

  • Support licensing applications, country expansion, hiring, partnerships and strategic projects. 

  • Prepare clear briefs, updates, research notes, meeting follow-ups and action trackers.

  • Work across product, engineering, finance, legal, compliance, operations and country teams. 

  • Identify execution gaps and push teams to close them. 

  • Own urgent business problems that do not fit neatly into one department.


What We're Looking For 

  • High-ownership business generalist with strong execution discipline. 

  • Clear writer, structured thinker and strong follow-through operator. 

  • Able to work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. 

  • Comfortable handling ambiguity, urgent problems and shifting priorities. 

  • Strong judgement on what matters, what is blocked and what needs escalation. 

  • Able to keep teams moving without creating unnecessary process. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, operations, strategy, fintech or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Turns unclear priorities into clear actions. 

  • Can chase, unblock and execute without being chased. 

  • Writes updates that make decisions easier. 

  • Stays calm when many things are moving at once. 

  • Cares about outcomes more than visibility.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings. 

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 

title: Kiinteistönhoitaja
description:
Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy vastaa Hekan kohteiden isännöinnistä, huollosta sekä siivouksesta alueittain. Pohjoisen alueella huolehdimme 12 000 asunnon osalta laadukkaasta ja sujuvasta asumisesta.Haemme kiinteistönhoitajaa vakituiseen tehtävään.
Kiinteistönhoitajan työhön kuuluu muun muassa kiinteistöjen yleishuolto, tekniset tehtävät, ulkoalueiden hoito sekä pienimuotoiset korjaustyöt.
Kiinteistönhoitajat ovat Hekan suurin ja asukkaillemme näkyvin työntekijäryhmä. Ihmisläheinen työ, jossa käydään usein myös asukkaidemme kodeissa, vaatii pelisilmää ja huumorintajua. Talot ja niiden asukkaat käyvät nopeasti tutuiksi, sillä jokaiselle kiinteistönhoitajallamme on oma nimetty alue, jolla hän työskentelee. Suurin osa työkohteista on tavallisia asuintaloja, mutta alueesta riippuen kiinteistönhoitajan työmaalle voi osua myös esimerkiksi päiväkoti, ravintola tai palvelutalo.
Kiinteistöhoitajan tehtävässä edellytämme soveltuvaa peruskoulutusta, B-ajokorttia ja tietoteknisiä perustaitoja. Kiinteistönhoitokoneiden ajotaidot ja vähintään muutaman vuoden kokemus kiinteistönhoitajan tehtävistä ovat eduksi. Kokemuksen kartuttua arvostamme valmiutta osallistua huoltopäivystykseen. Odotamme yhteistyökykyä, myönteistä asiakaspalveluasennetta, halua itsensä kehittämiseen sekä hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja.
Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja haastavan työn, jossa on mahdollisuus ammattitaidon kehittämiseen. Meillä on käytössä liukuva työaika sekä hyvät työsuhde-edut, kuten työsuhdepyöräetu, lounas-, liikunta-, kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja työmatkaedut. Mahdollisuus myös työsuhdeasuntoon.
Palkkaus ja muut työsuhteen ehdot määräytyvät KT:n yrityssektorin yleisen työehtosopimuksen (YTES) mukaan. Tässä tehtävässä aloittavan henkilön vähimmäisperuspalkka on 2241,81 €/kk. Lisäksi maksetaan kokemuslisää, jos työntekijällä on vähintään 5 vuotta kokemuslisään oikeuttavaa työkokemusta. Kokemuslisän suuruus on 5 % / 5 kokemusvuotta ja 10 % / 10 kokemusvuotta.
Työn aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.
Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa petri.sandgren@hekaoy.fi tai 09 5767 3705
Hakuaika päättyy 23.8.2026. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Jätä hakemuksesi Hae paikkaa -linkin kautta.

Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy (Heka) on Helsingin kaupungin omistama yhtiö. Heka on noin 55 000:lla Helsingissä sijaitsevalla vuokra-asunnollaan Suomen suurin asuntovuokranantaja. Noin 15 prosenttia helsinkiläisistä asuu Hekalla.

Hekassa työskentelee lähes 700 asumisen ammattilaista. Suurimmat henkilöstöryhmämme ovat kiinteistöhuolto ja siivous. Heka on savuton työpaikka.

Arvostamme työyhteisön monimuotoisuutta, ja edistämme yhdenvertaisuutta suunnitelmallisesti ja tavoitteellisesti. Kannustamme monenlaisista taustoista tulevia hakemaan meille töihin.

Lue lisää Hekasta osoitteesta www.hekaoy.fi.

title: Anlegg søker Driftsleder Elektro og Automasjon til vårt prosjekt OPS Hålogalandsvegen
description:
Skanska ble i 2023 tildelt kontrakt for bygging og drift og vedlikehold på OPS Hålogalandsvegen for Statens vegvesen. Prosjektet er et offentlig-privat samarbeid, også kalt OPS. Strekningen er en del av transportforbindelsen mellom Lofoten, Vesterålen, Harstad/Narvik lufthavn og E6. Totalt skal det bygges 82 kilometer ny vei, herunder 27 kilometer gjennom i alt sju tunneler. Det skal bygges 35 kilometer vei i dagens veilinje, mens 20 kilometer bygges som ny vei. I tillegg skal det bygges 22 broer i veglinja og i tillegg et betydelig antall mindre konstruksjoner, kulverter mm. I tillegg til å bedre trafikksikkerheten, vil prosjektet korte ned reiselengden og redusere reisetiden betydelig. Skanska har ansvar for drifts- og vedlikeholdskontrakten i en 15-årsperiode fra ferdigstillelse av bygging. Veien blir åpnet i to omganger, den første delen på ca 27 km blir åpnet høsten 2026 og drift- og vedlikehold vil løpe fra dette åpningstidspunktet. Skanska har inngått kontrakt med Svevia Norge som vil utføre mange av driftsoppgavene.

Rollen som Driftsleder Elektro og Automasjon er å sørge for at anlegget driftes og vedlikeholdes slik at alle krav gitt i kontrakten, håndbøker, instrukser, kravspesifikasjoner og beskrivelser knyttet til Elektro og Automasjon oppfylles.

Dette er en viktig rolle med store muligheter for personlig og profesjonell utvikling.

Ansvar i stillingen

  • Følge opp drifts og vedlikeholdsrutiner på elektro og automasjon
  • Styre driftsentreprenør elektro og automasjon
  • Bidra til rapportering på kontraktskrav til kunde
  • Økonomioppfølging iht budsjett for drift og vedlikehold
  • Følge opp kundens SHA plan
  • Rapporterer til Prosjektleder drift og vedlikehold

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Fagbrev elektriker eller automasjon, gjerne i kombinasjon med høyere utdannelse
  • God forståelse for kontraktsarbeid og økonomistyring
  • Strukturert og vet hva som kreves for å sikre både driftseffektivitet og kvalitet i leveransene
  • Fordel med god generell kjennskap til anleggsbransjen
  • Fordel med erfaring fra drift og vedlikehold.
  • Fordel med kjennskap til forvaltningsprogrammene, blant annet Plania, Brutus, ELRAPP og lignende
  • Fordel med erfaring med Statens vegvesen sine handbøker for drift og vedlikehold

Egenskaper

  • Jobber selvstendig
  • Strukturert og god til å planlegge
  • Gode samarbeidsevner
  • Ha god gjennomføringsevne, praktisk og løsningsorientert

Stillingen har fast kontorsted i Harstad regionen, det er ønskelig med lokal tilhørighet.

title: International Security Analyst
description:
We have multiple openings for International Security Analysts to support our work on nuclear security, with an emphasis on international nuclear security. As an integral member of an interdisciplinary team, you will support NNSA and other sponsors by assessing international nuclear security problems, formulating strategic approaches to reduce risk, and implementing nuclear security initiatives in the areas of human capital development, physical security system improvements, and international engagement to strengthen nuclear security capacity worldwide. This position will be in the Global Materials Security Program within the Global Security Principal Directorate’s Nuclear Threat Reduction (N) Program.

This position will be filled at either the SES.4 or SES.5 level depending on your qualifications. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if you are selected at the higher level.

In this role, you will

  • Lead, manage, and coordinate projects within the GMS international nuclear security program, including development of country strategies, bi-lateral relationship management, team leadership, sponsor reporting and funding oversight.
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for relevant technical and policy areas associated with the program’s international nuclear security mission area and sponsors as defined by the GMS program leader. Represent the program and provide strategic technical advice to sponsors and other U.S. Government (USG) organizations, traveling as necessary.
  • Manage the program's international engagements agenda, including producing high-quality technical presentations and reports. Develop and maintain an integrated strategy for program areas consistent with overall GMS strategic planning, utilizing key knowledge and insights on nuclear security, associated nuclear threat reduction efforts, and national security needs.
  • Develop and track project execution plans for assigned international engagements and research and development projects, including allocation and monitoring of available personnel and budgets.
  • Develop new program opportunities, including the definition and development of proposals in collaboration with potential sponsors and customers, including those outside of the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) such as Department of State (DoS) and other agencies.
  • Maintain and ensure appropriate quality standards of highly complex projects for all the program’s activities including reviewing, coordinating, and approving deliverables, publications and presentations. Promote and maintain a positive image of the Laboratory and strong internal/external customer relationships by ensuring project and program objectives and commitments are met successfully.
  • Effectively coordinate with other GS programs and LLNL scientific disciplines involved in nuclear security staying abreast of current technical developments and casework and promoting maximum utilization of the current nuclear forensic workforce and pipeline.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities at the SES.5 level

  • Develop innovative concepts and provide expert management, leadership, technical vision, and strategic planning for both analytic and research and development environments.
  • Influence strategic vision and implementation plans for senior management and external stakeholders to meet the needs of the broad US nuclear forensics and nuclear detection communities.
  • Cultivate mutually beneficial partnerships with external organizations, including academia, other national laboratories, government agencies, and facilities.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DOE (L/Q)-level security clearance which requires U.S. Citizenship.
  • Master’s Degree in physical science, engineering, international relations, political science, or other relevant field or the equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • Advanced leadership, communication, and team-building skills to lead collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams responsible for, and contributing to, international engagement in nuclear security, including coordinating with other relevant U.S. government programs.
  • Significant experience managing million-dollar budgets and effectively balancing highly complex technical and budgetary priorities. Advanced program management skills with ability to deliver successful results.
  • Expert problem-solving, analytical, technical, and organizational skills to independently advise, recommend, and approve appropriate actions and implement solutions. Ability to delegate effectively to lead, motivate, and build complex teams to work toward programmatic and institutional goals.
  • Significant experience cultivating successful and productive relationships with external clients/sponsors and the expert collaboration skills needed to effectively develop and sustain partnerships with other programs, directorates, laboratories, NNSA management, other institutions across the interagency and intelligence community.
  • Experience supporting international engagement activities in nuclear security, including delivering workshops and leading international meetings.
  • Expert communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively explain, present, negotiate, advise, and influence all levels of management.
  • Appropriate cultural sensitivity to help develop trust, confidence, and a collaborative attitude in our international partners.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively.

Additional qualifications, at the SES.5 level

  • Significant experience working with foreign partners and proven ability to lead, develop positions on, and implement nuclear security initiatives, or similar work on related programs.
  • Working knowledge of the IAEA’s Division of Nuclear Security efforts including implementation instruments, technical development needs, and international training needs at the IAEA and among foreign partners.
  • Working knowledge of global technical advancements that may influence or impact nuclear security.

Pay Range

$210,630 - $320,580 Annually

$210,630 - $267,060 Annually for the SES.4 level

$252,810 - $320,580 Annually for the SES.5 level

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

description:

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Sushi Clerk

Department: Hy-Chi

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

As a Sushi Clerk at Hy-Vee, you'll be a key part of our Hy-Chi department, helping fill customer orders, prepare fresh product, and keep the department running smoothly every day. Your attention to food safety, freshness, and customer service makes a real difference in the experience our customers have every time they visit.

If you take pride in working with food, enjoy a fast-paced environment, and love making customers happy, this could be a great fit for you.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting customers warmly, learning their names, and going the extra mile to make every visit a positive one

  • Take customer orders at the counter and over the phone, and assist customers with finding products, reaching items, and carrying heavy purchases

  • Review daily orders and monitor product freshness, appearance, and supply levels throughout your shift

  • Prepare, finish, and replenish product as needed, pulling items from the cooler or freezer for preparation

  • Follow and maintain proper sanitation procedures, keeping your work area clean and organized at all times

  • Check in product, put product away, label and date items accurately, and remove trash promptly

  • Anticipate daily product needs and follow or develop a production list to stay ahead

  • Order product and supplies as necessary

  • Work alongside your teammates to ensure a smooth, positive experience for every customer

  • Maintain compliance with Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all company policies

  • Assist in other store areas and take on special projects as needed

  • You'll receive direction and support from: Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home, Food Service Director, Hy-Chi Department Manager, Assistant Hy-Chi Department Manager, and Service Managers

Your Skills

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be able to:

  • Follow written and verbal instructions with confidence

  • Use basic math skills for simple addition, subtraction, counting, and recording

  • Communicate clearly with customers and teammates in a friendly, helpful way

  • Stay organized and keep up with the pace of a busy department

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Food Safety Certification required; six months or more of similar or related experience preferred

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home, Food Service Director, Hy-Chi Department Manager, Assistant Hy-Chi Department Manager, and Service Managers

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

  • Food Safety Certification required

  • Six months of similar or related experience preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

Working Environment

This is a fast-paced role with significant activity throughout your shift. You may encounter continuous exposure to raw fish, flour, dust, noise, and temperature extremes, with occasional exposure to cleaning chemicals or solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Android)
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Senior Android Engineer – Universal Components

About the Role

Our vision is to free everyone to safely use any technology. We promise to make identity work for everyone—whether you’re a developer looking to innovate or a security professional looking to mitigate. We are looking for curious, excited, boundary-pushing team members. So, if you’re a big thinker who is nimble and adaptable, Okta may be an ideal place to shine.

Okta’s Customer Identity Cloud (CIC), powered by Auth0 technology, is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.

We are looking for an experienced, developer-focused Senior Android Engineer to join our Universal Components team.

Job Description

You UNDERSTAND developers! You know what they need, how to talk to them, how to make their lives easier, and what turns friction into delight. You recognize when a framework, library, or product provides an exceptional developer experience.

As a Senior Android Engineer on the Universal Components team, you will leverage that developer-first mindset to build, architect, and maintain our open-source UI components, SDKs, and libraries. You will serve as an internal and external steward for the technologies you work with daily, shepherding our platforms forward and directly improving our entire developer journey—from onboarding, quickstarts, and documentation to direct support in developer channels.

Collaborating in a cross-functional environment alongside developer relations, onboarding, growth, dashboard, and core SDK teams, you will act as a go-to domain expert to provide a world-class experience for our component libraries.

The most vital qualifications for this position are deep Android engineering expertise, strong empathy for developers, self-direction, and a collaborative mindset.




What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building Modular UI: Architecting and developing composable, production-ready UI components from the ground up using Jetpack Compose and traditional XML views where necessary.
  • SDK Leadership: Directly shaping, developing, and maintaining our open-source Universal Components Android SDKs and client libraries.
  • Authoring Developer Resources: Writing, curating, and polishing technical content, including tutorials, guides, sample applications, and comprehensive API documentation.
  • Community & Advocacy: Championing Auth0 by engaging directly with the open-source developer community, providing domain knowledge, and offering technical assistance.
  • Domain Expertise & Mentorship: Serving as the go-to technical expert internally and externally, conducting thorough code reviews, and upholding high quality and UI testing standards across our mobile libraries.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Representing the company by sharing your technical expertise at conferences, tech events, community forums, or through technical publications.
  • Maintenance & Modernization: Troubleshooting, debugging, and fixing complex issues across client libraries while keeping pace with modern Android architecture and platform standards.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • 5+ years of professional expertise in native Android development using Kotlin & Java.
  • 3+ years of hands-on expertise building production interfaces with Jetpack Compose.
  • Proven ability to seamlessly translate design mocks (e.g., Figma) into clean, modular, and accessible Compose code.
  • Strong track record of developing reusable Android UI libraries, SDKs, or widely used application architectures.
  • Deep understanding of Android frameworks, core architecture components, and the broader Android ecosystem.
  • Experience deploying applications to the Google Play Store or publishing packages/libraries to artifact repositories like Maven Central.
  • Deep understanding of CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, CircleCI) and running automated UI and unit tests in continuous integration environments.
  • Deep knowledge of writing, running, maintaining, and debugging complex mobile applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with demonstrable experience authoring developer documentation (tutorials, blog posts, or guides).
  • The ability to be self-directed, take ownership, and work independently while thriving in a globally distributed team environment.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Knowledge or hands-on experience with Design Systems (building component libraries, design tokens, or multi-platform visual consistency).
  • Experience with iOS development (Swift & Objective-C) or cross-platform architectures.
  • Active contributions to open-source projects or experience maintaining public open-source repositories.
  • A personal technical blog or published articles on popular Android development platforms.
  • Knowledge or experience in the identity and access management (IAM) space.
  • Experience working in remote, distributed engineering teams.

title: Acute Care Technician
description:
SHIFT:

Rotating (United States of America)

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.


CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.


A Brief Overview
The Acute Care Technician provides direct and indirect care duties under the guidance and direction of the registered nurse. The role performs a variety of invasive and non-invasive technical skills and specialized patient care procedures as well as other duties to support 24-hours of hospital operations.

What you will do

  • 1. Assists in the provision of care to patients and families under the direction of the RN
  • Performs or assists RN with initial admission/intake
  • Documents patient care, vitals, weights, allergies, interventions
  • Quickly and accurately communicates patient information to the appropriate team member
  • Transfers patients to other departments and areas utilizing appropriate techniques and equipment to transport patients
  • Utilizes and exemplifies safety behaviors for error prevention. Identifies potential safety concerns and communicates with unit leadership as appropriate
  • Provides 1:1 observation for psychiatric emergencies per hospital standard
  • Application, documentation, removal, and supervision of restraints
  • Monitors care and escalates concerns
  • Dressing changes for central venous catheters
  • Airway management including tracheostomy changes, replacement and suctioning
  • Positioning patients for various procedures and specimen collections including lumbar punctures
  • Bladder catheterization and Foley insertion
  • OG/NG placement
  • Spinal immobilization
  • Recovers from Phase II sedation
  • 2. Performs procedures under direction of RN
  • Peripheral IV insertion with and without venous blood sampling
  • Venipuncture/phlebotomy
  • Primes fluids and enteral feeds
  • Point of Care Testing
  • Obtains and prepares supplies for procedures including, but not limited to, PIV insertion, PICC insertion, CVC dressing change and CVC repair
  • Oxygen administration, bag/valve/mask/mapleson airway support as ordered/needed
  • EKGs as ordered
  • Wound care and dressing application
  • Positioning, lifting, transferring, and turning of patients
  • Monitors patient during insertion of peripherally inserted central venous catheter (PICC) in Fluoroscopy or within intensive care units under direction of RN
  • 4. Maintains proficiency with transport and patient care equipment including, but not limited to, monitoring and infusion pumps
  • 5. Complies with all CHOP policies and procedures
  • 6. Area-based skills may include:
  • Emergency Department Based Skills:
  • Bladder scanning
  • Initiates Behavioral Health Screening.
  • Performs bedside role in traumas and resuscitations.
  • Hospital Decontamination Team member.
  • Performs casting and splinting under the direction of the ED Attending.
  • Collects evidence per hospital policy
  • Vascular Access Service (VAS) Based Skills:
  • Facilities planning of institution-wide PIV insertion classes and educates staff on PIV insertion
  • Collaborates with VAS Leadership team regarding course content and coordination of class schedule
  • Partners with individual units to provide just-in time education for RNs learning PIV insertion skills
  • Educates and trains staff new to PIV insertion and facilitates insertion opportunities for novice PIV inserters

Education Qualifications

  • High School Diploma / GED Required
  • Technical Diploma EMT-Paramedic, EMT, LPN or similar program Preferred

Experience Qualifications

  • At least one (1) year Previous clinical health care experience Required
  • ED/Critical Care Technician at another hospital Preferred

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to perform clinical technical tasks.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with people of all ages.
  • Basic knowledge of growth and development.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) - issued through on organization that requires a hands-on instructor lead psychomotor skills verification (ex. American Heart Association or Red Cross). - upon hire - Required
  • Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) - issued through on organization that requires a hands-on instructor lead psychomotor skills verification (ex. American Heart Association or Red Cross). - upon hire - Preferred or
  • Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) - issued through on organization that requires a hands-on instructor lead psychomotor skills verification (ex. American Heart Association or Red Cross). - upon hire - Preferred or
  • Pediatric Emergency Assessment, Recognition and Stabilization (PEARS) - issued through on organization that requires a hands-on instructor lead psychomotor skills verification (ex. American Heart Association or Red Cross). - upon hire - Preferred


To carry out its mission, CHOP is committed to supporting the health of our patients, families, workforce, and global community. As a condition of employment, CHOP employees who work in patient care buildings or who have patient facing responsibilities must receive an annual influenza vaccine. Learn more.

title: Haemme ravintolatyöntekijöitä Eepeen ABC:n ja Maran henkilöstöpooliin
description:
Primary location:

SEINÄJOKI

Haemme ravintolatyöntekijöitä Eepeen ABC:n ja Maran henkilöstöpooliin

Avoinna olevat ravintolatyöntekijän työtehtävät ovat vakituisia, osa-aikaisin työtunnein, keskimäärin 36-72h/3vko ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.

Haemme tekijöitä laajasti poolin eri toimialueille eli rannikon, Suupohjan, Härmänmaan sekä Seinäjoen ja lähikuntien alueille. Mikäli sinua kiinnostaa henkilöstöpoolissa työskentely Eepeen ABC - liikennekaupan ja Maran ravintolamaailma toimipaikoissa hae mukaan!

Henkilöstöpoolissa työskentely on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa – yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen! Pooli on tosi tykätty, joustava ja monipuolinen työskentelymalli, jossa työntekijät pääsevät työskentelemään joustavasti useissa Eepeen toimipaikoissa. Henkilöstöpoolilaisena sinulle kasvaa monipuolinen osaaminen ravintolan työtehtävistä. Poolin tavoitteena on helpottaa yksiköiden arkea, tuoden apua ja osaamista sinne, missä sitä eniten tarvitaan.

Avoinna olevat työtehtävät ABC:n ja maran henkilöstöpoolissa ovat ravintolatyöntekijän työtä. Ravintolatyöntekijät työskentelevät tyypillisesti ravintolamaailmassa tai liikennemyymälässä ja tekevät monipuolisia ravintola-alan tehtäviä, kuten myynti- ja asiakaspalvelu-, keittiö- ja hesburgerin työtehtäviä. Poolilainen on todellinen arjen moniosaaja ja osaamisen lähettiläs, joka vie hyviä käytäntöjä toimipaikasta toiseen. Hän pääsee auttamaan toimipaikkoja, joilla on äkillinen tarve saada huippu työkaveri avuksi. Poolilaisella on useampi työnteon yksikkö, ja alussa on kattava ja käytännönläheinen perehdytysjakso, jonka aikana ravintolan toimintatavat tulevat tutuiksi. Meillä työskennellään yhdessä tiimin kanssa, joten toivomme sinulta hyviä yhteistyötaitoja. Työ edellyttää oman auton käyttöä ja liikkumista alueen henkilöstöpoolin yksiköissä.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Täysi-ikäisyyttä

  • Mahdollisuutta liikkua poolin toiminta-alueella

  • Valmiutta työskennellä monipuolisessa vuorotyössä, myös juhlapyhinä ja viikonloppuisin

  • Suomen kielen taitoa asiakaspalvelutilanteissa

  • Ravintolatyöntekijän työ on tänä päivänä yhä digitaalisempaa, ja siksi odotamme sinulta toimeen tarttuvaa ja sujuvaa otetta järjestelmiin ja ravintolan tietoteknisiin työvälineisiin.

  • Aikaisempi kokemus ravintola-alan tehtävistä on hyödyksi, mutta positiivinen asenne ja aito halu oppia ja tehdä asiakaspalvelutyötä ovat kaikkein tärkeintä menestyäksesi tehtävässä

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai henksuhintainen hotellihuone viikonlopuksi? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakua täältä.

  • Koko henkilöstöämme koskeva tulospalkkiojärjestelmä

  • Kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan ja hyvinvoinnin Epassi-edut

  • Poikkeuksellisen paljon erilaisia mahdollisuuksia!

Me Eepeellä sanomme olevamme Ihan tavallisissa töissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. Meillä on myös poikkeuksellisen kivoja työkavereita, erinomaisia henkilöstöetuja ja harvinaisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Tutustu meihin työnantajana sekä työskentelyyn henkilöstöpoolissa tästä.

Pitkä hakuaika mahdollistaa hakemisen aina syyskuulle saakka – käsittelemme kuitenkin hakemuksia ja teemme valintoja jo hakuaikana, joten hae mukaan viipymättä!

Haku on avoinna 13.9.2026 saakka.

Mainitse hakemuksella mille poolin toiminta-alueista haet:

  • Rannikko/Suupohja

  • Härmänmaa

  • Seinäjoki/lähikunnat

Lisätiedoissa voit olla yhteydessä:

5.8. - 25.8. Elina Mäki-Opas, resurssipäällikkö

📞010 764 7101 | elina.maki-opas@sok.fi

26.8. alkaen

Kati Lehtimaa, henkilöstöpoolin päällikkö

📞 050 311 5893 | ✉️ kati.lehtimaa@sok.fi

👉Täytä sähköinen hakemus ja liity mukaan Eepeen henkilöstöpooliin

******************************************

Etelä-Pohjanmaan Osuuskauppa on monipuolinen työpaikka!

Eepee on osuuskauppa, jonka omistavat sen yli 95 000 asiakasomistajaa. Tarjoamme toimialueellamme työpaikan 1300 palvelualan ammattilaiselle 71 toimipaikassamme.

Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. Tavallinen työ on sitä, mitä pitääkin olla – tehokasta, arvokasta ja tärkeää. Ihan tavallisen työn lisäksi, meillä on epätavallisen hyvät edut ja poikkeuksellisen mahtavat työkaverit. Tutustu meihin paremmin ja kurkkaa, mitä tulevat työkaverisi kertovat työstään – ehkä seuraava tarina on sinun.

title: Regional Finance Business Partner, Southeast
description:
Cobalt Service Partners

Reports to: Regional President with dotted line into Director ofFinance

Position: Southeast Regional Finance Business Partner

Location: Remote within the Southeast, based near a major hub airport (e.g., Atlanta, Charlotte, Nashville). ~20–25% travel.

Cobalt Overview

Cobalt Service Partners is an Alpine Investors-backed platform acquiring access-solutions businesses: access control, video surveillance, alarm, and commercial door systems. We partner with founder-led companies, honor their legacies, sharpen operations, and grow through high-velocity M&A.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on, strategic finance leader to partner with a Regional President across four to five acquired partner companies — a roughly 50/50 blend of controllership and FP&A. You’ll flex to hands-on close and accounting transitions at more recently acquired companies and to forward-looking planning where teams are more established, driving margin, cash flow, and better decisions along the way.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the finance partner to the Regional President: monitor performance, drive margin and EBITDA expansion, and turn analysis into decisions.
  • Own budgeting, reforecasting, variance analysis, and flash reporting on Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA across the region.
  • Oversee monthly close for the partner companies (GAAP, on time), including the transition from cash to accrual accounting.
  • Own cash flow forecasting and working capital across the region.
  • Lead ERP implementation and system integrations, standardizing process across companies.
  • Maintain internal controls and compliance, and support integration and audits with the HoldCo finance team.

What You Bring

  • 7–12+ years in finance and accounting spanning both FP&A and controllership; bachelor’s in Accounting or Finance. CPA or CMA preferred.
  • Multi-entity, regional, or decentralized experience - ideally in a PE-backed or acquisitive environment - with real ownership of close, reporting, and variance analysis.
  • Strong GAAP, budgeting, forecasting, modeling, and cash flow / working-capital fundamentals.
  • Comfortable in ERP-level, multi-entity environments, with the flexibility to learn and build process across systems (Sage Intacct a plus). Percentage-of-completion / job-costing experience is a plus.
  • A trusted partner who can lead and mentor finance staff and influence senior operators without direct authority.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary (actual offer based on experience).
  • PTO & Paid holidays.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • A dynamic, growth-oriented environment backed by a leading PE sponsor.

Our Values

Unwavering stewardship: We believe advancing founders’ legacies is a privilege. We do right by our founders, teams, and customers in good times and in bad.

Excellence in action: We hold ourselves accountable to the highest standards. We’re bold in our pursuits, don’t make excuses, and relentlessly empower each other to get the job done.

Seek and tell the truth: We are honest with ourselves and others. We do what we say we’ll do, say what needs to be said, and search for the right answer regardless of where it comes from.

Love learning: We are always learning as individuals, as a team, and as a business. We show up humble, curious, and with the courage to change our minds.

Enjoy the ride: We are fired up by our mission, love our team, and don’t take either for granted. We show up authentically, assume best intent, and try not to take ourselves too seriously.

Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at Cobalt

Cobalt is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Guided by our PeopleFirst philosophy — which emphasizes attributes over experience — we welcome applicants of every background and evaluate them without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and related conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or over), disability, medical condition, marital or domestic-partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.

description:
Imagine a career at one of the nation's most advanced health networks.


Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.


LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary
Performs laboratory procedures to obtain results for providers to utilize in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases. Uses established procedures and protocols that require the exercise of independent judgment and responsibility with minimal technical supervision.

Job Duties
  • Performs any high complexity, moderate complexity, or waived laboratory testing in the assigned testing department. Utilizes advanced clinical laboratory instrumentation and methodologies according to departmental standard operating procedures. Confirms, verifies, and reports the results of this testing independently exercising broad independent judgment. Monitors results for reasonableness and critical values.
  • Conducts and evaluates established quality control per departmental standard operating procedures. Troubleshoots and reports to management any unacceptable quality control before reporting patient results.
  • Performs required departmental preventative maintenance per standard operating procedures.
  • Recognizes and corrects instrument or procedural malfunctions within the scope of the standard operating procedures and records troubleshooting activities.
  • Provides clinical orientation and/or training of new employees/students.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree as a medical laboratory technician or
  • Specialized Diploma must meet CLIA grandfathered MLT regulations.
  • Less than 1 year of experience and a clinical laboratory internship.
  • Demonstrated technical skills. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific documents.
  • Ability to read, understand, and speak basic English.
  • Demonstrated ability to use/learn the computer system, word processing, e-mail, and applicable software programs.
  • Demonstrated dependability/flexibility in meeting scheduling needs of the department, unit, and hospital.
  • Ability to apply common mathematical skills.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Preferred Qualifications
  • MLT - Medical Laboratory Technician ASCP - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire

Physical Demands
Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

ATALIAN to międzynarodowa organizacja w sektorze Facility Management, działająca w 15 krajach i zatrudniająca ponad 67 000 pracowników. Na polskim rynku jesteśmy obecni od 2000 roku. Nasz zespół w całej Polsce tworzy około 1200 pracowników, którzy codziennie dbają o czystość, sprawność techniczną i przyjemność użytkowania budynków naszych klientów.
Od sprzątania i utrzymania technicznego, przez pielęgnację terenów zielonych, prowadzanie kantyn czy obsługę recepcji, aż po kompleksowe zarządzanie budynkami - zapewniamy naszym klientom komfort prowadzenia ich własnego biznesu. Jak to robimy? Osiągamy to dzięki bliskiej współpracy z klientami, odciążając ich od codziennych trudności i oferując elastyczne, szyte na miarę rozwiązania.
ATALIAN to nie tylko miejsce pracy. To przestrzeń, w której możesz się rozwijać, realnie wpływać na otaczającą Cię rzeczywistość i współtworzyć przyszłość opartą na zrównoważonym rozwoju, innowacji i sile relacji międzyludzkich.

Opis stanowiska:

Miejsce pracy: Rybnik, plac Wolności

Dni pracy: poniedziałek – piątek

Godziny pracy: 1.5 h dziennie; w godz. 8.30-10.00

Zakres pracy: Utrzymanie porządku i czystości w pomieszczeniach biurowych w placówce bankowej.

Wymagania:

  • komunikatywna znajomość języka polskiego, samodzielność, zaangażowanie, chęci do pracy

Oferujemy:

  • wynagrodzenie brutto 31.40 zł/h - zawsze na czas!
  • długoterminową współpracę w oparciu o umowę zlecenie
  • pakiet benefitów MEDICOVER: prywatna opieka medyczna i pakiet sportowy
  • możliwość przystąpienia do: PZU ubezpieczenie grupowe, PPK, PPE
  • program poleceń pracowniczych

title: betterpeople A/S søger på vegne af Rotpunkt Glostrup en salgsansvarlig
description:
Har du erfaring fra køkkenbranchen og lyst til at tage næste skridt? Hos Rotpunkt Glostrup får du ikke bare ansvar for dit eget salg, du får mulighed for at sætte retning, skabe resultater og blive en nøgleperson i udviklingen af en ambitiøs forretning med store vækstplaner.

betterpeople A/S søger på vegne af Rotpunkt i Glostrup en salgsansvarlig

Rotpunkt

Rotpunkt er kendt for køkkenløsninger i høj kvalitet, produceret i Tyskland og skabt med fokus på design, funktionalitet og fleksibilitet. Virksomheden henvender sig til kvalitetsbevidste kunder, som ønsker individuelle løsninger og professionel rådgivning gennem hele processen.

Samtidig er Rotpunkt en virksomhed med ambitioner. Der arbejdes målrettet med vækst og udvikling, og kulturen er præget af korte beslutningsveje, høj grad af frihed og et ønske om at give dygtige medarbejdere mulighed for at tage ansvar og udvikle sig sammen med virksomheden.

Salg, rådgivning og mulighed for at sætte retningen

Som salgsansvarlig bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen i butikken i Glostrup. Din primære opgave bliver at skabe stærke kundeoplevelser og omsætte kundernes ønsker til konkrete køkkenløsninger. Du følger kunden gennem hele forløbet, fra den første dialog og opmåling til tilbudsgivning og den afsluttende levering.

Stillingen er først og fremmest en salgsrolle, men den rummer mere end det. Vi søger en profil, som naturligt tager ansvar, går forrest og bidrager til at skabe struktur, energi og retning i teamet. Du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for både kolleger og ledelse, og i takt med at du viser resultater og initiativ, vil du få mulighed for at påtage dig et større ansvar i forretningen.

Der er tale om en rolle, hvor du får stor frihed til at præge din egen hverdag, samtidig med at du bliver en nøgleperson i virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling.

Stærk køkkenfaglighed og naturligt ejerskab

For at få succes i rollen er det afgørende, at du kommer med erfaring fra køkkenbranchen. Du forstår kundernes behov, kender salgsprocessen og har den faglige ballast, der gør dig i stand til at rådgive på et højt niveau.

Vi forestiller os, at du har flere års erfaring med salg af køkkenløsninger og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem stærke relationer. Samtidig tager du naturligt ejerskab for dine opgaver og trives i et miljø, hvor initiativ og handlekraft bliver værdsat.

Vi ser gerne, at du har lysten og evnen til at tage ansvar, samle mennesker omkring dig og bidrage til, at teamet lykkes i fællesskab.

Et stærkt produkt, stor frihed og spændende udviklingsmuligheder

Hos Rotpunkt bliver du en del af en virksomhed, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med et produkt, du kan være stolt af. Du får frihed til at skabe individuelle løsninger for kunderne og oplever en organisation, hvor gode idéer bliver hørt, og hvor der er kort vej fra tanke til handling.

Du bliver en del af et mindre team med stor fleksibilitet og mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel. Samtidig får du mulighed for at udvikle dig i takt med virksomhedens vækst og blive en endnu mere central del af organisationen over tid.

Rekrutteringen varetages af betterpeople A/S

Da stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, behandler vi ansøgninger løbende. Der ventes dog gerne på den rette kandidat. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så kontakt venligst Sine Fæste på e-mail sfm@betterpeople.dk. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt og med diskretion. Med henvisning til persondatareglerne modtages ansøgninger KUN via link på hjemmesiden. Kan du ikke uploade din ansøgning via ansøgningsknappen, bedes du kontakte os.

OBS: Vores annonce bliver automatisk og løbende fornyet på jobportalerne, indtil stillingen er besat. En fornyelse af et stillingsopslag er ikke et udtryk for genopslag, selvom det kan fremstå sådan.
