title: Junior Project Manager Events
description:
De kracht van OVAL ligt in het produceren en uitvoeren van spraakmakende projecten. Als Junior Project Manager Live ben jij de waarmaker voor onze klanten. Jij vertaalt de vraag van onze klanten naar een tastbaar product. Events, experiences en activaties.

Als Junior Project Manager ben je multi-getalenteerd. Je bent daadkrachtig, je surft op de golven van hogere werkdruk en deadlines en je staat graag "met je poten in de klei" tijdens de uitvoering van een productie. Aan de andere kant kun je de rust nemen om helder te communiceren met klanten en de verschillende partijen, je bent gastvrij, creatief en houd je balans en energie voor de volgende projecten die eraan komen.

Als Junior project manager werk je samen met een Senior Project manager, maar je houd er ook van om initiatief te nemen en je bent niet bang om soms zelfstandig te (leren) werken. Je bewaakt budgetten en planningen en communiceert met klanten over de voortgang.

  • Je assisteert en produceert producties/events voor verschillende klanten op wisselende locaties. Je beheert samen met de Senior Project Manager de toegewezen projecten van A tot Z. Van offerte, budget planning, productie tot uitvoering.
  • Je werkt samen met een team (strategie, creatie en campagnes) aan effectieve en creatieve plannen voor klanten.
  • Je werkt volgens professionele procedures, ook wel de 'Way of Working' genoemd.
  • Je onderzoekt en bespreekt de wensen en behoeften van klanten.
  • Je signaleert kansen bij klanten en deelt deze intern aan de juiste collega’s.
  • Je luistert goed en vraagt door in gesprekken met klanten, stakeholders en leveranciers.
  • Je presenteert ideeën en feiten op heldere wijze, afgestemd op de luisteraar.
  • Je bouwt een netwerk van relaties op die van pas komen bij het realiseren van evenementen en experiences.
  • 1+ jaar werkervaring met het uitvoeren van (meerdaagse) events met minimaal 100+ Personen.
  • Ervaring bij een bureau en met zakelijke klanten is een pré.
  • In bezit van een bachelor of master in Events, Communicatie of Hotelschool.
  • Nieuwsgierig van aard met aandacht voor details.
  • Proactief en ondernemend: je handen jeuken altijd.
  • Je kunt helder communiceren en met vlagen onder druk werken.
  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en je kunt goed uit de voeten met de Engelse taal.
  • Je houdt van een goede teamspirit en bouwt graag aan goede connecties.
  • Je hebt een flinke dosis humor en houdt ervan om af en toe lekker te ‘ouwehoeren’ met anderen.
  • Je bent vooral lekker jezelf, meer heb je niet nodig!
  • Toffe merken als klanten om voor te werken, zoals Nintendo, Google, bol. en TikTok.
  • Een cultuur die gebouwd is op plezier, verbinding en empathie.
  • Een passend salaris.
  • De ruimte om te ondernemen en jezelf te ontwikkelen.
  • Hybride werken
  • Een gezonde huisgemaakte lunch (voornamelijk vegetarisch)
  • Een mooi kantoor midden in Antwerpen of Ghent
  • Het allergezelligste team met collega’s in 4 verschillende landen.

title: Vi söker en butiksmedarbetare till Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Uppsala
description:
Butiksmedarbetare för Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Uppsala

Föreställ dig ett arbete där dagarna flyger förbi. En arbetsplats omgiven av kreativa produkter och härliga kollegor. En plats med glada och lojala kunder. Så är det hos Flying Tiger Copenhagen, och nu vill vi ha dig ombord! Brinner du också för att alltid ge kunden det lilla extra? Då tycker vi att du ska bli vår nya kollega i Uppsala.

Det krävs något utöver det vanliga att arbeta hos oss på Flying Tiger Copenhagen. Du ska veta vad god service är och brinna för att visa det! Våra kunder ska känna sig välkomna i våra butiker och lämna med ett leende på läpparna och en lust att komma tillbaka!

Vem är du?

Det ska vara roligt att vara i en Flying Tiger Copenhagen butik – både för våra kunder, och för dem som arbetar där. Därför är du en person som sprider positiv energi som smittar av sig på både kunder och kollegor. Du är bra på att hålla i ordning runt om kring dig och ser till att butiken alltid ser fin och inbjudande ut. Din främsta arbetsuppgift är att ta hand om våra kunder men innefattar också att packa upp leveranser, exponera varor och kassaarbete.

Vi förväntar oss att du är:

  • Serviceinriktad

  • Ansvarstagande

  • Lösningsorienterad och effektiv

  • Samarbetsvillig och flexibel

  • Någon som trivs med att arbeta i ett högt tempo

Vilka är vi?

Hos oss på Flying Tiger Copenhagen har vi starka värderingar som vägleder oss i allt vi gör – från hur vi tänker till hur vi arbetar. Vi har en öppen kultur där vi värdesätter varandra och skapar plats för olikheter, innovation och människor som är genuint intresserade av andra människor. Vi har en kreativ och informell atmosfär, där vi välkomnar mångfald och där samspel och team-spirit är nyckeln till framgång!

Låter det som något du vill vara en del av? Då finns det inget att vänta på – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Tjänsten är på 5-10 timmar per vecka och extra vid behov.

Tillträde 1/09/2026 eller enligt överenskommelse.

Du behöver ha fyllt 18 år för att tillträda denna tjänst.

Rekrytering kan ske löpande, så skynda dig att skicka in din ansökan! Sista ansökningsdag är 31/08/2026

title: Consultant Risicomanagement Verzekeren
description:
Als Consultant Risicomanagement Verzekeren speel jij een belangrijke rol in het beheersen en optimaliseren van complexe verzekeringsrisico’s binnen DAS. Je combineert inhoudelijke acceptatie-expertise met scherpe analyses van portefeuilles en adviseert interne en externe stakeholders over risico’s, rendement en beleid. Hoe jij dit precies vormgeeft? Dat is aan jou. We vertrouwen op jouw expertise en analytisch vermogen om tot de juiste afwegingen en oplossingen te komen.

Dit ga je doen als Consultant Risicomanagement Verzekeren

In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beoordelen van complexe risico’s én voor het analyseren en verbeteren van de verzekeringsportefeuille. Je werkt op tactisch en inhoudelijk niveau en treedt op als sparringpartner voor collega’s, intermediairs en management. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

Acceptatie van complexe en afwijkende risico’s

  • Beoordelen, offreren en accepteren van complexe en afwijkende particuliere en zakelijke verzekeringsrisico’s

  • Besluitvorming binnen senior mandaat over premies, clausules, uitzonderingen en afwijzingen

  • Afhandelen van complexe premie- en provisietransacties binnen het acceptatieproces

  • Fungeren als vraagbaak en escalatiepunt voor collega acceptanten

Ontwikkeling vakbekwaamheid en kennismanagement

  • Verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en borgen van een structureel opleidingsprogramma voor acceptanten van DAS en haar volmachtpartners.

  • Ontwerpen van opleidingscurricula, trainingsmaterialen, e-learningmodules en praktijkgerichte workshops op het gebied van acceptatie, risicomanagement en portefeuilleoptimalisatie.

  • Bewaken van de vakinhoudelijke kwaliteit en deskundigheid van acceptanten door middel van kennisontwikkeling, coaching en periodieke kennisoverdracht.

  • Fungeren als inhoudelijk expert en kennisdrager voor acceptatiebeleid, risicobeheersing en portefeuillemanagement.

Portefeuilleanalyse & naselectie

  • Uitvoeren van diepgaande analyses op portefeuille- en rendementsniveau

  • Signaleren van naselectiepotentie en formuleren van concrete verbetermaatregelen

  • Initiëren van naselectietrajecten, waaronder aanpassingen in dekking, voorwaarden of beëindiging van risico’s (exclusief fraude)

  • Monitoren van resultaten van genomen maatregelen en rapporteren aan stakeholders

  • Adviseren over structurele verbeteringen in acceptatie- en risicobeleid

Relatiebeheer, advies & kennisdeling

  • Optreden als inhoudelijk sparringpartner voor assurantieadviseurs, volmachten en verzekeraars

  • Adviseren van distributiepartners over risicoacceptatie, portefeuilleopbouw en inrichting

  • Ondersteunen van accountmanagement bij portefeuillebesprekingen en strategische trajecten

  • Het ontwerpen en verzorgen van kennissessies en inhoudelijke trainingen voor interne en externe relaties

  • Vertegenwoordigen van DAS bij projecten, tenders en relatie-evenementen

Beleid, kwaliteit & ontwikkeling

  • Actief bijdragen aan de doorontwikkeling van acceptatie- en risicobeheerbeleid

  • Signaleren van trends, knelpunten en opleidingsbehoeften

  • Coachen en begeleiden van collega’s binnen acceptatie en portefeuillebeheer

  • Opstellen van rapportages en analyses

  • Deelnemen aan multidisciplinaire projecten, zoals productontwikkeling, conversies en procesverbeteringen

Waar kom je terecht?

Je komt te werken binnen het Expertisecentrum binnen Commercie, waar je samenwerkt met collega’s binnen acceptatie en risicobeheer. In deze rol heb je een duidelijke advies- en expertpositie en werk je intensief samen met verschillende interne en externe stakeholders. Je levert een directe bijdrage aan een rendabele, beheerste en toekomstbestendige verzekeringsportefeuille.

Bij DAS werken we vanuit drie kernwaarden. 'Echt in Contact' betekent dat we helder, persoonlijk en respectvol communiceren: we luisteren, stellen de juiste vragen en zorgen voor duidelijke vervolgstappen. Met 'Samen Scherp' maken we samen het verschil door verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, focus aan te brengen en resultaat te leveren. En met 'Ruimte voor Nieuwsgierigheid' blijven we ons ontwikkelen, experimenteren we, en omarmen we vernieuwing zoals digitalisering en AI. Zo bouwen we elke dag aan vertrouwen, kwaliteit en oplossingen die mensen echt verder helpen.


Je werkt vanuit ons moderne hoofdkantoor in Amsterdam, met mogelijkheden voor thuiswerken. Het kantoor is gemakkelijk bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer, op slechts 5 minuten lopen van station Amsterdam Bijlmer ArenA.

  • HBO+ / WO werk- en denkniveau

  • In het bezit van Wft Basis, Schade particulier en zakelijk en geldige PE

  • Aanvullende vakinhoudelijke opleidingen (bijv. GA) zijn een pré

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen acceptatie en/of portefeuillebeheer

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het analyseren van complexe portefeuilles en rendementsvraagstukken

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en in staat om complexe materie helder over te brengen

  • Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor zowel interne als externe stakeholders

Bij DAS vinden we het belangrijk dat iedereen zich welkom voelt. We waarderen verschillen en streven naar een inclusieve werkomgeving. Daarom nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren precies zoals je bent.

Wat bieden wij

  • Een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) opgebouwd uit 8% vakantiegeld, 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering en de waarde van 48 bovenwettelijke vakantie-uren

  • Het IKB kan worden ingezet voor extra salaris, extra vakantie-uren kopen en de aanschaf van fiscaal vriendelijke doelen zoals de aankoop van een fiets, fitnessabonnement of telefoon

  • Bij voorkeur een contract tussen de 32 en 38 uur

  • 200 uur vakantie o.b.v. 38 uur, waarvan 48 uur als opbouw in je IKB

  • 1 Diversiteitsdag

  • Hybride werken en flexibel reizen

  • Budget voor een thuiswerkplek, een thuiswerkvergoeding en een reiskostenvergoeding

  • Een laptop en een vergoeding voor mobiele telefonie

  • Een goede pensioenregeling en een tegemoetkoming in de kosten van de zorgverzekering

  • Onbetaald verlofregeling

  • Vrijwillige deelname aan JongDAS of de actieve personeelsvereniging

  • Het kantoor van DAS in Amsterdam beschikt over een volledig modern ingerichte gym

title: Project Manager - Planning, Design and Construction
description:
Imagine a career at one of the nation's most advanced health networks.


Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.


LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary
This role is responsible for overseeing assigned capital projects at application enterprise locations. This includes full lifecycle project management—from planning and design through construction and project closeout. The role ensures successful execution of all project phases by coordinating with internal stakeholders, external consultants, contractors, and regulatory bodies to deliver projects on time, within budget, and in compliance with applicable codes and standards.

Job Duties
  • Manage planning, design, and construction of capital projects, including new buildings and renovations at applicable enterprise location.
  • Coordinate and oversee both external contractors and in-house maintenance staff during construction and renovation activities.
  • Develop, maintain, and take accountability for project scope, schedule, and budget in alignment with client needs and organizational goals.
  • Assist in preparation and management of contracts for architectural and engineering consultants and oversee design activities through construction administration.
  • Lead bidding, award, and construction execution processes to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and on schedule.
  • Oversee ancillary project components such as telecommunications/data coordination and relocation services.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree in construction management, architecture, or engineering.
  • 5 years directly related experience in healthcare or higher education capital project management.
  • Strong working knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems in healthcare, laboratory, and medical office environments.
  • Awareness of current industry trends and emerging technologies in MEP design.
  • Familiarity with AutoCAD and Revit for basic tasks and file manipulation.
  • Proficient in project management software including eBuilder, Microsoft Office, and Microsoft Project.
  • Working knowledge of building codes relevant to healthcare and research facilities.
  • Understanding of regulatory agencies such as the State Department of Health, City of Philadelphia, New Jersey Department of Health, and The Joint Commission.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Engineering, architectural, construction management, facilities management, or related certificates, licenses, and registrations.

Physical Demands
Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Ärrä-yrittäjäksi Turun Yliopistonkadulle!
description:
Hae yrittäjäksi Turun uudistuvaan Ärrään – rakenna menestystä kaupungin ydinkeskustassa

Oletko valmis ottamaan seuraavan askeleen työurallasi ja rakentamaan omaa menestystarinaasi yrittäjänä? Nyt sinulla on ainutlaatuinen mahdollisuus päästä vetämään uutta Ärrä-myymälää Turun vilkkaalle Yliopistonkadulle.

Reitan Convenience Finland etsii yrittäjää myymälään, joka uudistuu Ärrä-konseptin mukaiseksi vuoden 2027 alussa. Kyseessä on erinomainen liikepaikka Turun keskustassa, jossa yhdistyvät aktiivinen kaupunkielämä, monipuolinen asiakasvirta ja moderni convenience-kauppa.

Miksi juuri tämä mahdollisuus?

Ärrä on suomalaisille tuttu ja rakastettu brändi, joka kehittyy jatkuvasti vastaamaan asiakkaiden arjen tarpeisiin. Yliopistonkadun myymälässä pääset mukaan rakentamaan uuden ajan Ärrää yhdessä vahvan ketjun ja tukiorganisaation kanssa.

Yrittäjänä vastaat oman myymäläsi menestyksestä, henkilöstöstä ja asiakaskokemuksesta. Samalla saat käyttöösi Suomen suurimman franchise-ketjun toimintamallit, työkalut ja tuen.

Mitä tarjoamme yrittäjälle?

  • Valmis liiketoiminta ja tunnettu brändi
  • Aloitat toiminnan valmiissa liiketilassa keskeisellä sijainnilla. Hyödynnät tunnetun ketjun vahvuudet, valmiit toimintamallit ja uskollisen asiakaskunnan.
  • Kattava tuki yrittäjyyden tueksi
  • Et ole matkassa yksin. Saat tueksesi kokeneen kenttäorganisaation, koulutukset, markkinointituen sekä taloushallinnon palvelut.
  • Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan ansaintaan
  • Yrittäjänä johdat liiketoimintaasi omalla tyylilläsi, kehität myyntiä ja rakennat tulosta yhdessä henkilöstösi kanssa.
  • Selkeä ja matalan kynnyksen aloitus
  • Yrittäjyyden käynnistäminen on tehty mahdollisimman suoraviivaiseksi. Kauppias sijoittaa yritykseensä 10 000 euroa (SVOP) sekä järjestää liiketoimintaan liittyvät vakuudet. Lisäksi aloitusmaksu maksetaan yrityksen tuloksesta ensimmäisen toimintavuoden aikana. Reitan Convenience Finland tarjoaa valmiin franchise-konseptin sekä liiketoiminnan käynnistämiseen tarvittavat keskeiset ratkaisut.

Kenelle yrittäjyys sopii?

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos olet:

  • positiivinen ja energinen tekijä
  • asiakaspalvelusta innostuva ihmisten johtaja
  • myyntihenkinen ja tavoitteellinen
  • valmis ottamaan vastuuta liiketoiminnan tuloksesta
  • kiinnostunut kehittämään sekä itseäsi että tiimiäsi

Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta kaupasta, ravintola-alalta tai muusta palveluliiketoiminnasta. Myös esihenkilökokemus ja ketjuliiketoiminnan tuntemus ovat etuja, mutta ratkaisevinta ovat oikea asenne, yrittäjähenkisyys ja halu menestyä.

Sujuva suomen kielen taito on tehtävässä välttämätön.

Turun sydämessä, asiakkaiden arjessa

Yliopistonkatu on yksi Turun keskustan keskeisimmistä kauppakaduista. Uusi Ärrä tulee palvelemaan niin alueen asukkaita, opiskelijoita, työmatkalaisia kuin kaupungissa vierailevia asiakkaita. Tässä tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan myymälän tulevaisuutta näkyvällä paikalla ja osana jatkuvasti uudistuvaa convenience-liiketoimintaa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos haluat yrittäjäksi vahvan ketjun tuella ja nähdä oman työsi tulokset konkreettisesti, tämä mahdollisuus voi olla juuri sinua varten.

Jätä hakemuksesi jo tänään ja tule rakentamaan Turun uuden Ärrän menestystarinaa yhdessä Reitan Convenience Finlandin kanssa.

Yrittäjänä olet oman menestyksesi avain.

title: Data Programmer (UK - Hybrid)
description:
Join a team that's going places!

Every member of Celerion is involved in making a distinctive contribution to the health and well-being of people around the world. That's the sense of purpose shared by our employees. We are a performance-driven drug research company, operating in robust and growing markets. We have an exciting future and offer a strong development environment for our great employees.

Come be part of our Data Management and Biometrics team as a Data Programmer.

This full-time position will be attached to our Belfast, Northern Ireland clinical trial facility with a work-from-home/hybrid working arrangement available within the UK.

The purpose of the Data Programmer role is to develop and support clinical database programming activities and associated documentation involved in clinical trial set-up, conduct and close-out stages in line with protocol requirements, standard operating procedures (SOPs/PGs), Good Clinical Programming Practices (GXP), Clinical Data Interchange Standards (CDISC) and other applicable sponsor or regulatory requirements.

Essential Functions:

  • SAS Pre-lock programming - Deliver and support all pre-database lock SAS programming processes associated with data collection, reporting and cleaning
  • Data import and integration - Support data import programming and reconciliation activities as needed
  • Data transfer programming - Deliver and support raw/CDASH, lab only, CDISC/SDTM or sponsor specified custom data transfers
  • Process Improvements - Actively participate in process improvement initiatives
  • Quality/timelines - Ensure that data programming delivers quality outputs on time or better following good programming practices, including adequately-documented SAS code

This full-time position has an attractive salary and benefits package including pension, life assurance, permanent health insurance and private medical insurance.

Training will be provided on clinical research data programming skills.

Education and Skill requirements

  • Bachelor's degree with 1+ yrs programming experience OR comparable experience in related industry, previous experience with SAS and clinical data preferred.
  • Computer science, Mathematics or IT graduate applicants also considered.
  • Demonstrated communication and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated problem solving and decision making skills
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Internal Celerion candidates with strong clinical data review, data management or IT background will also be considered.
Celerion are an equal opportunities employer

   Souschef i BR - København V 
  Souschef hos BR 
 Dit ønske er, at udvikle dig til en stærk og dygtig leder, og du trives i et miljø, der - trods travlhed - er præget af en stemning, hvor vores kunder i alle aldre kan finde begejstring og inspiration blandt de kendte klassikere og de nyeste skud på legetøjsstammen. 

 Som souschef hos BR bliver du butikschefens højre hånd, og du er med til at skabe et team præget af samarbejde og fleksibilitet, hvor kunden og den gode vejledning og service er i centrum. Du bliver del af et hold af medarbejdere med en fælles begejstring for legetøj og ikke mindst for legebørn. At skabe den gode kundeoplevelse hos BR er meget mere end at sørge for fyldte hylder og en god bundlinje. Det er at evne at skabe den rette stemning, det er at støtte dine kolleger i at give den helt rette service, og det er at give kunderne en oplevelse, der får dem til at komme igen og igen. 

 Med andre ord, du får en spændende udviklingsstilling med masser af udfordringer, ansvar og fart over feltet, hvor du og resten af teamet får belønningen for jeres arbejde, når I giver kunderne den gode indkøbsoplevelse med smil og kvalitet, når ønsker bliver opfyldt. 

 Din opgave er først og fremmest at sikre, at kunderne får et fantastisk besøg hos os. Herudover skal du sikre varebestillinger, markedsføringsplanlægning, prisstyring, varepræsentationer og vareopfyldning. 

 Skab den rette stemning 
 En stor del af din arbejdsdag foregår i butikken, hvor du vejleder og hjælper kunderne. Som souschef går du forrest i teamet, og du skal være et forbillede, der motiverer dine kolleger til at følge dit eksempel. Du arbejder tæt sammen med butikschefen, og du forstår at formidle ledelsens visioner, så du støtter op om, at hele teamet er topmotiverede for at virkeliggøre dem. 

 Hvem er vores ny souschef? 
 
 Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring eller en uddannelse fra detailbranchen. 

 Du er serviceminded, fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket, når situationen kræver det. 

 Du har fokus på teamet, og du bidrager til det gode sammenhold. 

 Du kan lide, at der er travlt og forstår at styre og planlægge din hverdag. 
 
 Vi kan tilbyde dig 
 et spændende job med masser af udfordringer for et af Danmarks mest kendte brands af både børn, deres forældre og bedsteforældre. 

 Er det dig? 
 Så send os din ansøgning hurtigst muligt gennem linket her på siden. 

 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. 

   

 Det skal være en oplevelse at besøge BR. Hver gang. Uanset om vores kunder kommer for at købe eller for at ønske. Vi har det brede udvalg, den personlige betjening og plads til legebørn i alle aldre.

  • 실험실 소모품 구매 및 SAP 프로세싱

  • 공용 분석 구역 지원팀원 및 관련 부서와 원활한 커뮤니케이션

자격 요건

  • 품질 관리(QC) 또는 화학 산업 공장에서 2년 이상의 실험실 테스트 경험

  • 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 고객 중심으로 업무 수행할 수 있는 능력

  • 높은 수준의 안전 의식 및 실험실 내 안전 준수

  • 신체적 요구 능력 (보조장비/장치 구비 또는 미구비시)

    • 색깔/문자/그림 구별 능력

    • 사물을 식별 가능 (안경으로 시력 보정가능, 단 케미칼 취급소임에 따라 콘텍트 렌즈 착용으로 시력 보정은 불가합니다.)

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



The Solutions Consultant is passionate about supporting our Sales Team and customers technical questions regarding products and services. This person is accountable for exceeding monthly and quarterly quotas and driving adoption and utilization with customers and prospects in collaboration with internal teams and the broader Docusign partner ecosystem.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Solutions Consultant.

Responsibility

  • Prepare and deliver technical presentations explaining products or services to customers and prospective customers

  • Confer with customers and engineers to assess the solutions needs and to determine software requirements

  • Collaborate with sales teams to understand customer requirements and provide sales support

  • Secure and renew orders and arrange delivery

  • Plan and adapt products to meet customer needs

  • Help solve customer problems by creating demos, POC etc

  • Recommend improvements to customers, showing how changes will lower costs or increase production

  • Help in researching and developing new products


Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • 3+ years' experience as a technology solutions consultant

  • 3+ years' experience supporting sales teams and customers technical questions

  • 3+ years' experience helping customers solve problems and creating demos and POCs

  • Oral Fluent English

Preferred

  • Proficient in delivering software demonstrations in-person and virtually

  • Experience with technical business documentation like workflow diagrams, proposals, SOWs, RFPs and RFIs, etc

  • Proven experience working with employees at all levels of an organization

  • Familiarity with Enterprise-class software systems like ERP, CRM, and ECM systems

  • Familiarity with system integration methods such as web services, SOAP APIs, and REST APIs

  • Familiarity with web-based solutions, website development, HTML, XML, and structured data

  • Familiarity with electronic signature concepts

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Willingness to travel as needed


Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

title: Engineer - Test Engineering
description:
Job Description – Engineer – Test Engineering

Job Title: Engineer – Test Engineering
Department: Manufacturing Engineering / Test Engineering
Location: Hyderabad/ Mysuru (as applicable)
Experience: 2–5 Years
Industry: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Engineer – Test Engineering with 2–5 years of experience in the EMS industry. The candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing test strategies, supporting production testing, coordinating with ICT and FCT vendors, and ensuring effective test coverage to achieve high product quality and manufacturing efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement test strategies for new and existing electronic products.
  • Analyze product requirements, schematics, and specifications to define appropriate testing methodologies.
  • Work with ICT (In-Circuit Test) and FCT (Functional Circuit Test) vendors to determine test coverage and Design for Testability (DFT) requirements.
  • Prepare test plans, test procedures, and cost estimations for new product introductions (NPI).
  • Support the installation, qualification, and maintenance of production test equipment.
  • Troubleshoot test failures and coordinate with Manufacturing, Quality, Design, and Process Engineering teams to identify and resolve issues.
  • Ensure optimum test coverage to improve first-pass yield and reduce production defects.
  • Monitor test performance and recommend continuous process improvements.
  • Maintain documentation related to test fixtures, programs, validation reports, and engineering changes.
  • Support customer audits and quality improvement initiatives as required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 2–5 years of experience in Test Engineering within an Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) environment.

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with electronic testing equipment and test specifications.
  • Good understanding of ICT, FCT, DFT, and manufacturing test methodologies.
  • Knowledge of electronic components, PCB assemblies, and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Experience in creating test strategies and preparing cost estimations.
  • Ability to interpret circuit diagrams, BOMs, and product specifications.
  • Familiarity with NPI processes and production test implementation.
  • Basic understanding of quality standards and manufacturing best practices.

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  • Good planning, documentation, and organizational skills.
  • Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with automated test equipment (ATE), ICT, and FCT platforms.
  • Exposure to DFT analysis and test fixture development.
  • Knowledge of IPC standards and electronics manufacturing quality systems will be an added advantage.

Summary of Job Duties:

"This posting can fill a LMSW or LCSW position"

LMSW -
The Licensed Master Social Worker (LMSW) provides clinical psychosocial services and case management for the WPRCI patients and families in our outpatient clinical areas. Services include but are not limited to: initial psychosocial assessment with new patients; ongoing psychosocial assessment as needed during treatment process; development of treatment plans/interventions; coordination with inpatient Care Management/medical staff; advocacy for patient/family with healthcare providers and community resources; patient/family education, information and referrals; assistance with financial/social needs related to housing, transportation, food, medications, and access to treatment/clinical trials; interdisciplinary team coordination/communication; and assistance with mental health issues and emotional adjustment to illness, including emotional support, psychotherapy (individual, group, family, couples, children), crisis intervention, and grief counseling. Participates in program development under the supervision of LCSW staff. Participates in supervision process with LCSW toward obtaining LCSW.

LCSW -
Serves within multidisciplinary team to provide clinical psychosocial services for patients in the UAMS Cancer Service Line to include: initial psychosocial assessment with new patients; ongoing psychosocial assessment as needed during treatment process and beyond; development of treatment plans/interventions that are documented in the EMR; response to emotional components of illness, including adjustment to illness and grief counseling, psychotherapy (individual, couples, family, children), and crisis intervention. Provides direct counseling and education to patients/families regarding financial/social support to insure completion of treatment and access to clinical trials. Develops programs that offer specialty care to support them through the continuum of cancer treatment. Supervises graduate interns through their field experience and final requirements for graduation. Serves as liaison with other departments/agencies, both internal and external. Models positive collaboration/interaction with colleagues, management team, and other UAMS departments. Periodic travel and evening work may be required

title: KYB Analyst
description:
About seQura

seQura provides innovative, flexible and easy-to-use payment technologies that help merchants acquire, convert and retain more customers.

We make a difference sales performance by tailoring our solutions to different sectors, to address their unique pain points and deliver superior results in Retail, Education (EduQa), Optics (OptiQa), Repairs and Travel.

Each area will include a variety of activities, and you'll be able to choose from 34 different activities that best meet your needs to configure a plan that best works for you.

What you’ll need 🫲🏽

  • At least 2 years of experience in a similar position, and background in KYC/KYB & onboarding of merchants.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, or related field.

  • Banking or Fintech experience is a must.

  • Specific training in Financial Crime: AML, Sanctions, AB&C and/or Fraud will be a great plus.

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, in Spanish and English.

  • Organized, disciplined, structured and, you can manage your workload and communicate properly.

  • Strong analytical ability and attention to detail, and strong research skills.

  • A strong drive and enjoy working in a high paced operational environment.

  • Proactive, hands-on, and self-driven.

  • Detailed oriented and enjoy a structured way of working.

title: L3 Network Security Engineer (Managed Firewall | Network Infrastructure)
description:
About the Role:

Saint Fox is looking for an experienced L3 Network Security Engineer to own the design, deployment, and day-to-day management of enterprise network security infrastructure for our clients. This is a senior hands-on role. You will work across Cisco and Palo Alto environments, drive incident escalations to closure, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture decisions. You will sit within the Managed Firewall and Secure Access practice, working closely with Security Analysts and Principal Engineers to keep client environments stable, documented, and audit-ready.

Key Responsibilities:

Firewall Operations
• Design, deploy, and manage Cisco ASA and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) firewalls in enterprise and multi-site environments.
• Operate and tune Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls including policy management, App-ID, User-ID, and threat prevention profiles.
• Manage Palo Alto Panorama for centralised policy and device management across multiple firewalls.
• Perform rule-base reviews, clean-up, and optimisation on a scheduled basis to reduce attack surface and policy drift.
• Respond to and resolve L3 firewall incidents and escalations within agreed SLA windows.

Network Infrastructure
• Configure and manage Cisco Catalyst and Nexus switching platforms including VLANs, STP, VPC, and QoS.
• Administer Cisco Wireless infrastructure including WLC (Wireless LAN Controllers) and Cisco Access Points across campus and branch environments.
• Troubleshoot complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 network issues from physical through to application layer.
• Maintain and enforce network segmentation policies aligned to Zero Trust principles. Routing and Connectivity
• Configure and manage dynamic routing protocols including OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP.
• Manage site-to-site and remote-access VPN including Cisco AnyConnect and Palo Alto Global Protect.
• Support SD-WAN and SASE integration efforts where applicable

Operations and Governance
• Own change management for network security changes including planning, testing, and rollback procedures.
• Maintain accurate and current network diagrams, run books, and configuration documentation.
• Participate in vulnerability and patch management cycles for network devices.
• Support internal and external audits by providing evidence and configuration reviews.
• Provide mentoring and technical guidance to L1 and L2 engineers

Requirements

Experience
• 8 to 15 years of hands-on experience in network security engineering.
• At least 4 years working at L3 or equivalent senior engineer level.
• Demonstrated production experience with Cisco ASA and/or FTD firewalls.
• Demonstrated production experience with Palo Alto Networks NGFW and Panorama.
• Solid experience with Cisco Catalyst and Nexus switching in enterprise environments.
• Working experience with Cisco WLC and enterprise access point management.

Technical Skills
• Cisco Firewall: ACLs, NAT, VPN, HA, and Firepower management centre.
• Cisco Switching: VLAN, STP, RSTP, VPC/vPC, port-channel, QoS, and SPAN.
• Cisco Wireless: WLC management, AP provisioning, SSID design, RF planning basics, and client troubleshooting.
• Palo Alto: Security policies, NAT, decryption, URL filtering, Wildfire, Panorama, and HA configuration.
• Routing: OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, PBR, and route redistribution.
• VPN: IPsec, SSL-VPN, GlobalProtect, and AnyConnect.
• Packet analysis using Wireshark or equivalent.
• Working knowledge of NAC, 802.1X, and RADIUS.

Preferred Certifications:
• Required: CCNP Security or CCNP Enterprise (current and valid).
• Preferred: Palo Alto PCNSE (or working towards it).
• Preferred: Cisco CCIE Security or equivalent advanced certification.

Soft Skills:
• Clear communicator. You can explain a complex network problem to a non-technical stakeholder without burying them in acronyms.
• Methodical under pressure. You follow process during incidents and document what happened after ward.
• Self-directed. You manage your workload, flag blockers early, and do not wait to be chased.
• Collaborative. You work well with security analysts, project managers, and client technical teams

Benefits

Why Join St. Fox:

• Opportunity to work onsite at a leading customer location, enabling direct engagement with innovative projects.
• A collaborative and dynamic working environment focused on continuous learning and professional growth.
• Exposure to advanced technologies and ongoing training opportunities.
• Clear career progression pathways supported by experienced leadership.

What We Offer:

• An opportunity to work in a rapidly growing company with potential for personal and professional growth.
• Opportunity to work in a rapidly growing company with potential for personal and professional growth.
• A collaborative and inclusive culture that values each employee’s contribution towards our goals.
• Competitive compensation package including attractive bonus structures and benefits

How to Apply: Interested candidates should submit a detailed resume and a cover letter outlining their qualifications and experience relevant to the role applied for. Applications should be sent via our careers portal or to hr@stfox.com

St. Fox is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Messenger I- Koch Center (Evening Shift)
description:
About Us:

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

Exciting Opportunity at MSK: Join one of the nation’s leading healthcare institutions and build a meaningful career with purpose as a Messenger at our Koch Center location. Whether you’re seeking stability and excellent benefits or looking to grow your career in healthcare, this role offers the opportunity to make an important impact every day.

Service is at the heart of everything we do. As a Messenger, you will help support patient care by ensuring the safe, timely, and efficient transportation of pharmaceuticals, medical supplies and equipment, documents, laboratory specimens, and patients throughout MSK locations in New York City. Apply today to join our Transportation team!

Role overview:

  • Pick up and deliver mail between the Main Campus mailroom and other designated locations.
  • Retrieve and deliver medical instruments to Central Sterile Processing at designated pickup times.
  • Safely transport specimens, mail, treatments, and other materials from off-site locations to their designated destinations using approved containers.
  • Transport patients safely and courteously.
  • Communicate professionally and respectfully with patients, hospital staff, and colleagues.
  • Respond promptly to pickup requests from off-site locations and within the Main Campus.
  • Answer telephone calls clearly and professionally, identifying yourself and your location.
  • Obtain and document all required information from callers, including the caller’s name, time of call, extension, item being picked up, pickup location, recipient, and delivery priority.
  • Complete all required documentation related to pickups and deliveries.

Key qualifications:

  • Motivated to provide outstanding customer service.
  • Action-oriented and eager to take on new opportunities and challenges with urgency, energy, and enthusiasm.
  • Adaptable and able to adjust your approach to meet changing priorities and situational demands.
  • A sound decision-maker with the ability to make timely choices that keep operations moving forward.
  • Skilled at planning and prioritizing work to meet organizational goals and commitments.
  • Committed to maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, and reliability.

Core skills:

  • Prior courier or messenger experience is preferred.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Dedicated, dependable, motivated, and hardworking.
  • Basic knowledge of internet navigation and email.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and respond effectively to time-sensitive requests.

Additional information:

  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 2:00 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

title: Eurofins Ufaglærte laboratoriemedhjælpere til studiejob, weekend- og ferieafløsning, samt sabbatår | SmartRecruiters
description:
Ufaglærte laboratoriemedhjælpere til studiejob, weekend- og ferieafløsning, samt sabbatår  
   undefined 
              
               Vejen, Danmark   
                      

 Deltid 
 
    
  
 
  
 
  
 Firmabeskrivelse  

 
 Eurofins er et af Danmarks største laboratorier, hvor vi er stolte af at bidrage til sundhed og sikkerhed i samfundet, når vi dagligt udfører analyser for vores kunder af bl.a. fødevarer og foder, medicinalprodukter, byggematerialer og miljøanalyser af vand, jord og luft.   
 
  
 
  
 Stillingsbeskrivelse  

 
 Til laboratoriet i Vejen søger vi dygtige unge over 18 år, til stillinger som ufaglærte assistenter. Vi søger dig der er naturvidenskabeligt interesseret og er nysgerrig på at lære mere om processerne i forbindelse med analysearbejdet, som vores dygtige laboratorieteams udfører. Vi sørger for en grundig oplæring. Det er derfor ikke et krav at du tidligere har arbejdet i et laboratorium - men det er vigtigt at du har vilje og evner at tilegne dig ny viden og kan lide at følge procedurer. 

 Som laboratorieassistent bliver du en del af "Team Ung", der består af en bred vifte af studerende fra gymnasier og universitetet som har studiejob, samt især unge der arbejder i deres sabbatår. Et sabbatår ved os er et glimrende springbræt til et studiejob, når du starter din uddannelse. Her er der rig mulighed for at få indblik i de mangeartede opgaver og jobfunktioner der findes i vores laboratorier, som varetages af bl.a. laboranter, kemikere, mikrobiologer, miljøteknologer, ingeniører, farmaceuter, mm.   

 Arbejdet består i forskellige opgaver, der alle bidrager til produktionen i laboratorierne, som f.eks.: 
 
 Registrering af prøver 

 Prøveforberedelse 

 Arbejde med analyseinstrumenter 

 Forefaldende arbejde i laboratoriet, herunder opfyldning af forbrugsvarer 

 Oprydning og rengøring i afdelingen 
  
  
 
  
 Kvalifikationer  

 
 Dine faglige og personlige kompetencer er: 
 
 Du er interesseret i naturvidenskab 

 Du arbejder omhyggeligt og systematisk og forstår vigtigheden af kvalitet i arbejdet 

 Du trives med rutiner, er god til at arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver 

 Du er lærenem og har en positiv og fleksibel indstilling til tingene 

 Du er stabil i dit fremmøde og i din arbejdsindsats 

 Arbejdsopgaverne kræver at du forstår, skriver og taler dansk, samt har kendskab til Office-pakken 

 Du skal være fyldt 18 år 
  
  
 
  
 Yderligere informationer  

 
 Arbejdsstid
 
Du vil indgå i afdelingens arbejdsplan som vil aftales ved ansættelse.
 
Der er mulighed for både timeløns- og fuldtidsansættelse. 

 Arbejdssted
 
Ladelundvej 85, 6600 Vejen
 
(tæt på Esbjerg-motorvejen og kun et par kilometer fra togstationen i Brørup) 

 Tiltrædelse
 
Efter aftale 

 Vil du vide mere
 
Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os på HR-Danmark@sc.eurofinseu.com. Du kan læse mere om Eurofins på  www.eurofins.dk . 

 Ansøgning
 
Du søger stillingen online ved at klikke på "Jeg er interesseret". Ansøgninger sendt på mail tages ikke i betragtning. Send dit CV og evt. relevante bilag hurtigst muligt. Under "Besked til ansættelsesteamet" modtager vi meget gerne en kort motivation for din ansøgning. 

 I forbindelse med ansættelse, vil du blive bedt om at fremvise straffeattest.  

   

 Eurofins Scientific er en international life science virksomhed, som tilbyder et unikt udvalg af analyser til kunder inden for mange forskellige industrier, med det formål at gøre livet og vores miljø mere sikkert, sundere og mere bæredygtigt. Fra den mad du spiser, til vandet du drikker, til medicinen du anvender, arbejder Eurofins sammen med de største virksomheder i verden, for at understøtte, at de produkter virksomhederne udbyder er sikre, deres ingredienser er autentiske og at mærkningen på produkterne er korrekte. Eurofins er verdensledende inden for test af fødevarer, miljø, farmaceutiske og kosmetiske produkter, samt agro-science CRO services. Eurofins er ydermere en af de globale markedsledere inden for specifikke test og laboratorieservices inden for genomics, farmakologi, retsmedicin, CDMO, avanceret materialevidenskab, samt support til kliniske studier. 
 

 
På lidt mere end 30 år er Eurofins vokset fra at været et enkelt laboratorium i Nantes i Frankrig, til at bestå af 65.000 medarbejdere i et netværk af mere end 1000 selvstændige selskaber og over 950 laboratorier i 57 lande. Eurofins tilbyder en portefølje af mere end 200.000 analytiske metoder, til at evaluere sikkerhed, identitet, sammensætning, ægthed, oprindelse, sporbarhed og renhed af biologiske stoffer og produkter. Som en af de førende spillere inden for specialiseret klinisk diagnostisk test, tilbyder vi endvidere vi innovative klinisk diagnostiske testydelser.
 

 
I 2025 genererede Eurofins en samlet indtægt på 7,296 milliarder Euro og er i blandt de aktier, som har performet bedst i Europa over de sidste 20 år. 
 
  
 
  
   
 Ved at klikke på linket ovenfor eller et tredjepartslink i dette opslag, forlader du dette websted og går til et tredjepartswebsted, hvor tredjepartswebstedets vilkår og privatlivspolitik gælder.

title: Lead Talent Program Coordinator
description:
Job Posting:

Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best-in-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in.

The Lead Talent Program Coordinator serves as the lead coordinator for the planning, coordination, and execution of learning experiences across various programs both enterprise-wide and in market for Ferguson Academy. This role is responsible for leading the day-to-day coordination of high-impact, executive priority, Academy programs while helping establish consistent standards for learner experience, program execution, and operational excellence.

As a senior member of the coordination team, this individual serves as a lead resource and mentor to other Learning Experience Coordinators, partnering closely with Academy leaders, facilitators, vendors, Instructional Design, Business Learning, and the Events Planning team to deliver modern, engaging, and seamless learning experiences.

This role is based full-time at Ferguson's Tampa Headquarters in Ybor City, Florida, supporting Academy experiences hosted at headquarters, the future design and build out of our HQ learning space, as well as regional learning events.

Key Responsibilities:

Learning Experience Leadership

  • Serve as the lead coordinator for high-profile Academy programs and enterprise learning experiences.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance, mentoring, and coordination support to Learning Experience Coordinators.
  • Help establish and maintain consistent standards for learner experience and program execution across the Academy.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, modernize, and scale coordination processes and operational practices.
  • Serve as a trusted resource for Academy teams on learning experience coordination and operational best practices.

Program Execution & Learner Experience

  • Lead onsite execution of Academy learning programs, ensuring venue readiness, learner support, facilitator support, materials, schedules, and overall experience quality.
  • Coordinate participant communications and pre-program logistics to ensure learners are informed, prepared, and supported.
  • Support program budgets, vendor management, invoices, and billback processes.
  • Coordinate facilitator schedules, program calendars, room assignments, and delivery logistics across multiple programs and audiences.
  • Partner with Instructional Design, Business Learning, Insights, and Academy leadership to deliver engaging, polished learning experiences.
  • Help define and continuously improve standards for a modern, frictionless learner experience across Academy programs.

Workday Learning Administration & Reporting

  • Coordinate Workday Learning administration, including course setup, enrollment, session management, attendance tracking, and reporting.
  • Partner with HR Operations to maintain accurate learner data, rosters, completion records, and communications.
  • Support operational reporting related to participation, scheduling, utilization, and program delivery.
  • Partner with Learning Technology and HR Operations to improve operational workflows and learner experience within Workday Learning.

Events Partnership & Experience Planning

  • Partner closely with the Events Planning team to coordinate headquarters learning experiences, leadership programs, and regional learning events.
  • Influence future design of HQ learning facilities
  • Align logistics, learner communications, hospitality standards, and operational processes across Academy programs.
  • Support continuous improvement of onsite learning environments and participant experience.
  • Help develop scalable processes for travel coordination, venue management, scheduling, and event execution.

Academy Brand, Communications & Innovation

  • Reinforce the Ferguson Academy brand through consistent, learner-centered experiences and communications.
  • Lead coordination-related communications, including shared inbox management, learner outreach, facilitator communications, and scheduling.
  • Drive continuous improvement in learning coordination tools, templates, and operational workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to improve learner engagement, communication clarity, and overall program experience.
  • Support the continued evolution of Academy operations through modern, scalable, and technology-enabled practices.

Qualifications & Critical Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in program coordination, training delivery support, event management, or related learning and development roles.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple programs and priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience coordinating onsite events, leadership programs, or large-scale learning experiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, collaboration, and operational expertise.
  • Experience mentoring or serving as a lead resource for peers is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Workday Learning or similar learning management systems.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder partnership skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
  • High attention to detail with a strong focus on learner experience and operational excellence.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve processes, drive consistency, and modernize ways of working.
  • Strong customer service mindset with a passion for creating exceptional learning experiences.
  • Must be based at Ferguson's Tampa Headquarters in Ybor City, Florida, and work primarily from the office (minimum four days per week) to support headquarters-based and regional Academy experiences, with flexibility to work extended or adjusted hours during program delivery weeks.

At Ferguson, we care for each other. We value our well-being just as much as our hard work. We are committed to a holistic approach towards benefits plans and programs that support the mental, physical and financial well-being of our associates. Our competitive offering not only includes benefits like health, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance and a 401(k) with a company match, but our associates also enjoy additional meaningful and inclusive enhancements that are adaptable to their diverse situations and needs, including mental health coverage, gender affirming and family building benefits, paid parental leave, associate discounts, community involvement opportunities and more!

title: Employer Branding Specialist
description:
About Eneba

At Eneba, we’re building an open, safe and sustainable marketplace for the gamers of today and tomorrow. Our marketplace supports close to 20m+ active users (and growing fast!), provides a level of trust, safety and market accessibility unparalleled to none. We’re proud of what we’ve accomplished in such a short time and look forward to sharing this journey with you. Join us as we continue to scale, diversify our portfolio, and grow with the evolving community of gamers.

We’re the People Team. Besides finding and welcoming new team members, we ensure both individuals and teams are set up for success, play to their strengths, and are high-performing. In doing so, we show care and empower our colleagues as they collectively grow Eneba.

We also care deeply about productivity and scalability. Day to day, you’ll find us building and maintaining programs for talent acquisition, culture and inclusion, performance, learning and development, compensation, employee wellness and more.

Responsibilities

  • We're building something bold at Eneba - and we need the world's best talent to help us do it. As our Employer Branding Manager, you'll be the person who shapes how we show up as an employer. From our LinkedIn presence to how candidates feel after their first interview, you'll own it all.

    You'll sit in the Talent Acquisition team, work closely with Marketing, and leadership, and have genuine influence over how we attract top talent across Europe. This isn't a role for someone who wants to manage frameworks - it's for someone who wants to build things, move fast, and make an impact.

    • Own and evolve Eneba's employer value proposition (EVP) - make sure it's real, not just a slide.

    • Build and execute an employer branding strategy that strengthens both our external reputation and internal employee experience.

    • Shape how Eneba is perceived by current and future employees, ensuring a consistent and authentic employer brand inside and outside the company.

    • Create content that people actually want to engage with - employee stories, LinkedIn campaigns, behind-the-scenes, careers page copy, internal culture and engagement communications.

    • Partner with Marketing on creative assets, videos, and visual storytelling.

    • Work side by side with the TA team to make sure our brand lives throughout the entire candidate journey.

    • Partner with People and business leaders to drive employee advocacy initiatives and strengthen pride, engagement, and connection across the organization.

    • Own our presence on LinkedIn, Glassdoor, and other platforms - post, respond, grow.

    • Run targeted campaigns around key hiring pushes, events, and company milestones.

    • Track what matters: follower growth, engagement, Glassdoor ratings, application quality, referral rates.

    • Benchmark us against competitors in the gaming and tech space and tell us where we're winning and where we're not.

Requirements

    • 3–5 years in employer branding, people marketing, or recruitment marketing - you've done this before.

    • You've built or meaningfully grown an employer brand, ideally in a fast-paced tech or scale-up environment.

    • Strong content instincts - you can write, you have an eye for what works, and you understand what makes people stop scrolling.

    • You know LinkedIn Talent Solutions, Glassdoor, and similar platforms inside out.

    • Data doesn't scare you - you set KPIs, track them, and use the results to make better decisions.

    • Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal.

    • You don't wait to be told what to do - you spot the opportunity and go.

    Bonus points

    • Background in gaming, e-commerce, or marketplace businesses

    • You can put together a decent visual in Canva or Figma without needing to involve a designer for every small thing

    • Experience running employee advocacy or referral programmes

    #LI-DNP

    What it’s like to work at Eneba

    *Opportunity to join our Employee Stock Options program.

    *Opportunity to help scale a unique product.

    *Various bonus systems: performance-based, referral, additional paid leave, personal learning budget.

    *Paid volunteering opportunities.

    *Work location of your choice: office, remote, opportunity to work and travel.

    *Personal and professional growth at an exponential rate supported by well-defined feedback and promotion processes.

    *Please attach CV's in English.

    *To find out about how we handle your personal data, make sure to check out our Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



Docusign is seeking a Software Engineer to work on the next generation of our Search and Data Platform. As part of the Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) initiative, our team is transitioning customer-facing reporting and search capabilities to a modern, highly scalable cloud data platform. You will move beyond standard feature development to build the distributed infrastructure that allows millions of users to instantly discover, filter, and analyze their agreements. We are looking for a builder who has experience with modern search frameworks, distributed systems, and solving "never-been-done-before" problems at scale. You will work closely with product leaders from proof-of-concept to V1 release, ensuring our solutions are fault-tolerant, secure, and blazingly fast.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Manager, Machine Learning.

Responsibility

  • Build fault-tolerant, high-throughput search systems using microservices architecture

  • Lead the implementation and optimization of search clusters to ensure sub-second query performance across petabytes of data

  • Develop and deploy scalable services in Azure, leveraging containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code

  • Collaborate with Product Management to translate business requirements into technical designs, drive implementation, write ample test coverage, and oversee the release process

  • Conduct code reviews, and work with cross-site teams to drive engineering best practices

  • Identify and resolve production issues, ensuring 99.99% availability for critical search services


Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Informatics, or relevant fields

  • 3+ years of software development experience in object-oriented languages (C#, Java, C++, or Go)

  • 1+ years of experience with large-scale data systems and search engines (e.g., Elasticsearch, Solr)

  • 1+ years of experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka)

  • 1+ years of experience building services in public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP)

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Direct involvement in the design and operation of high-availability SaaS platforms (99.9%+ uptime)

  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools (Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps)


Wage Transparency



Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations:

California: $118,000.00 - $183,050.00 base salary

Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $111,900.00 - $162,250.00 base salary

This role is also eligible for the following:

  • Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre-established sales goals. Non-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance.
  • Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Global benefits provide options for the following:

  • Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region
  • Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement
  • Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment
  • Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions
  • Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements
  • Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life-changing events

Work Authorization Notice: Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship.


Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

title: Butikkmedarbeider till Lyko Kvadrat
description:
Hos Lyko finnes det ingen vanlige butikker. Vi endrer bildet av hva retail er og bør være! Vår Beauty Playground er ikke bare til for å være fin – den skal brukes. Vi elsker når krølltengene går i stykker etter mange testrunder, for det betyr at kundene våre føler, kjenner på, prøver og opplever på ordentlig. Akkurat slik det skal være! Vi vet at det bygger engasjement – og det er nettopp derfor kundene våre kommer tilbake. Beauty Playground er ikke bare en butikk, det er et sted der både beautyjunkies og de som "bare skulle ha en ny håndsåpe" føler seg hjemme.

Vi synes (selvfølgelig) at vår nettbutikk er fantastisk, men det er i våre fysiske butikker vi virkelig gjør en forskjell. Det er der vi møter kundene våre – og det er der magien skjer. I møtet med kunden kan du som butikkmedarbeider snu deres dag på bare noen sekunder. En kunde kommer inn, kanskje litt sliten etter dagen – og går ut med en rosa pose fylt med selvtillit, glød og følelsen av å ha blitt sett. Akkurat slik vil vi at det skal føles! WOW!

Vi søker nå etter tre nye kollegaer til vårt herlige team i Lyko Kvadrat, som kan jobbe 5 og 10 timer per uke. Dette er En fast stilling med seks måneders prøvetid ⭐

Hva du kommer til å fokusere på:
Sammen jobber vi hele tiden mot å gi kundene våre en opplevelse i verdensklasse, og i dette arbeidet står du som butikkmedarbeider i front. Som butikkmedarbeider hos oss på Lyko er du mye mer enn "bare" butikkmedarbeider – du er en rådgiver, inspirator og en viktig del av kundens opplevelse. Hos oss handler det om å møte hver kunde på ordentlig. Du tar kontakt, lytter og deler din kunnskap på en personlig måte – alltid med mål om å hjelpe kunden med å finne riktig produkt for deres behov. Det er slik vi skaper den magiske følelsen av å ha blitt både sett og boostet ✨

I tillegg til kundemøtene har du også ansvar for daglig drift, som inkluderer bestillinger, påfyll av varer og visuell kampanjeoppbygging. Du har også ansvar for helhetsinntrykket i butikken, at den er ren, fin og inspirerende – spotless, rett og slett!

For denne rollen tenker vi at du:

  • Elsker skjønnhet! Å dele kunnskap og ideer med kunder og kollegaer er det gøyeste du vet
  • Er en lidenskapelig selger som elsker kundemøtet, og drives av å oppnå resultater
  • Som person er du en prestisjeløs og engasjert energiskaper
  • Er fleksibel og trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team

  • Er trolig utdannet makeup-artist, frisør eller hudpleier
  • Er minst 18 år gammel

title: CEO Office - AI Neobank App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for strong operators to join the CEO Office for BJAK's AI Neobank app expansion.

This role is for someone who can help turn CEO priorities into execution across product, hiring, licensing, partnerships, market launch and daily operating rhythm.

What You'll Own

  • Drive CEO-level priorities from problem definition to execution. 

  • Track OKRs, decisions, blockers, owners and deadlines across teams. 

  • Support licensing applications, country expansion, hiring, partnerships and strategic projects. 

  • Prepare clear briefs, updates, research notes, meeting follow-ups and action trackers.

  • Work across product, engineering, finance, legal, compliance, operations and country teams. 

  • Identify execution gaps and push teams to close them. 

  • Own urgent business problems that do not fit neatly into one department.


What We're Looking For 

  • High-ownership business generalist with strong execution discipline. 

  • Clear writer, structured thinker and strong follow-through operator. 

  • Able to work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. 

  • Comfortable handling ambiguity, urgent problems and shifting priorities. 

  • Strong judgement on what matters, what is blocked and what needs escalation. 

  • Able to keep teams moving without creating unnecessary process. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, operations, strategy, fintech or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Turns unclear priorities into clear actions. 

  • Can chase, unblock and execute without being chased. 

  • Writes updates that make decisions easier. 

  • Stays calm when many things are moving at once. 

  • Cares about outcomes more than visibility.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings. 

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Australia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Australia.


Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Insurance Follow-Up Representative
description:
Imagine a career at one of the nation's most advanced health networks.


Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.


LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary
Works collaboratively with department leadership to review and manage open Accounts Receivable, accurately documenting follow-up activities resulting in the resolution of underpayments and denials. Conducts root cause analysis of denials and takes the action necessary to resolve the denial escalating accounts to management that need to be submitted to the provider representative for contracting action. Identifies denial and underpayment trends that require computer system modifications and recommends necessary to implement corrective action. Prepares reports for meetings with provider representative and senior leadership, as required.

Job Duties
  • Demonstrates knowledge of insurance carrier reimbursement requirements to evaluate underpayments that are related to insurance carrier clinical and payment policies.
  • Demonstrates the ability to apply LVHN insurance contracts terms to claim payment reviews and the ability to determine if the source of an underpayment is related to a contract management discrepancy, an underpayment, or a line item denial.
  • Conducts a root cause analysis of denials, taking the appropriate corrective action as required, escalating denial trends to management, and routing denials to the appropriate area for resolution.
  • Calculates and submits adjustment and refund requests utilizing the appropriate adjustment code, refund reason, and clearly documents the account history.
  • Identifies the patient out of pocket expense related to non-covered services, co-pays, deductible, and co-insurance allocating the patient responsibility to the patient within the timely filing limit.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of and compliance with established organizational and departmental policies, procedures, objectives and goals.
  • Works collaboratively with management to establish issue logs and account examples for meetings with the insurance carrier provider rep.
  • Responds and reviews all emails and correspondence within 24-48 hours, manages mail received from patients and insurance carriers for appropriate distribution.

Minimum Qualifications
  • High School Diploma/GED
  • 2 years of professional or facility billing and/or collections for all major third party payers or work experience in healthcare related field.
  • Excellent follow-up and verification skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Knowledge of insurance contracts, and regulations.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint applications.
  • Strong analytical, mathematical and organizational skills.
  • Successful Completion of DOE and Revenue Cycle Education Training within 3 months of hire.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree in Health Care Science, Business or related field.
  • CPAT - Certified Patient Accounting Technician - State of Pennsylvania

Physical Demands
Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.
