title: Demand Planner Storing en onderhoud
description:
Jouw energie in de plus

Als demand planner vertaal je klant-, markt- en assetontwikkelingen naar een scherp demand plan en help je Stedin vooruit in de energietransitie.

Waarom werken bij Stedin jou energie oplevert:

  • Direct impact op de energietransitie en een toekomstbestendig energienet.

  • Veel ruimte om demand planning, forecasting en de samenwerking tussen portfoliomanagement en S&OP verder te professionaliseren.

  • Hybride werken vanuit hartje Rotterdam in een betrokken en deskundig team.

Werk om trots op te zijn

De energietransitie zorgt voor een enorme toename in werk en complexiteit. Als demand planner zorg jij dat we grip krijgen op de vraag: je brengt de storingsprognose, onderhoudsplannen en vervangingsbehoefte vanuit Asset Management samen in één helder demand plan. Zo help je Stedin om vraag en aanbod beter op elkaar af te stemmen, knelpunten tijdig te signaleren en het portfolio voorspelbaar en uitvoerbaar te maken.

Een dag als demand planner:

  • Je start de dag met een verse dataset en een kop koffie. Terwijl je de laatste storingsprognose doorneemt, zie je waar de vraag verandert en wat dat betekent voor het demand plan.

  • Daarna stem je met portfolio managers af welke ontwikkelingen extra aandacht vragen en waar de forecast moet worden aangescherpt. Je maakt inzichtelijk waar knelpunten in de keten ontstaat en helpt mee om daar met het S&OP-team concrete acties op te zetten.

  • Lunchen doe je in het bedrijfsrestaurant met je collega’s. Of je loopt een rondje door de stad of langs de Maas.

  • Na de lunch werk je verder aan het verbeteren van het forecastingproces en de demand planning-structuur. Je denkt niet alleen mee over de inhoud, maar ook over hoe de samenwerking binnen S&OP slimmer en effectiever ingericht kan worden.

  • Aan het einde van de dag werk je je acties, mail en inzichten bij en kijk je terug op een afwisselende werkdag waarin analyse, samenwerking en continue verbetering samenkomen.

Hier laad jij van op

Alle financiële arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rij, weet je meteen waar je aan toe bent:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van maximaal € 6.207,- (bij 40 uur), 24,5 vakantiedagen en pensioenopbouw bij ABP waarbij wij 70% van de premie betalen.

  • Bovenop je salaris ontvang je een persoonlijk budget van 24% (inclusief 8% vakantiegeld). Jij kiest wat je met het budget doet: bijvoorbeeld extra salaris of (tot max. 35,5) verlofdagen. In onze rekentool zie je hoe het werkt.

  • Jaarlijks € 700,- (bruto) om te besteden aan je eigen energie, bijvoorbeeld voor je sportabonnement of je nieuwe sportkleding.

Daar komt dit nog bovenop:

  • Moderne thuiswerkfaciliteiten en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,40 per dag. Bij Stedin werken we 50% thuis en 50% op kantoor.

  • Reizen naar kantoor doe je met de ov-vrijregeling. Dat is een ov-kaart die je ook in je vrije tijd kan gebruiken. Of met de flexibele reisregeling, waarbij je zelf kiest, combineert en varieert hoe je naar je werk reist en een extra vergoeding krijgt als je met de fiets komt.

  • Jouw ontwikkeling staat centraal: events bezoeken met collega’s en trainingen en opleidingen volgen. Zo haal jij het beste uit jezelf.

Vol energie vooruit met team Portfoliomanagement

Als demand planner werk je in het Portfoliomanagementteam binnen Asset Management. Met datagedreven inzichten bouwen we aan een voorspelbaar en realiseerbaar portfolio. De sfeer is open en behulpzaam: collega’s houden elkaar goed op de hoogte, zoeken actief de samenwerking op en er is veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng en initiatief. Je werkt in hartje Rotterdam met koffie op de 6e, uitzicht vanaf de 10e en een verse lunch op de 18e.

Met deze kwaliteiten groei jij hier verder

Jij brengt structuur in complexe vraagstukken en weet hoofd- en bijzaken goed van elkaar te onderscheiden. Je bent analytisch sterk, kunt goed plannen en organiseren en schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende stakeholders en onderwerpen. Tegelijkertijd communiceer je helder en sta je stevig in je schoenen, zodat je inzichten ook echt landen in de organisatie.

Verder heb je:

  • Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van Supply Chain Management of Bedrijfskunde.

  • Ervaring met het werken met data en het overzichtelijk maken van informatie voor anderen.

  • Ervaring in een soortgelijke functie of aantoonbare affiniteit met demand planning, forecasting en ketensamenwerking.

Zet de stap naar jouw volgende uitdaging

We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten.

Dit is nog goed om te weten:

  • Je werkt in principe 40 uur per week. Wil je parttime werken? Dan is 36 of 32 uur ook een optie.

  • De sluitingsdatum van deze vacature is 14 augustus. De eerste gesprekken staan gepland op maandag 17 en woensdag 19 augustus.. Indien positief, vragen we je een assessment te maken en plannen we een tweede gesprek in op maandag 24 augustus of woensdag 26 augustus. Zo weet je snel waar je aan toe bent.

title: Onderwijskundige Onderwijsontwikkeling en kwaliteitsborging SGBO
description:
Functie

Hoe zorg je dat de opleiding van artsen past bij de voortdurende veranderingen in hun vakgebied? Hoe ontwerp je onderwijs dat niet alleen kennis overdraagt, maar professionals ook helpt zich persoonlijk te ontwikkelen in hun vak? En hoe vertaal je nieuwe onderwijskundige inzichten, evaluaties en kwaliteitsinformatie naar onderwijs dat echt beter wordt? Dat zijn de vraagstukken waar je als onderwijskundige binnen de SGBO dagelijks aan werkt.

De SGBO van het Radboudumc leidt al ruim 65 jaar artsen op tot bedrijfs- en verzekeringsarts. Dat doen we met een team van (eindverantwoordelijke) instituutsopleiders, wetenschappelijk docenten en gedragswetenschappers die zich iedere dag inzetten voor kwalitatief hoogwaardig medische vervolgopleidingen.

Je stapt in op een bijzonder moment. De komende jaren ontwikkelen we ons onderwijs verder volgens het onderwijsmodel van blended leren, waarin we de kracht van werkplekleren, fysiek onderwijs, online leren en AI optimaal met elkaar verbinden. Daarnaast werken we het komende jaar aan een curriculumherziening voor de opleiding Bedrijfsgeneeskunde. Voor jou is dit een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van onze opleidingen.

In deze ontwikkelingen trek jij de kar voor (eindverantwoordelijke) instituutsopleiders, docenten, teamleiders en het hoofd opleiding. Je bent architect voor curriculumontwikkeling, onderwijsontwerp en toetsing, en je initieert en begeleidt onderwijsvernieuwing. Samen met collega’s van de onderwijs- en ontwikkelgroep vertaal je onderwijskundige inzichten naar concrete verbeteringen in de dagelijkse onderwijspraktijk.

Je speelt een belangrijke rol in het ontwerpen van onderwijs en in de kwaliteitsborging ervan. Je zorgt ervoor dat kwaliteitszorg niet alleen een administratief proces is maar daadwerkelijk leidt tot beter onderwijs. Juist de combinatie maakt deze functie aantrekkelijk.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je vervult een voortrekkersrol bij onderwijskundige vraagstukken, onderwijsvernieuwing, blended leren en curriculumherziening.
  • Je signaleert kansen voor onderwijsinnovatie en weet hoe je bij innovatie AI en digitale leermiddelen in kan zetten.
  • Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen opleidingsvisie, curriculum, toetsing en uitvoering.
  • Je bent actief betrokken bij de kwaliteitscyclus (KOERS).
  • Je analyseert evaluaties, kwaliteitsinformatie en landelijke ontwikkelingen en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteringen.
  • Je schrijft onderwijskundige beleidsadviezen en vertaalt deze naar projectplannen.

Jouw werkplek

Je komt terecht in een betrokken en toegankelijk team van bedrijfsartsen en verzekeringsartsen, gedragswetenschappers, docenten kennis & wetenschap. Bij onderwijsontwikkeling en kwaliteitszorg zijn ook de onderwijs- en ontwikkelgroep, de kwaliteitsadviseur, de beleidsmedewerker en team evaluaties betrokken. We versterken ons onderwijs door samen te werken, kennis uit te wisselen en elkaar voortdurend te inspireren. Er is veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, nieuwe ideeën en professionele ontwikkeling.

De SGBO heeft kantoorwerplekken bij het Radboudumc en maakt gebruik van verschillende onderwijslocaties, zowel binnen als buiten het Radboudumc. Jouw werk doe je deels vanuit de kantoorwerkplekken, deels vanuit huis en ook ga je regelmatig naar de onderwijslocaties om het onderwijs om aiossen, (gast)docenten en SGBO-opleiders en –docenten te ontmoeten.
De SGBO verzorgt in Nijmegen de opleidingen tot bedrijfsarts en tot verzekeringsarts en vormt een zelfstandige eenheid binnen de afdeling Eerstelijnsgeneeskunde van het Radboudumc. De SGBO draagt ook bij aan studentenonderwijs wetenschappelijk onderzoek. De opleiding bestaat al ruim 65 jaar en heeft op dit moment zo'n 390 artsen in opleiding.

De afdeling Eerstelijnsgeneeskunde
Eerstelijnsgeneeskunde loopt voorop in het vormgeven van geïntegreerde zorg op het gebied van onderwijs, opleiding, onderzoek en patiëntenzorg. Samen met anderen werken we aan mensgerichte, houdbare en duurzame oplossingen voor belangrijke vraagstukken rondom de zorg van morgen en aan blijvende inzetbaarheid van onze (zorg)professionals.

Onze missie: ‘Wij ontwikkelen de medisch-generalistische zorg van de toekomst’

De afdeling bestaat uit de units onderzoek, onderwijs, opleidingen (voor huisarts, specialist ouderengeneeskunde, verslavingsarts, bedrijfsarts en verzekeringsarts) en patiëntenzorg. Ruim 360 eerstelijnsprofessionals werken dwars door deze units samen aan de ontwikkeling van de medisch-generalistische zorg. Daarmee is onze afdeling dé thuishaven voor medische professionals, docenten, opleiders en onderzoekers in de eerstelijnszorg.

De afdeling kent een cultuur van laagdrempelig inspireren, pionieren, ontplooien en verbinden die ELG-eigen is en die we ook vragen van onze medewerkers. Geïntegreerde zorg, de ontschotting van de zorg, is een speerpunt van onze afdeling. Dat zien we in onze intensieve samenwerking met lokale, regionale en landelijke partners en netwerken – binnen en buiten het ziekenhuis. Deze eerstelijns-synergie vormt de basis voor continuatie van onze traditie van pionieren en verdere ontwikkeling van kennis rondom de eerstelijnszorg.

Profiel

Je voelt je verantwoordelijk en toont eigenaarschap voor de ontwikkeling en kwaliteit van onze opleidingen. Je weet hoofd- en bijzaken van elkaar te onderscheiden en vertaalt complexe onderwijskundige vraagstukken naar concrete verbeteringen. Je werkt graag samen en weet mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen. Je bent analytisch en schrijft gemakkelijk beleidsstukken en projectplannen.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Een afgeronde wo-opleiding in onderwijskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in een voortrekkersrol bij onderwijsontwikkeling en -vernieuwing.
  • Aantoonbare expertise op het gebied van curriculumontwikkeling, leer- en toetsactiviteiten en kwaliteitsborging.
  • Organisatiesensitiviteit en het vermogen om verschillende belangen met elkaar te verbinden.
  • Goede analytische en schriftelijke vaardigheden.
  • Ervaring als docent in (post)academisch onderwijs.

Goed om te weten

  • Nieuwsgierig? Spreekt deze functie je aan, maar twijfel je of deze stap bij je past? Of ben je enthousiast maar past het net niet. Juist dan nodigen we je uit om contact met ons op te nemen: kitty.meijer@radboudumc.nl, tristan.garos@radboudumc.nl of marjolein.bastiaanssen@radboudumc.nl
    We vertellen je graag meer over het werk van een onderwijskundige en je kunt ook een dag meelopen. Zo kun je kennis maken met het team en zelf ervaren hoe het is om bij de SGBO te werken.
  • De sollicitatiegesprekken (twee rondes) vinden plaats op 3 september in de ochtend. Fijn als je hier alvast rekening mee houdt.
  • Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.

Wij werven zelf voor deze vacature. Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs; delen in je netwerk wél.

title: CEO Office - AI Neobank App
description:

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com.


The Role

You will join one of our established high-performing teams within the Betting division, as we invest in our core and future Betting products. You will be focusing on the delivery of technical and product-focused initiatives, to expand and scale up our industry's leading Sportsbook and Risk Management products.

One example is our Advanced Risk team, who were set up to challenge conventional wisdom about risk management for sports betting operators. Using new measures of liability that take account of correlations between different markets on an event, and by monitoring betting patterns from the moment an event is opened for betting, we apply margins asymmetrically in a way that helps operators to make higher profit margins, reduce volatility and improve customer experience with greater uptime and fewer rejected bets. Our software provides customers with a new level of flexibility over the way they manage their Sportsbooks to meet their financial objectives. Smart algorithms allow decisions about bets to be taken quickly at scale while enabling close control when desired, reminiscent of earlier days of sports betting.


How will you work?

Join a specially formed, highly skilled team delivering an innovative & intelligent product! Forming part of a multi-disciplinary Agile team of Software Engineers, Data Scientists, QA Engineers and a Product Manager, you will look to work closely to the fundamental principles of continuous delivery and empowered, high-performing teams.

We operate in a squad model to allow focus on the business top priorities, allowing exposure across multiple products while still maintaining strong ownership of your team’s domain.

If you are looking to tackle hard problems with smart solutions, collaborate with astute engineers and deliver high calibre code with an autonomous & performance focused approach that supports success, delivery & quality, then this is for you.

As a Senior Software Engineer 1 (SR1) you and your team will build highly distributed, real-time, dynamically scaling systems using modern CI/CD pipelines & cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for innovating, architecting, delivering & maintaining an industry-revolutionising product. You will lead execution of multi-sprint features or systems with measurable business impact.

We will lean on your technical expertise and your pragmatic approach to problem solving; working in a team that prioritises the principles of Agile delivery and continuous improvement. You will have a Data-driven, evidence-based mentality, comfortable with the principles of continuous experimentation and validation.


What skills do you have?

  • You will have expert level knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (C#, Java, JS, Kotlin, Python, PHP, Golang, C++)
  • Flexibility to work on all areas of the service stack, front-end, back-end, infrastructure etc.
  • You will have a strong understanding of the principles of good software design. Familiarity with core concepts such as information hiding, abstraction, module design, cohesion and coupling.
  • You will have strong software architecture knowledge, including architectural patterns and how to apply them to highly-scalable, fault-tolerant, observable microservices and systems.
  • You will have detailed knowledge of testing methodology (TDD) and designing high-quality testing suites resilient to changes in implementation.
  • You will have experience of source control, continuous integration, pipeline design, containerised workloads and infrastructure as code.
  • You will have experience in messaging and asynchronous communication technologies (RabbitMQ, Pulsar)
  • Understanding of Data Structures, Databases and Caching Technologies
  • You bring clarity to complex domains, rapidly developing a deep understanding and challenging unclear requirements. You lead conversations that drive alignment and uncover edge cases others might miss.
  • You will have experience in mentoring engineers both within and outside the immediate team.


It is advantageous for you to have knowledge of the following:

  • You will have expert knowledge of C#
  • Operation of Kubernetes Clusters
  • Building cloud native applications (AWS)
  • Front-end web technologies (React, shadcn)
  • Domain Driven Design
  • Mathematical Aptitude, particularly statistics
  • Data Engineering skills
  • Experience in building production grade software with Agentic AI


What we expect from our co-workers

  • Curiosity and strong desire to learn and improve.
  • Social skills, being able to act as a facilitator, can balance enabling others with individual contributions.
  • Time management and asynchronous communication skills relevant for a remote-first engineering organization.
  • Enthusiasm and ability to work collaboratively within a team.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Adherence to our core engineering principles of Aligned Autonomy, Psychological Safety and Continuous Improvement.

We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. Occasional travel may be required.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports.

title: International Admissions Counseling Lead

description:

title: Medical Education & Operations Lead
description:
At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb, RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:

Medical Education & Operations Lead

Position Overview

RayzeBio, a Bristol Myers Squibb company, is a dynamic biotechnology company headquartered in San Diego, CA. The company is focused on improving survival of people with cancer by harnessing the power of targeted radioisotopes. RayzeBio is developing innovative drugs against targets of solid tumors. Led by a successful and experienced entrepreneurial team, RayzeBio aims to be the global leader in radiopharmaceuticals.

The Medical Education & Operations Lead will serve as a senior leader within Medical Affairs, responsible for driving operational strategy, execution, and team effectiveness across the function. This role provides leadership and oversight for conference planning, annual medical planning, budget management, contract administration, review of sponsorships and grants, internal team training, Extended Medical Leadership Team operations, and other high-priority cross-functional initiatives. The position is pivotal in ensuring operational excellence and seamless execution of key medical affairs priorities. The role will report into the Head of Medical Capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Medical Operations Leadership

  • Lead the strategic planning and operational oversight of Medical Affairs activities, ensuring alignment across annual medical planning, execution priorities, and functional objectives.
  • Provide leadership for extended Medical Leadership Team and Department Hot Topics Meetings, including agenda planning, follow-up tracking, and coordination of key team initiatives.
  • Oversee internal medical team training and onboarding programs to strengthen team effectiveness, capability development, and operational consistency.
  • Direct oversight of core operational processes, including budget planning and tracking, contract management, and governance of sponsorship and grant review activities.
  • Lead cross-functional project management for key Medical Affairs initiatives, ensuring clear timelines, accountability, and effective execution across stakeholders.
  • Drive process excellence and continuous improvement across the function, including implementation of tools, systems, and scalable ways of working to enhance team performance.

Conference Planning & Team Oversight

  • Lead team oversight for conference planning and execution, including pre-congress planning, onsite coordination, and post-congress follow-up.
  • Ensure effective coordination of medical meetings, events, and congress-related activities in partnership with internal stakeholders, vendors, and external organizers.
  • Establish clear processes and accountability for conference logistics, deliverables, and resource planning to ensure high-quality execution.

Budget, Contracts, Sponsorships & Grants

  • Own and oversee the Medical Affairs budget, including planning, tracking, forecasting, and reconciliation in partnership with Finance.
  • Provide leadership for contract management processes across vendors, venues, and service providers, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and timely execution.
  • Review and oversee sponsorship and grant processes to ensure appropriate governance, alignment, and operational follow-through.
  • Identify risks, gaps, and opportunities across operational and financial processes, and implement improvements to strengthen execution and compliance.

Other Duties as Assigned

  • Adapt to changing priorities; take on additional projects and responsibilities as needs evolve.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience within pharmaceutical, life sciences, or medical affairs environments.
  • Familiarity with event planning, logistics, and operational support highly desirable.
  • Strong budget management, contract administration, and vendor coordination skills.
  • Proven experience managing SharePoint or similar digital collaboration platforms.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently, with strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to multi-task and manage competing priorities, with flexibility to travel as required for congress support.
  • Team-oriented with a high degree of professionalism, integrity, and customer service focus.
  • Leverages AI to drive program, portfolio, or functional performance through prioritization and scaled adoption

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

 Eurofins VBM Laboratoriet A/S (tæt ved Aalborg) søger dygtige medarbejdere til en fuldtidsstilling som laboratoriemedhjælper med start snarligt og mindst et år frem.

 Prøveforberedelse af jord- og bygningsaffalds-prøver.

 Du har sabbatår mindst frem til sommeren 2026

 Yderligere informationer  

 
 Vi tilbyder

Du kan læse mere om Eurofins VBM på  www.VBMlab.dk  og  www.eurofins.dk .

title: Putkiasentaja (Tampere+lähikunnat)
description:
Hei sinä putkiasentaja! Oletko vailla töitä ja sinulta löytyy kokemusta etenkin saneerauspuolen kohteista?

Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme putkiasentajaa Tampereelle ja lähikuntiin. Töitä on tarjolla ainakin 4kk ajalle. Osaavalle tekijälle töitä voi olla pidemmällekin ajalle. Putkiasentajan tehtävässä asennetaan lämpö- ja vesijohtoputkia puristamalla ja hitsaamalla. Yrityksessä löytyy osaamista sekä uudis-, että saneerauspuolelle. Työkohteet ovat pääsääntöisesti saneerauskohteita, mutta myös uudiskohteita on työnalla. Työkohde sijaitsee tällä hetkellä Tampereella Hervannassa.

Olisi hienoa, jos olisit kerryttänyt jonkin verran kokemusta putkiasentajan tehtävistä. Toivomme kokemusta etenkin saneerauspuolelta. Ensisijaisesti etsimme tehtäävään hieman kokeneempaa putkiasentajaa. Etuna tehtävään on TIG-hitsaus taito, mutta se ei ole kuitenkaan ole täysin pakollista. Asiakasyrityksemme tarjoaa kokemusta omaaville henkilöille varmasti alaan nähden kilpailukykyistä palkkaa. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää ennen kaikkea itsenäistä työotetta sekä reipasta ja motivoitunutta asennetta työtä kohtaan. Edellytämme hakijoilta B-ajokorttia. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus helpottaa työmaalle pääsyä.

Töitä tehdään päivätöinä ma-pe 40h/vko. Työsuhteessa noudatetaan talotekniikka LVI-toimialan työehtosopimusta.

title: Funding Management Specialist
description:
At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

About the Role

The primary objective of this role is to safeguard continuity of patient funding by ensuring the accurate, compliant, and timely management of funding documentation, approvals, and customer account maintenance.

The role requires proactive collaboration with healthcare professionals (HCPs), funding bodies, patients, and internal stakeholders to establish and maintain valid funding arrangements, supporting uninterrupted access to patient care.

It is responsible for completing all necessary funding verification, approval processes, and account setup activities for both NHS-funded and self-funded patients. Customer and patient records are maintained across multiple systems, including SAP, Evolve, SAP CRM ICE, and PCRM.

The position combines administrative execution with customer interaction, involving both inbound and outbound communication with HCPs, patients, Field Sales teams, and Technical Consultants. Performance is measured against defined service levels, quality standards, compliance requirements, and key performance indicators (KPIs).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set up and maintain customer and patient accounts, ensuring all funding information is complete, accurate, and compliant with company procedures
  • Liaise with healthcare professionals and other stakeholders to obtain, validate, and update funding documentation where required
  • Manage workloads effectively through a shared team inbox, ensuring timely processing and fair distribution of tasks
  • Proactively monitor funding expiry dates and follow up with customers and funding providers to ensure continuity of patient funding
  • Update payer information accurately when customers change address, hospital, or funding arrangements
  • Process warranty pump information to support uninterrupted patient care
  • Investigate invoice queries and gather supporting information for disputed invoices prior to escalation through formal dispute processes
  • Complete pump serial number transfers and account updates in line with regulatory and compliance requirements
  • Identify and resolve duplicate accounts and data quality issues in a timely manner
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient, compliant, and continuously improving funding, account management, and invoicing processes
  • Maintain a strong understanding of all Funding Management activities and support cross-training within the team
  • Regularly review and update the team Training Matrix, identifying training needs and development opportunities
  • Maintain a personal Development Plan aligned with agreed short- and long-term business and personal objectives

Key Measures & Expected Results:

  • Accountable for ensuring continuity of Funding
  • Turnaround time from start to completion of new account set-up
  • Minimise backlog (of cases with funding/approvals pending, or dispute cases)
  • On or above-target compliance with set quality standards on contact handling procedures for HCPs with funding queries, and system usage

Qualifications:

Required

  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in a customer support, funding, accounts, or administrative role involving customer account setup and maintenance
  • Experience managing funding arrangements, ideally involving third-party payers
  • Experience handling customer invoicing queries via email
  • Strong administrative, organisational, and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Numerate with sound understanding of financial and invoicing processes
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (filtering, sorting, data extraction, dataset manipulation, reporting)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven experience working within defined financial, administrative, compliance, and customer service procedures
  • Flexible and adaptable approach, with ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Competent in using multiple systems simultaneously while maintaining data accuracy and quality

Preferred

  • Experience in funding, accounts, or customer support within medical devices, healthcare, or regulated industries
  • Knowledge of diabetes therapies and/or medical devices
  • Understanding of the UK healthcare system, including NHS funding pathways
  • Touch-typing proficiency
  • Experience with SAP, CRM systems, and Microsoft Office applications

#BetterDaysStartNow

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

Benefits & Compensation

MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.


About MiniMed

We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes. Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey — meeting them where and how they need it.

  • Clear writer, structured thinker and strong follow-through operator. 

Help us create a better future, quicker

As the subject matter expert for marine operations in Offshore O&M, you will be responsible for marine assurance processes and the selection and vetting of vessels.

What you’ll be doing

Developing, implementing and updating marine assurance processes and procedures for vessel acceptance at operational sites, ensuring they remain fit for purpose, you will develop, implement and update minimum requirements for vessels based on lessons learned, legislative updates, industry best practices and site-specific needs.

Participating in tender processes for marine services and O&M marine logistics tenders from a technical perspective, including but not limited to identification of potential suppliers, preparation of Scope of Works and contribution to the technical evaluation, you will manage, monitor and evaluate these frameworks to ensure contractors deliver as per our requirements whilst optimising marine operations and reducing operational costs.

Defining and assessing relevant KPIs associated to the marine logistics fleet as well as supporting the development and implementation of O&M logistics strategies for new operational windfarms based on windfarm requirements and industry best practices, you will analyse and recommend new sustainable vessel and decarbonisation strategies for logistics. You will also assist HSE and Environmental teams with marine-related incidents at O&M sites.

title: Respiratory Equipment Technician
description:
Imagine a career at one of the nation's most advanced health networks.


Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.


LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary
Performs inventory, cleaning, sterilizing, and replenishing equipment and supplies and identifies equipment due for preventative maintenance and places work orders for repair. Oversees the process of equipment handling and disinfection of reusable respiratory critical care equipment.

Job Duties
  • Assists in the pick-up and collection of soiled patient equipment to the designated cleaning area.
  • Assists in the turnover and set-up of equipment by cleaning all patient care equipment, performing appropriate self-diagnostic tests on equipment, and ensuring all needed equipment is available for patient care/procedures.
  • Inspects, monitors, and verifies patient medical equipment is in good working condition.
  • Ensures proper functioning of respiratory equipment by providing functional safety testing of all critical care life support equipment.
  • Redistributes cleaned patient medical devices upon request by a respiratory therapist and to an established equipment location/unit to maintain par levels.
  • Manages medical gas cylinders and ensures safe storage and transport.
  • Orders, tracks, and monitors equipment inventory and rental equipment program.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Must be 18 years old or older
  • Ability to interact with many levels of healthcare professionals and the general public.
  • Ability to adhere to infection control guidelines related to cleaning clinical equipment.
  • Ability to pay attention to detail in equipment assembly and when checking for proper operation.
  • Understanding of computers and ability to learn new software support.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Maintenance training from respective vendors for life support equipment maintenance.
  • Computer training on Lawson and Score Sleep Software.

Physical Demands
Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Project Coordinator, Corporate Events
description:
Building a Brand Starts with a Story

FIRST is a leading global brand experience agency providing Content, Creative, Digital Technology, Management & Delivery, and Data & Insights services. For 30 years, we have utilized three flexible delivery models: Embedded teams, Corporate Campus operations, and a Full-Service Agency.

Managing over 37,000 events & projects annually across 110 countries, FIRST serves 130+ brands, specializing in Fortune 500 companies within the Financial Services, Technology, Healthcare, Media, and Professional Services sectors. FIRST is part of the broader Encore family of companies. Encore is a global leader in event production and technology.

Consistently recognized for excellence, recent honors include 2026 Chief Marketer Agency of the Year, the Ad Net Zero Award for sustainability, and more.

Learn more at

What You Would Get To Do

As a Project Coordinator, you will support the planning and delivery of virtual, in-person, and hybrid events for high-touch clients. You will help coordinate event logistics, budget tracking, registration, transportation, food and beverage, and onsite staffing while contributing creative solutions and exceptional service.

This is an excellent opportunity for an entry-level event planner to build corporate event experience alongside a dynamic team of event professionals. Domestic travel is required.

Your Contributions

  • Support the planning and execution of virtual, in-person, and hybrid events.
  • Coordinate events from creative concept and initial briefing through delivery and reconciliation.
  • Assist with budget management, site selection, hotel and venue coordination, registration, transportation, food and beverage, décor, staffing, name badges, materials, and shipping.
  • Support event management teams with onsite execution.
  • Keep team members and internal stakeholders informed of relevant logistical details through timely, effective communications.
  • Help ensure events adhere to client operating standards.
  • Maintain accurate and timely event budgets, invoices, and reconciliations.
  • Share best practices and insights regarding suppliers, services, and venues.
  • Proactively contribute ideas and creative solutions that enhance each event.

What We Are Looking For

Please be aware that we know experience does not always look like we describe it. If you believe you would be an excellent fit for this role, please apply - we would love to see how you could fit at FIRST.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 1–2 years of experience, including entry-level venue sourcing, meeting planning, and team support.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with colleagues, clients, vendors, and suppliers.
  • Resourceful, creative problem-solving skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues at all levels while also working independently.

title: Senior CRM Specialist
description:
Grandstand (Nasdaq: GRSD) is the intelligence layer of sports, gaming and entertainment. We build the brands people trust, the data our partners depend on, and the technology this industry runs on with exceptional people, not shortcuts.

OpticOdds delivers enterprise-grade data infrastructure to B2B partners worldwide, while OddsJam and RotoWire put that same real-time intelligence directly into the hands of consumers. On the gaming and entertainment side, our portfolio includes some of the biggest names in the space: , , , and . Our flagship sites reach millions of consumers every month.

We're the first, and only, U.S. publicly traded company of our kind, and the first company to win EGR's Affiliate of the Year three times. We hold every hire to the same five standards: Taste, Agency, Speed, Craft, Responsibility.

As a Senior CRM Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in driving the commercial success of our CRM programme. You'll take ownership of customer journey optimisation, testing, segmentation and automation across multiple brands and international markets, ensuring every communication is designed to maximise engagement, retention and revenue.

Working closely with Commercial, Product, Data and Operations teams, you'll identify opportunities to improve customer lifecycle marketing, build sophisticated automated journeys and continually optimise performance through data-driven decision making.

This role is ideal for someone who is commercially minded, highly analytical and naturally curious, someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies quickly and taking ownership of delivering measurable business results.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of CRM performance across all customer communications, continually identifying opportunities to increase engagement, conversion, retention and overall revenue.
  • Lead the CRM testing roadmap, developing a culture of continuous experimentation through A/B and multivariate testing across customer journeys, content, timing, segmentation and personalisation.
  • Own and evolve customer segmentation strategies, ensuring every communication reaches the right customer at the right time using behavioural, transactional and lifecycle data.
  • Continuously analyse journey performance, proactively identifying opportunities to optimise automations, improve customer experience and maximise commercial return.
  • Take responsibility for identifying new CRM opportunities independently, bringing forward ideas backed by data and seeing them through to implementation.
  • Design, build and optimise automated customer lifecycle journeys across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation.
  • Develop dynamic and personalised CRM campaigns across Email, SMS, Push Notifications and emerging engagement channels.
  • Partner with Commercial, Product, Data and Operations teams to ensure CRM activity supports wider business objectives and revenue targets.
  • Build and optimise landing pages that support CRM campaigns and improve conversion performance.
  • Monitor campaign performance and produce regular reporting with clear commercial insights and recommendations.
  • Maintain excellent database hygiene, customer segmentation and GDPR compliance.
  • Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate campaign creation, reporting, analysis and personalisation while maintaining high editorial standards.
  • Stay informed on emerging CRM technologies, AI capabilities and industry best practices, recommending new approaches that improve team performance.
  • Support and mentor junior CRM team members while promoting best practices across the wider business.

Requirements

Essential

  • 4+ years' experience in CRM, Lifecycle Marketing or Marketing Automation.
  • Proven experience delivering measurable commercial growth through CRM optimisation and customer lifecycle marketing.
  • Strong experience building and managing complex automated customer journeys.
  • Excellent understanding of customer segmentation, personalisation and lifecycle marketing.
  • Experience leading structured testing programmes and using data to drive commercial decisions.
  • Highly analytical with the ability to identify opportunities independently and take ownership through to delivery.
  • A proactive, self-starting mindset with excellent problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment.
  • Confident working autonomously, researching solutions and driving projects forward with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple brands and priorities simultaneously.

Desirable

  • Previous experience within the online gambling, sports betting or affiliate marketing industry, with a proven track record of delivering successful CRM initiatives.
  • Hands-on experience using Bloomreach Engagement.
  • Experience with HTML/CSS for email development.
  • Experience using reporting platforms such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve CRM production, reporting and customer personalisation.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do.

You'll be naturally curious, commercially minded and constantly looking for ways to improve performance. You'll enjoy digging into data, finding opportunities others have missed and taking ownership of delivering measurable results. You're someone who learns quickly, thrives on solving problems independently and is comfortable challenging the status quo in pursuit of better customer experiences and stronger commercial outcomes.

You'll be equally comfortable collaborating with stakeholders across the business or rolling up your sleeves to build, test and optimise campaigns yourself.

Perks & Benefits

  • Comprehensive private Healthcare Insurance
  • Flexible work environment and home office available
  • Home office allowance
  • Gym & Leisure Allowance
  • All the hardware and software you need to be successful
  • Regular company events and social outings, activities, Spot Awards and a Monthly Social Club
  • Access to courses for Personal and Career Development
  • Company Paid Volunteer Day

description:

betterpeople A/S søger på vegne af Rotpunkt Aarhus en salgs- & indretningskonsulent.

Rotpunkt

Rotpunkt Køkken tilbyder kvalitetsløsninger inden for køkken, bad og garderobe med fokus på tysk kvalitet, funktionelt design og individuelle løsninger. Virksomheden hjælper kunder med at realisere deres boligdrømme gennem professionel rådgivning og skræddersyede løsninger, der matcher både behov og livsstil.

Rotpunkt Aarhus er i vækst og er præget af høje ambitioner, korte beslutningsveje og et stærkt fokus på kundeoplevelsen. Kulturen er uformel, engageret og præget af et tæt samarbejde, hvor faglighed, ansvar og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Skab unikke køkkenløsninger og stærke kunderelationer

Som salgs- & indretningskonsulent hos Rotpunkt bliver du en central del af showroomet i Aarhus, hvor din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe stærke kundeoplevelser og omsætte kundernes ønsker til inspirerende og funktionelle løsninger inden for køkken, bad og garderobe.

Du følger kunden gennem hele salgsprocessen – fra den første dialog og behovsafdækning til design, tilbudsgivning, ordre og opfølgning frem mod den endelige levering. Gennem professionel rådgivning, høj faglighed og en naturlig forståelse for kundens behov skaber du løsninger, der kombinerer design, funktionalitet og kvalitet.

Stillingen er en udpræget salgsrolle, hvor du motiveres af at skabe resultater og opbygge langvarige kunderelationer. Samtidig bliver du en del af et dedikeret team, hvor samarbejde, videndeling og faglig udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du får en høj grad af selvstændighed, stor indflydelse på dine projekter og mulighed for at arbejde med attraktive løsninger i høj kvalitet.

Du kombinerer køkkenfaglighed, salg og stærk kunderådgivning

For at få succes i rollen er det afgørende, at du har erfaring fra køkkenbranchen og en solid forståelse for den rådgivende salgsproces. Du trives med kundekontakten, forstår at afdække kundernes behov og motiveres af at skabe løsninger, der både giver tilfredse kunder og stærke salgsresultater.

Vi forestiller os, at du har flere års erfaring med salg af køkkenløsninger og er vant til selvstændigt at drive komplekse salgs- og rådgivningsforløb. Du har sans for indretning, design og materialer og evner at omsætte kundernes idéer til inspirerende og funktionelle løsninger.

Som person arbejder du struktureret og selvstændigt, tager ansvar for dine projekter og følger naturligt dine kunder hele vejen gennem processen. Samtidig trives du i et team, hvor samarbejde, ordentlighed og høj faglighed er med til at skabe de bedste kundeoplevelser.

Et kvalitetsprodukt, stærkt fællesskab og gode udviklingsmuligheder

Hos Rotpunkt bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høje ambitioner og et kvalitetsprodukt, du kan være stolt af. Du får en grundig introduktion til virksomhedens produkter og arbejdsgange, så du bliver klædt godt på til rollen. Samtidig får du stor frihed under ansvar i din hverdag.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og arbejdsglæde prioriteres højt. Kulturen er uformel, beslutningsvejene er korte, og du får mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling i takt med virksomhedens fortsatte vækst.

description:

Leads, supervises, and supports Substation and Telecom crews by coordinating daily field operations, enforcing safety and quality standards, managing tools and equipment, resolving technical issues, maintaining documentation, coaching team members, ensuring compliance with company and regulatory requirements, directing emergency response activities, and performing additional duties to sustain safe, reliable, and efficient work execution.

title: QA Automation Engineer (Python)

The customer is a UK-based financial services provider specializing in digital banking solutions. Operating on a fully cloud-based platform, the company offers a range of innovative products, including savings accounts, loans, and mortgages, designed to cater to specific customer needs. With a strong focus on simplicity, agility, and customer-centric design, they aim to modernize the banking experience. The company is regulated by the UK’s financial authorities and has earned recognition for its innovative approach in the financial services sector.

The project is focused on developing and enhancing digital banking solutions for a UK-based bank, delivering straightforward savings and mortgage products through modern, customer-centric platforms. The initiative aims to improve user experience, streamline financial services, and support the bank’s growth through secure, scalable, and innovative digital technologies.

  • Experience with Python / Behave.
  • Experience with AWS services.
  • Experience with playwright.
  • Experience with automated test tools.
  • Ability to draw in and coordinate resources from across the business in order to address issues.

Nice to haves:

  • Test ISQTB certified.

  • Degree/Advanced degree and/or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

Reasons why this job would be interesting to you:

  • Experience in teamwork with leaders in FinTech, Healthcare, Retail, Telecom, and others. Andersen cooperates with such businesses as Samsung, Siemens, Johnson & Johnson, BNP Paribas, Ryanair, Mercedes, TUI, Verivox, Allianz, T-Systems, etc..
  • The opportunity to change the project and/or develop expertise in an interesting business domain.

  • Guarantee of professional, financial, and career growth! The company has introduced systems of mentoring and adaptation for each new employee.

title: Kainuun vastaanottokeskuksen sosiaaliohjaaja
description:
Oletko sosiaali- ja asiakaspalvelutyön osaaja? Haluatko tehdä ihmisläheistä ja merkityksellistä työtä monimuotoisessa työyhteisössä?

Haemme nyt sosiaaliohjaajaa yksikköömme Kainuuseen! Rooli on kokoaikainen ja työsuhde solmitaan toistaiseksi voimassa olevana.

Babando tuottaa Maahanmuuttoviraston toimeksiantona vastaanottokeskuspalveluita Kajaanissa. Babando on moderni sosiaali- ja terveysalan kasvuyritys ja valtakunnallinen toimija, jonka tiimillä on vuosien kokemus vastaanottokeskusten menestyksekkäästä operoinnista ja johtamisesta. Tuotamme ensiluokkaisia vastaanottopalveluja sotaa paenneille tilapäistä suojelua saaville henkilöille sekä turvapaikanhakijoille. Nykyiset yksikkömme sijaitsevat Kainuussa ja Rovaniemellä.

Sosiaaliohjaajan työnkuva Vastaanottokeskuksen sosiaaliohjaajana vastaat vastaanottopalveluihin kuuluvista lakisääteisistä sosiaalihuollon palveluista. Työnkuvaasi kuuluu muun muassa turvapaikanhakijoiden ja tilapäistä suojelua saavien neuvontaa ja ohjausta, hyvinvoinnin seuraamista ja edistämistä, palvelun- ja tuen tarpeen arviointia, etuuskäsittelyä, lausuntojen laatimista ja tarvittavan avun tarjoamista ilmenneissä ongelma- ja kriisitilanteissa. Vastuullasi on vahvistaa vastaanottokeskuksessa majoittuvien yksilöiden ja perheiden toimintakykyä sekä luoda turvallista yleisilmapiiriä. Työ on päivätyötä. Tukenasi on Babandon valtakunnallinen sosiaalityöntiimi ja yksikössäsi työskentelee myös sosiaalityöntekijä. Työ on moniammatillista tiimityötä.

Mitä edellytämme vastaanottokeskuksen sosiaaliohjaajalta? Edellytämme sinulta sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (817/2015) mukaista pätevyyttä ja oikeutta käyttää sosiaaliohjaajan ammattinimikettä. Vastaanottopalveluista ja sosiaalihuollosta säädettyjen lakien perusteellinen tuntemus on työssä tärkeää. Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen työskentelystä vastaanottokeskuksessa, monikulttuurisessa ja -ammatillisessa työyhteisössä sekä kokemuksen työskentelystä tulkin kanssa. Ajokortti, hyvä IT-osaaminen sekä hyvät suomen ja englannin kielen taidot ovat välttämättömiä työssä. Lisäksi arvostamme laajempaa kielitaitoa.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos koet vastaanottokeskustyön merkitykselliseksi ja sinulla on aito halu olla vaikuttamassa positiivisesti ja ennaltaehkäisevästi apua tarvitsevien elämäntilanteeseen. Odotamme sinulta kykyä ottaa itsenäisesti vastuuta ja työskennellä terävällä ja määrätietoisella otteella nopeasti muuttuvassa ympäristössä. Hyvät kommunikointi- ja yhteistyötaidot ovat työssä ensiarvoisen tärkeitä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle? Tarjoamme sinulle huikean mahdollisuuden päästä tekemään työtä merkityksellisen asian äärellä. Vastaanottokeskuksen sosiaaliohjaajan työssä pääset kartuttamaan ammatillista osaamistasi ja opit työskentelystä monikulttuurisessa ja -ammatillisessa ympäristössä. Tarjoamme sinulle ammatillisesti arvokkaan tilaisuuden kehittyä, menestyä ja samanaikaisesti vaikuttaa positiivisesti satojen ihmisten elämiin.

Työsuhteen ehtojen ja palkkauksen osalta noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Palkkauksessa huomioidaan myös hakijan aikaisempi työkokemus. Työsuhde solmitaan Babando Oy:n kanssa. Työsuhteen alussa noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.

Koetko, että sinulla olisi edellytykset menestyä tässä työtehtävässä? Täytä hakemus ja muistahan liittää mukaan CV:si! Haku päättyy 20.8.2026:https://babando.teamtailor.com/jobs/8177381-kainuun-vastaanottokeskuksen-sosiaaliohjaaja?promotion=2133264-trackable-share-link-tyomarkkinatori

Toimithan hakemuksesi pian, sillä rooli täytetään heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä!

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa vastaanottokeskuksen johtaja Emma Juntunen 10.8.2026 alkaen, emma.juntunen@babando.fi tai 044 710 1448.

title: Digitaliseringskonsulent til AI, RPA og udvikling på tværs af Solrød Kommune
description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle og implementere AI- og RPA-løsninger, der skaber reel værdi i en kommunal organisation?

Solrød Kommune søger en digitaliseringskonsulent, der kan kombinere teknisk udvikling med organisatorisk forståelse og tydelig kommunikation på tværs af kommunens centre. Du skal både kunne se mulighederne i RPA og AI sammen med ledere og medarbejdere – og kunne omsætte dem til konkrete løsninger gennem udvikling, prompts, dokumentation, drift og forankring.

I Solrød Kommune har vi gennem flere år arbejdet målrettet med RPA og har i dag omkring 70 robotter i drift, som er udviklet i tæt samarbejde med kommunens fagområder. Vi ønsker at styrke arbejdet yderligere og samtidig øge anvendelsen af AI med henblik på en stadig mere effektiv opgaveløsning. Derfor søger vi en profil, der trives i krydsfeltet mellem teknologi, organisation og udvikling.

Jobbet

Der er tale om en stilling med både praktiske udviklingsopgaver, driftsansvar og en central rolle i at udvikle organisationen digitalt. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med en erfaren kollega på området med henblik på at omsætte faglige behov til løsninger, der kan bruges i hverdagen i hele kommunen.

Du skal blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Planlægning og afholdelse af møder, workshops og dialogforløb, der udbreder kendskabet til mulighederne med RPA og AI.
  • Afdækning af behov og arbejdsgange i tæt samarbejde med ledere og medarbejdere i kommunens centre.
  • Udarbejdelse af procesbeskrivelser, business cases, dokumentation og beslutningsoplæg.
  • Udvikling, test og vedligeholdelse af RPA-løsninger, fx i Microsoft Power Automate og relevante scripting- eller automatiseringsværktøjer.
  • Drift, fejlhåndtering og videreudvikling af eksisterende RPA-robotter.
  • Udvikling og kvalificering af AI-løsninger, herunder prompter, use cases, arbejdsgange og organisatorisk implementering.
  • Rådgivning om ansvarlig anvendelse af AI, herunder governance, compliance og praktisk brug i en kommunal kontekst.
  • Deltagelse i interne og tværkommunale netværk om RPA, AI og digitalisering.
Om dig

Du bliver en vigtig drivkraft i arbejdet med at udvikle, drifte og implementere RPA- og AI-løsninger på tværs af Solrød Kommune. Vi søger en profil, der både kan arbejde teknisk i løsningerne og skabe tillid i dialogen med organisationen. Du er nysgerrig på arbejdsgange, kan stille de rigtige spørgsmål og har blik for, hvordan digitale løsninger kan skabe værdi i praksis.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med RPA – både praktisk design, udvikling, test, drift og videreudvikling.
  • Har teknisk og organisatorisk forståelse for AI og gerne erfaring med at udvikle, afprøve og forbedre prompter eller AI-understøttede arbejdsgange.
  • Kan omsætte faglige behov til konkrete automatiseringer, AI-løsninger eller digitale forbedringer.
  • Er god til at kommunikere og kan formidle tekniske muligheder på en måde, der giver mening for ledere og medarbejdere.
  • Kan facilitere dialoger, workshops og afklaringsforløb, hvor nye muligheder bliver gjort konkrete.
  • Har forståelse for dokumentation, dataflows, systemafhængigheder og stabil drift.
  • Trives med både selvstændige udviklingsopgaver og tæt samarbejde med mange forskellige interessenter.
  • Har lyst til at lære nyt og være med til at forme kommunens videre arbejde med RPA og AI.
Om os

Du bliver ansat i digitaliseringsteamet, der hører under Center for HR, Politik og Digitalisering. I teamet får du gode kolleger med forskellige arbejdsområder, og vi arbejder tæt sammen, hjælper hinanden og sparrer på tværs. Du vil samtidig også have en tilknytning til IT-afdelingen.

Du kommer til at arbejde med RPA, AI og digitalisering i tæt samarbejde med en anden digitaliseringskonsulent og centerets øvrige digitaliseringskonsulenter.

Vi er en flad organisation, hvor der er kort vej fra idé til handling. Du vil opleve en uformel tone på alle niveauer, et stærkt kollegaskab og frihed under ansvar.

Løn og arbejdsvilkår

I Solrød Kommune prioriterer vi fleksibilitet for medarbejderne, og som administrativ medarbejder har du særlige muligheder. Du vil blive en del af vores ordning ”Fleksibel Fredag”, som betyder, at du som medarbejder fra uge til uge selv kan vælge, om du om fredagen vil arbejde hjemme, holde fleksfri eller arbejde på arbejdspladsen.

Derudover er det efter aftale med nærmeste leder muligt at arbejde hjemmefra endnu én dag om ugen fra mandag til torsdag, hvis det giver mening for opgaveløsningen.

Lønnen fastsættes ud fra kvalifikationer med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation. Lønintervallet for stillingen er 35.950 kr./mdr. til 43.007 kr./mdr. Begge beløb er ekskl. pension. Arbejdstiden er 37 timer pr. uge med tiltrædelse pr. 01.10.2026 eller efter aftale.

Vil du vide mere?

Du kan læse mere om Solrød Kommune på www.solrod.dk. Du er også velkommen til at kontakte Teamleder for Digitalisering Johan Brink Vase på tlf. 2167 7184 eller digitaliseringskonsulent Trine Mogensen på tlf. 5618 2014.

Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfrist er torsdag den 20. august 2026 kl. 12. Vi stiler efter at holde første samtale tirsdag d. 25. august. Anden samtale afholdes torsdag d. 27. august.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.


I Solrød Kommune gør vi en forskel sammen med borgerne. Vi arbejder for at virkeliggøre byrådets vision om, at Solrød skal være det bedste sted at leve og bo. Som arbejdsplads er vi et fællesskab, hvor vi løfter opgaverne på tværs af institutioner og afdelinger, og hvor du som medarbejder er en vigtig medspiller. Vi er i bevægelse og har hele tiden fokus på at lære og blive bedre. Vi tager ansvar for at løse opgaverne med blik for helheden, og du har som medarbejder indflydelse på løsningen af opgaverne og på din arbejdsplads.

title: Medical Imaging Technologist I
description:
At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we bring over 50 years of experience delivering industry‑leading clinical trial endpoint technology solutions. As clinical trials continue to evolve through innovation and advanced technologies, we remain at the forefront—unlocking better evidence through faster, integrated insights. As a Neuroscience Medical Imaging Technologist I, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, accuracy, and compliance of imaging data that supports global clinical research and improves patient outcomes.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Medical, dental coverage.
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Engaging employee programs

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Review and analyze imaging data to ensure clarity, quality, and technical adequacy
  • Verify imaging data compliance with study protocols and regulatory requirements
  • Generate and track image queries and collaborate with Sponsors and Sites to resolve issues
  • Perform protocol‑based image measurements and analysis, as applicable
  • Prepare and review images for submission to clients and regulatory agencies
  • Support study startup and site activities, including reviewing site evaluations and assisting with imaging protocol training
  • Provide technical support to clinical sites for imaging‑related questions and challenges
  • Assist in the development and review of imaging guidelines, manuals, and study documentation
  • Support user acceptance testing and contribute to enhancements of imaging tools and systems
  • Maintain and archive imaging data in accordance with study and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve issues and improve processes
  • Assist in training and onboarding of new team members
  • Perform image data translation and digitization activities

What We Look For

  • Current board certification in a relevant imaging modality required
  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in a health or science‑related field preferred
  • 2+ years of experience as an Imaging Technologist or in a clinical research environment
  • Experience with at least one imaging modality
  • Familiarity with clinical trials or pharmaceutical environments preferred
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and imaging‑related systems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • High attention to detail with a commitment to quality and accuracy
  • Strong organizational and problem‑solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a virtual, global environment
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing demands
  • Willingness to travel as needed (approximately 0–15%) and perform extended computer‑based work

At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life‑changing therapies to patients faster.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst to lead requirements discovery, analysis, and documentation for complex platform integration projects. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution by mapping end-to-end system flows, analyzing APIs, and translating requirements into clear, actionable specifications for engineering and delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead requirements gathering workshops, stakeholder interviews, and functional solution analysis.

  • Produce and maintain core documentation, including BRDs, FRDs, process maps, transaction flows, and sequence diagrams.

  • Create and manage Jira epics, features, user stories, and detailed acceptance criteria.

  • Analyze and document system integrations, API interfaces, and data payloads (JSON, Swagger/OpenAPI).

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Architecture teams throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

  • Track and manage integration dependencies, system boundaries, scope changes, and cross-platform data movement.

  • Support end-to-end testing, issue triage, UAT/CAT, and release readiness activities.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Technical BA supporting complex enterprise platforms or system integrations.

  • Functional understanding of API documentation, Swagger/OpenAPI specifications, JSON payloads, and sequence diagrams.

  • Strong proficiency in Agile methodologies and hands-on experience in Jira (epics, user stories, acceptance criteria).

  • Ability to map complex business processes, transaction flows, system interactions, and integration dependencies.

  • Solid understanding of authentication concepts, tokens, endpoints, environment configurations, and release setups.

  • Experience working within regulated, compliance-driven, or audit-heavy environments.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven ability to translate technical constraints into business impacts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-volume, transactional domains (e.g., FinTech, Payments, E-commerce, or High-Load Platforms).

  • Practical SQL knowledge for data analysis and troubleshooting.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., IREB/CPRE, SAFe, CBAP).

  • Background supporting multi-market, multi-region, or multi-jurisdiction platform implementations.

description:

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Checker

Department: Grocery

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

Our Checkers are often the last face a customer sees before leaving the store, which makes this role one of the most important ones we have. In this position, you'll operate the register, assist customers throughout the store, and help make sure every visit ends on a great note.

If you enjoy working with people, take pride in doing things right, and want to be part of a team that truly cares about customers, we'd love to have you join us.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile, learning their names, and going out of your way to make every visit a great one

  • Operate the cash register accurately, scanning product and processing all payment types including cash, checks, credit cards, coupons, food stamps, WIC checks, rain checks, in-store charges, and lottery transactions

  • Count back change, issue receipts, and provide cash refunds or credit memorandums for returned merchandise as needed

  • Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal guidelines regarding WIC, food stamps, and the sale of tobacco, liquor, and lottery tickets

  • Place merchandise in bags or boxes, assist courtesy personnel, and support drive-up and carry-out service

  • Stay knowledgeable of item look-up numbers, department numbers, item features, and weekly ad price changes and sale items

  • Stock, face, and rotate merchandise, clean shelves, understand shelf tags, and take customers to items when requested

  • Keep the register area clean, ensure adequate supplies are available, and report improper cash levels in the cash drawer

  • Verify register balances at the beginning and end of each shift where applicable

  • Communicate clearly on the intercom or telephone and answer customer questions, following up with appropriate personnel as needed

  • Stay aware of your surroundings to support store safety and security

  • Assist store management with displays and decorations for special promotions and events as needed

  • Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned

  • Maintain strict adherence to personal hygiene, dress standards, and all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines

  • Report to work when scheduled and on time

Your Skills

To be successful, you'll need to be able to:

  • Follow detailed written or verbal instructions and work through tasks with a few concrete variables

  • Perform arithmetic calculations involving fractions, decimals, and percentages

  • Understand and follow verbal or demonstrated directions and communicate supply needs orally or in writing

  • Work effectively as part of a team to deliver a great customer experience

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of HWH, Perishables, and Store Operations; Service Managers

Education and Experience

  • No education or experience requirements; we will provide all the training you need to succeed

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

​

Working Environment

This is a fast-paced role in a retail store environment where you will be on your feet throughout your shift. You will have frequent exposure to temperature extremes and possible dampness, as well as occasional exposure to equipment movement hazards and cleaning chemicals or solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

The anticipated hourly starting wage for this position is $13.00 to $16.25 depending on experience.

For information on company benefits visit Benefits | Hy-Vee.

Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary
Performs laboratory procedures to obtain results for providers to utilize in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases. Uses established procedures and protocols that require the exercise of independent judgment and responsibility with minimal technical supervision.

Job Duties
  • Performs any high complexity, moderate complexity, or waived laboratory testing in the assigned testing department. Utilizes advanced clinical laboratory instrumentation and methodologies according to departmental standard operating procedures. Confirms, verifies, and reports the results of this testing independently exercising broad independent judgment. Monitors results for reasonableness and critical values.
  • Conducts and evaluates established quality control per departmental standard operating procedures. Troubleshoots and reports to management any unacceptable quality control before reporting patient results.
  • Performs required departmental preventative maintenance per standard operating procedures.
  • Recognizes and corrects instrument or procedural malfunctions within the scope of the standard operating procedures and records troubleshooting activities.
  • Provides clinical orientation and/or training of new employees/students.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree as a medical laboratory technician or
  • Specialized Diploma must meet CLIA grandfathered MLT regulations.
  • Less than 1 year of experience and a clinical laboratory internship.
  • Demonstrated technical skills. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific documents.
  • Ability to read, understand, and speak basic English.
  • Demonstrated ability to use/learn the computer system, word processing, e-mail, and applicable software programs.
  • Demonstrated dependability/flexibility in meeting scheduling needs of the department, unit, and hospital.
  • Ability to apply common mathematical skills.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Preferred Qualifications
  • MLT - Medical Laboratory Technician ASCP - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire

Physical Demands
Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Yleislääkäri, Porvoo
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt Yleislääkäriä Porvooseen.

Mitä työ yleislääkärinä Porvoon Terveystalossa pitää sisällään?

Työ Porvoon Terveystalossa on työ, joka mukautuu sinun arkeesi sopivaksi. Yleislääkärinä Porvoossa pääset tekemään monipuolisia yleislääkäritasoisia tehtäviä sekä hyödyntämään ja kasvattamaan osaamistasi eri asiakasryhmien parissa. Työtehtävät koostuvat ajanvarauksellisesta vastaanottotyöstä työterveys-, vakuutus- ja yksityisasiakkaiden parissa.

Terveystalo on mukana 65 vuotta täyttäneiden valinnanvapauskokeilussa. Tavoitteena on parantaa terveyspalveluiden saatavuutta, vahvistaa valinnanvapautta ja keventää julkisen terveydenhuollon kuormitusta. Kokeilun myötä yleislääkärin työkuva monipuolistuu ja laajentuu. Tarjoamme ammattilaisillemme työn tueksi perehdytyksen, koulutuspaketin ja kollegiaalisen substanssituen.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Monipuolisen ja joustavan vastaanottotyön
  • Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen tai vuokraprosentin
  • Mahdollisuuden erikoistua tai pätevöityä työterveyslääkäriksi
  • Nimetyn lääkäri- ja asiantuntijavastaavan tukemaan sujuvaa arkeasi ja perehdyttämään sinut Terveystaloon

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

  • Suomessa laillistettua lääketieteen lisensiaatin tutkintoa
  • Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa
  • Vahvaa asiakaspalveluasennetta ja kykyä kohdata erilaisia asiakkaita ammattitietoisesti.
  • Hyviä viestintätaitoja ja kykyä työskennellä tiimissä.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jätä yhteystietosi hakulomakkeen kautta tai ole yhteydessä matalalla kynnyksellä ura-asiantuntija Saara Mitruseen numeroon 050 349 4112 tai sähköpostitse saara.mitrunen@terveystalo.com.
