If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for strong operators to join the CEO Office for BJAK's AI Neobank app expansion.

This role is for someone who can help turn CEO priorities into execution across product, hiring, licensing, partnerships, market launch and daily operating rhythm.

What You'll Own

  • Drive CEO-level priorities from problem definition to execution. 

  • Track OKRs, decisions, blockers, owners and deadlines across teams. 

  • Support licensing applications, country expansion, hiring, partnerships and strategic projects. 

  • Prepare clear briefs, updates, research notes, meeting follow-ups and action trackers.

  • Work across product, engineering, finance, legal, compliance, operations and country teams. 

  • Identify execution gaps and push teams to close them. 

  • Own urgent business problems that do not fit neatly into one department.


What We're Looking For 

  • High-ownership business generalist with strong execution discipline. 

  • Clear writer, structured thinker and strong follow-through operator. 

  • Able to work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. 

  • Comfortable handling ambiguity, urgent problems and shifting priorities. 

  • Strong judgement on what matters, what is blocked and what needs escalation. 

  • Able to keep teams moving without creating unnecessary process. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, operations, strategy, fintech or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Turns unclear priorities into clear actions. 

  • Can chase, unblock and execute without being chased. 

  • Writes updates that make decisions easier. 

  • Stays calm when many things are moving at once. 

  • Cares about outcomes more than visibility.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings. 

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Thailand. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Thailand.


Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Team Leader till Postnord TPL Norrköping
description:
Bli en del av vårt team
Vi behöver förstärka teamet och söker en Team Leader till ett av våra lager i Norrköping. I rollen som Team Leader ingår du i den dagliga produktionen, samt leder en del av verksamheten och utvecklar både medarbetare och verksamheten mot fastställda mål.

I rollen som Team Leader är ditt viktigaste uppdrag att motivera medarbetarna att nå våra mål samt stötta dem i sin utveckling, samt se till att arbetet utförs enligt fasta rutiner och kundöverenskommelser för att driva den dagliga produktionen. Ditt ansvar är att planera och prioritera utifrån order, leveransschema för ansvarsområdet och till stöd har du Production Manager, som är din närmsta chef.

Som Team Leader stöttar du ditt team i deras dagliga arbetsuppgifter vilket omfattar att plocka gods efter order, packa gods, påfyllning, truckkörning, returhantering och intag och uttag av gods. Fler arbetsuppgifter för rollen är att hantera avvikelser, arbeta med förbättringar och lära upp nya kollegor.

Du kommer arbeta i ett team med mycket kunskap som ska förvaltas på bästa möjliga vis. Du arbetar tätt ihop med övriga ledare på lagret.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • God förmåga att förmedla instruktioner och kunskaper på svenska i tal och skrift
  • Gymnasieutbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
  • Yrkeserfarenhet av produktion och/eller logistik och lager
  • Tidigare erfarenhet av ledarskap
  • God datorvana i Office paketet
  • Truckkort med behörighet A1-A4 & B1-B3
  • Flexibilitet att arbeta varierande arbetstider

Om dig
Du har en bra ledarskaps- och problemlösningsförmåga, samt bra på att kommunicera muntligt och brinner för ledarskap och trivs att ha ansvar. Du är drivande i att utveckla processer och följa policys, riktlinjer och rutiner, där du följer upp och vid behov vidtar korrigerande och förebyggande åtgärder för att undvika avvikelser.

Du har ett stort engagemang och god samarbetsförmåga och en god arbetsmoral som du använder för att få gruppen att gemensamt nå sina mål där ni bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat. Du är självständig, noggrann, strukturerad och van att prioritera arbetsmoment med en social förmåga. Tydlighet och god kommunikation är en stor del av din vardag.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas på personliga egenskaper och erfarenhet.

Vi levererar
Anställning sker enligt Transportavtalet med anställningsformen tillsvidare heltid med provanställning 6 månader. Lön är enligt kollektivavtal och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Alla våra medarbetare får en grundlig introduktion för att säkerhetsställa de bästa förutsättningarna för att ta sig an sina arbetsuppgifter.

Vi erbjuder dig ett arbete med stor variation i arbetsinnehåll, en god laganda och en arbetsmiljö där din röst är viktig. Människor med olika bakgrund arbetar hos oss. Du kommer därför vara en del av en arbetsplats med stor mångfald, vilket bidrar till bättre resultat för verksamheten.

Övrigt
Om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen kommer vi att kräva att du beställer ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret från polisens hemsida. Detta är ett krav enligt PostNord-koncernens rekryterings- och säkerhetsrutiner och syftar till att säkerställa en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö samt skydda våra medarbetare, kunder och det gods som anförtrotts oss. Av säkerhetsskäl utför vi även alkohol- och drogtester genom samarbetspartner.

Ansök
Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-08-31. Urval sker löpande och tillsättning av tjänst kan ske innan sista ansökningsdag.

Har du någon fråga eller fundering är du välkommen att kontakta Jörgen Larsson via epost: jorgen.larsson@tpl.postnord.com Observera dock att ansökningar ej mottages via mail.

För fackliga kontaktpersoner se:

Välkommen med din ansökan. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Product Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:
About

스위더는
"Make everyday ​life ​more ​convenient and ​sweeter for everyone" 이라는 ​비전을 ​바탕으로, 지금껏 ​존재하지 않았던 프리미엄 ​이동 서비스를 ​첫 ​스텝으로 만들어가고 ​있습니다. ​
이를 ​통해 일상 속 ​새로운 ​이동 경험을 제공하고, ​​새로운 ​비즈니스 생태계 창출을 ​목표로 나아가고 있습니다.
수많은 고객과 현장에서 직접 소통하며 실제 문제와 니즈를 발견해 왔으며, 이를 바탕으로 현재 서비스의 기획부터 개발, 검증, 출시까지 제품화 전 과정을 함께 만들어가고 있습니다. 각 단계에 주도적으로 참여하며, 제품의 성장과 완성도를 함께 책임질 분을 찾고 있습니다.

팀 스위더는
미국 Microsoft, Salesforce, Amazon, Dropbox 본사 등에서 15년 이상의 실무 경험을 쌓은 베테랑들이 모여, 하나의 목표를 향해 나아가고 있는 조직입니다. 초기 투자금도 확보하여, 안정적인 환경에서 제품 개발에 집중할 수 있는 기반을 갖추고 있습니다.

팀 스위더는
무엇보다도 짧은 시간 안에 다양한 시도를 하고, 끊임없이 두드리며 끝내 해내는 실행력과 자존감을 가진 분들을 초대합니다. 학벌이나 스펙보다는 끊임없이 배우려는 그릿(grit)과, 긍정적인 임팩트를 만들어내겠다는 열정을 더 중요하게 생각합니다.
대기업이나 학교에서의 주어진 업무보다, 스스로 시도하고 주도한 다양한 제품 개발 경험을 높이 평가합니다. 짜여진 이력서 보단 지난 시간 진행했던 프로젝트 및 개발한 서비스앱를 보여주시는 것이 좋습니다.

Responsibilities

• React 기반의 웹 서비스 및 운영·관리 도구를 개발합니다.
• FastAPI 기반의 백엔드 API를 설계하고 개발합니다.
• 서비스 운영에 필요한 데이터 구조와 비즈니스 로직을 설계합니다.
• 결제, 인증, 메시지 발송 등 다양한 외부 서비스 및 API를 연동합니다.
• AWS 클라우드 환경에서 서비스를 구축하고 안정적으로 운영합니다.
• 서비스에서 발생하는 기술적 문제를 분석하고 개선합니다.
• 기획, 개발, 검증, 출시 등 제품화 전 과정에 함께 참여합니다.

Requirements

• React를 활용한 프론트엔드 개발 경험이 있는 분
• Python 및 FastAPI를 활용한 백엔드 API 개발 경험이 있는 분
• REST API 설계 및 외부 API 연동 경험이 있는 분
• 관계형 또는 NoSQL 데이터베이스에 대한 기본적인 이해가 있는 분
• Git을 활용한 협업 및 코드 관리 경험이 있는 분
• 기술적 문제를 논리적으로 분석하고 해결할 수 있는 분
• 맡은 업무에 책임감을 가지고 팀과 함께 개발 프로세스를 만들어갈 수 있는 분

Preferred

• TypeScript를 활용한 개발 경험이 있는 분
• AWS 기반의 클라우드 또는 서버리스 환경에서 개발·운영한 경험이 있는 분
• Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB 등 AWS 서비스를 활용해 본 분
• 결제, 인증, SMS, 푸시 알림 등 외부 서비스를 연동해 본 분
• 서비스 초기 단계에서 제품을 설계하고 출시해 본 경험이 있는 분
• 테스트 코드 작성, CI/CD 구축 및 운영 자동화 경험이 있는 분
• 성능 개선, 장애 대응 및 운영 환경의 문제를 해결해 본 경험이 있는 분

Benefits

᛫ 후보자별 상황과 포지션에 따라 수습 기간 이후 평가를 거쳐 정규직 전환 프로세스가 진행되며, 수습 중에도 경쟁력 있는 연봉이 지급됩니다.
᛫ 근무: 출근 및 리모트 혼합
᛫ 연봉: 신입/경력에 따라 협의
᛫ Equity: 직무/레벨에 준하는 비율로 부여

description:
Imagine a career at one of the nation's most advanced health networks.


Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.


LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary
Responsible for assisting specialty pharmacists, specialty manager and director in the day to day operations of the pharmacy which includes, but is not limited to, order entry, benefit investigation, prior authorization initiation, and financial assistance. Acts as a liaison to our specialty providers which may include spending time in the specialty practices.

Job Duties
  • Assists specialty pharmacists in daily pharmacy operations.
  • Conducts monthly patient outreach which includes a medication reconciliation, adherence screen, and delivery method.
  • Assists in streamlining communication with the patient, insurance companies, pharmacists, nurses, lab, and other healthcare-related parties.
  • Initiates and makes every attempt to obtain prior authorization for specialty medications.
  • Acts as the patient's financial coordinator by gathering alternative payment sources available through copay and patient assistance programs and communicating it to them in a clear and effective manner.
  • Uses pharmacy software to record the receipt of prescriptions including the prescription itself, chart notes, and insurance information.
  • Collaborates with department leaders to design, develop, and evaluate clinical systems to support practice area.
  • Plans, educates, and executes performance improvement initiatives to achieve the organization's clinical quality goals.
  • Recommends and implements strategies that minimize cost and optimize medication use outcomes.
  • Prepares medication for verification in accordance with hazardous drug handling procedures
  • Communicate with specialty providers through multiple modalities including EPIC, Skype, Tiger Text, email and phone
  • Prepares medication shipments in accordance with the company's cold chain requirements and pack out guidelines

Minimum Qualifications
  • High School Diploma/GED
  • 2 years experience in retail, specialty, or clinical pharmacy setting.
  • Ability to prioritize workload and complete assignments and follow-up in a timely manner.
  • Demonstrated strength in listening, oral and written communications.
  • Excellent data management software skills with demonstrated adaptability to internal systems.
  • Problem solving and interpersonal skills and the ability to work independently.
  • Strong organization skills as well as attention to detail.
  • CPhT - Certified Pharmacy Technician - Pharmacy Technician Certification Board Upon Hire and
  • RPT - Registered Pharmacy Technician - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire

Preferred Qualifications
  • 3 years experience in a retail, specialty or clinical pharmacy setting and
  • 1 year experience in inventory management, insurance verification and benefits investigation.
  • Basic knowledge of computer programs such as e-mail, and Microsoft office

Additional Qualifications

    Physical Demands
    Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Kirvesmiehiä Keski-Suomen alueelle
description:
Etsimme kirvesmiehiä Keski-Suomen alueelle!

Haemme ammattitaitoisia kirvesmiehiä Keski-Suomen alueella sijaitseville työmaille. Työkohteet voivat vaihdella osaamisen mukaan uudispuolelta saneerauksiin, Työnkuva pitää sisällään yleensä monipuolisesti eri tehtäviä riippuen työmaan vaiheesta.

Toivomme hakijoilta aiempaa kokemusta vastaavanlaisista työtehtävistä sekä kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn. Arvostamme lisäksi reipasta ja työteliästä asennetta työmaalla sekä luotettavuutta.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

* Rakennusalan koulutus
* Usean vuoden kokemus rakennusalalta
* Hyvä suomen kielen taito
* Korkea työmoraali

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, etta tyosopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tarkeaa, etta viihdyt tyossasi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

* Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan vähintään TES:in mukaan alk. 15,55 €/h
* Palkanmaksun joka toinen perjantai
* Perehdytyksen työhön.
* Paivittaisen tuen tyoasioissa.
* Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.
* Hyville tyypeille on aina kysyntää ja autamme sinua löytämään uusia töitä määräaikaisen työsuhteen päättyessä.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Hakemuksia tulee paljon, ja jotta hakuprosessi on kaikille reilu, voimme ottaa huomioon vain järjestelmässä tehdyt hakemukset.

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

* liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi
* kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaaville henkilöille sähköpostia otsikolla "Haettu työ" osoitteeseen mikko-matti.viinikka(at)visiohr.fi. Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-15.00.

Arvostamme, että sähköpostissa kysyt vain työtehtävään liittyviä asioita. Jätä esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Keski-Suomessa työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Jyväskylästä käsin Mikko-Matti ja Ari

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Keski-Suomi on osa Visio Henkilostoratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilostopalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua pelia ja tarjoamme toita niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyo perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

title: Positiv personlig assistent sökes till aktiv man utanför Västerås
description:
Vill du bli en viktig del av vårt tighta och positiva assistans-team?

Jag är en glad och driven man som efter en ryggmärgsskada lever ett aktivt och innehållsrikt liv på landet strax utanför Västerås, tillsammans med min familj. Jag söker nu en ny medarbetare som vill bli en del av vårt fantastiska team.

Mina dagar handlar om allt från morgon- och kvällsrutiner, träning och personlig hygien till matlagning, arbete och att helt enkelt njuta av livet. Ibland är det fart och fläkt, ibland lugnt och skönt. Jag älskar musik, film, brädspel och TV-spel, och jag tillbringar gärna tid på sjön. Mental hälsa och välmående ligger mig varmt om hjärtat.


Vem är du?

Du är en lugn, positiv och självständig person med god människokännedom. Du har en naturlig förmåga att känna av när och hur ditt stöd behövs, och du trivs med att både ta eget ansvar och samarbeta. Personkemi, tillit och flexibilitet är det viktigaste för oss – inte formell utbildning.

Du är lyhörd, respektfull och förstår vikten av att jag själv bestämmer över mitt liv. Du är rökfri, har körkort och tillgång till bil (vi bor på landet). Framför allt vill du vara med och skapa en trygg och trivsam vardag där vi både kan skratta och ta oss an dagens uppgifter tillsammans.


Vad vi erbjuder dig:

  • 100% tjänst med ett mycket uppskattat arbetsschema:
  • Arbetspass: 07:00–19:00
  • Rullande 4-veckorsschema: 2 dagar arbete / 2 lediga – 3 dagar arbete / 2 lediga – 2 dagar arbete / 3 lediga
  • Ledig varannan helg
  • Möjlighet till ett långsiktigt samarbete – vi vill att du ska trivas och stanna
  • En liten, tight grupp där alla ställer upp för varandra
  • Ingångslön ca 30 400 kr/månad (inkl. 12% semesterersättning) vid 100%
  • Friskvårdsbidrag 2 500 kr/år vid fullt intjänat år


Tjänsten är tillgänglig från 1 augusti 2026.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid att vi ska trivas tillsammans. För mig är det viktigt att vi kan ha roligt på jobbet och att du känner att din arbetsdag är meningsfull.


Låter det här som något för dig?

Skicka din ansökan med ett personligt brev och CV till: info@signumassistans.se


Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Däckmontör sökes till Djursholms Däckservice
description:
Däckmontör sökes till Djursholms Däckservice

Vill du arbeta på en av Stockholms mest moderna däckverkstäder?

Djursholms Däckservice hjälper privatpersoner och företag med allt inom däck och fälg. Vi är en modern fullserviceverkstad med stort fokus på kvalitet, service och långsiktiga kundrelationer. Nu söker vi en engagerad däckmontör som vill bli en del av vårt team.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en professionell miljö där vi värdesätter noggrannhet, eget ansvar och ett högt kundfokus.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som däckmontör kommer du bland annat att arbeta med:

  • Montering och demontering av personbilsdäck.
  • Hjulskiften
  • Hjulinställningar
  • Reparation av däck.
  • Tvätt, kontroll och hantering av däckhotell.
  • Kundbemötande och rådgivning kring däck och fälg.
  • Bidra till ordning, struktur och hög kvalitet i verkstaden.

Under högsäsong arbetar vi i ett högt tempo där samarbete och effektivitet är avgörande, medan övriga delar av året ger möjlighet att arbeta mer med service, hjulinställningar, lagerhantering och utveckling av verksamheten.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har erfarenhet av däckbranschen eller fordonsarbete (meriterande men inget krav).
  • Är praktiskt lagd och trivs med ett fysiskt arbete.
  • Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten.
  • Tar egna initiativ och ser vad som behöver göras utan att behöva bli tillsagd.
  • Tar ansvar för både ditt eget arbete och arbetsplatsens ordning.
  • Trivs med att arbeta i team och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö.
  • Har ett professionellt bemötande mot kunder och kollegor.
  • Har B-körkort (krav).
  • Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.
  • Vill utvecklas långsiktigt tillsammans med oss och är stolt över att leverera ett arbete av hög kvalitet – varje dag.

Vi erbjuder

  • En trygg heltidsanställning.
  • Arbete i en modern och välutrustad verkstad.
  • Trevliga kollegor och god sammanhållning.
  • Möjlighet att utvecklas inom företaget och ta ett större ansvar över tid.
  • Konkurrenskraftiga villkor.
  • Ett företag med höga ambitioner där kvalitet, service och professionalism genomsyrar allt vi gör.

Om Djursholms Däckservice

Vi är en väletablerad däckverkstad i norra Stockholm med fokus på kvalitet, service och långsiktiga kundrelationer. Vårt mål är att ge varje kund en smidig, trygg och professionell upplevelse – oavsett om det gäller ett enkelt hjulskifte, hjulinställning eller kompletta hjullösningar.

Vi tror på att bygga ett lag där alla tar ansvar, hjälper varandra och ständigt strävar efter att leverera högsta kvalitet.

Ansökan

Skicka ditt CV och en kort presentation till oss. Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Senior Technical Officer, Demand Planning – Malaria. Dar Es Salaam
description:
Job Summary:

The Senior Technical Officer (STO), Demand Planning-Malaria provides technical support to the National Malaria Control Program (NMCP) to ensure availability and efficient management of Malaria commodities and related supply chain systems and supports the implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of malaria demand planning activities. The role provides technical guidance and capacity building, demand planning and supply systems strengthening to NMCP and other malaria stakeholders in Tanzania. The STO contributes to knowledge products through the creation and management of reports, technical materials, and conflict-sensitive solutions on demand planning activities relating to Malaria. Working closely with project leadership, s/he supports project implementation by evaluating programmatic effectiveness, providing technical oversight, and preparing technical assessment reports. The role contributes to business development efforts, including supporting the management of opportunity identification, capture, proposal development, and strategic partnering.

Accountabilities:

Technical Requirements:

  • Provides the National Malaria Control Program (NMCP) and key stakeholders with technical support and guidance to strengthen malaria commodity demand planning and supply chain management.

  • Strengthens staff and partner capacity through technical assistance, mentoring and training in malaria demand planning for Malaria ecosystem including supply chain management.

  • Ensures timely availability of quality Malaria commodities across the health system.

  • Plans for and ensures execution of quantification exercises for Malaria commodities while advocating for best practices in forecasting and supply planning.

  • Participates in Bottom-up quantification (BUQ) exercises and supply chain reviews for Malaria commodities.

  • Supports NMCP in the design, planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of integrated Malaria interventions and ensures that Malaria commodities are consistently available at the right quantities, of the required quality, and at the right time.

  • Participates in pipeline analyses, tracks supplies, identifies potential challenges relating to supply chain and supports mitigation measures.

  • Strengthens capacity of frontline workers and stakeholders on logistics and supply chain systems related to malaria.

  • Supports the development and maintenance of feedback mechanisms for dissemination of approved malaria stock status reports, to all levels of the health system and stakeholders.

  • Monitors progress in performance of demand planning activities for malaria and share regular updates with NMCP and the Project.

  • Works closely with the team to ensure project implementation remains technically sound and adheres to organizational strategy and standard operating procedures (SOP’s).

  • Develops or writes technical briefs, reports, or other necessary materials to facilitate research, best practices, policies, and procedures on demand planning for Malaria activities.

  • Provides mentorship and team building at the task level.

  • Provides technical support in the development and dissemination of tools, materials, reports, papers, and intervention for research projects on Malaria activities.

  • Provides technical input on Malaria best practices to assist with implementation

  • Monitors performance milestones for demand planning and supply chain activities and reports to supervisors.

Business Development and Client/Funder Support:

  • Contributes to proposal writing for procurement of malaria commodities, diagnostics and other related lifesaving commodities.

  • Develops technical proposals, budgets, and work plans related to malaria demand planning and supply chain strengthening.

Applied Knowledge & Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of concepts, practices, and procedures for forecasting, demand planning and supply chain management with providing technical support for forecasting and supply chain planning activities. Ability to develop scopes of work, technical specifications for partners and consultants, etc.

  • Broad knowledge of quality assurance standards and continuous quality improvement principles.

  • Proficiency in database management software and online search tools.

  • Demonstrates cultural sensitivity and diversity as well as understanding of the political, contextual, and ethical issues in assigned work

  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with clients and staff.

  • Must be able to read, write, and speak fluent English and Kiswahili.

  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills.

  • Demonstrated project management skills.

  • Ability to influence and collaborate with others.

  • Strong stakeholder engagement and government relationship management experience.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify issues, and prepare reports, solves problems and implement corrective action.

  • Experience using data for decision making and evidence-based forecasting.

Supervision Given/Received:

  • Mentors’ junior staff- to strengthen their technical capacity and performance.

  • Reports to Senior Technical Advisor, Systems Strengthening & Demand Planning

Education: ** **

  • Master’s degree (or its International Equivalent) in public health, Pharmacy, Laboratory or a related field, with a minimum of six years of professional experience in commodity forecasting, quantification, demand planning or supply chain management

Experience: ** **

  • Minimum of 6+ years of progressive responsible experience in national quantifications for malaria commodities, demand planning or supply chain management at national or sub-national level.

  • Experience working with non-governmental organization/s (NGO), government ministry or entity, implementing partners, donors or private organization/s.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of Tanzania’s health supply chains systems and malaria commodity management

  • Proficiency in national quantification and forecasting tools including Quantimed, Pipelines, ForLab, or equivalent tools)

  • Experience using LMIS/eLMIS platforms and other electronic logistics information systems for forecasting, reporting and supply chain performance monitoring

Typical Physical Demands:

  • Typical office environment.

  • Ability to spend long hours looking at computer screen and doing repetitive work on a keyboard.

  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time.

  • Ability to lift/move up to 5 lbs.

Technology to be Used:

  • Personal Computer/Laptop, Microsoft applications (i.e., Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams), cell phone/mobile technology, and standard office equipment.

Travel Requirements:

  • 10% - 25%

How to Apply:

FHI 360 has a competitive compensation package. Interested candidates may apply online by uploading their Application Letter, Curriculum Vitae (CV)/Resume, Photocopies of Certificates and Names and Addresses of three (3) referees

FHI 360 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Closing Date: 21 August 2026. Only short listed candidates will be contacted

title: Respiratory Care Practitioner - Respiratory Therapy - PRN 0.3 (as scheduled) (71154)
description:
In an environment of continuous quality improvement under general supervision and upon passing proficiency testing, assumes responsibility for performing basic respiratory care for adult and pediatric patients. Upon completion of didactic course work and orientation, may perform various respiratory monitoring and evaluation procedures for patients of all ages. Exhibits the MHS Standards of Excellence and exercises strict confidentiality at all times.

Job Functions:

  1. Assesses patient need for respiratory therapy by interviewing patients, performing limited physical examinations, reviewing and evaluating existing clinical data and developing a respiratory plan of care with recommendations for the appropriate type and frequency of treatment, including goals
  2. Initiates, conducts, and evaluates efficacy of therapeutic procedures/interventions and recommends changes to the respiratory plan of care for goal achievement and successful outcomes
  3. Performs cardiopulmonary diagnostic and/or neurodiagnostic procedures, calculates test results, determines reliability, performs quality control, evaluates implication of test results and makes clinical and critical decisions accordingly
  4. Assists in discharge planning for respiratory patients including BiLevel, oxygen and NIV
  5. Responsible for the operation verification procedures, cleaning/disinfection, calibration, set-up, maintenance, troubleshooting and transportation of respiratory care, cardiopulmonary diagnostic and neurodiagnostic equipment.
  6. Maintains par inventory levels for supplies and rental equipment
  7. Assists physicians and/or performs special procedures: bronchoscopy, a-lines, intubation, meconium aspiration, IVs, phlebotomy, tilt table studies, continuous EEG monitoring, EEGs and EMGs
  8. Educates patients and family on medications, equipment , lung cancer screening and disease management using Stop Light criteria
  9. Performs ABG draws, analysis, quality control, proficiency testing and ABG system maintenance
  10. Uses clinical and critical thinking skills as responder to Code Blue, Code Pink, Rapid Response, and Trauma Alert Level 1
  11. Independently provides critical care including, but is not limited to; application and monitoring of invasive and noninvasive mechanical ventilation, medical gases, patient care transports, resuscitation, airway care, high risk deliveries, and rapid response calls
  12. Performs as an integral member of the free standing ED team, assisting where and when needed for smooth patient care flow and improved customer satisfaction
  13. Responsible for accurate documentation, billing procedures, patient tracking, and reports
  14. Participates on committees/ ICU patient rounds, Tumor Board, IT project teams
  15. Actively participates in quality and safety through tracking, reporting and recommendations
  16. Participates in community events/education/marketing
  17. Assumes all other duties and responsibilities as necessary

title: Servis till Coco Beach Club
description:
Drömmer du om att jobba på en plats där solen skiner, musiken spelar, tempot är högt och varje arbetsdag känns som en semester? Då är Coco Beach Club på Ellery Beach House rätt plats för dig.

På Ellery Beach House arbetar vi tillsammans för att skapa upplevelser utöver det vanliga. Vi är ett stort team med stark gemenskap och drivs av våra värderingar – personliga, professionella, passionerade och lekfulla. Här är ditt bemötande lika viktigt som din service, och tillsammans skapar vi en miljö där både gäster och kollegor trivs.

Om Coco Beach Club

Coco Beach Club är hjärtat av Ellery Beach House – en pulserande mötesplats inspirerad av Malibu och Palm Springs. Här möts gäster över långa luncher, cocktails vid poolen och livliga eftermiddagar där musik, mat och människor står i centrum.

Nu söker vi en Servitris som vill vara med och skapa magiska gästupplevelser i en miljö där ingen dag är den andra lik.

Som servitris på Coco Beach Club är du en viktig del av gästupplevelsen från första mötet till sista skålen. Du ansvarar för din egen station, guidar gästerna genom mat- och dryckesupplevelsen och ser till att varje besök känns personligt, professionellt och minnesvärt.

Du arbetar i ett högt tempo tillsammans med ett engagerat team där samarbete, energi och glädje är en självklar del av vardagen.

Vem är du?

Du älskar mötet med människor och har en naturlig känsla för service. Du är trygg i serveringsrollen, gillar när tempot är högt och motiveras av att överträffa gästernas förväntningar.

Vi tror att du:

  • Har några års erfarenhet av servering.

  • Har ett genuint intresse för mat, dryck och värdskap.

  • Är social, positiv och utåtriktad.

  • Trivs i ett högt tempo och behåller lugnet även när det är mycket att göra.

  • Tar ansvar, arbetar självständigt och bidrar till ett starkt team.

  • Vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss och skapa upplevelser som gästerna kommer ihåg.

Vi erbjuder

  • En tjänst på 80%

  • En av Stockholms mest inspirerande arbetsplatser.

  • Ett fantastiskt team med stark gemenskap.

  • Möjlighet att utvecklas inom service och hospitality.

  • En arbetsplats fylld av energi, musik, människor och minnesvärda upplevelser – varje dag.

Övrigt

Tillträde och lön enligt överenskommelse.

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

title: CEO Office - AI Neobank App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for strong operators to join the CEO Office for BJAK's AI Neobank app expansion.

This role is for someone who can help turn CEO priorities into execution across product, hiring, licensing, partnerships, market launch and daily operating rhythm.

What You'll Own

  • Drive CEO-level priorities from problem definition to execution. 

  • Track OKRs, decisions, blockers, owners and deadlines across teams. 

  • Support licensing applications, country expansion, hiring, partnerships and strategic projects. 

  • Prepare clear briefs, updates, research notes, meeting follow-ups and action trackers.

  • Work across product, engineering, finance, legal, compliance, operations and country teams. 

  • Identify execution gaps and push teams to close them. 

  • Own urgent business problems that do not fit neatly into one department.


What We're Looking For 

  • High-ownership business generalist with strong execution discipline. 

  • Clear writer, structured thinker and strong follow-through operator. 

  • Able to work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. 

  • Comfortable handling ambiguity, urgent problems and shifting priorities. 

  • Strong judgement on what matters, what is blocked and what needs escalation. 

  • Able to keep teams moving without creating unnecessary process. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, operations, strategy, fintech or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Turns unclear priorities into clear actions. 

  • Can chase, unblock and execute without being chased. 

  • Writes updates that make decisions easier. 

  • Stays calm when many things are moving at once. 

  • Cares about outcomes more than visibility.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings. 

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Hong Kong. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Hong Kong.


Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior QA Engineer (TradeZella product)
description:
We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer who cares about product quality end-to-end, someone who gets trading through real experience, professional or personal. Trading doesn’t need to be your career; a hobby or a past chapter counts, but long-term investing alone doesn’t.

You’ll join TradeZella , our trading journaling and educational platform, and focus on how the product works in real conditions: testing functionality, investigating edge cases, and resolving complex issues together with engineering, product, and support teams. This role requires a genuine interest in the trading domain, along with strong UX testing skills.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR?

Required skills


Testing & QA expertise:
🔹 Strong experience with manual testing and end-to-end validation
🔹 Solid UX testing skills beyond formal requirements (user acceptance testing, business acceptance testing, usability validation)
🔹 Hands-on day trading experience (any market: stocks, forex, futures, crypto), past or present, professional or personal, with the ability to walk us through at least one strategy you’ve traded
🔹 Experience in investigating customer issues and performing root cause analysis
🔹 Experience in building and improving QA processes

Technical skills:
🔹 Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including log analysis (CloudWatch, Logs Explorer)
🔹 Good understanding of networks, HTTP, APIs, and web/client architectures
🔹 Experience with version control systems (GitHub, GitLab, etc.)
🔹 Experience using AI tools for workflow optimization

Communication & mindset:
🔹 Ability to translate technical concepts for different audiences (engineering ↔ non-technical)
🔹 Strong sense of ownership and accountability
🔹 Structured, detail-oriented approach
🔹 Fluent English (written and spoken)

As a plus

🔸 Experience with Playwright (TypeScript)

Your responsibilities

  • Analyze requirements, test functionality, and identify defects and edge cases

  • Own investigation of complex customer issues through L3 support, driving root cause resolution

  • Partner with engineering and product to resolve issues and improve system reliability

  • Improve QA practices and elevate debugging and investigation standards, including AI adoption practices

  • Support releases and ensure stable rollouts with active post-release follow-up

Du skaber struktur i hverdagen, støtter teamet og er med til at sikre gode oplevelser for vores gæster. Samtidig bidrager du til et trygt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi lykkes sammen, og træder naturligt frem, når butikschefen ikke er der. title: Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja/Neidonkallion päiväkoti
description:
Olet hyvä tiimityöntekijä kahden varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan rinnalla. Lastenhoitajana edistät päiväkodin lasten kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia, kasvua ja kehitystä yhteistyössä työyhteisösi ja perheiden kanssa. Vastaat lapsiryhmäsi mahdollisesta lääkehoidosta. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan työhösi, sillä annamme aktiivisuudelle ja uusille ideoille tilaa.

Arvostamme osaamistasi, kokemustasi ja kiinnostustasi pienten lasten pedagogiikan kehittämisestä ja pienryhmätoiminnasta, hyviä ryhmä- ja yksilöohjaustaitoja sekä erinomaisia työyhteisötaitoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
- Monipuolisen tehtävänkuvan, jossa sinulla on mahdollisuus tehdä työtä omalla persoonalla ja vaikuttaa päiväkodin toimintaan laajemminkin
- Ketterän, joustavan ja jatkuvasti kehittyvän toimintakulttuurin
- Hyvän työyhteisön ja osaavan esimiehen
- Kattavat koulutusmahdollisuudet oman osaamisesi kehittämiseen
- Työterveyshuollon palvelut
- Edullisen ja monipuolisen työpaikkaruokailun
- Kilpailukykyisen palkan 2557,41 €
- 200 €/hlö/vuosi liikunta-, kulttuuri-, ja hyvinvointietuna (Epassi)
- Ilmaisen uintimahdollisuuden Kirkkonummen uimahallissa henkilökorttia vastaan

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena lastenhoitajan tehtävään on varhaiskasvatuslain 540/2018 28§:n mukainen kasvatus- ja ohjausalan perustutkinto (lastenohjaaja), sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai muu vastaava soveltuva tutkinto, joihin sisältyy tai joita on täydennetty riittävän laajoilla lasten hoidon, kasvatuksen ja opetuksen tutkinnonosilla sekä Valtioneuvoksen asetuksessa § 3 (1177/2018) määrittelemät soveltuvat tutkinnot. Lisäksi kelpoisuusehdot täyttävät varhaiskasvatuslain 540/2018 henkilöstöä koskevan siirtymäsäännöksen mukaiset hakijat.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6.2 §:n tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote. Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 55 §:n mukaista terveydentilan selvitystä hengityselinten tuberkuloosista.

Haastattelu tehtävään järjestetään erikseen sovittavana ajankohtana.

Hakemukset toimitetaan 14.8.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä sähköisesti os. www.kuntarekry.fi (työavain KIR-03-282-26).

title: Afdelingssecretaresse Polikliniek
description:
Over de functie

Samen met je collega’s zorg je voor de administratieve ondersteuning van de orthopedische polikliniek. Je verwerkt de e-mail en post, plant afspraken, beantwoordt telefoontjes en bereidt spreekuren voor. Hierbij werk je nauw samen met medewerkers ontvangst en registratie, doktersassistenten, polikliniekmedewerkers, verpleegkundigen en artsen. Een dag per week werk je bij de receptie, waar je patiënten gastvrij ontvangt en hen wegwijs maakt binnen het RHOC. Bij alles wat je doet, staat de patiënt centraal. Je werkt nauwkeurig en begrijpt welke invloed een juiste administratieve verwerking heeft op het gehele zorgproces binnen het Orthopedisch Centrum.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding tot medisch secretaresse en relevante werkervaring;
  • Je hebt affiniteit met de zorg, blijft rustig onder druk en kunt goed schakelen, organiseren en vooruitdenken;
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op. Daarnaast ben je digitaal vaardig en beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed;
  • Je bent 24 uur per week beschikbaar. Je werkt in ieder geval op donderdag en vrijdag van 08.00 tot 16.30 uur en bent daarnaast flexibel inzetbaar op andere dagen, bijvoorbeeld tijdens vakantieperiodes.

Wij bieden je

  • Afhankelijk van je werkervaring, word je ingeschaald tussen de € 2.630,- en € 3.548,- (FWG 30) bruto op basis van een fulltime werkweek (36 uur) conform Cao Ziekenhuizen;
  • Je ontvangt reiskostenvergoeding. Wij bieden je een fiscale uitruilregeling voor Reiskostenvergoeding en wij bieden je een fiscale uitruilregeling voor een (elektrische) fiets;
  • Het Orthopedisch Centrum biedt je 144 vakantie uren én minimaal 57 PLB uren op jaarbasis bij een fulltime dienstverband;
  • Naast 8,33 % vakantiegeld krijg je bij ons een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.
  • Naast deze aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden geven wij je nog drie redenen om te kiezen voor het Orthopedisch Centrum:
  • Werken in regelmatige dagdiensten met een vitaliteitsprogramma;
  • Kans om mee te werken aan het meest specialistisch Orthopedisch Centrum met als streven de beste te willen zijn;
  • Je krijgt voldoende ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden d.m.v. scholingen en trainingen om te zorgen voor kwaliteitsverbetering. De kwaliteit van zorg in het Orthopedisch Centrum komt tot uiting in excellente prestaties van al haar medewerkers, individueel én als team.

Meer informatie over de functie

Ben jij enthousiast over deze vacature? Je sollicitatie is van harte welkom! Klik op de sollicitatie button en volg de stappen. Je schriftelijke sollicitatie met curriculum vitae en motivatie is welkom voor 1 september 2026. Je ontvangt een reactie of uitnodiging per mail van ons.

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen? Neem dan gerust contact op met Rinske Tabak, manager polikliniek, via r.tabak@rhoc of (079) 206 5590. Rinske zal ook bij de sollicitatiegesprekken aanwezig zijn.

De werving voor het Reinier Haga Orthopedisch Centrum wordt uitgevoerd door het HagaZiekenhuis, derhalve verloopt de communicatie rondom het sollicitatieproces via team Recruitment van het HagaZiekenhuis.

title: Verkoopadviseur
description:
Heb jij affiniteit met auto's, een commerciële instelling en al wat ervaring in de verkoop? Dan hebben wij een mooie kans voor jou!

Voor onze moderne Van Mossel Ford vestiging in Terneuzen zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste Verkoopadviseur die onze klanten op een klantgerichte en overtuigende manier begeleidt bij de aankoop van hun nieuwe of gebruikte Ford.

Wat ga je doen?

Als verkoopadviseur bij Van Mossel Ford in Terneuzen ben jij hét aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten in de showroom. Je helpt hen bij het maken van de juiste keuze, adviseert over modellen en diensten en zorgt ervoor dat ze tevreden én met een goed gevoel de showroom verlaten.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Adviseren van klanten over Ford-modellen en bijbehorende diensten;

  • Verkopen van zowel nieuwe als gebruikte auto's;

  • Opstellen en opvolgen van offertes en verkoopovereenkomsten;

  • Meedenken over de uitstraling van de showroom en het aanbod;

  • Samenwerken met collega's om elke klant een optimale ervaring te bieden.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent commercieel ingesteld, houdt van klantcontact en weet hoe je een goed gesprek voert. Je werkt graag in een team, denkt in kansen en vindt het leuk om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen de automotive.

Verder heb je:

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in een commerciële functie, bij voorkeur in de automotive of retail;

  • MBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift;

  • Een proactieve en klantgerichte houding.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Van Mossel krijg je niet alleen een leuke en afwisselende baan, maar ook de kans om te groeien binnen een ambitieus en stabiel familiebedrijf.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Een goed salaris passend bij jouw ervaring;

  • Aantrekkelijke bonusregeling;

  • Auto van de zaak, ook voor privégebruik;

  • Zakelijke mobiele telefoon;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Toegang tot trainingen, workshops en de Van Mossel Academy & Ford Nederland

  • Een fijne werksfeer in een betrokken team.

Enthousiast?

Zie jij jezelf al rondlopen in onze Ford showroom in Terneuzen? Solliciteer direct via onze website. We maken graag kennis met je!

title: Medical Office Clerk (Advanced) – PRN
description:
As an Advanced Medical Office Clerk, you'll help patients access primary, specialty, and subspecialty care while supporting accurate medical record workflows within an on-site military healthcare facility in the Oceanside area. Working with patients, healthcare providers, and clinic staff, you'll coordinate appointments, verify patient information, maintain medical records, and provide responsive administrative support.

Employment Type: PRN

Compensation:

  • $19.26–$24.07 USD per hour
  • Health & Welfare (H&W): Up to $5.09 per hour, in accordance with the Service Contract Act (SCA).

Schedule: PRN eight-hour shifts may be scheduled Monday–Friday between 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m., excluding federal holidays. Hours may vary based on operational needs and are not guaranteed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer telephone calls, route callers appropriately, and take accurate messages.
  • Schedule, reschedule, and cancel primary, specialty, and subspecialty care appointments.
  • Verify patient eligibility and demographic information, provide appointment instructions, and direct patients to appropriate departments.
  • Maintain patient schedules, appointment logs, medical records, and tracking information; obtain, organize, file, retrieve, deliver, and archive records in accordance with applicable requirements.
  • Review patient records for completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and obtain missing results or documentation requested by healthcare providers.
  • Compile medical record data, prepare statistics, and support quality-assurance reviews.
  • Use military healthcare and eligibility systems, including AHLTA, CHCS, MHS GENESIS, and DEERS.

Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED equivalency.
  • At least one year of medical office scheduling, medical office, or other relevant experience; alternatively, RHIT or RHIA certification.
  • Basic knowledge of medical terminology and the ability to type at least 50 words per minute.
  • Administrative and clerical skills, including receptionist duties, telephone support, customer service, written communication, and use of standard office equipment and software.
  • Knowledge of general medical ethics and applicable Joint Commission and Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care standards related to complete, timely, and accurate health records.
  • Ability to obtain authorization to access a military installation and be issued a Common Access Card (CAC).
  • Ability to perform work involving extended sitting, standing, walking, or bending; use a step ladder to retrieve records; and carry materials weighing 25–50 pounds, with reasonable accommodation where applicable.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Privacy Disclaimer: Policy Link

By clicking “I’m Interested” and submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the applicable Privacy Policy (available via the link above) and agree that International SOS Government Medical Services, may collect, use, store, transfer, and otherwise process your personal information in accordance with that Privacy Policy for recruitment and hiring purposes.

Compensation Disclaimer:
Pay range is based on several factors and may vary in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Final salary and offer will be determined by the applicant’s background, experience, skills, internal equity, and alignment with geographical market data.

Benefits Language (FTE roles):
Full-time positions are eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k plan, paid time off, and an annual bonus. International SOS Government Medical Services complies with all federal, state, and local minimum wage laws.

Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) Statement:
International SOS Government Medical Services is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against employees or job applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

title: Anlægsgartner til De Fælles Kirkegårde i Aarhus Nordre Provsti
company: Kirke- og Regnskabskontoret i Aarhus Nordre Provsti
description:
Anlægsgartner til De Fælles Kirkegårde i Aarhus Nordre Provsti

Brænder du for grønne områder, biodiversitet og meningsfuldt arbejde? Vi søger en fagligt dygtig og engageret anlægsgartner til vores team ved De Fælles Kirkegårde i Aarhus Nordre Provsti. Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med tiltrædelse den 1. september 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Om jobbet

Som kirkegårdsgartner bliver du en vigtig del af vores grønne team, som varetager drift og vedligeholdelse af syv kirkegårde: Skejby, Lisbjerg, Elev, Todbjerg, Mejlby, Ølsted og Trige.
Vi udfører både traditionel pleje af kirkegårdens forskellige grønne områder, kiste- og urnenedsættelser samt omlægningsopgaver - altid med fokus på kvalitet og respekt for det enkelte sted. Der er ikke opgaver i kirken, men du skal være indstillet på at indgå i weekendvagtordning ift. kistenedsættelser og urnenedsættelser på lørdage.

Om os

De Fælles Kirkegårde i Aarhus Nordre Provsti er en nyere virksomhed ledet af en kirkegårdsleder og en bestyrelse bestående af repræsentanter fra menighedsrådene i de tilknyttede sogne.
Vi prioriterer bæredygtighed, biodiversitet og den grønne omstilling i vores daglige arbejde og er stolte af vores kirkegårde. Hos os får du engagerede kolleger, godt arbejdsmiljø og mulighed for at bidrage med dine ideer og faglighed.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er faglært anlægsgartner og har erfaring med pleje af kirkegårde
  • Har interesse og kompetencer inden for anlæg og udvikling af nye områder og bede
  • Er fortrolig med brugen af maskiner såsom hækkeklippere, trimmere og mindre entreprenørmaskiner
  • Arbejder selvstændigt med øje for kvalitet
  • Har interesse for grøn omstilling og naturbaserede løsninger
  • Er en god og hjælpsom kollega, der bidrager til det gode samarbejde
  • Er villig til at deltage i arbejdet ved begravelser og urnenedsættelser

title: Integration Consultant within eHealth
description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.

The position

In your role as integration consultant at Cambio Healthcare, you will be an important part of Cambio’s technical consulting organization. Our mission is to support our customers with technical and integrational solutions linked to our EHR System - COSMIC. We are also tasked with creating a new ecosystem to facilitate third-party integrations so that we, together with others, can improve the entire chain in healthcare. You play a crucial role in our constant endeavor to support our customers in the best possible way. One of your most important tasks is to realize the benefits and opportunities that our solutions mean for the end users in healthcare. In the near future, our new customer group will introduce COSMIC, where you will be an important part of implementing successful integration solutions.

Becoming part of our team means that you will be one of our integration consultants and work externally towards our customers and contribute with competence in our product and their technical interoperability. It also involves work integration management and development of our integration platform, Cambio Open Services (COS). COS is our open platform that enables innovation and integration by promoting collaboration with third party solutions. This makes it possible for us to create exciting new solutions to offer our customers.

For example, you will work with:

  • Development of our customers competence and understanding of our solutions

  • Introduction, implementation, and development of integration solutions

  • Project lead and support for example implementations, education, and developments

  • Guide third-party providers in connections to our integration platform

We strive to have a team that, together with different skills and experience, can support our customers in their work going forward in the best possible way. We work to always stay at the forefront of new technologies and standards while supporting each other and sharing our knowledge.

At Cambio, we encourage taking initiatives that contribute to the development of the company and ourselves. For us, it is important that you should have the opportunity to grow, both as a person and as an employee. Our culture is described through the words “Trust”, “Care” and “Together” which permeate everything we do.

About you

For this role, we are looking for a person who is responsible, self-motivated and a humble team player. You find it easy to build relationships with our partners and are educational in your way of communicating. As a person, you are flexible, pragmatic, unprestigious and above all independent. You like to work on your own, but are also a team player of rank when required.


Requirements

  • Experience working with system integrations and/or APIs

  • Experience of working with IT solutions for larger organizations

  • Good technical knowledge in relevant areas for the role

  • Ability to travel for work when required

  • Proficiency in Swedish is a prerequisite for this position, as our client in the public sector specifically requires Swedish language skills.

It's a bonus if you

  • Highly meritorious with experience of COSMIC and related integration solutions

  • Knowledge of working with standards in medical informatics, preferably FHIR

  • Experience in administration and/or use of API Gateways

  • Experience in project management

  • Experience in the consulting industry

  • University degree or other higher education in IT or other relevant area

Place of employment: Stockholm, Linköping
Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)

Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period

Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.

We look forward to receiving your application!

CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW

Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life. Read more about us here!


A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible -explore our employee benefits

Learn more about our recruitment process here

Are you interested in Cambio but you don’t feel that this position is the perfect match? Check out our other open positions at our career site.

title: Care Services Employee
location: NSW - Sydney, CBD, Inner West and Eastern Suburbs
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a special kind of person – a St Vincent’s kind of person. Someone who puts compassion, connection and caring for other people at the heart of everything they do.

As a Care Services Employee, you will partner with residents to support their daily routine, lifestyle and choices and ensure they feel safe, valued, respected and engaged. You will provide direct care and assistance to residents with all activities of daily living, personal care needs (including personal hygiene) and attending to the daily running of the household as part of a supportive, dedicated team at St Vincent’s Care Services Edgecliff.

St Vincent's Care Services Edgecliff is just 4km east of Sydney's city centre. Our small but homey 39 bed facility is located in a tranquil, leafy suburb within walking distance of public transport.

At St Vincent’s Care, our Heartprint model ensures compassionate, holistic, person-centred care that empowers residents and fosters a sense of belonging, independence, and cultural respect, creating a life filled with purpose and wellbeing.

We are seeking people who are passionate about providing care that is sensitive to resident’s individualised needs, preferences and choices and are committed to building strong, meaningful connections with residents.

What’s on your resume is important, but what’s in your heart matters more.

Because at St Vincent’s, kindness works for us.

Applicants must have availability to work varied shifts (AM, PM and Nights) Monday to Friday.

Things that work for us:

  • Certificate III in Individual Support/Aged Care or similar qualifications essential

  • 6 months+ experience in a similar role with residential aged care experience is a must.

  • Must be available to work varied shifts.

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills

  • Experience with AutumnCare (or similar software) with ability to maintain excellent records

  • Understanding of Aged Care, resident rights/responsibilities with ability to follow the care plan

  • Nationally Coordinated Criminal Check History (valid within 6 months)

  • NDIS Worker Screening Check may be a requirement of this role.

Things that work for you:

  • More take-home pay with competitive salary packaging options up to $15,990, Novated leasing, plus an optional Meals and Entertainment card up to $2,650 per annum

  • Better work-life balance with consistent fortnightly rosters patterns for permanent positions -no rotating rosters!

  • Opportunity to work for the nation’s largest Catholic not-for-profit health and aged care provider, with a rapidly growing and progressive vision

  • Join an organisation where staff feedback indicates they are largely treated with respect, are confident in their management’s leadership and would stay if offered a similar job elsewhere

  • Career development, mentoring and leadership opportunities within St Vincent’s network

  • Like-minded colleagues with a friendly team environment and a great community care spirit

  • Rewarding work that focuses on relationships over routines

  • No cost uniforms and training

  • No mandatory COVID vaccinations! Free annual flu vaccination (recommended).

  • Employee Assistance Program for staff and their families

  • Access to the Fitness Passport (FP)

Why become part of the St Vincent’s Care family?

Because you’re like us, you believe that every act of kindness makes the world a better place. Better for everyone who lives in the 20+ facilities and locations we operate in Queensland, New South Wales and Victoria. Better for all our staff and employees, who work to provide the highest levels of care and quality of life for our clients. And better support for our local communities.

For more than 175 years, St Vincent’s Care has been a leading Catholic provider of Aged Care Services in Australia, upholding compassion, justice, integrity and excellence in all we do.

At St Vincent’s we value inclusivity and diversity and acknowledge the important of creating a work environment that is welcome, safe, fair and impartial and invite people from all backgrounds to join our caring family.

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


About Lilly & the Role

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. At our Global Business Solutions (GBS) center in Kuala Lumpur, the Trial Capabilities team supports clinical trials across Asia Pacific through high‑quality financial, operational, and compliance processes.

Purpose

The Trial Capabilities (TC) Internship provides undergraduate or graduate students with the opportunity to gain practical experience in clinical research and development. Working alongside the GBSKL TC team, interns will assist in the preparation, maintenance, and closure of investigator sites, as well as ensuring inspection readiness at all times. Additionally, interns will have the opportunity to participate in a mini project as part of the GBSKL TC team's process improvement initiatives. The internship also promotes relationship building with TC team members through participation in team building activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete all onboarding modules and the relevant TC curriculum assigned by GBSKL HR and TC management.
  • Assist TCS or TCA to perform clinical study or investigator site management activities.
  • Undertake TC routine tasks including administrative tasks in supporting the TC operation (e.g. upload and file study related documents into VC or SharePoints, perform data entry of clinical trial information into various clinical trial systems including maintaining systems and local tracking tools, performance metrics reporting, etc).
  • Perform quality review (QC) on documents related to Trial Capabilities.
  • Participate in process improvement projects for Trial Capabilities.
  • Understand, comply, and reinforce local regulations and guidance, Lilly medical policies and procedures, and GCP.
  • Participate in team building activities and other activities organized by the GBSKL teams.

Requirements

  • A degree or currently pursuing a degree in a scientific or health related field.
  • Able to commit to a full‑time internship (6 months).
  • Have aptitude in learning new skillsets and knowledge.
  • Willing to learn and comply with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Mandarin (ability to support in Traditional Mandarin preferred).
  • Good interpersonal communication, organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Good word processing skills and knowledge of MS Office applications.
  • Good attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Positive attitude, initiative, and a collaborative mindset.

Preferred Skills

  • Interest or coursework in finance, accounting, data analytics, life sciences, health sciences, computer science, AI/data science or business.
  • Problem‑solving, organization, and critical‑thinking skills.

Why Join Us?

  • Gain exposure to a global healthcare company with real‑world impact.
  • Exposure to clinical operations.
  • Contribute to regional projects that improve ways of working.
  • Build skills in analysis, automation, and process optimization.
  • Receive mentorship from experienced Trial Capabilities professionals.

How to Apply

Submit your CV and a short note on why you're interested in this internship.

title: Product Engineer – High Explosives PRT
description:
We have multiple openings for Product Engineers to support a modernization program. In this role, you will support the High Explosives (HE) Product Realization Team (PRT), contributing to HE material characterization, process development, producibility, surveillance, and the release of product definition, including drawings and specifications, to production agencies. You will also help resolve production partner issues and develop and execute engineering evaluations of production and surveillance processes at manufacturing facilities.

These positions are within the Defense Technologies Engineering Division (DTED) in the Engineering Directorate, which supports Strategic Deterrence (SD) Programs.

These roles may offer a hybrid schedule, with a mix of in-person and virtual work. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

These positions will be ﬁlled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

  • Support and coordinate the release of complex engineering drawings and other HE PRT documentation including project plans, qualiﬁcation plans, design requirement documentation, and interface deﬁnition, following standard techniques and methodologies.
  • Support the development and documentation of engineering requirements, support explosives material characterization and specification maturation, process development, and lead the product realization process by collaborating with Production Agencies, using defined practices, principles, and concepts.
  • Contribute to and/or prepare supporting safety and engineering documentation.
  • Participate in engineering test operations, provide engineering support, and collaborate with team members in analyzing results, and writing technical reports.
  • Review and support explosives producibility, manufacturability and machining, including requirements tradeoffs and process adjustments, and provide solutions to operational problems of moderate to high complexity.
  • Participate in formal and informal engineering design reviews, multi-site PRT meetings, and program reviews.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities, at the SES.3 level

  • Utilize advanced engineering knowledge and apply relevant experience and broad technical concepts and techniques to resolve complex technical and programmatic issues.
  • Exercise independent judgment to determine methods, techniques, and evaluations criteria to obtain and analyze results, and to provide solutions for a diverse range of moderately complex problems that require the creative use of established or innovative methods and often involve multiple, largely identiﬁable factors.
  • Coordinate and contribute to the execution of explosives testing and data analysis and prepare technical reports, documentation, and presentations.
  • Contribute to the successful completion of project and organizational goals and provide input on technical issues for speciﬁc tasks and projects.
  • Provide guidance and/or informal mentoring to less experienced team members.
  • Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related technical ﬁeld, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
  • Minimum of two years of professional engineering experience supporting one or more of the following: product development, product realization, manufacturing engineering, process engineering, design engineering, systems engineering, materials engineering, testing, or production support.
  • Familiarity and fundamental knowledge of and experience with requirements development and engineering drawings.
  • Fundamental knowledge of and operational experience with engineering testing processes, and demonstrated ability to conduct data analyses.
  • Familiarity and fundamental knowledge of and/or experience with design principles.
  • Knowledge of and/or applied experience with material properties and manufacturing methods.
  • Proficient verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills necessary to effectively collaborate in a multidisciplinary team environment, present and explain technical information, and interact with LLNL weapons program staff, nuclear security enterprise sites, and federal management staff.
  • Ability to travel.

Additional qualiﬁcations at the SES.3 level

  • Advanced knowledge and understanding of hardware design, fabrication or testing processes.
  • Advanced knowledge and understanding of and operational experience utilizing systems engineering, design for manufacturing, and quality engineering.
  • Experience preparing and conducting design/project reviews, as well as performing and completing the subsequent documenting, tracking, and reporting of action items.
  • Experience organizing, directing, and monitoring schedule and budgets) for multiple concurrent projects and the ability to reprioritize and change programmatic direction depending on emergent requests.

Qualiﬁcations We Desire

  • Master’s degree in Engineering or related ﬁeld.
  • Experience with product development processes including requirements management, design prototyping, product testing, business planning, pilot production, and manufacturing. Experience in manufacturing or setting up manufacturing processes at a production facility.
  • Ability to interpret speciﬁcations and mechanical drawings including Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T).
  • Knowledge of design applications employing high explosive materials.
  • Working knowledge of quality engineering and/or quality assurance and control.
  • Experience in deﬁnition/speciﬁcation releases, conﬁguration management, and Product Lifecycle Management systems.
  • Experience working in the NNSA’s nuclear weapons program, with working knowledge of NNSA’s Defense Programs Business Process Systems.

Pay Range

$146,340 - $222,564 Annually
$146,340 - $185,544 Annually for the SES.2 level
$175,530 - $222,564 Annually for the SES.3 level

This is the lowest to highest salary in good faith we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. Pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, speciﬁc competencies, relevant education, qualiﬁcations, certiﬁcations, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Also, all L or Q cleared employees are subject to random drug testing. Q-level clearance requires U.S. citizenship.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

Pre-Placement Medical Exam

All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.
