Working Conditions (travel, hours, environment)

  • Limited travel may be required by car
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to a warehouse environment and moving vehicles. The noise level in the work environment is typically moderate to noisy.

Physical/Sensory Requirements

Medium Work – Ability to exert 20-50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10-25 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than negligible up to 10 pounds of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. The employee is often required to use their hands and fingers, to handle or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

Monday - Friday 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM

Bonus opportunities & career advancement opportunities at every level

Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and other Insurance Plans (subject to eligibility criteria)

title: Kalder alle supersælgere! Circle K Lyngbygårdsvej i Lyngby søger en sælger på 15 timer.
description:
Kære fremtidige kollega.

Først og fremmest, lad os starte med at sige, at et job som Sælger hos Circle K ikke er for alle. Men det er et job der passer til mange, og måske også dig?

At arbejde som sælger på Circle K er ikke som ethvert sælgerjob. Os der arbejder her er vilde med det, og spørger du en af vores uundværlige sælgere om hvorfor, vil de bl.a. nævne: Selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og ansvar.

Vi leder efter en positiv teamplayer som:

  • Har en sælger gemt I sig, motiveres af salg og kan levere en service lidt ud over det sædvanlige

  • Kan bevare overblikket og humøret, når der kommer uforudsete udfordringer ind af døren, og formår at løse dem med sund fornuft. Også selvom der er lang kø

  • Har en interesse for at tilberede mad. For vi elsker det! Og vi ser derfor gerne, at du har lyst til, at lave de lækreste sandwich og de bedste burgere.

  • Forstår vigtigheden af, at vores kunder får den bedste oplevelse når de besøger os. Dette indebærer også at butikken, kundetoilet og forplads er ren og pæn.

  • Du forstår betydningen af, at arbejde i et team, hvor alle er afhængige af- og stoler på, at hver løfter sit. Og til tider er villig til at give lidt ekstra.

Hvad kan I tilbyde mig?

Vi er en dynamisk, handlingsorienteret organisation, hvor vi arbejder sammen som ét team. Vi tager ikke os selv alt for højtideligt og engagerer os ikke i politik eller bureaukrati. Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på.

Det er altafgørende at du har lysten og motivationen til at lære nye ting, udvikle dig og bidrage til vores ”one-team” kultur. Hvis du har ambitionen om at bygge en karriere, får du unikke muligheder i Circle K, så længe du har den motivation der skal til.

Udover helt unikke udviklingsmuligheder, tilbyder vi et job med yderst attraktive fordele og personalegoder. Som en del af vores Circle K familie vil du bl.a. få medarbejderrabat på brændstof, bilvask samt på mad og drikkevarer i vores butikker.

Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring

  • Fordelagtige lønninger og forskudttidstillæg

  • Og ikke mindst, Danmarks bedste kollegaer

Så hvis du vil have et job, hvor du kan være med til at give vores kunder den bedste oplevelse, udvikle dig og blive en del af et fantastisk team på Circle K Lyngbygårdsvej, så er det nu du skal sende din ansøgning afsted.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Store Manager Tobias Gabriel Combet på tlf. nr.: +45 45 88 37 76

Antal timer:

15 timer.

Arbejdstiden er placeret på tidspunkter, der betyder, at stillingen er forbeholdt ansøgere over 18 år og ikke egner sig som studiejob.

Vagtfordeling:
Skiftende vagter på hele døgnet i hverdag og weekend.

Ansøgningsfrist og tiltrædelse:

Løbende

Som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen, indhenter vi referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgivere.

Hos os behøver du, hverken CV eller ansøgning for at søge job. Når du trykker på ”ansøg nu” kommer du til en portal, hvor du skal svare på nogle spørgsmål om forskellige arbejdssituationer, som samtidig giver dig et indblik i, hvordan det er at arbejde i Circle K.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Hos Circle K er der plads til alle, og vi arbejder altid sammen som One team! Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på. Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge stillingen – uanset alder, køn, religion, handicap, etnisk baggrund etc. Det vigtigste for os er, hvordan du er som menneske.

title: Front-end/Full-stack Developer
description:
GP Solutions is looking for a Fullstack Developer!

Project: Leading travel technology provider. B2B platforms designed for airline partners to deliver differentiated retail products and seamless connected journeys.

Technology stack: Next.js / React / Node / Typescript / Jest / Storybook / Vercel / HTML / CSS / Emotion.

A Strong Candidate Will Have:

  • Strong commercial experience with React and TypeScript.
  • Experience building production applications with Next.js or another SSR framework;
  • Strong HTML, CSS, responsive-design, and accessibility knowledge;
  • Experience shipping and maintaining production software;
  • Ability to solve complex technical problems independently;
  • Clear communication in English (B2 level);
  • Mentoring less experienced developers;
  • Relevant degree or equivalent experience proving your expertise.

Will Be a Plus:

  • System design skills and ability to weigh different architectural approaches;
  • Multi-brand or whitelabel platforms;
  • Tailwind CSS and CSS-in-JS migrations;
  • Web performance and conversion optimization;
  • Experimentation, analytics, and funnel optimization;
  • Localization and international products;
  • Third-party supplier and payment integrations;
  • Monitoring through Sentry or similar tooling;
  • Airline, travel, e-commerce, booking, or payment products.

Soft Skills:

  • Responsibility, proactivity, stress tolerance;
  • Positive mindset and customer-oriented approach;
  • Strong analytical skills to tackle complex technical challenges alone.

Your Responsibilities Will Include:

• Own the implementation and launch of key features for new business partners;

• Design and build responsive, accessible booking experiences (search, pricing, checkout, payment, confirmation);

• Integrate frontend and third-party services, weighing trade-offs between approaches;

• Configure and troubleshoot partner-specific branding, localization, and integrations;

• Drive improvements in performance and conversion rates;

• Investigate and resolve production issues independently, knowing when to escalate;

• Champion platform reliability through monitoring, testing, and high engineering standards;

If you are looking for a place where you’ll tackle challenging projects alongside some of the most talented and dynamic people you’ve ever worked with, GP Solutions might just be the place for you.

title: Senior Programme Manager
description:
The Senior Programme Manager will lead the successful delivery of complex, high-value programmes within the UK TacCIS and wider defence, engineering and technical delivery environment. The role is responsible for driving programme performance across time, cost, quality, risk, financial and contractual commitments, while leading multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors and suppliers both directly and through subordinate managers.

The role requires strong programme governance, stakeholder management and customer leadership, with regular engagement at senior internal and external levels. The postholder will oversee programme planning, delivery assurance, financial control, risk and opportunity management, performance reporting and continuous improvement across a portfolio of medium to high complexity projects.

In addition to delivery responsibilities, the Senior Programme Manager will support business growth through capture, bid and proposal activity, ensuring opportunities are aligned to customer needs, business strategy and long-range planning objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the successful delivery of complex, high-value programmes across time, cost, quality, risk and contractual commitments.
  • Manage programme teams, subcontractors, suppliers and delivery partners both directly and through subordinate managers.
  • Establish robust programme governance, planning, reporting and performance controls across the portfolio.
  • Own programme financial performance, including budgets, forecasting, cost control, EAC/ETC, cash and margin.
  • Identify, assess and manage programme risks and opportunities, ensuring mitigation plans are implemented and escalated where required.
  • Act as a senior interface with customers, users, internal stakeholders, suppliers and delivery partners.
  • Provide clear, timely and accurate programme reporting to support senior decision-making.
  • Lead cross-functional delivery teams across engineering, commercial, supply chain, finance and project controls.
  • Ensure contractual deliverables, milestones, KPIs and customer commitments are met.
  • Support business growth through capture, bid and proposal activity for new and follow-on opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement across programme delivery, governance, team performance and customer outcomes.
  • Align programme delivery with wider business strategy, long-range planning and organisational objectives.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience in complex programme delivery, strong commercial and financial acumen, proven leadership of cross-functional teams and supply chains, and the ability to operate confidently across both Waterfall and Agile delivery environments. Experience in Tactical Communications, defence, engineering or similar complex technical domains would be advantageous.

  • Extensive experience delivering complex, high-value programmes, including leadership of multidisciplinary teams and supply chains.
  • Proven track record of leading programme delivery through subordinate managers, including governance of project and programme managers.
  • Experience managing strategic programmes and/or portfolios of low to high complexity, within a structured delivery and governance framework.
  • Demonstrable experience of financial management and commercial accountability at programme level.
  • Experience of leading or contributing to strategic capture and proposal activities for follow-on or new business opportunities.
  • Degree-qualified in a relevant discipline (e.g. Engineering, Business, IT) or equivalent experience.
  • Professional certification (e.g. APM PMQ/APMP, SAFe Agilist or equivalent) is advantageous.
  • Evidence of ongoing professional development aligned to programme leadership and delivery excellence.

Salary for this position is £76,000 - £96,000, depending on experience plus our excellent flexible benefits package.

We offer hybrid working - for this role ideally we are looking for an average of 2 days per week per month on site.

We pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose, offering impressive benefits:

  • A compressed nine-day fortnight and compressed hours - which means every other Friday off.
  • A personalized career development plan, alongside regular progress reviews - supporting and valuing your progression within the Company.
  • A flexible working environment where your contributions are recognized and rewarded with flexible benefits

We believe in maintaining a diverse workplace - inclusive of beliefs, cultural background, job experiences, thoughts and ideas. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we welcome you to join our inclusive team!

Our success is fuelled by our colleagues and the wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills they bring to the Company.

We are a Disability Confident Employer, as such we offer an interview to disabled people who meet the minimum criteria for the job.
Please email disabilityconfident@gd-ms.uk if you would like your application to be considered under the DC Scheme.

All successful/appointed applicants must be able to obtain a level of UK Security clearance that is appropriate for the role and undertake suitable Right to work checks

title: Administrative profiler med drive? Vi har 3.000 grunde til at søge.
description:
Next har vækst på erhvervsuddannelserne. Derfor søger vi 3 medarbejdere som brænder for at varetage administrative opgaver, der understøtter 3.000 erhvervsuddannelseselever på 24 uddannelser. Der er mulighed for fastansættelse og/eller midlertidige ansættelse.

Har du styr på detaljerne, overblik i travlheden og lyst til at gøre en reel forskel for elever og virksomheder hver eneste dag? Trives du med administrative opgaver – og med at være en del af et fællesskabsorienteret team, der får tingene til at glide bag kulisserne?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter til vores administrative team i Glostrup og Herlev.
Hos os er administration ikke “bare” administration. Vi mærker hver dag, at vores arbejde gør en forskel.

Hvem er vi?
På NEXT arbejder vi for, at alle får en uddannelse. Fordi uddannelse skaber stolthed, mening og muligheder for fremtiden. Vi tilbyder gymnasier, erhvervsuddannelser, eux, 10. klasse og efteruddannelse i hele Storkøbenhavn – og bag det hele står en stærk administration i Virksomheds- og Uddannelsesservice.

Du bliver en del af et team på femten engagerede kolleger, der sammen understøtter flere end 3.000 elever på tværs af alle NEXTs erhvervsuddannelser. Vi samarbejder tæt, hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok. Vi er professionelle og har en stærk faglighed og et godt socialt miljø. Vi står sammen og er fagligt nysgerrige, vi inddrager ny teknologi i opgaveløsningen, samtidig med at vi værdsætter de personlige relationer til uddannelsesafdelingerne.

Du bliver en del af Virksomheds- og Uddannelsesservice og refererer til afdelingslederen.
Du bliver en del af et team med primært arbejdssted på Hovedstadens Håndværkercampus i Glostrup eller i vores skoleoplæring i Herlev. Samtidig vil du komme rundt på NEXTs uddannelsesafdelinger, når opgaverne kalder på det, f.eks. til møder eller svendeprøveafslutninger.

Vi tilbyder en hverdag med fleksibilitet og mulighed for selv at tilrettelægge dine opgaver inden for almindelig arbejdstid. Samtidig vægter vi det nære samarbejde højt, og derfor er vi de fleste dage samlet på vores fælles kontor, hvor vi sparrer, hjælper hinanden og løfter opgaverne i fællesskab.

Primære arbejdsopgaver
Teamet er omdrejningspunkt for den administrative understøttelse af elever, virksomheder, undervisere, ledere, skemalæggere samt faglige og lokale uddannelsesudvalg. Vi er optaget af, i fællesskab at udvikle vores praksis og samtidig sikre driften, så alle elever kan gennemføre deres uddannelse.

Du bliver en central del af maskinrummet og får blandt andet ansvar for:
  • vigtig kommunikation med uddannelsesafdelingerne på mail, telefon og personligt
  • daglig sagsbehandling i vores mange administrative systemer
  • planlægning, koordinering og opfølgning
  • besvarelse af henvendelser fra elever, virksomheder og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • udvikling af teamets praksis for opgaveløsning i samspil med kolleger og afdelingslederen
  • desuden arbejder vi løbende med interne mini-projekter der forbedrer vores egen praksis.

Du vil opleve en hverdag med mange eksterne og interne kontaktflader, afbrydelser og forskelligartede opgaver – og netop det trives du med.

Hvem er du?
  • Du er typen, der holder hovedet koldt og humøret højt – også når tempoet stiger.
  • Du er:
  • relationskompetent – glider nemt ind i mange forskellige menneskelige relationer og bidrager positivt
  • nysgerrig – udfordrer gerne egen og andres praksis og lytter til nye måder at arbejde på
  • samarbejdende og positiv – både med teamet, med nærmeste leder, i organisationen og med elever og virksomheder
  • modig – afprøver systemer, AI, robotter, brug af data og andre nye muligheder
  • struktureret - har blik for systematik
  • løsningsorienteret og pragmatisk
  • rettidig – inddrager og følger tæt op med kolleger og samarbejdspartnere
  • kommunikativ stærk – både i skrift og tale
  • serviceminded – på mail, i telefonen og i den personlige kontakt.

Måske har du flere års erfaring fra en administrativ stilling i det offentlige og har lyst til nye udfordringer. Eller du er nyuddannet fra en videregående uddannelse med mod på at prøve kræfter med administration i en stor organisation. Det kan også være du er sabbatist og skal begynde på en videregående uddannelse i efteråret 2027. Det vigtigste er ikke din titel og uddannelse – men din tilgang.

Hvad kan du forvente?
  • Du får en arbejdsplads med:
  • et levende miljø og mange relationer
  • et stærkt fællesskab der vægter faglighed og socialt samvær
  • en uformel tone og plads til grin
  • en organisation i udvikling
  • fokus på kompetenceudvikling – også din
Ansættelsesvilkår
Da du bliver en del af hverdagen i et skolemiljø, skal du forvente, at mængden af arbejdsopgaver varierer i løbet af skoleåret og at du skal kunne være mobil ift. NEXTs mange adresser. Af hensyn til driften holder vi ferier når eleverne også holder ferie (sommerferien, vinterferien, efterårsferien, påskeferien og juleferien).

Der er tale om en fast stilling på 37 timer/uge og en midlertidig stilling på 37 timer/uge (frem til sommeren 2027) begge stillinger med primært arbejdssted i Herlev.

title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) - Media Planning & Fulfillment Tools
description:
bonial helps you save time, money and paper!

We are a digital advertising partner for offline businesses - we support retailers in their marketing activities and help them find a new audience. Would you like to join and be a part of digitalisation of retail?

Bonial is part of Axel Springer SE and is disrupting the retail landscape as the leading "Drive to Store" partner in Germany and France. Through our platforms "kaufDA" and "MeinProspekt" in Germany, and “Bonial” in France, we connect millions of users with their favorite shops and brands—driving real impact every single day.
We are in the midst of an exciting growth phase, scaling fast and transforming the way people discover retail. At Bonial, we thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced environment fueled by motivated, results-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic team that’s shaping the future of retail, we’d love to meet you.


bonial welcomes both full- and part-timers!

Your Role

You will own the product area within our Client Facing Platforms group, building internal tools and solutions that help Bonial deliver value to our retail partners at scale.

Your team focuses on Bonial Console: a set of internal tools that help plan content publication based on client contracts and monitor campaign setup. Your main focus area is the detailed media planning process — translating the requirements from client contracts (localisation, publication plan, click targets, overall runtime) into a detailed fulfillment plan that enables correct day-to-day operational workflow management.

With it, you'll hold a genuine mandate to rethink how Bonial turns client contracts into daily operations at scale. We're looking for someone who looks at how our internal operations run today and refuses to accept "that's just how it works" as an answer. Your job isn't to make the current process faster or better, it's to question whether it should exist in its current form at all, to build and champion something better. You'll need to be equally comfortable redesigning a screen and redesigning the workflow, the handoffs, and the assumptions that teams have been quietly operating on for years — then bringing engineering, operations, data, and leadership along with you.

You'll report directly to the Head of Product, with real license to challenge how things are done.

Your responsibilities:

● Own and drive product strategy and roadmap for your area, making clear prioritisation calls, including what not to build

● Run continuous discovery of internal processes, tools, and users to map workflows, connections, and bottlenecks, and turn findings into a prioritised roadmap and clear user stories

● Size and validate ideas before building; maintain a prioritised backlog with clear rationale, owning the quarterly view for your domain head and C-level counterparts

● Lead the full product lifecycle: problem framing, scoping, shipping, measuring outcomes, and iterating

● Define success metrics and use data and experimentation to validate direction and guide decisions, not just report on performance

● Align stakeholders across Product, Business Operations, Engineering, Data, and leadership around a shared direction, building trust and clear expectations

● Present product updates, progress reports, and strategic recommendations to stakeholders and senior management

● Map workflows with department leadership and C-level stakeholders to find where time and capacity are lost, distinguishing quick wins from processes that need full redesign

● Drive product innovation by tracking industry trends and technology, and by embedding AI-driven approaches and tools into both the product and your own ways of working

Your profile:

● Strong experience in Product Management, including automation experience, in an agile, fast-paced tech environment, with a track record of owning a product area end-to-end

● Proof you've shipped automation or AI solutions from requirements to live systems with real adoption

● The judgment to turn ambiguity into a scoped, prioritised plan, and the influence to drive change with senior stakeholders

● Strong stakeholder management skills, able to align competing priorities and drive decisions across teams

● Data-driven and tech-savvy: able to self-serve on data, form hypotheses, and engage deeply with engineers on technical solutions

● Pragmatic and goal-oriented mindset, able to navigate ambiguity and break complex problems into tangible pieces

● Real experience working with internal users and developing internal tooling

● Familiarity with inventory management, ad delivery, or campaign operations is an advantage

What We Offer:

High growth story - Bonial is a high-growth and dynamic company with continuous potential into the future. We are a leading player and a driving force in an industry that is undergoing a massive and a once-in-a-lifetime shift from print to digital.

Innovation & tech - we are a high-tech company focused on innovative technology, leveraging AI and other tools to maximize productivity and efficiency. We leverage these tools to continually enhance the performance of our company and our people, while driving results for our customers and users.

Exciting environment for professional development - strong support for your professional development, backed-up by a feedback culture to help you identify your strengths and opportunities.

Diversity - proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we aim to enable everyone to show up as their full selves. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and to being a safe space regardless of race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender, gender identity or gender expression.

Wellbeing - we believe mental health is as important as being fit. That's why we're giving you free access to nilo.health, a mental health app. In terms of physical training, other than our awesome gym in the office, we also cover part of the subscription to the Urban Sports Club. We can also offer you a corporate pension scheme so you don't have to worry about your retirement.

Sustainability - together with our Green team, we offer you the opportunity to engage in projects that promote sustainability, environmental development and the impact that we make on our planet.

Flexibility - Currently, we have a policy that allows for up to 20% mobile work, which can be conducted from anywhere within Germany, and the option to work from abroad. Additionally, we offer 28 days of holiday. You also get an extra day for each calendar year (up to 30 days) as well as other occasions (moving, working on a social project, etc).*

Modern office - Zen Rooms where employees can pray, relax or simply have some quiet time; fully equipped gym in the office, and a roof terrace for amazing social events.

Free lunch – whenever you’re at the office, we offer you different lunch options – and it’s all on us! Enjoy your lunch at a nearby restaurant that partners with us! Hot and cold drinks, fruit, regular varied and healthy breakfasts and other snacks at the office are, of course, always available for free for our employees.*

Social Culture – which encourages people to start conversations, build relationships and participate together in the community through regular team events.

Visa Sponsorship – we provide visa sponsorship for those of you who are eager to join us from outside of Germany.

Partner for retail - we empower retailers to reach their customers in the most efficient and effective way possible. We see ourselves as a critical business partner for retail, and as highlighted in our Company Vision, we “Enrich local shopping for everyone. Everyday.”

As part of the Axel Springer Group, we also align with the Axel Springer Essentials.


If you think you could fit the bill, we'd love to hear from you!

You can check out our bonial_people Instagram or read more about bonial culture and tech on Medium.

*as per our current Works Agreements

title: Koulunkäynninohjaaja, Lauttasaaren ala-asteen koulu
description:
Haemme yhteisölliseen ja ammattitaitoiseen joukkoomme Lauttasaaren ala-asteen kouluun sinua, joka olet motivoitunut tekemään koulunkäynninohjaajan tehtäviä. Lauttasaaren koulu on noin 600 oppilaan ala-aste. Meillä voi opiskella suomenkielisellä luokalla, englannin kielirikasteisella luokalla tai ruotsin kielikylpyluokalla. Koulumme on pidetty työpaikka, jossa on toisiaan tukeva työyhteisö. Meille on helppo tulla sekä jalan, pyörällä kuin julkisilla kulkuvälineilläkin. Meille on siis helppo tulla ja jäädä!

Kiinnostaako sinua työskentely Lauttasaaren alueen lähikoulussa? Sopisit työyhteisöömme hyvin, jos olet positiivinen, ratkaisukeskeinen, yhteistyökykyinen ja oma-aloitteinen tekijä. Arvostamme myönteistä suhtautumista työtehtäviin, vahvoja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä osaamista toimia kaikenlaisten oppijoiden kanssa. Lähetä hakemus ja kerro meille enemmän, mitä toisit mukanasi kouluumme!

Koulunkäynninohjaajana työskentelysi tavoitteena on oppijan ohjaaminen ja tukeminen koulunkäynnin- ja oppimisprosessin eri vaiheissa. Työnkuvaan kuuluu myös huolenpitoa oppilaan hyvinvoinnista. Meillä työtehtäväsi ovat monipuolisia oppilaan oppimista ja hyvinvointia tukevia. Koulunkäynninohjaajana voit toimia perusopetuksessa ryhmäavustajana tai lähialueen erityisluokassamme. Tehtävänkuvasi määräytyy luokan ja oppilaiden tarpeiden mukaan ja työtehtävät voivat vaihdella. Työpäiväsi voi sisältää esimerkiksi oppilaiden taksikyyditysten valvomista, oppitunneilla avustamista, oppilaiden henkilökohtaista avustamista kouluarjen tilanteissa, välitunti- ja ruokailun valvontaa sekä pienempien ryhmien ohjausta.

Toivomme, että sinulla olisi tehtäväsi puitteissa osaamista ja motivaatiota tukea oppilaiden liikunnallista koulupäivää ja kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia.

Työaikasi on 26h/vko ja siihen perustuva tasopalkka on 1632,15€. Lisäksi palkkaan kuuluu mahdolliset KVTES:n mukaiset lisät. Tasopalkka voi muuttua osaamisen ja vastuutason mukaisesti. Koulunkäynninohjaajan kokonaistuntimäärä voidaan tarkistaa lukuvuosi kerrallaan koulun resurssin puitteissa koulun toiminta-ajaksi.

Koulunkäynninohjaajat otetaan Helsingin kaupungin palvelukseen ja työsopimukseen kirjataan ensimmäinen toimipaikka. Toimipaikka määräytyy kulloinkin käytettävissä olevien resurssien perusteella ja voi vaihtua vuosittain.

Työsopimukseen sisältyy 30 vrk kesäkeskeytys, joka ajoitetaan pääsääntöisesti heinäkuulle ja vuosilomat ajoitetaan pääsääntöisesti koulujen loma-ajoille. Muina koulujen loma-aikoina koulunkäynninohjaajat ja erityiskoulunkäynninohjaajat voivat myös työskennellä vammaisten lasten keskitetyssä loma-ajan toiminnassa. Loma-aikoina toimipaikka voi olla joku muu Helsingin kaupungin koulu.

Saat tietoa rekrytoinnin jatkosta rehtorilta viikolla 34 sähköpostitse. Haastattelut pidetään koululla Lauttasaaressa osoitteessa Myllykalliontie 3 keskiviikkona 26.8.2026 klo 10.00-14.00 välisenä aikana. Työt alkavat maanantaina 31.8.2026.

Mitä Helsingin kaupunki tarjoaa sinulle?

Meille on tärkeää, että voit tehdä vaikuttavaa työtä hyvän helsinkiläisen elämän eteen. Haluamme, että onnistut ja innostut työssäsi. Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia kasvaa ja kehittyä ammattilaisena. Tuoreimman henkilöstökyselyn mukaan meillä viihdytään ja työ koetaan mielekkääksi!

Saat käyttöösi Suomen suurimman työnantajan henkilöstöedut, kuten jopa 550 euron Epassi Flex -edun käytettäväksi työmatkoihin sekä kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hyvinvointipalveluihin. Lue lisää henkilöstöeduistamme ja tutustu Helsingin kaupunkiin työnantajana osoitteessa: https://www.hel.fi/fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/miksi-toihin-kaupungille



Kelpoisuusehto:

Kelpoisuusehtona on koulunkäynnin ja aamu- ja iltapäivätoiminnan ohjauksen ammattitutkinto, koulunkäyntiavustajan ammattitutkinto tai muu soveltuva tutkinto.

Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään suomen kielen hyvää suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Tehtävään otettavan tulee toimittaa itseään koskeva lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) tarkoittama rekisteriote.

title: MIG-hitsaaja
description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme motivoitunutta MIG-hitsaajaa kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Asiakkaamme on vakavarainen ja arvostettu yritys, joka tarjoaa työntekijöilleen vakaan työympäristön sekä kilpailukykyisen kuukausipalkan.

Hae paikkaa nopeasti, sillä täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

title: Meat Cutter
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Meat Specialist

Department: Meat

FLSA: Non-Exempt

General Function

The meat specialist is a fully skilled job that cuts and merchandises all fresh meat commodities.

Core Competencies

  • Partnerships
  • Growth mindset
  • Results oriented
  • Customer focused
  • Professionalism

Reporting Relations

Accountable and Reports to: District Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Operations, Perishables, Health Wellness Home; Service Managers; Meat Department Manager or Assistant Meat Department Manager where applicable.

Positions that Report to you: None

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provides prompt, efficient and friendly customer service by exhibiting caring, concern and patience in all customer interactions and treating customers as the most important people in the store.
  • Smiles and greets customers in a friendly manner, whether the encounter takes place in the employee’s designated department or elsewhere in the store.
  • Makes an effort to learn customers’ names and to address them by name whenever possible.
  • Assists customers by:
    • escorting them to the products they’re looking for
    • securing products that are out of reach
    • loading or unloading heavy items
    • making note of and passing along customer suggestions or requests
    • performing other tasks in every way possible to enhance the shopping experience.
  • Answers the telephone promptly and provides friendly, helpful service to customers who call.
  • Works with co-workers as a team to ensure customer satisfaction and a pleasant work environment.
  • Tenderizes, grinds, and cuts merchandise.
  • Prepares cutting lists for case fills.
  • Conducts cutting tests.
  • Orders new items (not strictly for replenishment).
  • Monitors refrigeration for proper temperatures.
  • Maintains strict adherence to department and company guidelines related to personal hygiene and dress.
  • Adheres to company policies and individual store guidelines.
  • Reports to work when scheduled and on time.

Secondary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manages the department in the absence of the department manager and assistant department manager
  • Wraps, weighs, and labels product
  • Performs cleaning in the department
  • Replenishes and organizes coolers
  • Assists in other areas of store as needed
  • Performs other job related duties and special projects as required

Supervisory Responsibilities

Manages the department in the absence of the Department Manager and Assistant Department Manager

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Worker Characteristics

  • Must be able to solve practical problems; variety of variables with limited standardization; interpret instructions.
  • Must have the ability to do arithmetic calculations involving fractions, decimals, and percentages.
  • Have the ability to file, post, and mail materials; copy data from one record to another; talk with customers to identify their requests; guide people and provide basic direction.

Education and Experience

High School or equivalent, Hy-Vee food safety training. Over one year of related work experience preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Must be physically able to exert up to 100 pounds of force (energy exerted) occasionally; exert up to 50 pounds of force frequently; and exert up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
  • Visual requirements include vision from less than 20 inches to more than 20 feet with or without correction, depth perception, color vision (ability to identify and distinguish colors), and field of vision.
  • Must be able to perform the following physical activities: Climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions.

Working Conditions

This position is exposed daily to dirt, noise, temperature extremes, dampness, vibrations, equipment movement hazards, cleaning chemicals/solvents, and electrical shock. This is a fast paced work environment.

Equipment Used to Perform Job

Power ban saw, Grinder, Tenderizer, Slicker, Bone duster (where applicable), Knives, Tumblers, Automatic patty machine (where applicable), Automatic stuffier, Wrapping system, Rotisserie, Pallet jack, Familiar with software.

Confidentiality

Has access to confidential information such as cutting tests, tonnage sheets, monthly reports, and projection sheets.

Contacts

Has daily contact with customers and the general public, and vendors/suppliers in the absence of the department manager.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Strategy Realization Analyst
description:
Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. Come join a #1 team and do some good!


Responsibilities

In this job, you help shape and carry out the department’s strategic initiatives by supporting planning, analysis, coordination, and hands-on project work. You translate strategy into action by advancing key projects, supporting execution, and providing the visibility, structure, and insight needed to keep work aligned, accountable, and moving forward.

  • Supporting Program Planning and Execution: Coordinating planning activities for strategic programs and department initiatives to help keep work organized, aligned, and moving forward
  • Maintaining Roadmaps and Tracking Progress: Managing roadmaps, milestone trackers, status updates, action logs, and dependency tracking to provide visibility into program progress
  • Supporting Prioritization and Intake: Gathering information, organizing requests, and documenting impacts and constraints to support intake, triage, and prioritization decisions
  • Preparing Governance and Leadership Materials: Developing materials for program kick-offs, governance meetings, executive updates, and cross-workstream discussions with the ability to craft clear, compelling narratives that help senior leaders understand decisions, tradeoffs, and impacts.
  • Coordinating Across Workstreams: Partnering with business, technology, process, analytics, and operational teams to collect updates, align activities, and support collaboration
  • Conducting Analysis and Reporting: Performing analysis and reporting to support strategic planning, execution readiness, prioritization, and decision-making
  • Improving Tools and Processes: Helping develop templates, tools, and standard processes that strengthen planning, reporting, accountability, and governance

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Coffee Shop Barista

Department: Coffee Shop

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

As a Barista at Hy-Vee, you'll be the friendly face our customers look forward to seeing every morning. In this role, you'll craft beverages, keep the coffee shop stocked and spotless, and make sure every customer walks away with exactly what they came in for, and a smile to go with it.

If you enjoy connecting with people, love a fast-paced environment, and take pride in doing things well, this could be a great fit for you.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting customers warmly, learning their names, and going the extra mile to make every visit a positive one

  • Take customer orders at the counter and over the phone, and assist with finding products and answering questions

  • Prepare and replenish coffee shop products as needed throughout your shift

  • Monitor product freshness and appearance and follow or develop a production list to stay ahead of daily needs

  • Handle food safely and keep the work area clean, neat, and up to department standards at all times

  • Check in product, put product away, and review invoices as needed

  • Run the department register and process payments where applicable

  • Remove trash promptly and maintain a tidy department

  • Work alongside your teammates to ensure a smooth, positive experience for every customer

  • Maintain compliance with Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all company policies

  • Assist in other store areas and take on special projects as needed

  • You'll receive direction and support from: Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home, Food Service Director, and Coffee Shop Department Manager

Your Skills

You don't need prior experience for this role! We'll happily train and support you as you grow. To be successful, you'll need to be able to:

  • Follow written and verbal instructions with confidence

  • Use basic math skills for simple addition, subtraction, counting, and recording

  • Communicate clearly with customers and teammates in a friendly, helpful way

  • Stay organized and keep up with the pace of a busy coffee shop environment

  • Less than a high school diploma or equivalent accepted; up to six months of similar or related experience preferred

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home, Food Service Director, and Coffee Shop Department Manager

Education and Experience

  • Less than a high school diploma or equivalent experience accepted

  • Up to six months of similar or related work experience preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

Working Environment

This role is performed in a store coffee shop environment with significant pressure to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities throughout your shift. You may encounter exposure to noise, equipment movement hazards, cleaning chemicals or solvents, and possible electrical shock and temperature extremes. title: Workplace Health Consultant (Casual) – Melbourne
description:
The Company

Vitality Works, part of the Sanitarium Group, partners with leading organisations across Australia and New Zealand to deliver evidence-informed workplace health solutions. Our Health Promotion & Injury Prevention (HPIP) team works across major infrastructure, construction, manufacturing, mining and utility environments to reduce injury risk and improve workforce capacity.

We are seeking a clinician or exercise scientist to join our Melbourne team on a casual, sessional basis (a few days per month).

This role is well suited to a Physiotherapist, Exercise Physiologist, Chiropractor, Occupational Therapist or Exercise Scientist looking to apply their expertise in a preventative, workplace setting alongside their primary role.

The successful candidate must be based in Melbourne and be willing to travel outside the Melbourne area as required.

The Role

As a Workplace Health Consultant at Vitality Works, you will deliver structured, evidence-based health promotion and injury prevention initiatives on-site.

Key responsibilities include:

· Delivering workshops focused on musculoskeletal and psychological risk reduction

· Conducting targeted health risk screenings (e.g. blood pressure, metabolic indicators)

· Providing brief early-intervention consultations and preventative guidance

· Supporting ergonomic and movement education initiatives

· Building strong relationships with site leaders and stakeholders

· Contributing to reporting aligned to measurable program outcomes

You will operate as a trusted health professional within complex work environments, translating clinical knowledge into practical, scalable prevention strategies.

About You

· Tertiary qualification in Physiotherapy, Exercise Physiology, Occupational Therapy, Exercise Science or similar

· Relevant registration/accreditation (where applicable)

· CPR & First Aid certification

· Strong communication skills and professional presence

· Interest in occupational health, prevention and population-level impact

· Workplace health experience is advantageous but not essential.

title: Software Engineering Analyst
description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description: Let's introduce ourselves

At Volvo Cars, we're on an ambitious journey to redefine the future of mobility. Safety has always been at the heart of everything we do – and today, that mission extends deep into our self-driving and driver-assistance technologies. Within R&D, our AD/ADAS organisation develops the features that help our customers drive safer, smoother and with more confidence every day, from Pilot Assist to highway autonomous drive and beyond.You'll join a cross-functional team that acts as the "detectives" of our AD/ADAS development. When a complex, system-level issue appears in a test fleet vehicle and no single team owns it, we're the ones who step in, trace it end-to-end, and make sure it gets solved – and that we learn from it.What we offer:

  • A chance to shape features that genuinely matter for road safety, at a company where safety is more than a slogan.
  • A modern R&D environment in Gothenburg with access to test vehicles, rigs and a strong AD/ADAS ecosystem.
  • A culture that values curiosity, collaboration and personal growth, with strong support for continuous learning.
  • Competitive compensation, flexible working, and the Volvo Cars benefits package.

What you'll do

As a System Analyst, you'll lead system-level issue analysis for our AD/ADAS features. Your work will directly influence the quality of features our customers rely on every day. In this role, you will:

  • Lead fault tracing of complex, unclear issues that span multiple functions, software releases and teams.
  • Translate fuzzy problem statements from the field into clear hypotheses, reproducible findings and concrete corrective actions.
  • Decide independently where to focus testing, when to escalate, and which stakeholders to involve – often under time pressure close to a release.
  • Drive exploratory and pre-merge testing on our ADAS test fleet, including hands-on work with vehicles, logs and signals (FlexRay, CAN, Ethernet, in-vehicle diagnostics).
  • Drive lessons learned back into system design and test coverage ("shift-left"), so the same issue doesn't appear twice.
  • Run KPI and fault analysis to spot trends, prioritise the right problems and shorten the lead time from "fault found" to "fault fixed".
  • Support the launch of new car programs and features by identifying risks early, before formal verification gates.
  • Collaborate closely with design, verification & validation, program management and our partners – including Zenseact.
Profile description: What you'll bring

We're looking for an engineer who thrives in ambiguity, loves digging into data, and gets energy from solving the problems no one else can crack. You likely have:

  • A degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, Vehicle Engineering or similar.
  • Solid experience with embedded automotive systems – ideally in AD/ADAS, active safety, powertrain or another safety-critical domain.
  • Hands-on experience in system-level fault tracing, root-cause analysis and exploratory vehicle testing.
  • Strong skills in log and signal analysis (FlexRay/CAN/Ethernet, Wireshark, in-vehicle diagnostics tools) and scripting in Python.
  • A good understanding of V&V processes and modern software development flows (CI/CD, pre-merge testing, fault reporting).
  • Fluency in English; Swedish is a plus, not a requirement.

Who you are:

  • You're curious and analytical – the kind of person who isn't satisfied until you understand why.
  • You take ownership of unclear, unowned problems and drive them to closure.
  • You communicate clearly with both deeply technical engineers and program-level stakeholders.
  • You build trust across teams and influence without needing formal authority.
  • You're pragmatic: you balance speed and rigour, and you know when to dig deeper and when to ship.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Job Description

As a Technical PM, you will be responsible for: 1) supply chain coordination of the electronic components and embedded systems of our robots,conduct technical review/QA directly with suppliers. 2) Testing, trouble shooting of power electronics, digital electronics (PCBA validation), firmware, communication protocols, and interfaces on robots. 3）Overseeing small-batch production timeline and quality management with suppliers. 4）Functional calibration and test bench development and set up. 5)Collaborating closely with both the supply chain & manufacturing team in Shanghai and the engineering team in Zurich, you will contribute to ensuring the reliable integration and high performance of the electronic systems in our robots.

We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic, hands-on environment and has a proven track record of bringing electromechanical systems from prototype to production, with a strong focus on quality and supply chain efficiency.

What you’ll be doing

  • Independent supply chain coordination of the electronic components and embedded systems of our robots,conduct technical review/QA directly with suppliers.

  • Independent Testing and trouble shooting of power electronics, digital electronics (PCBA validation), firmware, communication protocols, and interfaces on robots.

  • Functional calibration and test bench development and set up.

  • Collaborate with mechanical engineers to ensure seamless integration of electronics into mechanical assemblies.

  • Identify, evaluate, select, and manage suppliers for electrical components and subassemblies.

  • Work closely with suppliers for the transfer of designs and technical documentation.

  • Perform thorough testing and troubleshooting of electronic and embedded systems.

  • Support continuous improvement cycles across assembly, testing, and deployment phases.

  • Document processes, test results, and improvements to ensure traceability and knowledge sharing.

  • Coordinate with the Zurich R&D team and local suppliers to implement design updates quickly and reliably.

  • Support design improvements and iteration in the context of manufacturability.

    • What you must have

  • Master’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Embedded Systems.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in electrical system development, testing, and low-volume manufacturing.

  • Experience in setting up functional benches for electronic components.

  • Generate test bench’s test script and test plan.

  • Experience in the testing, and integration of PCBAs for embedded or robotic systems.

  • Strong trouble-shooting skills for embedded hardware and firmware.

  • Familiarity with power distribution, motor controllers, sensors, and communication protocols (CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, etc.).

  • Familiarity with ROS, embedded Linux, or microcontroller platforms (e.g., STM32, ESP32, etc.).

  • Familiarity with AI tools that lift work productivity.

  • Proven track record of working with external suppliers.

  • Experience with quality control and validation of electrical components and assemblies.

  • Strong adaptability and comfort with frequent iteration and evolving designs.

  • Strong communication skill and ability to work in a dynamic team environment.

  • Fluent in Mandarin and English to effectively navigate local and international interactions

    • Get some bonus points

  • Experience in the robotic, automotive, Semi-conductor, and consumer electronics sector.

  • Experience in startups or fast-paced product development environments.

  • Experience with compliance testing (EMC, safety, etc.) for robotic or embedded products.

title: Circle K Skærup Vest i Vejle søger 30 timers nattevagt. En stilling hvor du altid er på arbejde sammen med en kollega
description:
Lad os sige det som det er. At arbejde som nattesælger hos os er ikke for alle. Men vi tror det er noget for dig!

Os som arbejder her er vilde med det, og hvis du spørger en af vores uundværlige nattesælgere, hvorfor de elsker at arbejde ved Circle K, kan det ofte koges ned til 3 ord: Frihed, fleksibilitet og selvstændighed.

For at trives i netop denne stilling skal du nemlig først og fremmest forstå hvad det vil sige at arbejde med frihed under ansvar. Du har et stort ansvar for, at det hele spiller i løbet af natten, så vores kunder oplever en service i verdensklasse, får serveret lækker mad og får den bedste oplevelse i butikken. Din rolle og dit arbejde som nattesælger vil være altafgørende for at butikken kan køre optimalt resten af dagen.

Og vi er ikke et sekund i tvivl om, at det er en rolle du kan påtage dig!

Vi leder efter en positiv teamplayer som:

  • Er en rigtig natteravn, der bare arbejder bedst når vi andre ikke gør. Erfaring med tidligere nattearbejde er derfor et plus!

  • Kan lide at tilberede mad. For vi elsker det! Og vi ser derfor gerne, at du har lyst til at ligge en dyd i at smøre de lækreste sandwich og lave den bedste burger.

  • Kan holde hovedet koldt, når der kommer uforudsete udfordringer ind af døren, og formår at løse dem med sund fornuft

  • Har en smule rengøringsvanvid, eller blot forstår at vores kunder får den bedste oplevelse med et rent toilet og en ren butik

  • Motiveres af at yde fantastisk kundeservice og ved hvad der skal til for at vores kunder får det bedst mulige pit-stop når de er på farten om natten

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

Hos Circle K er der plads til alle! Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på, og vi arbejder altid samme som One team!

Det er altafgørende at du har lysten og motivationen til at lære nye ting, udvikle dig og bidrage til vores ”one-team” kultur. Hvis du har ambitionen om at bygge en karriere, får du unikke muligheder i Circle K, så længe du har den motivation der skal til.

Udover helt unikke udviklingsmuligheder, tilbyder vi et job med attraktive fordele og personalegoder. Som en del af vores Circle K familie vil du blandt andet få gode medarbejderrabbatter på brændstof, bilvask samt på mad og drikkevarer i
alle vores butikker. Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring!

  • Fordelagtige lønninger og nattillæg

  • Og ikke mindst, Danmark bedste kolleger!

Så hvis du vil have et job, hvor du har fri om dagen men ejer natten, så send os din ansøgning med det samme, og så lover vi dig, at du bliver en del af et fantastisk team på Circle K Skærup Vest. Hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet er du velkommen til at kontakte Store Manager Helle Kofoed på tlf: 75 86 05 22.

Antal timer:
30 timer i fast vagtplan. Arbejdstiden er placeret på tidspunkter, der betyder, at stillingen er forbeholdt ansøgere over 18 år og ikke egner sig som studiejob.

Specifikt for denne station:
Skærup Vest er en af vores helt store og travle motorvejs stationer. Du kommer til at indgå i et team med ca. 25 kollegaer, og er aldrig alene på arbejde. Stationen er også den største vi har på food salg, og derfor skal du også være indstillet på, at produktion og salg af food fylder en del. På denne station er man altid på arbejde med en kollega.

Ansøgningsfrist
Løbende

På vej i den rigtige retning - vil du være med?

Hos Circle K arbejder vi på en mere bæredygtig og klimavenlig transport. Vi arbejder for at elbiler, flydende el og biobrændstoffer er både tilgængelige og effektive, da de får en afgørende rolle i den bæredygtige fremtid, vi sætter kursen mod.

description:
Data Platform Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

We are seeking a Data Platform Engineer to design, build, and operate high-performance, highly reliable inference platforms for serving large machine learning models in production. The role focuses on the systems engineering side of AI deployment, including request routing, batching, caching, autoscaling, GPU utilization, and end-to-end observability across diverse model workloads.   • Hands-on experience with LLM or large model inference frameworks such as vLLM or TensorRT-LLM.
  • Strong understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and accelerator utilization.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, autoscaling, and modern cloud platforms.
  • Experience with observability stacks including metrics, tracing, and structured logging.
  • Solid grounding in performance engineering and capacity planning.
  • Strong communication and incident response skills.

  • Open-source contributions to model serving infrastructure.

title: Test Lead
description:
About us

HammondCare provides expert aged care, home care, dementia care and palliative care for older people, regardless of circumstances, beliefs, background or financial situation. We are led by our not-for-profit, Christian foundations and backed by research and clinical expertise.

When it comes to our people – those we serve and those who serve – we are committed to inclusion across race, culture, ethnicity, gender, sex, sexuality, religion and ability. In our innovative residences, our hospitals, or in client homes, we aim to set the global standard of relationship-based care for older people with complex needs.

We’ve been caring for people for over 90 years – so, if you love to care, join us, and make a career move that matters.

It's not just care, it's HammondCare.

About the Opportunity

The Information Technology (IT) function is seen as an important enabler to the achievement of HammondCare’s mission. This is driven by the requirement of the organisation to meet the changing needs of people with complex health or aged care needs and our employees within a growing geographically diverse organisation and across a continuum of care.

The Test Lead is responsible for defining, coordinating, and executing testing activities across complex digital transformation and customer service technology initiatives. The role ensures that new platforms, integrations, workflows, and customer-facing capabilities are delivered with the quality, stability, and reliability required to support HammondCare's care, operational, and service delivery outcomes.

Working across multiple workstreams, vendors, and delivery teams, the Test Lead provides leadership for quality assurance practices, ensuring solutions are thoroughly tested across applications, integrations, data flows, business processes, and user experiences. The role partners closely with business stakeholders, delivery teams, vendors, and subject matter experts to ensure technology solutions are fit-for-purpose and ready for production deployment.

Operating within Agile and project delivery environments, the Test Lead establishes testing standards, coordinates testing resources, manages risk, and drives continuous improvement in testing maturity and delivery quality.

Key Focus Areas:

  • Test Strategy & Quality Assurance: Define and implement testing approaches that ensure solutions meet functional, integration, performance, security, and business requirements

  • End-to-End Solution Validation: Coordinate testing across platforms, integrations, customer service technologies, business applications, data, and operational processes

  • Delivery Risk Management: Identify quality risks early, manage defects effectively, and provide clear visibility of testing readiness and deployment confidence

  • Testing Capability & Continuous Improvement: Establish testing standards, improve testing practices, and build quality assurance capability across delivery teams

This is a maximum term contract for 12 months based at St Leonards with hybrid working opportunities.

What you will be doing

  • Define Test Strategy and Planning: Develop test strategies, plans, schedules, and quality assurance approaches aligned to project objectives, risks, and delivery timelines

  • Lead End-to-End Testing Activities: Coordinate functional, system, integration, regression, user acceptance, and operational readiness testing across multiple technology solutions and workstreams. Look to automate where possible

  • Manage Testing Across Complex Integrations: Ensure end-to-end validation of integrations between customer-facing systems, enterprise platforms, workflow solutions, data services, and third-party applications

  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Partner with business stakeholders and subject matter experts to plan, execute, and complete user acceptance testing activities

  • Manage Defects and Quality Risks: Establish defect management processes, monitor remediation progress, and ensure quality risks are proactively identified and addressed

  • Validate Business Processes and Customer Journeys: Ensure end-to-end business processes, customer interactions, workflow automation, and operational procedures perform as expected across multiple systems

  • Provide Release Readiness Assurance: Assess testing outcomes and provide recommendations regarding deployment readiness, outstanding risks, and production release decisions

  • Work with Delivery Teams and Vendors: Collaborate closely with project managers, business analysts, developers, architects, external vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure quality expectations are met

  • Establish Testing Standards and Governance: Implement consistent testing methodologies, documentation standards, quality controls, and reporting across initiatives

  • Track and Report Quality Metrics: Provide clear reporting on test progress, defect trends, risk exposure, quality outcomes, and release readiness to delivery and governance stakeholders

  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve testing practices, automation, tooling, quality processes, and overall delivery performance

What we can offer you

We care about your wellbeing at HammondCare and as a result offer a wide range of health and lifestyle benefits including:

  • NFP salary packaging ($15,900 tax free) plus meals and entertainment benefit (up to $2,650 tax free)

  • Additional leave purchase options and 14 weeks paid parental leave

  • Flexible working options, including hybrid arrangements

  • Discounts on everyday products and services

  • Discounted healthcare memberships - access to network of fitness centres and pools for employees and families

  • Free access to independent counselling support for employees and families

  • Health & Wellbeing programmes

  • Reward & Recognition programmes

  • Referral bonuses

  • Career and professional development opportunities

About you

  • Commitment to engage and align with HammondCare’s Christian Mission, Motivation and Mission in Action

  • 7+ years' experience in software testing, quality assurance, or test management roles and advanced ISTQB certification or equivalent

  • Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience)

  • Experience leading testing activities across large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives

  • Experience testing integrated enterprise environments including CRM, customer service, workflow, ERP, digital, and data platforms

  • Experience with Salesforce, contact centre technologies, customer platforms, or case management systems desirable

  • Experience testing data migration, integration, and workflow automation solutions desirable

To Apply

If you are ready to make a difference with HammondCare, Apply Now!

title: Tarjoilijoita keikkatöihin, Tampere, Staffpoint
description:
Etsimme tarjoilijoita Tampereen huippuhotelleihin!

Haluatko loistaa Tampereen ravintolamaailman huipulla ja olla luomassa asiakkaille unohtumattomia palvelukokemuksia?

Etsimme nyt asiakasyrityksillemme Tampereelle ammattitaitoisia ja asiakaspalveluhenkisiä tarjoilijoita keikkatyöhön. Työskentelet kaupungin arvostetuimmissa hotelleissa, joissa mikään päivä ei ole samanlainen. Hotellimaailmassa tärkeintä on aito halu kohdata ja palvella jokainen vieras ikimuistoisella tavalla. Työskentelet nopeatempoisessa ja korkeaan laatuun panostavassa ympäristössä, jossa ensiluokkaisen asiakaskokemuksen luominen sekä tiimityö ovat kaiken keskiössä.

Toivomme sinulta:

- Aiempaa vahvaa kokemusta a la carte -tarjoilusta, tilaustarjoilusta ja/tai edustustarjoilusta.


- Timanttista asiakaspalveluasennetta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja pelisilmää muuttuvissa tilanteissa.


- Erinomaista tiimihenkeä ja kykyä toimia paineen alla.


- Hyvää viini- ja alkoholijuomien tuntemusta.


- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.


- Täysi-ikäisyyttä sekä voimassa olevaa anniskelu- ja hygieniapassia.


Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Mielenkiintoisen ja vauhdikkaan työympäristön Tampereen laadukkaimmissa hotelleissa.


- Joustavan keikkatyön, jonka voit sovittaa omaan elämäntilanteeseesi.


- Asiantuntevan työyhteisön ja perehdytyksen tehtäviin.


- StaffPointin vaihtuvat työsuhde-edut.


- Palkan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan (Marava TES).


Valitut henkilöt työllistyvät StaffPointille. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Kuulostaako tämä sinun seuraavalta askeleeltasi? Jätä hakemuksesi pikaisesti oheisen linkin kautta! Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja teemme valintoja jo hakuaikana, joten varmista paikkasi tiimissä lähettämällä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian.

Odotamme innolla, että pääsemme tutustumaan sinuun!


StaffPoint Oy

Jokin tässä työpaikassa sai sinut pysähtymään. Hyvä, että pysähdyit.

Ehkä etsit uutta työtä.

Ehkä vain katsot, mitä työpaikkoja olisi tarjolla.

Me StaffPointilla emme täytä vain työpaikkoja. Autamme sinua löytämään työn, joka sopii arkeesi ja elämäntilanteeseesi.

Olemme yksi Suomen johtavista hotelli-, ravintola- ja catering-alan ammattilaisia työllistävistä henkilöstöpalveluyrityksistä, joten vaihtoehtoja riittää ja työnhaku on sujuvaa.

Kuuntelemme, mitä haluat seuraavaksi. Siksi moni löytää kauttamme työn, joka sopii omaan arkeen ja vie eteenpäin.

Tämä voi olla se käänne, jota et tiennyt etsiväsi. Katso, mihin se voi sinut viedä.

title: Freelance Presentation Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.
  • Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.
  • Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.
  • Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.
  • Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.
  • Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.
  • Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.
  • Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.
  • Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Klubpædagog til Gladsaxe Skole
description:
Bliv en vigtig del af børns fritidsliv – Gladsaxe Skole søger en relationsstærk pædagog til Klubben
Vil du arbejde et sted, hvor fritidspædagogikken fylder, fællesskaberne er stærke, og hvor både børn og voksne trives?

På Gladsaxe Skole søger vi en relationsstærk og engageret pædagog til vores Klub for 4.–6. klasse.
Hos os får du ikke bare et job – du bliver en del af et varmt, humoristisk og fagligt stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi tror på, at gode relationer, meningsfulde aktiviteter og stærke børnefællesskaber gør en reel forskel.
Vi søger særligt dig, der brænder for fritidspædagogik, og som ser Klubben som et vigtigt udviklings- og dannelsesrum for børnene.

Om os
På Gladsaxe Skole bygger vi vores hverdag på værdierne ordentlighed, tryghed, engagement og nysgerrighed.

Vi er en skole med ca. 700 elever og en stabil medarbejdergruppe, hvor mange har været ansat i mange år. Det giver os et stærkt fundament præget af erfaring, kontinuitet og tryghed – samtidig med, at vi er nysgerrige på nye ideer og perspektiver.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af lærere og pædagoger gennem professionelle læringsfællesskaber, co-teaching og systematisk feedback. Vores pædagogiske tilgang tager afsæt i Louise Klinges kerneelementer for relationskompetent praksis.

Samtidig vægter vi fritidspædagogikken højt. Klubben er ikke “bare pasning” – det er et vigtigt fællesskab, hvor børn udvikler relationer, identitet, deltagelsesmuligheder og mod på fællesskabet gennem aktiviteter, ture, kreative miljøer, bevægelse og nærværende voksne.

Om stillingen
Du bliver en del af et engageret og selvstyrende klubteam med høj faglighed, stor frihed og tæt samarbejde.
Din primære arbejdstid vil være i Klubben, men stillingen omfatter også skoletid. Derfor søger vi dig, som har lyst til at bringe fritidspædagogiske perspektiver aktivt i spil – både i undervisningen og i børnenes fritidsliv.
Vi ønsker en pædagog, der har lyst til at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder, stærke relationer og meningsfulde fællesskaber for alle børn.

Vi tilbyder
  • En professionel mentorordning det første år
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab med både erfarne og nye kræfter – og plads til grin i hverdagen
  • En arbejdsplads med høj anciennitet, hvor tryghed og kontinuitet går hånd i hånd med udvikling og nye idéer
  • Frihed og tillid til at skabe aktiviteter, ture og initiativer, der giver mening for børnene
  • Tæt samarbejde mellem lærere og pædagoger – både i skole og Klub
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor fritidspædagogikken bliver taget alvorligt og prioriteret

Vi søger dig, der
  • Er uddannet pædagog – eller har tilsvarende relevante pædagogiske kompetencer
  • Har et stærkt ressourcesyn på børn og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger
  • Brænder for fritidspædagogik og for at skabe inkluderende fællesskaber
  • Er god til relationer og kan skabe trygge deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn
  • Er initiativrig, ansvarsfuld og har lyst til at sætte dig selv og dine idéer i spil
  • Er energisk, nysgerrig og fagligt ambitiøs
  • Gerne har specialpædagogiske kompetencer (ikke et krav, men en fordel)

Hvorfor vælge os?
Fordi du hos os får mulighed for både at udvikle dig fagligt, gøre en forskel for børnene og blive en del af et arbejdsfællesskab med høj trivsel, stærke relationer og plads til humor.
Vi tror på, at børn udvikler sig bedst i fællesskaber med nærværende voksne – og vi tror på, at gode arbejdsfællesskaber smitter direkte af på børnene.

Om stillingen
Der er tale om en fast fuldtidsstilling i vores Klub med opgaver både i skole og Klub.
Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst om principper om Ny Løn.

Vil du vide mere?
Læs mere om Gladsaxe Skole her:
Gladsaxe Skole

Du er også meget velkommen til at kontakte skoleleder Vibeke Damgaard telefon 23 84 73 39 for at høre mere om stillingen.

Din ansøgning
Vi modtager ansøgninger frem til den 21. august 2026 og holder løbende samtaler.
Ansøgning, CV, dokumentation for uddannelse, udtalelser og øvrige relevante bilag bedes vedhæftet.

I Gladsaxe tager vi udgangspunkt i borgernes og virksomhedernes behov og trivsel i alt, hvad vi gør. Bæredygtig velfærd og udvikling er en mærkesag for os og vi arbejder for både social, miljømæssig og økonomisk bæredygtighed. Med FN’s verdensmål som ramme ser vi en bæredygtig fremtid som noget, vi skaber sammen – med borgere, virksomheder, foreninger og lokalsamfundet. Du kan læse mere om vores mål i Gladsaxestrategien.

Ingen ansatte i Gladsaxe Kommune må ryge eller bruge tobaksrelaterede produkter i arbejdstiden, som for eksempel snus og vapes.

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn/identitet, seksualitet, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

Our team, located in Amsterdam, is looking for self-driven, talented people who can help make digital assets available for everyone.

About the Opportunity

We are an exchange. System scalability, performance and engineering productivity matters in everything that we do. Our platform domain is committed to fostering autonomy by offering engineering teams paved paths to develop robust, secure, compliant and scalable systems. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Empower teams to build scalable systems with strict requirements on latency, availability, and/or throughput.

  • Team up with engineering teams to understand their pain points and work backward to craft the right solution.

  • Enable teams to fully own their systems by providing them with the capabilities to seamlessly deploy and closely observe their applications.

  • Leverage infrastructure as code and automation to build reproducible systems that are consistent across multiple environments.

  • Support your teammates in growing every day by providing them with constructive feedback, guidance, and sharing knowledge.

What We Look For

  • Experience with one or more programming languages. We mostly use Python, Kotlin and Go.

  • Solid understanding of the fundamentals in distributed systems, systems engineering and networking.

  • Fluency in leveraging infrastructure as code and automation. We use tools such as Terraform to build reproducible systems that are consistent across multiple environments.

  • Proficiency in container orchestration within a cloud-first environment. We operate entirely on the Cloud, using Kubernetes as our orchestration tool.

  • Exceptional communication skills. We expect engineers to talk to various stakeholders to derive requirements, drive discussions, and facilitate decision-making processes effectively.

  • Extraordinary sense of ownership. We are committed to empowering engineers with freedom and accountability.

We're far more interested in your capabilities as an engineer rather than in your specific knowledge of a certain tool and/or technology. Not sure if you tick all the boxes? Let's talk.

At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions.

Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate.

What We Offer

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.
