Samarbejdet foregår som udgangspunkt virtuelt, hvorfor du kan udføre opgaven hjemmefra.

Stillingen

Som speciallægekonsulent bidrager du til Pensionsafdelingens arbejde med vurdering af graden af nedsættelse af erhvervsevnen som læge for de medlemmer, der søger om dækning ved tab af erhvervsevne. Herudover skal speciallægekonsulenten vurderer, om en ansøgning om udbetaling ved kritisk sygdom er berettiget i henhold til forsikringsbetingelserne.


Arbejdet består i, ud fra afgivne speciallægeerklæringer for medlemmet, at vurdere, om erhvervsevnen som læge er nedsat i en grad, der berettiger til udbetaling ved tab af erhvervsevne. I forhold til kritisk sygdom vurderes sagen på baggrund af indsendte journaloplysninger/epikriser.


Omfanget af arbejdet er ca. 7-10 timer om ugen. Det varierer dog i omfang.


Arbejdet foregår virtuelt, hvorfor arbejdet gennemføres hjemmefra. Sagerne løses i samarbejde med Pensionsafdelingens eksperter på området.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi forventer, at du har været speciallæge i nogle år med klinisk virke, og vi søger specifikt indenfor klinisk onkologi, intern medicin: hæmatologi, intern medicin: kardiologi, neurologi eller psykiatri. Du skal kunne vurdere de indsendte speciallægeerklæringer og ud fra en almen medicinsk tilgang fastsætte, om nedsættelsen af erhvervsevnen som læge er nedsat i en grad, der berettiger til udbetaling ved tab af erhvervsevne.


I forhold til kritisk sygdom skal du ud fra de indsendte journaloplysninger kunne vurdere om kriterierne for udbetaling er opfyldt.


Vi forventer ikke, at du har forhåndskendskab til pensionsområdet - men, at du har viljen til at tilegne dig den nødvendige processuelle viden, der skal bruges for at understøtte den samlede vurderingsproces.

Spændende faglige udfordringer med varierende indhold

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, SaaS platforms, and digital-first businesses. Unlike traditional outsourcing models, you are placed directly with a client as an in-house team member, contributing to impactful, real-world products.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing performance marketing agency that helps direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands scale profitably through Paid Media, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), creative strategy, and conversion-focused publisher networks. Acting as an extension of their clients’ in-house growth teams, they specialize in rapid testing, high-converting funnels, and data-driven experimentation to drive measurable revenue growth.

Job Summary

As a Remote QA Engineer, you'll be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and mobile applications. You'll collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and designers to validate new features, identify defects, and improve testing processes throughout the software development lifecycle.

The ideal candidate has experience with both manual and automated testing, thrives in a remote-first environment, and is committed to delivering exceptional user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create, execute, and maintain test plans, test cases, and testing documentation.
  • Perform manual testing for web and mobile applications to ensure functionality and usability.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using modern testing frameworks.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects through resolution.
  • Conduct functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and smoke testing.
  • Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman or similar platforms.
  • Collaborate with developers to reproduce issues and verify bug fixes.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and release testing.
  • Continuously improve QA processes, automation coverage, and testing standards.
  • Ensure software meets quality expectations before production releases.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, Software Test Engineer, or Quality Assurance Engineer.
  • Strong knowledge of manual software testing methodologies.
  • Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Lifecycle (STLC).
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs using Postman or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum development environments.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or other issue-tracking platforms.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL and database testing.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with remote teams.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
  • Exposure to performance, load, or security testing.
  • ISTQB Certification or equivalent QA certification.
  • Experience working with SaaS or cloud-based applications.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary based on experience and seniority

🚀 Work on impactful, user-facing products with a global reach

📈 Clear career progression in a high-growth tech environment

🌎 Fully remote role with an international team.

🎓 Access to ongoing learning and professional development.

🤝 Collaborative engineering culture with modern development practices.

title: Myyjä 10h/vko, JYSK Heinola
description:
Liity JYSKin tiimiin!

Etsimme myynnistä motivoituvaa, aikaansaavaa ja energistä myyjää, joka nauttii vaihtelevista ja työntäyteisistä työpäivistä. Teet kilpailuhenkisellä asenteella joka päivä töitä tavoitteiden eteen. Muuttuvat tilanteet ovat sinulle mieluisia, ja tartut toimeen kun näet asian, joka vaatii tekijää.

Sinusta huippumyyjä? Kyllä, se on täysin mahdollista. JYSKissä asenne ja tavoitteellisuus ratkaisevat. Kilpailuhenkisissä tiimeissämme jokainen pyrkii olemaan viikon paras. Meillä voit myös luoda uraa.

MYYJÄN TYÖ JYSKISSÄ

Myyjänä JYSKissä pääset osallistumaan myyntiin, asiakaspalveluun, kassatyöhön ja myymälän ylläpidollisiin tehtäviin. Myös, juuri sinulle nimetty, oma tuoteryhmävastaavan rooli on mahdollista saavuttaa heti perehdytyksen jälkeen, kun osaat perustyötehtävät.

Työpäiväsi ovat vaihtelevia ja työntäyteisiä. Työskentelet tiiviisti tiimin kanssa saavuttaaksesi myymälän tavoitteet. Toteutat JYSKin palvelukonseptia: olet työvuorosi alkaessa valmiina palvelemaan asiakkaita, toimit asiantuntevasti ja myyt parhaat ratkaisut. Varmistat tiimin kanssa, että myymälä on aina siisti, täynnä pientuotteita ja valmis uuteen myyntipäivään sekä kampanjoihin. Huolehdit myös varaston turvallisuudesta ja siisteydestä. Nautit fyysisestä työstä, kuten tavaroiden vastaanotosta, purkamisesta ja hyllyttämisestä sekä varastossa että myymälässä. Joka päivä kertyy tuhansia askelia hyötyliikuntaa.

MITÄ TARJOAMME

Olemme yksi Suomen parhaista työpaikoista, meillä viihdytään pitkään. JYSK arvot ovat osa jokapäiväistä työtämme ja tekemistämme. Jokainen voi olla oma itsensä ja vaikuttaa työympäristöönsä. Erilaiset taustat ja kokemukset rikastuttavat työyhteisöämme.

Etumme: -Perehdytysohjelma ja mahdollisuus ansaita myyntibonuksia. -Monipuoliset työtehtävät ja mahdollisuuden kehittyä myynnin ammattilaiseksi. -Työvuorosuunnittelu tukee jaksamista. -Turvallinen työympäristö ja apuvälineet fyysiseen työhön. -Henkilökunta-alennus, työterveyspalvelut ja Edenred liikunta- ja kulttuurietu. -JYSK Awards -palkintogaala. -Vakavarainen yritys, jossa on pitkiä työuria, ja erilaisia uramahdollisuuksia.

MITÄ ODOTAMME

-Motivoidut ja innostut myymisestä, sekä haluat tehdä tulosta. -Viihdyt nopeatempoisessa työympäristössä, ja sinulta löytyy positiivista asennetta myös kiireisinä työpäivinä. -Valmiutta tarttua itsenäisesti monipuolisiin työtehtäviin, mutta myös kykyä työskennellä tiimissä. -Olet joustava työaikojen suhteen, koska töitä tehdään vaihtelevasti eri vuoroissa aamulla, illalla kuin viikonloppuisinkin. -Edellytämme tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä vähintään 18 vuoden ikää. -Edellytämme tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä hyvää suomen kielen taitoa, jotta hän pystyy ymmärtämään ja noudattamaan työnantajan toimintaohjeita sekä toimimaan suorassa asiakaspalvelukontaktissa.

Jos olet valmis tarttumaan haasteeseen ja haluat olla osa JYSKin menestystarinaa, lähetä hakemuksesi meille jo tänään!

title: Lead Blockchain Development Engineer (Java)
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
Responsibilities:
  1. Participate in the integration of new blockchain networks to support deposit and withdrawal operations for exchanges or Web3 platforms
  2. Participate in the development of custody business requirements
  3. Participate in business requirements analysis, system design, development, testing, and deployment; deliver high-quality engineering work
  4. Write technical and system documentation to ensure code maintainability and team collaboration efficiency
Requirements:
  1. 5+ years of Java development experience in a computer science or related field
  2. Solid Java fundamentals, good coding practices, and strong programming skills; familiar with mainstream open-source frameworks and components with a solid depth of understanding
  3. Proficient with everyday toolsincluding Git, Maven, and Linux
  4. Familiar with distributed system design; proficient with mainstream middleware including MySQL, Redis, and MQ (e.g., Kafka)
  5. Strong sense of responsibility, clear logical thinking, curious and research-oriented mindset, strong learning ability, and a collaborative team spirit

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Hørespecialist hos HEIMDALL’S Hørecenter Aalborg
description:
Hørespecialist hos HEIMDALL’S Hørecenter Aalborg






























































































































Hørespecialist med selvstændigt ansvar til HEIMDALL'S Hørecenter i Aalborg

Vil du være en del af et hørecenter i vækst - hvor høj faglighed, stærke relationer og klare ambitioner går hånd i hånd? Har du lyst til at have et selvstændigt ansvar i dagligdagen? Og ønsker du at give en sublim kundeoplevelse? 

Så har du her muligheden for at kombinere dine audiologiske kompetencer med en central rolle hos os.

Hos HEIMDALL’S Hørecenter i Aalborg søger vi en fagligt stærk og engageret hørespecialist med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Du får selvstændigt ansvar for driften i Aalborg og bliver den lokale nøgleperson i et hørecenter i målrettet vækst.

I det daglige arbejder du selvstændigt og har frihed til at tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag og sikre den høje kvalitet, vi er kendt for. Samtidig bliver du en del af et dedikeret team af kolleger placeret rundt om i landet, hvor du sparrer fagligt, deler erfaringer, og udvikler forretningen gennem faste online møder og tæt samarbejde.

Som hørespecialist hos HEIMDALL'S Hørecenter vil du blive en del af en voksende forretning, hvor du ikke blot får ansvar for din egen hverdag. Du får reel indflydelse på udviklingen af et hørecenter med klare ambitioner - et sted, hvor hver rådgivning og hver løsning er målrettet at skabe bedre livskvalitet for høreapparatsbrugere.  

Vi er lokalt forankret og stolte af at hjælpe borgere i Aalborg og Nordjylland med uvildige løsninger på deres høretab. Vores vækst bygger på kvalitet, tillid og langvarige relationer. Derfor prioriterer vi tid til den enkelte kunde, til grundig behovsafdækning, høj faglig og den nyeste teknologi fra førende producenter i Danmark. 


Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet audiologiassistent og betragter dig selv som én af de dygtigste. Du har minimum 2 års erfaring og du er komfortabel med mere end ét høreapparatmærke. Du interesserer dig for den nyeste teknologi og er i stand til at kommunikere forskellene på de forskellige mærker til kunderne, så deres valg af høreapparater bliver taget på et oplyst og objektivt grundlag.


Hvorfor vælge HEIMDALL’S Hørecenter?

Bliv en del af et dynamisk team, hvor dine gode ideer altid tæller og hvor du gør en forskel for både kunder og forretning. Vi lægger vægt på sparring og faglig udvikling, hvor vi konstant har fokus på at udvikle dine kompetencer.

Vi tilbyder dig:


Stort ansvar i dagligdagen, hvor kunderne er i centrum


Et udviklende miljø, hvor der ikke er langt fra tanke til handling


37 timers stilling med fleksibilitet efter ønske


Attraktiv pensionsaftale og sundhedsforsikring


Løn efter kvalifikationer



Om HEIMDALL’S Hørecenter

HEIMDALL’S blev grundlagt i 2020 med én mission: at give alle mennesker bedre hørelse på den måde, der passer bedst til dem. Vi kombinerer høj faglighed, personlig rådgivning og moderne teknologi for at levere høreløsninger af høj kvalitet og sætte nye standarder for kundeoplevelsen.

Vores klinikker ligger i Frederiksberg, Lyngby, Roskilde, Odense M, Odense C, Aarhus og Aalborg. Som medarbejder hos os er du med til at sikre, at kunderne oplever vejen til bedre hørelse som enkel, tryg og komfortabel.

Vi arbejder for, at alle skal have en bekymringsfri hverdag med god lyd - uden at prisen bestemmer kvaliteten. Vi gør det nemt for kunderne at få adgang til de bedste høreapparater til de bedste priser - med service, når og hvor de har brug for det.

Hos HEIMDALL’S Hørecenter bliver du en del af en voksende organisation med korte beslutningsveje, tydeligt ansvar og et stærkt fællesskab.


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har den rette kandidat

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Director of Audiology, Connie Irene Andersen på: karriere@heimdalls.dk eller se mere på www.heimdalls.dk.

Ønsker du at være en central del af HEIMDALL’S Hørecenters vækst? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig! Send dit CV og ansøgning via vores rekrutteringssystem.

title: Insurance Follow-Up Representative
description:
Imagine a career at one of the nation's most advanced health networks.


Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.


LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary
Works collaboratively with department leadership to review and manage open Accounts Receivable, accurately documenting follow-up activities resulting in the resolution of underpayments and denials. Conducts root cause analysis of denials and takes the action necessary to resolve the denial escalating accounts to management that need to be submitted to the provider representative for contracting action. Identifies denial and underpayment trends that require computer system modifications and recommends necessary to implement corrective action. Prepares reports for meetings with provider representative and senior leadership, as required.

Job Duties
  • Demonstrates knowledge of insurance carrier reimbursement requirements to evaluate underpayments that are related to insurance carrier clinical and payment policies.
  • Demonstrates the ability to apply LVHN insurance contracts terms to claim payment reviews and the ability to determine if the source of an underpayment is related to a contract management discrepancy, an underpayment, or a line item denial.
  • Conducts a root cause analysis of denials, taking the appropriate corrective action as required, escalating denial trends to management, and routing denials to the appropriate area for resolution.
  • Calculates and submits adjustment and refund requests utilizing the appropriate adjustment code, refund reason, and clearly documents the account history.
  • Identifies the patient out of pocket expense related to non-covered services, co-pays, deductible, and co-insurance allocating the patient responsibility to the patient within the timely filing limit.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of and compliance with established organizational and departmental policies, procedures, objectives and goals.
  • Works collaboratively with management to establish issue logs and account examples for meetings with the insurance carrier provider rep.
  • Responds and reviews all emails and correspondence within 24-48 hours, manages mail received from patients and insurance carriers for appropriate distribution.

Minimum Qualifications
  • High School Diploma/GED
  • 2 years of professional or facility billing and/or collections for all major third party payers or work experience in healthcare related field.
  • Excellent follow-up and verification skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Knowledge of insurance contracts, and regulations.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint applications.
  • Strong analytical, mathematical and organizational skills.
  • Successful Completion of DOE and Revenue Cycle Education Training within 3 months of hire.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree in Health Care Science, Business or related field.
  • CPAT - Certified Patient Accounting Technician - State of Pennsylvania

Physical Demands
Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current position, however management reserves the right to revise or change as necessary to meet organizational needs. Other responsibilities may be assigned when circumstances require.

 Du kender måske allerede Netto som Danmarks største dagligvarekæde - men vidste du også, at vores medarbejdere er rigtig glade for at arbejde her? 

 Du bliver nemlig del af et helt specielt sammenhold med masser af opbakning, og hvor vi alle løfter i flok. For det vi laver er vigtigt, men dem, vi laver det med, er endnu vigtigere. 

 Vi håber, du er lige så begejstret for dyrevelfærd, reduktion af madspild og en bæredygtig fremtid, som vi er. Vi har bl.a. vores eget økologiske brand: ØGO. Og det er naturligvis til gode Netto-priser.

title: Remote QA Engineer
description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, SaaS platforms, and digital-first businesses. Unlike traditional outsourcing models, you are placed directly with a client as an in-house team member, contributing to impactful, real-world products.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing performance marketing agency that helps direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands scale profitably through Paid Media, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), creative strategy, and conversion-focused publisher networks. Acting as an extension of their clients’ in-house growth teams, they specialize in rapid testing, high-converting funnels, and data-driven experimentation to drive measurable revenue growth.

Job Summary

As a QA Engineer, you'll play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and mobile applications. You'll collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and designers to identify issues early, improve testing processes, and help deliver high-quality software releases.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in manual and/or automated software testing who enjoys solving problems and contributing to fast-paced product development teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
  • Perform manual testing for web and mobile applications.
  • Develop and maintain automated test suites where applicable.
  • Identify, document, track, and verify software defects using bug-tracking tools.
  • Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot issues and validate fixes.
  • Conduct regression, functional, integration, usability, and performance testing.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release testing.
  • Ensure software meets quality standards before production deployment.
  • Continuously improve QA processes, documentation, and testing methodologies.
  • Communicate testing progress, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance or QA Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of software testing principles and QA methodologies.
  • Experience performing manual testing across web applications.
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar.
  • Experience working with bug tracking and project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Trello.
  • Understanding of Agile or Scrum software development methodologies.
  • Experience testing REST APIs using tools like Postman is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL and database testing is preferred.
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, collaborative environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Git version control.
  • Performance or security testing experience.
  • ISTQB Certification or equivalent QA certification.
  • Experience testing SaaS platforms or cloud-based applications.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary based on experience and seniority

🚀 Work on impactful, user-facing products with a global reach

📈 Clear career progression in a high-growth tech environment

🌎 Fully remote role with an international team.

🎓 Access to ongoing learning and professional development.

🤝 Collaborative engineering culture with modern development practices.

description:
Frokostansvarlig - Copenhagen Atomics

					Frokostansvarlig				

					

				

		

					

		

				


		

		

				

							

				

					

				

									Kom og bliv en del af Copenhagen Atomics, og hjælp os med at udvikle vores thorium-baserede salt-smelte-reaktor.

Copenhagen Atomics har udviklet en ny form for atomreaktor, som er markant mere effektiv end nogen anden reaktortype. Denne nye teknologi vil fundamentalt ændre den globale energisektor i fremtiden, da vores reaktorer vil kunne producere energi til en markant lavere pris end nogen anden energiform, inklusiv fusion.
Din nye afdeling:
Du vil som Copenhagen Atomics’ nye frokostansvarlige blive en del af vores Facility team, hvor du selvstændigt skal arbejde med at få driften af vores køkken til at fungere. De vigtigste opgaver indebærer opstilling og afrydning af frokost på daglig basis, opvask, samt bestilling af diverse varer til køkkenet og vores fredagsbar. Vi forestiller os, at du står foran et eller to sabbatår, og kunne tænke dig et job med en masse ansvar og udviklingsmuligheder.
Du vil få en vigtig rolle med at:

 	
Bestilling og opstilling af frokost, diverse andre fødevarer samt drikkevarer

 	
Klargøring af mødelokaler

 	
Ansvarlig for vores ugentlige grill arrangement om torsdagen: Nuclear Lunch

 	
Organisere og planlægge fredagsbar


For at lykkes i denne rolle, har du:

 	
En høj grad af struktur i dit arbejde

 	
Du er social og kan lide at møde og tale med dine kollegaer

 	
Lyst til at komme med input til forbedringer af diverse opgaver

 	
Evnen til selv at påtage dig et ansvar og løse opgaver fra start til slut

 	
En lyst til at blive en del af en virksomhed med gode kollegaer og høje ambitioner

 	
Et eller to år foran dig, hvor du gerne vil arbejde og dygtiggøre dig.


Om Copenhagen Atomics og næste skridt:
Innovation og udvikling er to nøgleord hos Copenhagen Atomics, og det er centralt for at vi når vores ambitiøse mål. Hvis du bliver en del af Copenhagen Atomics, vil du være med til at udvikle banebrydende teknologi, som har potentialet til grundlæggende at ændre verden, som vi kender den i dag.

Vi er i dag mere end 80 medarbejdere, primært bestående af tekniske profiler, herunder ingeniører, maskinmestre og smede på vores lokation i Tårnby, København. Vi arbejder hver dag på at udvikle en ny, billig og effektiv thorium-baseret salt-smelte-reaktor, som i fremtiden vil blive masseproduceret.

Hvis du synes, at dette lyder som en spændende mulighed, vil vi bede dig sende dit CV sammen med en kort ansøgning og dine karakterer. Bemærk: Husk at sende alle efterspurgte dokumenter.

Vi kalder løbende folk til samtale.

title: Field Service Coordinator
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Field Service Coordinator (Care Coach 1) assesses and evaluates member's needs and requirements to achieve and/or maintain optimal wellness state by guiding members/families toward and facilitate interaction with resources appropriate for the care and wellbeing of members. The Service Coordinator work assignments are often straightforward and of moderate complexity.

This role involves meeting members in their location, spending quality time assessing their needs and barriers and then connecting our members with quality services to promote their ultimate well-being and drive health outcomes.

Responsibilities include:

  • Administer initial and ongoing long-term services and support (LTSS) related assessments through person-centered thinking approaches.

  • Contacts members both telephonically and/or in-person to establish goals and priorities, evaluate resources, develop plan of care and identify LTSS providers and community partnerships to provide a combination of services and supports that best meet the needs and goals of member and caregiver through person centered thinking approaches.

  • Development and continuous modification of Service Plan and involve applicable members of the care team in care planning (Informal caregiver coach, PCP, etc.)

  • Support members through navigation of their LTSS and related environmental and social needs Utilize available information pertaining to member to prevent the need for administration of duplicative assessments.

  • Focuses on supporting members and/or caregivers in accessing long term services and support, social, housing, educational and other services, regardless of funding sources to meet their needs.

  • Assisting members in maintaining Medicaid eligibility

  • Collaborate with Medical Director/Geriatrician/Care Coordinator as deemed necessary to ensure cohesive, holistic service delivery and support positive member outcomes.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in health and human services field
  • 2 or more years of related experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Word and Excel
  • Exceptional verbal/written communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to use a variety of electronic information applications/software programs
  • This role is considered patient facing and is part of Humana's Tuberculosis (TB) screening program. If selected for this role, you will be required to be screened for TB.
  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences
  • •This role is part of Humana's driver safety program and therefore requires an individual to have a valid state driver's license and are expected to maintain personal vehicle liability insurance. Individual must carry vehicle insurance in accordance with their residing state minimum required limits, or $25,000 bodily injury per person/$25,000 bodily injury per event /$10,000 for property damage or whichever is higher
  • Must have a separate room with a locked door that can be used as a home office to ensure continuous privacy while you work
  • You must reside in Indiana

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience with electronic case note documentation and experienced with documenting in multiple computer applications/systems
  • Experience with health promotion, coaching and wellness
  • Knowledge of community health and social service agencies and additional community resources
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$53,700 - $72,600 per year

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

title: Nuclear Medicine Technology Assistant - Nuclear Medicine - PRN 0.2 (as scheduled) (71336)
description:
In an environment of continuous quality improvement, the Nuclear Medicine Technology Assistant is responsible for providing administrative, clinical support, and patient care assistance to the Nuclear Medicine department to promote efficient workflow and high-quality patient care. This role is responsible for coordinating patient scheduling and documentation, facilitating communication between departments, supporting technologists and nursing staff with patient preparation and transport, maintaining supplies and equipment, and performing clerical functions necessary for daily department operations. The Nuclear Medicine Technology Assistant helps maintain a clean, safe, and organized environment while adhering to departmental policies, infection prevention practices, radiation safety protocols, and the principles of ALARA to minimize radiation exposure to patients, staff, and the public. The position delivers compassionate patient interactions and contributes to a collaborative, patient-centered healthcare team. Exhibits the MHS Standards of Excellence and exercises strict confidentiality at all times.

Job Functions:

  1. Performs clerical functions including maintaining patient history worksheets, patient reminder calls, answering telephones, Merge Cardio reporting, Meditech scheduling of inpatients, PACscan, and entering provider orders in Meditech.
  2. Coordinates patient flow and flow of information in collaboration with the technologists and nurses to maintain communication between departments.
  3. Assists with all aspects of patient care and non-patient care (i.e. cleanliness of unit, ordering of supplies, stocking supplies, stocking linens, prepping imaging table) within their scope of practice as assigned by technologist and nurses.
  4. Safely transfers patient to and from carts, beds, wheelchairs, utilizing proper body mechanics and lifting devices as available and as needed.
  5. Assists with patient/family teaching as appropriate.
  6. Assists with the maintenance of supplies and equipment.
  7. Enters daily patient charges and validates charge reconciliation.
  8. Complies with all safety and infection control standards related to position.
  9. Utilizes appropriate interpersonal communication which facilitates productive relationships with other team members.
  10. Seeks help from appropriate resources as needed.
  11. Maintains open lines of communication between self and professional staff.
  12. Clarifies any unclear communication between members of the healthcare team.
  13. Uses proper channels of authority in communicating information.
  14. Assumes all other duties and responsibilities as necessary.

title: Yleislääketieteen erikoislääkäri - Harjavalta, Satakunta
description:
Hei erikoislääkäri tai yleislääketieteseen erikoistuva, tervetuloa vahvistamaan Solon lääkäritiimiä!

Meillä arvostetaan asiantuntemusta ja kollegiaalisuutta. Haluamme tarjota ympäristön, jossa osaamisesi saa arvoisensa paikan.

Etsimme kahta yleislääketieteen erikoislääkäriä Harjavallan sote-keskukseen ja Kokemäen sote-pisteelle 1.10.-31.3.2027 väliselle ajalle. Voit olla myös yleislääketieteeseen erikoistuva lääkäri.

Työyksikkö ja työtehtävät
Harjavallan sote-keskuksessa ja Kokemäen sote-pisteessä tuotetaan avoterveydenhuollon lääkäri- ja hoitajavastaanoton palvelut, mukaan lukien kiirevastaanotto, neuvola- ja kouluterveydenhuollon palvelut, alueen (Nakkila, Harjavalta, Kokemäki) noin 18 500 asukkaalle.

Edellytämme sinulta
- Erikoislääkärin pätevyyttä
- Tartuntatautilain 48§ mukaista rokotussuojaa
- Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa

Työaika ja korvaus
Voit työskennellä joko kokoaikaisesti tai osa-aikaisesti, kuitenkin vähintään neljänä päivänä kuukaudessa.
Kokonaiskorvaus on 11 000 €/kuukaudessa kokoaikaisesta työstä. Voimme tarjota sinulle joko toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsuhteen tai mahdollisuuden valita itsellesi sopivan työskentelytavan, esimerkiksi ammatinharjoittajana.

Miksi tämä on loistava tilaisuus?
ePassi etu 400 €/vuosi – Käytettävissä liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointipalveluihin (työsuhteissa, jotka kestävät vähintään 60 työvuoroa)
Työterveys – Hyvinvointia tukevat työterveyspalvelut
Vahva tuki ja yhteisö – Et jää yksin! Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, vastuulääkärien tuen sekä kannustavan ja osaavan työyhteisön ympärillesi
Hyvä ja motivoiva palkka – Panostamme reiluun ja motivoivaan palkkaukseen
Mahdollisuus kehittyä – Tarjoamme koulutusrahan, joka kasvaa tehtyjen työtuntien myötä

Mikä on Solo Health?
Olemme suomalainen, mutkattomasti toimiva porukka. Meillä hommat etenevät nopeasti ja ilman turhia välikäsiä – yhteyshenkilösi tuntee sinut nimeltä ja vastaa kysymyksiisi selkeästi. Tunnemme sote-alan arjen ja ymmärrämme, että elämässäsi on muutakin kuin työ.

Työllistämme lääkäreitä, hoitajia, psykologeja ja sosiaalityöntekijöitä moninaisiin sosiaali- ja terveysalan tehtäviin ympäri Suomen – myös hiljaisessa haussa oleviin työpaikkoihin, joita et löydä muualta. Vuonna 2019 perustettu Solo Health on Suomen nopeimmin kasvava sote-alan toimija. Vuonna 2025 lähes 800 sote-ammattilaista toimi erilaisissa tehtävissä Solon kautta.

Olemme luotettava ja joustava kumppani julkiselle sektorille sekä pienissä palvelukokonaisuuksissa että laajoissa ulkoistuksissa. Panostamme palveluidemme laatuun, vaikuttavuuteen ja henkilöstömme ammattitaitoon.

Ihmiset ovat toimintamme ydin. Tarjoamme säännöllistä koulutusta ja tukea työhyvinvointiin, mistä kertoo poikkeuksellisen korkea henkilöstötyytyväisyytemme (NPS 82). Meillä ammattilaiset viihtyvät ja voivat työskennellä eettisesti sekä laadukkaasti.

Solo Health on terveydenhuollon paras työkaveri, joka tuntee alan haasteet ja pitää huolta ihmisistä.

Heräsikö kysyttävää?
Jos sinulla on kysyttävää työhön liittyen, ota rohkeasti yhteyttä:
Aluepäällikkö Krista Salminen
044 493 1448
krista.salminen@solohealth.fi [krista.salminen@solohealth.fi]

title: Director, Software Engineering - Enterprise Infrastructure
description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

This role will be based in Mountain View, CA.

The Enterprise Infrastructure Engineering (EIE) team builds and operates the Compute, Storage, Network, and Public Cloud infrastructure that powers LinkedIn’s enterprise platforms and services. The team delivers reliable, secure, and cost-efficient foundations across offices, data centers, and Azure, enabling critical business systems and modern CI/CD platforms for internal applications.

We are seeking a seasoned engineering leader to own strategy, execution, and outcomes for LinkedIn’s enterprise infrastructure. This leader will be responsible for the end-to-end portfolio across network (Wi-Fi, VPN, global sites), compute and storage (Windows/Linux Servers and Endpoints, data services, identity), and Azure tenants/regions, including CI/CD platforms supporting internal applications like LangSmith, AI integrations, and enterprise data pipelines.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Define and drive a multi-year technical infrastructure vision across network, compute, storage, and Azure, balancing reliability, security, velocity, and cost efficiency.

  • Own service reliability for global network, routing, firewall telemetry, and identity/access pathways

  • Drive AI transformation and automation for Infra, developer velocity, and operations

  • Partner with InfoSec to harden posture (e.g., device identity, AAA, policy enforcement), complete rollouts with high compliance across global interfaces.

  • Lead Azure governance for tenants, subscriptions, and shared services; scale visibility dashboards, cost guardrails, and remediation workflows in partnership with platform teams.

  • Drive Zero Trust initiatives to modernize remote and enterprise access; coordinate cross-functional execution spanning network architecture, client upgrades, and policy refactoring.

  • Oversee Infra migrations with predictable delivery and minimal user impact

  • Provide direction for internal CI/CD platforms that serve enterprise applications (e.g., integrations for agent workflows, data pipelines) to improve developer velocity and operational rigor.

  • Help lead the strategy and end-to-end delivery of corporate endpoint platforms and global VD to provide scalable device management and engineering escalation.

  • Scale org effectiveness across distributed teams; ensure strong on-call, runbooks, and incident leadership practices.

  • Manage multi-vendor ecosystems, negotiate contracts, and align investments to business outcomes and platform roadmaps.

  • Establish annual goals/OKRs and measurable outcomes tied to platform health, compliance, and TCO (e.g., availability, MTTR, capacity, cost per workload).

  • Hire, coach, and grow a diverse leadership bench (Sr. Managers, Managers, Staff+ ICs); foster a culture of clarity, accountability, craftsmanship, and bias for action.

Basic Qualifications:

  • BA./B.S. Degree or higher in Computer Science or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 12+ years of experience in infrastructure/software engineering with 8+ years of people management experience.

  • Experience in areas such as global network, compute, storage, and public cloud (Azure) portfolios in enterprise environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated outcomes in Infra reliability engineering, security and compliance programs, and cost optimization across complex ecosystems.

  • Deep expertise in Network architecture, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), firewall telemetry, and distributed logging pipelines.

  • Hands-on leadership across Azure governance (tenants, subscriptions, policy), platform observability, and FinOps practices.

  • Strong experience in CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, and enterprise developer platforms supporting internal applications.

  • Track record of managing multi-vendor environments and large capital/operating budgets tied to business outcomes.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management with executive communication and data-driven decision-making.

  • Ability to clearly communicate with all levels of the organization and across functions, and translate strategy to execution.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to influence and work effectively across organization boundaries.

  • Ability to maintain good judgment in fast-paced, high-stress environments.

  • Ability to innovate and scale ideas/processes to large teams.

  • Experience managing complex software teams.

Suggested Skills:

  • Infrastructure Engineering

  • Leadership

  • Azure Cloud

  • Storage

  • Networks

title: Lid van de Rekenkamer
description:
Veilig, voldoende en schoon water voor zo’n 778.000 inwoners, 17.000 bedrijven en de natuur in het oosten van Brabant: daar draag jij als lid of voorzitter van de Rekenkamer aan bij! Vanwege het vertrek van zowel de leden als de voorzitter ontstaat er ruimte voor versterking van de Rekenkamer. Wij zijn daarom op zoek naar drie nieuwe onafhankelijke leden: twee leden en een voorzitter, die gezamenlijk bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling en positionering van de Rekenkamer van waterschap Aa en Maas.

Daarom kies je voor de rekenkamer

  • Jij staat als mens centraal en krijgt alle ruimte om je rol met aandacht te vervullen
  • Jouw scherpe blik draagt bij aan een toekomstgericht waterschap
  • Werk met impact: samen maken we de wereld een beetje beter met veilige dijken en voldoende en schoon water

Jouw impact

Je ondersteunt het algemeen bestuur bij zijn controlerende taak. Dat doen de twee leden plus de voorzitter van de Rekenkamer door onafhankelijk onderzoek te doen naar de doeltreffendheid, doelmatigheid en rechtmatigheid van beleid en uitgaven. De bevindingen dragen bij aan een lerende en verbetergerichte organisatie.

Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden

  • Samen bepalen van onderzoeksonderwerpen (zoals subsidies, investeringsprojecten of regelingen)
  • Uitvoeren van onderzoeken of regie voeren op uitbesteding
  • Informatie ophalen binnen de organisatie (bijvoorbeeld via interviews) en vertalen naar conclusies
  • Opstellen en toelichten van rapportages aan het algemeen bestuur
  • Monitoren van de opvolging van aanbevelingen en rapporteren hierover

Specifiek voor de voorzitter

  • Leiding geven aan de Rekenkamer en bewaken van kwaliteit en onafhankelijkheid
  • Coördineren van de onderzoeksagenda
  • Optreden als eerste aanspreekpunt richting algemeen bestuur en organisatie

Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Werk met impact: wat jij doet is belangrijk!
  • Vergoeding voor reiskosten
  • Benoeming voor een periode van 6 jaar
  • Een maandelijkse vergoeding: Als lid van de rekenkamer ontvang je 40% van de vergoeding ven een lid van het algemeen bestuur en voor de voorzitter is dit 50% Maandelijkse vergoeding: circa € 342 bruto (lid Rekenkamer), circa € 428 bruto (voorzitter Rekenkamer)

Deze functie past bij jou als je …

  • Ervaring hebt met het opzetten, begeleiden en/of uitvoeren van (rekenkamer)onderzoek
  • Goed kunt functioneren in een onafhankelijk team
  • Bij voorkeur al enige ervaring hebt met rekenkamer(commissie)werk
  • Goede sociale, communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden hebt
  • Onafhankelijk en objectief kunt denken
  • Stevig in je schoenen staat en anderen in beweging weet te krijgen
  • Gevoel hebt voor onderliggende belangen, krachtenvelden en gevoeligheden, en die weet te vertalen naar heldere inzichten.

Goed om te weten: om de onafhankelijkheid van de rekenkamer te waarborgen, is het belangrijk dat je als lid geen persoonlijk of zakelijk belang hebt bij het werk van het waterschap. Daarom kom je niet in aanmerking voor dit lidmaatschap als je werk van substantieel belang is voor ons waterschap. Of als je verbonden bent aan organisaties of instellingen die een financiële of bestuurlijke band hebben met waterschap Aa en Maas.

Typisch de Rekenkamer

De Rekenkamer bestaat uit twee leden en een voorzitter en onderzoekt of het bestuur van het waterschap goed functioneert. De nadruk ligt op het leren en verbeteren, met een open en constructieve benadering. Voor onderzoeken is een werkbudget beschikbaar. Zie meer informatie ook op onze pagina Rekenkamer - Waterschap Aa en Maas.


Dit drijft ons

Om de effectiviteit van de rekenkamer te borgen, streven we bij de samenstelling van de Rekenkamer naar een natuurlijke mix van focus op inhoud, proces en relatie. De leden brengen de volgende gezamenlijke deskundigheid in:

  • Brede kennis van het werkveld van waterschappen
  • Inhoudelijke en technische kennis om vraagstukken in samenhang te overzien
  • Affiniteit met cijfers (inhoudelijk en/of financieel)
  • Juridische basiskennis
  • Kennis van onderzoeksprocessen en ervaring met het voeren van de regie daarop
  • Kennis van het werken op basis van standaarden, bijvoorbeeld bij het archiveren en rapporteren door de rekenkamer
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden

Solliciteer en word commissielid

Enthousiast? Solliciteer dan uiterlijk 8 september 2026 via de button. Bekijk onder aan de vacature hoe ons sollicitatieproces verloopt.

Op vrijdag 18 september worden de gesprekken gevoerd.

Goed om te weten: we hechten bij Aa en Maas veel waarde aan een veilige werkomgeving. Daarom vragen we je om een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).

title: Operations Associate/Coordinator
description:
This is a remote position.

We are looking for an Operations Associate/Coordinator to join their team. Our client is a fast-growing property maintenance and operations platform that has built a reputation for connecting clients with vetted vendors and delivering end-to-end job management with speed and precision. This is a full-time, 100% remote opportunity for a highly organized, phone-first coordinator ready to own the full lifecycle of a maintenance job, from the first inbound ticket to the final closed invoice.

Responsibilities

The Operations Associate/Coordinator will be responsible for managing maintenance jobs from start to finish, serving as the key point of contact between clients, vendors, and internal teams. Specific responsibilities include:

  • Receiving and triaging inbound client tickets; classifying each by trade, urgency, and scope; confirming site contacts and access details; and flagging emergency situations to the dispatch team
  • Proactively sourcing vendors through outbound cold calls, asking commercial qualification questions early in the conversation, sharing job photos during calls, and verbally confirming receipt
  • Coordinating and booking site visits with both vendors and site contacts; stacking offset visits on the same day for non-emergency multi-bid jobs; and reconfirming all appointments 24 hours in advance
  • Driving the quoting process by pursuing remote quotes where feasible, negotiating against ballpark estimates, aligning comparable bids, and documenting all scope assumptions in writing
  • Collecting and verifying required documentation — including W9s, Certificates of Insurance (COI), and signed quotes — prior to scheduling any work; ensuring COIs correctly name the appropriate parties; and following up on missing items the same day
  • Overseeing work execution by holding vendors accountable to agreed scope and timelines, coordinating on-site access, resolving scope changes before additional work begins, and keeping clients informed throughout
  • Confirming job completion through photos and site sign-off; reconciling the original scope against the final invoice; and routing any punch-list items back to the vendor before closing out the job
  • Approving and submitting vendor invoices, following up on client approvals, resolving billing discrepancies, and closing jobs in the system with a complete and clean paper trail

Requirements

  • Proven ability to manage multiple active threads simultaneously across voice, SMS, and email — comfortable with 10–30 open conversations at any given time
  • Experience in cold calling, vendor coordination, or operations roles where phone communication is the primary channel
  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to make cost-vs-speed tradeoffs under pressure
  • Strict documentation discipline — treating compliance paperwork as non-negotiable before work begins
  • Ability to remain calm and focused in fast-paced, high-volume environments
  • Professional-level written and spoken English
  • Spanish proficiency is a strong plus

Qualifications

  • Background in operations coordination, facilities management, field service coordination, or a related field
  • Experience in a client-facing or vendor-facing coordination role
  • Familiarity with trade industries such as roofing, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, locksmith, or general contracting is a plus but not required
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment while managing time-sensitive priorities

Benefits

  • Full-time position
  • 100% remote — work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Opportunity to be part of a growing operations platform with a clear structure and real impact
  • Collaborative team environment working alongside dispatchers, finance, vendor success, and operations leadership
  • Exposure to a fast-paced, U.S.-based operations model with strong systems and processes

title: QA Lead (all genders)
description:
We're looking for a QA Lead to join Gimica, our in-house game studio focused on creating casual, timeless mobile experiences with lasting appeal.

In this role, you'll own quality across our portfolio of ~70 live Unity mobile games. This is not a single-title QA role - our games each have their own release cycle while sharing SDKs, Firebase configuration, analytics, monetization, and backend services.

You'll define and scale our QA strategy, automation, and release processes to help a small team safely support a large portfolio. From driving test automation and release readiness to improving the shared systems that power every game, you'll play a key role in ensuring we deliver high-quality experiences to millions of players.

Job Responsibilities

  • Define and own the QA strategy across ~70 live mobile games, balancing centralized standards with title-specific needs.

  • Build scalable QA processes, automation, and release practices that improve quality without scaling headcount linearly.

  • Own release readiness across the portfolio, including release gating, staged rollouts, post-launch monitoring, and Go/No-Go recommendations.

  • Drive automated testing across Unity games and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines to improve release confidence.

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the QA team while collaborating closely with Game Engineering, Design, Producing, and external QA partners.

  • Champion quality across shared systems including SDK integrations, Firebase, analytics, monetization, and backend services.

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile game QA, including leading QA teams and driving QA strategy for live products.

  • Proven experience building and scaling in-engine test automation for Unity mobile games (AltTester/AltUnity, Unity Test Framework, or similar), ideally packaged as a shared test harness or SDK that can be rolled out across many titles without per-game code changes.

  • Hands-on experience with device-level, cross-app UI automation (e.g. Appium with UIAutomator2/XCUITest) for end-to-end flows that span multiple apps, such as a game handing off to a companion app, store and permission dialogs, or deep links, including apps without source access.

  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, TeamCity, or similar).

  • Strong understanding of release management for live mobile games, including staged rollouts, release gating, rollback strategies, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Experience with Firebase (Crashlytics, Remote Config, A/B Testing), analytics validation, and shared mobile SDKs.

  • Comfortable with Android & iOS debugging, performance testing, Charles Proxy, and mobile diagnostics.

  • Strong knowledge of Infrastructure for QA (device farms, emulators, or physical device labs) and modern QA processes.

  • Experience leading QA teams (internal, external, or both), mentoring engineers, and driving adoption across cross-functional teams.

  • Familiarity with Jira, Notion, and modern engineering workflows.

  • Bonus: Backend/API testing, maintaining large portfolios of live games, and using AI tools to improve engineering workflows.

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc.

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

  • Munich Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free lunch on a daily basis, and dog-friendly environment

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining model.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 30+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

title: Advanced Service Technician
description:
RaceTrac Company Overview

Job Description:

The Advanced Service Technician is responsible for the maintenance and repair of up to 15 RaceTrac and Raceway convenience stores in a designated region. This individual assesses, develops protocol, and resolves maintenance issues to ensure the operability of every store at all times.

The home store for this position is based at “8630 Lake Worth Rd Lake Worth, Florida 33467 ”

What You'll Do:

· Resolves maintenance and services issues at RaceTrac and Raceway convenience store locations to ensure full operability 24/7, ultimately increase the profitability of the company.

· Ensures each job is performed at a high level of skill and with optimal customer service.

· Serves as a knowledge expert in general maintenance functions including, but not limited to: HVACR, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, foodservice/beverage equipment, and petroleum dispensing systems.

· Accurately maintain tools and inventory on a service vehicle

· Provides project support to cross-functional departments in various initiatives related to stores.

· Responds to additional ad hoc maintenance requests communicated from store personnel as needed.

· Maintains knowledge of local and state guidelines for facility services as necessary.

· Works with other AST’s to cross train in multiple trades

What We're Looking For:

· Food and Beverage equipment repair knowledge preferred

· Fuel dispenser and pump repair knowledge preferred

· Technical School training in HVACR or electrical preferred

· 4+ years work experience preferred

· Type 1 & Type 2 EPA Certification for refrigerants

· Experience in a retail maintenance environment a plus

· General knowledge maintenance and repair procedures a plus

· Maintenance or repair certifications a plus

· Basic Microsoft office knowledge

#RTFS

Fueled by Growth, Driven by You

At RaceTrac, our people make the difference. Whether you’re working in a store, at our corporate office, or on the road, you’ll be part of a team that brings energy, innovation, and a passion for serving others every day. We support each other, celebrate wins big and small, and create opportunities for growth at every level. With four operating divisions RaceTrac, RaceWay, Energy Dispatch, and Gulf - there’s always a new challenge to take on and a new path to pursue. Join us and discover how far your career can go.

To see what #LifeatRaceTrac is like, visit our LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram pages.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment with RaceTrac without regard to their race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

Responsibilities:

  • Resolves maintenance and service issues at RaceTrac convenience store locations to ensure full operability 24/7, ultimately increasing the profitability of the company.
  • Ensures each repair is performed at a high level of quality minimizing repeat issues and with optimal customer service.
  • Serves as a knowledge expert in general maintenance functions including, but not limited to: HVACR, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, foodservice/beverage equipment, and petroleum dispensing systems.
  • Maintain tools and parts inventory on the service vehicle following RaceTrac’s policies and procesures
  • Provides project support to cross-functional departments in various initiatives related to stores.
  • Responds to additional ad hoc maintenance requests communicated from store personnel as needed.
  • Maintains knowledge of local and state guidelines for facility services as necessary.
  • Works with other AST’s to cross train in multiple trade

  • Ability to lift 50Ibs or more on a regular basis

Physical Expectations: (refers to the specific demands a job places on an employee's body, such as lifting requirements, prolonged standing or walking, and manual dexterity)

  • Lifting/Carrying: Ability to regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, frequently up to 75 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move 75-100 pounds.
  • Push/Pull: Ability to push/pull with up to 100 pounds of force occasionally.

Qualifications:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment with RaceTrac without regard to their race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

title: Ergoterapeut til område 2, Silkeborg Kommune
description:
Vi søger en ergoterapeut til område 2 i plejecentersektionen, Silkeborg Kommune

Vil du være med til at styrke beboernes hverdagsliv gennem rehabilitering, tværfaglighed og faglig kvalitet? I plejecentersektion søger vi en ergoterapeut, der har lyst til at gøre en forskel i tværfaglige teams.

Du skal brænde for at skabe kvalitet i hverdagsaktiviteter for beboerne på plejecentrene og indgå i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med den øvrige medarbejdergruppe. På alle plejecentre arbejder vi med personcentreret omsorg og har et stort fokus på faglig ledelse.

Rammen for stillingen:

På Silkeborg Kommunes plejecentre arbejdes der i tværfaglige team som led i implementeringen af den nye ældrelov. Der er stort fokus på det tværfaglige samarbejde, hvor den rehabiliterende indsats vil være omdrejningspunktet for alle beboer på vores plejecentre. Vi prioriterer en grundig introduktion samt løbende faglig sparring i hverdagen.

Plejecentersektionen er inddelt i tre geografiske områder med hver to ergo- og to fysioterapeuter. Du vil blive tilknyttet område 2, som består af plejecentrene:

  • Marienlund
  • Sejs
  • Bakkegården
  • Søvangen
  • Malmhøj (profil plejecenter for borgere med sindslidelser)
  • Solgården (profil plejecenter for borgere med alkoholmisbrug)

Din nærmeste leder vil være plejecenterlederen på Sejs plejecenter. Du vil få varierende indmødested i området.

Som ergoterapeut hos os vil dine opgaver bl.a. være:

  • Genoptræning efter serviceloven, sundhedsloven og ældreloven
  • Understøtte og sikre hensigtsmæssige forflytninger
  • Sikre relevante hjælpemidler til beboerne
  • Bidrage til den gode indflytning af nye beboer
  • Deltage i triageringsmøder og borgergennemgangen og bidrage til tværfagligt samarbejde omkring helhedspleje
  • Bidrage til den gode indlæggelse/udskrivelse i tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer i teamet
  • Rådgivning og vejledning til beboer og medarbejdere i forhold til at støtte beboerne i at mestre dagligdagen bedst muligt
  • Udarbejdelse af funktionsevnevurderinger med fokus på at tilrettelægge relevant rehabiliterende, trænings- og kompenserende indsatser, der understøtter beboernes selvstændighed i hverdagen
  • Vurdering og behandling af beboere med dysfagi

Vi ønsker os en terapeut der

  • har erfaring og interesse for arbejdet med den ældre borger og borgere med demens
  • kan arbejde ud fra en rehabiliterende og helhedsorienteret tilgang, hvor træning integreres i hverdagssituationer for beboerne
  • har en stærk monofaglig identitet, som kan være med til at skabe resultater i det tætte tværfaglige samarbejde
  • har en stor interesse for forflytningsområdet og gerne erfaring med dette
  • kan samarbejde tværfagligt og medvirker til et godt arbejdsmiljø og fælles kultur
  • er en relationel stærk medarbejder, der møder både beboere, pårørende og kollegaer med nærvær, respekt og empati
  • har du erfaring med omsorgssystemet Nexus er det en fordel
  • stillingen indebærer kørsel i eget køretøj. Der ydes kørselsgodtgørelse efter gældende regler

Derfor skal du vælge os

  • Du får en foranderlig og udfordrende hverdag, hvor du i høj grad kan være med til at skabe udviklingen
  • Mulighed for at præge implementering af ældreloven på plejecentrene
  • Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi kommunikerer konstruktivt og åbent, med plads til humor og grin
  • Du får dygtige og engagerede kollegaer, der står klar til at tage imod dig

Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning suppleret med C.V., autorisations id og
eksamensbeviser.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Stillingen er på 37 timer og ønskes besat pr. 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse. Du vil være selvtilrettelæggende og arbejdstiden er primært i dagtimerne. Der vil forekomme kørsel i arbejdstiden.

Hvis du vil vide mere
Vil du vide mere om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte: Områdeleder Helle Dencker tlf.: 22288366

Ansøgning:

Vi foretrækker, at du sender din ansøgning online.
Klik på Ansøg. Vedhæft din ansøgning og relevante bilag.

Ansøgningsfrist: 24. august 2026 kl.07.00

Vi regner med at ansættelsessamtaler bliver: 26. august 2026

Når vi ansætter personale inden for sundheds- og omsorgsområdet, er det en betingelse, at den person vi ønsker at ansætte, kan fremvise en tilfredsstillende privat straffeattest.

Om Plejecentersektionen i Silkeborg Kommune

Du bliver en del af en stor sektion med 18 plejecentre og omkring 700 medarbejdere. Sektionen er inddelt i tre områder med hver sin områdeleder samt 17 plejecenterledere.

Plejecentersektionen er en del af Sundhed og Omsorg i Silkeborg Kommune. Sundheds- og Omsorgsafdelingen samarbejder med borgere om at styrke sundhed og fremme borgerens selvstændige og meningsfulde liv i pleje- og sundhedsfaglige indsatser i hjemme- og sygeplejen, daghjem, midlertidige pladser, plejehjem, aktivitetscentre, sundhedshus mv.

Læs mere om os på vores hjemmeside

title: Senior Scheduler
description:
At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. We are one of the fastest-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 10 rankings in ENR. With over 60 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double-digit year-over-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless!

We're seeking an experienced Senior Scheduler to support the construction program of a major pharmaceutical client in Huntsville, AL. This role will lead scheduling activities across complex capital projects, making prior pharmaceutical construction experience essential. If you're looking to make an impact on high-profile projects with a collaborative team, we'd love to hear from you!

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Support Project Managers with quality project schedules at appropriate levels of detail for proposed and on-going projects.
  • Develop, monitor, status and resolve negative impacts to schedule critical paths.
  • Provide guidance on design issues, client concerns and code issues.
  • Lead project managers, design and contractors on monthly project progress of work.
  • Develop and maintain project risk assessments, qualitative and quantitative.
  • Develop and maintain 4D, 5D modeling.
  • Manage the development of critical monthly progress reports.
  • Participate in design verifications and construction site walks.
  • Support efforts to collect, integrate and report key project data.
  • Develop and maintain detailed construction schedules.
  • Perform forensic scheduling analysis.
  • Overview clients’ schedules for as-planned schedule validation, labor productivity, critical path delay and acceleration.
  • Development of risk management plan, using crystal ball, PRA.
  • Manage resource and cost loading of schedules.
  • Contributes to and monitors scope control, change management and associated implications to project cost and scheduling, escalating when appropriate.
  • Provides mentorship to Scheduler I & Scheduler II Team Members.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Attendance at work during normal business hours.

Knowledge & Skills Required:

  • Demonstrated knowledge of developing and maintaining project risk assessments (qualitative and quantitative).
  • Knowledge of 4D/5D modeling.
  • Experience with forensic scheduling analysis of construction or engineering projects independently.
  • Experience with estimate validation and adjustments and comparative cost analyses.
  • Knowledge of Pre- and Post-Construction cost audits and valuations.
  • Experience performing detailed cost and schedule analyses.
  • Knowledge of project document control.
  • ability to provide forensic scheduling analysis of construction or engineering projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop high-level logic driven schedules.
  • Utilize effective written and oral communication skills.
  • Understand how your role contributes to the organization's goals.

title: Lähihoitajia lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun Turkuun
description:
Etsimme nyt Turun tiimiimme (Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialueelle) lähihoitajia työskentelemään lapsiperheiden parissa! Työ tähtää perheiden arjen helpottamiseen ja tukemiseen. Työssäsi pääset leikkimään ja viettämään aikaa ihanien lasten kanssa sekä huolehtimaan heidän perustarpeistaan ja arkensa sujumisesta. Samalla helpotat perheen arjen kuormitusta ja autat vanhempia jaksamaan.

Pääsääntöisesti yksi työvuoro perheessä kestää kerrallaan 2-4 tuntia. Työtä on tarjolla arkisin klo 7-21 välillä, sekä lauantaisin klo 8-18 välillä. Voit itse valita, milloin haluat työskennellä! Toivomme kuitenkin, että voisit sitoutua yhteen asiakasperheeseen ainakin 2-3 kuukauden ajaksi. Työ tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti asiakasperheidemme omissa kodeissa, sekä kotien ympäristössä esimerkiksi leikkipuistoillen.

Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä osaamista lasten ja perheiden aitoon kohtaamiseen. Toivomme, että sinulta löytyy ammatillista kokemusta lapsiperheiden ja pienten lasten parissa toimimisesta.

MEILTÄ SAAT:

-Tuntipalkan 14,50-15,68€ + TES:in ilta- ja viikonloppulisät

-Siirtymäbonuksen siirtyessäsi asiakkaan luota toiselle päivän aikana

-Kivan ja joustavan työn lapsiperheiden parissa

-Aikaa kohdata jokaisen lapsen ilman kiireen tunnetta

-Mahtavan työporukan ja säännölliset yhteiset tapaamiset, sekä whatsapp-ryhmän jossa voit vaihtaa ajatuksia kollegoiden kanssa

-Esihenkilö Irenen tuen aina kun sitä tarvitset

-Kattavan perehdytyksen työhösi

-Hätäensiapukoulutuksen täpärien tilanteiden varalta sekä vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen

-Hyviä jäsenetuja Fitness24Seven-kuntokeskuksissa

-Yli 20h/viikossa tekeville tarjoamme myös liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, yksityisen työterveyshuollon

SINULTA TOIVOMME:

-Lähihoitajan (tai soveltuvaa sote-alan) tutkintoa (Huomioimme myös sairaanhoitaja-opiskelijat joilla 90op täynnä) -Ammatillista kokemusta lapsiperheiden parissa toimimisesta -Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja osaamista lapsen ja perheen kohtaamiseen -Reipasta ja oma-aloitteista asennetta työntekoon -Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti -Oma auto ja ajokortti ovat iso plussa!

Tehtävässä vaaditaan rikostaustaote, joka perustuu Lakiin lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä (504/2002)

Tehtävään valittavalla henkilöllä tulee olla vähintään yksi suosittelija aiemmista työsuhteista lasten parissa ja tehtävässä edellytetään rekisteröitymistä Valviran ammattihenkilöiden keskusrekisteriin.

Lähetä hakemus pian! Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana!

title: AWS Data Engineer with Talend
description:
Join an international data transformation initiative for a global organization modernizing its data platform and analytics capabilities in the cloud. The project focuses on building scalable, cloud-native data products and robust ingestion pipelines that enable reliable, business-critical data processing across multiple systems.

You will be part of a highly skilled engineering team responsible for designing and developing modern data solutions leveraging AWS, Snowflake, and Talend. This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, offering the opportunity to shape architecture decisions, mentor team members, and contribute to data platform evolution.

Work Mode: Hybrid (Warsaw) / Remote

Job Responsibilities

  • Design and develop cloud-native data pipelines using AWS services including Lambda, S3, Step Functions, DynamoDB, and SNS,

  • Build and maintain Change Data Capture (CDC) solutions ensuring sequential processing, idempotency, and data consistency,

  • Develop scalable data ingestion and transformation workflows using Talend,

  • Design and optimize analytical data models within Snowflake,

  • Create robust solutions for incremental loading, error handling, monitoring, and alerting,

  • Develop and optimize complex SQL-based transformations and database logic,

  • Work with Aurora PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning,

  • Define and maintain infrastructure using AWS CDK and CloudFormation,

  • Support CI/CD processes and engineering best practices within GitLab environments,

  • Troubleshoot data platform issues related to connectivity, networking, and operational reliability,

  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical documentation activities,

  • Collaborate closely with product owners, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment.

Expectations

  • At least 5 years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles,

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS serverless technologies (Lambda, S3, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SNS),

  • Proven expertise in Talend and large-scale ETL/ELT development,

  • Strong understanding of Change Data Capture (CDC) patterns and incremental data processing,

  • Experience working with Aurora PostgreSQL or other PostgreSQL-based solutions,

  • Practical knowledge of Snowflake Data Warehouse architecture and optimization techniques,

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python,

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK and/or CloudFormation,

  • Knowledge of GitLab CI/CD processes and software engineering best practices,

  • Understanding of monitoring and observability tools including CloudWatch,

  • Experience with technical documentation, solution design, and code reviews,

  • Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating within distributed teams,

  • Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving,

  • Fluent English (minimum B2/C1 level).

Nice to Have

  • Experience building Data Products in modern data platforms,

  • Previous experience in financial services, banking, or large-scale enterprise environments,

  • Mentoring or technical leadership experience,

  • Experience with data governance and data quality initiatives.

We Offer

  • Ongoing support from a dedicated agent, taking care of your project continuity, client contact, necessary formalities, work comfort and development,

  • Consultant Development Program – advice on growth planning based on the latest trends and market needs in IT, including consultations with agents and growth mentors,

  • Access to 7N Learning & Development – a development and educational platform with webinars, a library of articles and industry reports, and regular invitations to one-time and recurring development events – technical, business, and lifestyle,

  • Spectacular integration events, both for you (e.g., annual Kick-Off trip, Christmas parties, or Summer Olympics sports events) and for your loved ones,

  • Professional development through participation in internal initiatives and 7N Services,

  • Relationships and access to the knowledge of the most experienced IT experts in the market,

  • A complete benefits package, including funding for medical care, life insurance, sports cards for you and your loved ones, as well as discounts in stores in Poland and abroad.
