title: Studiejob hos Musikbyen Roskilde i Roskilde Kommune
description:
Roskilde Kommune har et stærkt, bredt og engageret musikliv. Nu kan du komme med på holdet og være med til at kommunikere og formidle musikbyens mange initiativer, så endnu flere børn, unge og voksne kan deltage i koncerter, festivaler og selv skabe musik sammen med andre.

Så er du god til at holde styr på detaljerne, har du erfaring med digital kommunikation på sociale medier, arbejder du struktureret, og kunne du tænke dig at få erfaring i at styrke musiklivet i en kommune er studiejobbet i Roskilde Kommune måske lige noget for dig.

I arbejdet kommer du helt tæt på udviklingen af Musikbyen Roskilde. Du bliver en del af kulturteamet i afdelingen Kultur, Bibliotek og Idræt. I din hverdag vil du primært samarbejde med kommunens Musikbysupervisor fra Musikkontoret i Byens Hus i hjertet af Roskilde by.

Dit primære fokus bliver at understøtte musikbyens kommunikation i Polyfon-universet (web, SoMe og nyhedsbreve) og hjælpe med at planlægge og afvikle netværksmøder i Roskilde Kommunes musikliv.

Dine opgaver kan være:
  • Målrettet og engagerende kommunikation på Polyfons SoMe-kanaler.
  • Opdatering af Polyfons hjemmeside.
  • Udarbejdelse af nyhedsbreve.
  • Indsamling af viden og data.
  • Planlægning og afvikling af netværksmøder.
  • Løbende administrative opgaver.
Om dig:
  • Du er studerende på en videregående uddannelse, gerne med mindst to år tilbage af studiet.
  • Du er velskrivende, føler dig hjemme på sociale medier og ved hvad der virker når man skal fange opmærksomheden hos ens følgere. Erfaring med at tage og redigere billeder er et plus.
  • Du har evnen til både at arbejde selvstændigt og indgå i et fællesskab.
  • Du interesserer dig for musik- og kulturlivet og har lyst til at få indsigt i arbejdet med musiklivet i Roskilde Kommune.
Om jobbet: Hos os bliver du en reel del af afdelingen, og du får ansvar og erfaring, som du kan tage med dig videre. Vi har en afslappet omgangstone, og vi prioriterer både samarbejde og det sociale fællesskab i hverdagen.

Du vil komme til at arbejde i Byens Hus, som ligger i hjertet af Roskilde by, men vil også få din gang på Roskilde Rådhus og til møder med musiklivets aktører.

Vi forventer, at du kan starte i september 2026.

Din ugentlige arbejdstid vil være på 10-15 timer, og arbejdstiden aftales så det passer til dit studie.

Du vil blive aflønnet efter gældende overenskomst.

Der indhentes straffeattest inden ansættelse.

Roskilde Kommune opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Yderligere information: Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Musikbysupervisor, Mikael Pass på mikaelpa@roskilde.dk eller på 2926 3343.

Du kan læse mere om Musikbyen Roskilde på eller på

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning senest den 7. september og forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 38.

title: Buyer – vikariat (ca. 1 år)
description:
Har du sterk forretningsforståelse, teft for trender – og lyst til å påvirke sortiment, marginer og resultater?

Da kan dette være en spennende mulighet for deg! Bik Bok søker en Buyer til et vikariat på omtrent ett år.

Rollen passer for deg som trives i krysningspunktet mellom business og mote, og som motiveres av å se resultatene av egne beslutninger.

Du vil ha en nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av kommersielle og lønnsomme kolleksjoner for hele Norden, samtidig som du bidrar til å forme strategi, sortiment og resultater.

Hos oss blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø og får jobbe tett med globale partnere, med reiser til produksjonsland som en naturlig del av arbeidet.

Om rollen

Som Buyer får du fullt ansvar for sentrale varegrupper – fra strategi og budsjettering til produktutvikling, kalkyle og prissetting. Du vil bruke økonomisk forståelse og analytiske evner til å styre sortiment, margin og lønnsomhet – samtidig som du har en kommersiell og trendbevisst tilnærming til produkt og kunde. Du jobber tett med design, supply chain, produksjonskontor og retail, og spiller en nøkkelrolle i å utvikle sterke og lønnsomme kolleksjoner for våre nordiske markeder.

Som Buyer vil du også være en sparringspartner for Buying Manager, bidra i tverrfaglige prosjekter og være en støttespiller for andre i teamet.

Arbeidsoppgaver og ansvarsområder

  • Planlegge og utvikle kolleksjoner med riktig produktmiks, pris og margin
  • Legge strategi for dine varegrupper basert på analyseav salg, lager og resultater
  • Budsjettering, kalkulering og prissetting
  • Bygge og forvalte relasjoner med leverandører
  • Samarbeide tett med design for å balansere mote, kommersialitet og lønnsomhet

Kvalifikasjoner og personlige egenskaper

  • Høyere utdanning innen økonomi, business, analyse eller tekstil/innkjøp
  • Erfaring fra innkjøp, controlling, category management eller retailanalyse
  • Trygg i Excel og vant til å jobbe med tall, kalkyler og marginstyring
  • Kommersiell teft og forståelse for kunde, marked og trender
  • Strukturert, selvstendig og evner å ta raske, datadrevne beslutninger
  • Får energi av et høyt tempo og trives med å jobbe i team

Oppstart: November eller etter avtale.

Hva vi tilbyr

  • En sentral rolle i utviklingen Bik Boks kolleksjoner
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø innen innkjøp og retail hos et av Nordens ledende motehus
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter i Varner-konsernet
  • Inkluderende og sosialt miljø med jevnlige samlinger og feiringer
  • Moderne kontor, fantastisk lunsj og egen kaffebar med barista
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn og betingelser, samt svært god personalrabatt i alle våre brands
  • Støtte til å reise grønnere til jobb
  • Rabatt på SATS-medlemskap

Er vi en god match? Da håper vi du søker allerede i dag.

Sammen bygger vi fremtidens motedestinasjon i Norden.

title: Senior Technical Officer (STO), Demand Planning Laboratory Services - Dodoma
description:
Job Summary:

The STO Demand Planning Laboratory Services provides technical assistance to the National AIDS, Sexually Transmitted Infections and Hepatitis Control Programme (NASHCOP) including the Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission of HIV (PMTCT) unit. The National TB and Leprosy Programme (NTLP), The National Malaria Control Programme (NMCP) and Laboratory Unit across disease areas to strengthen laboratory commodity planning and supply chain management. The STO ensures that HIV/AIDS, Malaria and TB laboratory commodities are accurately quantified, forecasted, procured, stored, distributed and managed according to national policies, set standard operating procedures and regulatory requirements. The STO will provide routine updates on commodities status, risks, data quality and work with MoH entities and related units to attain the best Laboratory commodities availability and accessibility in the country. The role contributes to strengthening laboratory systems by preparing knowledge of products related to laboratory services including preparation of technical reports and guidance materials, and evidence-based solutions. Working closely with project, NASCHOP & NTLP, the STO supports the evaluation of programmatic effectiveness, overseeing technical aspects, and providing technical assessment reports on laboratory services and associated supply chain activities.

Accountabilities:

Technical Requirements:

  • Leads forecasting, quantification, and demand planning for laboratory commodities to ensure uninterrupted availability of HIV, TB, Malaria and other priority laboratory products.
  • Develops, reviews, and updates national laboratory supply plans aligned with Ministry of Health priorities and disease programs.
  • Analyzes consumption, morbidity, service utilization, inventory, and pipeline data to generate accurate forecasts and inform procurement decisions.
  • Prepares quantification reports, procurement schedules, supply plans, and pipeline analyses.
  • Monitors stock status, inventory levels, shipment performance, commodity pipelines, and product shelf life.
  • Identifies supply chain risks and implement mitigation measures to prevent stockouts, expiries, and overstock situations.
  • Strengthens and support implementation of LMIS/eLMIS and ensure high-quality data for supply chain decision-making.
  • Establishes and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and supply chain performance monitoring frameworks.
  • Coordinates with government stakeholders, Medical Stores Department (MSD), procurement agencies, donors, implementing partners, and laboratory programs.
  • Maintains effective communication and provides timely updates to project leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Collaborates with laboratory, logistics, procurement, and program teams to strengthen integrated supply chain systems.
  • Provides technical assistance, coaching, mentorship, and supportive supervision to national and sub-national counterparts.
  • Designs and implement capacity-building initiatives on forecasting, inventory management, supply planning, and commodity management.
  • Conducts data quality assessments and support continuous improvement of laboratory supply chain systems.
  • Prepares monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc technical reports, dashboards, presentations, and performance analyses for stakeholders.
  • Documents lessons learned, best practices, and innovations to improve program performance and sustainability.
  • Supports emergency preparedness, contingency planning, and long-term institutionalization of effective supply chain practices.
  • Provides technical support in forecasting, quantification, and demand planning for laboratory commodities to ensure uninterrupted availability of HIV, TB, Malaria, and other priority laboratory products. Contributes to the development and revisions of national guidelines, SOPs, tools and policies related to laboratory commodities.
  • Coordinates with national programs, Medical Stores Department (MSD), procurement agencies, donors, and implementing partners on laboratory commodity planning.
  • Supports national procurement planning by preparing quantification reports, procurement schedules, pipeline analyses, and supply planning recommendations.
  • Monitors commodity pipeline, shipment status, inventory levels, and distribution performance.
  • Builds capacity of national and sub-national teams on laboratory commodity management, forecasting, and inventory control.
  • Ensures compliance with national guidelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and best practices in laboratory supply chain management.
  • Supports design and implementation of continuous quality improvement initiatives for laboratory commodity management and supply chain performance. Monitors key supply chain performance indicators and recommends quality improvement interventions to strengthen laboratory commodity security.
  • Represents the project in national and technical working groups and supply chain coordination meetings.

Project Design Implementation:

  • Participates in quarterly review of supply plan and generate updated supply plan and provide coaching to GoT counterparts in supply plan management.
  • Prepares and submits monthly and quarterly supply chain performance reports to the program, and facilitates its distribution to relevant stakeholders such as PEPFAR and Global Fund.
  • Monitors commodities shelf life, prepares and follows through with action plans to avoid expiry of products in storage facilities.
  • Coordinates and ensures effective communication with timely feedback to Program Manager, Logistics Management Service (LMS), MSD, Diagnostics Unit, PSU and IPs.
  • Coordinates with other stakeholders including implementing partners on areas of supplies availability, usages/consumption at Central and zonal levels.

Business Development and Client/Funder Support:

  • Provides technical input to funding proposals, concept notes, and procurement plans related to laboratory commodities, diagnostics, and other essential health products.
  • Contributes forecasting, quantification, budgeting, and work-planning inputs for demand planning and supply chain strengthening activities.
  • Supports development of technical narratives, implementation plans, and cost estimates for donor and government-funded initiatives.

Applied Knowledge & Skills:

  • Demonstrated knowledge of supply chain management principles, demand planning, forecasting and quantification, and supply chain methodologies, particularly within Laboratory commodities and diagnostics.
  • Proficiency with electronic database management software and online tools is required.
  • Strong understanding of public health supply chain systems, commodity management processes, and the application of evidence-based approaches to forecasting and planning.
  • Working knowledge of national health systems, donor-funded programs, policies, procedures, and regulatory frameworks that influence supply chain performance.
  • Ability to collect, validate, analyze, and interpret complex data sets to identify trends, inform decision-making, and support forecasting and supply planning activities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly and effectively to government counterparts, donors, stakeholders, and project teams.
  • Has sensitivity to cultural diversity and understanding of the political, contextual, and ethical issues in assigned areas.
  • Articulates, professional, and able to communicate in a clear, positive manner with clients and staff.
  • Fluency in English and Kiswahili.
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills.
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration, and influencing skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams and build productive relationships with stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify operational challenges, conduct root-cause analysis, develop practical solutions, and implement corrective actions to improve program performance.
  • Ability to solve problems and implement corrective action as needed.

Supervision Given/Received:

  • Supervises junior level staff.
  • Reports to Senior Technical Advisor, Systems Strengthening & Demand Planning

Education: ** **

  • Master's degree in laboratory sciences, Pharmacy, Public Health, Supply Chain Management, Health Logistics or a related field or its International Equivalent.

Experience: ** **

  • Minimum of 6 years of progressive responsible experience in laboratory commodity forecasting, national quantifications for Laboratory and diagnostic services, demand planning or supply chain management at national or sub-national level.
  • Experience in managing data collection, analysis and interpreting logistics, consumption, service utilization and stock data to support evidence-based forecasting and procurement decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting or providing technical assistance in related demand planning activities.
  • Experience working with non-governmental organizations (NGO), government ministries, implementing partners, donors or private organizations.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Tanzania’s health supply chain systems and laboratory commodity management.

Proficiency in national quantification and forecasting tools including., Quantimed, PipeLine, ForLab, or equivalent tools).

  • Experience using LMIS/eLMIS platforms and other electronic logistics information systems for forecasting, reporting, and supply chain performance monitoring.

Typical Physical Demands:

  • Typical office environment.
  • Ability to spend long hours looking at computer screen and doing repetitive work on a keyboard.
  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time.

Technology to be Used:

  • Personal Computer/Laptop, Microsoft applications (i.e., Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams), cell phone/mobile technology, and standard office equipment.

Travel Requirements:

  • 10% - 25%

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

title: Registration Specialist
description:
Imagine a career at one of the nation's most advanced health networks.


Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.


LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary
Coordinates all aspects of patient registration, insurance verification, and scheduling of patients accurately. Conducts patient interviews by phone and in-person for the purpose of establishing an account by gathering demographic, insurance, and clinical information to ensure appropriate patient scheduling and optimal financial clearance. Educates patients regarding financial responsibilities and collects out of pocket fees.

Job Duties

  • Ensures referring providers' orders are complete and match the appointment scheduled. Obtains a new order prior to test/treatment if order is incomplete or inaccurate.

  • Secures signatures to ensure timely reimbursement, which includes consents signed specific to service(s) being rendered.
  • Determines and collects patient financial liability and creates estimates, if applicable. Refers patients to financial resources as needed for assistance with financial counseling.
  • Reviews daily schedule and identifies potential scheduling conflicts affecting department flow and confers with colleagues and providers for a resolution.
  • Maintains compliance with registration accuracy.

Minimum Qualifications
  • High School Diploma/GED
  • 1 year Customer service or
  • 1 year Healthcare environment such as a hospital and/or physician office
  • Computer and typing proficiency.
  • Must be able to interact with a diverse customer base, including those seeking emergency services or treatment due to an accident or illness.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree Health care or related field
  • 2 years registration/insurance verification in a health care setting
  • Knowledge of medical terminology.
  • Bi-lingual - Spanish/English.

Physical Demands
Lift and carry 7 lbs., continuous sitting >67%, frequent keyboard use/repetitive motion, frequent fine motor activity/wrist position deviation.

Questo significa che puoi concentrarti esclusivamente sulla consulenza ai nostri potenziali clienti e sulla vendita diretta delle nostre soluzioni/prodotti. title: Kassa-myyjä, Kajaani Kehräämötie (määräaikainen 20h/vk)
description:
Hei!

Nyt on maailman paras ostaja hankkinut hyllyt täyteen laatutuotteita ja meillä on tarjolla työpaikkoja asiakaspalveluhenkisille ja vauhdikkaasta työstä nauttiville työkavereille! Haluatko sinä mukaan ystävälliseen porukkaamme?

Kassa-myyjänä pääset yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa varmistamaan asiakkaillemme mukavan ja mutkattoman asiointikokemuksen Tokmannin myymälässä.

Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myymälässämme asioivien asiakkaidemme auttaminen erilaisissa kysymyksissä, ja aina autamme myös toisiamme, kun tiimissä tarvitaan apua.

Kattavan valikoimamme ansiosta pääset laittamaan esille esimerkiksi pukeutumiseen, vapaa-aikaan sekä kodin arkeen ja kunnostamiseen liittyviä tuotteita ja opastamaan asiakkaitamme monenlaisissa kysymyksissä.

Tehtävä on 3 kuukauden mittainen määräaikaisuus. Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja työaika on 20h/vk. Sinulla on meillä työskennellessäsi myös mahdollisuus tehdä osa sopimuksesi tunneista tai lisätunteja työskentelemällä lähimyymälöissäsi. Täytämme tehtävän heti, kun löydämme sopivan työkaverin joukkoomme, joten toimithan pian!

Voit olla etsimämme työkaveri, jos olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on:

  • Iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne
  • Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää
  • Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä
  • Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli
  • Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin
  • Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen

Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.

Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.

title: Resande montör Infrastruktur
description:
Passera erbjuder tekniska säkerhetslösningar till små och stora verksamheter inom en mängd olika branscher. Vi hjälper dig att hitta en behovsanpassad lösning för lås, passersystem, brandlarm, utrymningslarm, inbrottslarm och övervakning. Passera finns till för dig – för säkerhets skull.

Vill du arbeta i säkerhetsbranschen och söker en roll med teknik och elinstallation i fokus? Trivs du som allra bäst när du får stor frihet och variation genom att arbeta ute hos spännande företagskunder? Nu har vi den perfekta möjligheten för dig!

Passera växer och förstärker sitt team med ett flertal Resande montörer.

Om tjänsten

I rollen som Resande montör väntar en spännande vardag med ansvar för installation och olika säkerhetssystem. Du arbetar med montage, kabeldragning och inkoppling samt även (om du besitter kompetens) driftsätter CCTV, larm och övrig säkerhetsanordning.

Vårt huvudkontor ligger i Jönköping. Du kan vara bosatt vart som helst i Sverige då majoriteten av din arbetstid spenderas på resande fot runt om i landet. Övernattningar på annan ort är ofta förekommande. Du skapar trygghet genom bra säkerhetslösningar hos dina kunder samtidigt som du säkerställer att de får bästa möjliga service.

Vem är du?

Du är svensk medborgare och har goda språkkunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift.

Du är ostraffad och blir godkänd i obligatorisk säkerhetsprövning.

Du har B-körkort.

Du arbetar som montör, elektriker eller tekniker idag.

Du är engagerad, självgående och har ett stort intresse för tekniken.

På Passera välkomnas du till ett fritt och varierat arbete med högt i tak och korta beslutsvägar. Teamet består av positiva kollegor som alla värdesätter en stark gemenskap och delar passionen för säkerhet. För oss är det högsta prioritet att du ska trivas och därför erbjuds du givetvis förmåner.

Förmåner

Passera AB värdesätter vi våra anställda och erbjuder en rad förmåner för att säkerställa en positiv och produktiv arbetsmiljö. Du kommer att få:

  • Konkurrenskraftig lön
  • Utbildnings- och utvecklingsmöjligheter
  • En stödjande och samarbetsinriktad arbetsmiljö
  • Hälsovårdsförmåner och friskvårdsbidrag
  • Förmåns eller servicebil

Ansökan

Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär som säkerhetstekniker?Skicka din ansökan inklusive CV och personligt brev till vår rekryteringsavdelning. Vi kommer att behandla ansökningar löpande, så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Välkommen att bli en del av vårt team på Passera AB, där vi tillsammans arbetar för att skapa säkra och tryggare miljöer för våra kunder.

Läs gärna mer på vår hemsida www.passera.se.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer - iOS or Android Contractor
description:
About us

At Westpac New Zealand, our purpose is to Help New Zealanders Succeed. As a Bank and one of New Zealand's leading employers, we are passionate about helping people. We are taking action today to create a better future for the people who bank with us, work with us, invest in us or are part of our broader communities.

Mō te tūranga | About the Role
Westpac is transforming its mobile experience for customers. This role is responsible for end‑to‑end delivery of production mobile solutions - from shaping technical approach and implementation through to testing, release and operational support - while championing code quality, security and sustainable reduction of technical debt.

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain applications and integration solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues promptly, ensuring system stability and participating in after-hours support when required.
  • Ensure best practice in design, coding standards, performance and security.
  • Collaborate with project teams from concept through delivery to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers and peers.
  • Create and maintain documentation throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to support transparency and knowledge sharing.
  • Implement changes aligned with design specifications and evolving business needs.
  • Analyse recurring issues and lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system performance and reliability.
  • Maintain and refine support procedures to ensure resilience and minimize downtime.
  • Contribute to release and deployment processes, ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with governance standards.
  • Implement automated testing and ensure high-quality code through code reviews and continuous integration practices.

Nā tāu rourou | What will you bring?

  • At least 5+ years of professional engineering experience in iOS or Android mobile app development.
  • Experience in DevOps such as CI/CD pipelines, containerisation and deployment automation.
  • Proficient in unit testing, code reviews, and debugging.
  • Ability to break down complex problems and deliver practical solutions.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design principles.
  • Integrates AI effectively into engineering workflows to improve quality and efficiency, demonstrates strong judgement on appropriate use, and coaches others on responsible AI practices.

title: CEO Office - AI Neobank App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for strong operators to join the CEO Office for BJAK's AI Neobank app expansion.

This role is for someone who can help turn CEO priorities into execution across product, hiring, licensing, partnerships, market launch and daily operating rhythm.

What You'll Own

  • Drive CEO-level priorities from problem definition to execution. 

  • Track OKRs, decisions, blockers, owners and deadlines across teams. 

  • Support licensing applications, country expansion, hiring, partnerships and strategic projects. 

  • Prepare clear briefs, updates, research notes, meeting follow-ups and action trackers.

  • Work across product, engineering, finance, legal, compliance, operations and country teams. 

  • Identify execution gaps and push teams to close them. 

  • Own urgent business problems that do not fit neatly into one department.


What We're Looking For 

  • High-ownership business generalist with strong execution discipline. 

  • Clear writer, structured thinker and strong follow-through operator. 

  • Able to work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. 

  • Comfortable handling ambiguity, urgent problems and shifting priorities. 

  • Strong judgement on what matters, what is blocked and what needs escalation. 

  • Able to keep teams moving without creating unnecessary process. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, operations, strategy, fintech or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Turns unclear priorities into clear actions. 

  • Can chase, unblock and execute without being chased. 

  • Writes updates that make decisions easier. 

  • Stays calm when many things are moving at once. 

  • Cares about outcomes more than visibility.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings. 

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Sweden. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Sweden.


Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: KONTAKTŲ CENTRO KOMANDOS VADOVĖ (-AS)
description:
Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io) kartu kurti naują kontaktų centrą Panevėžyje. Šioje pozicijoje būsi atsakinga (-as) už naujos komandos formavimą ir sklandžią kontaktų centro veiklą. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Prisidėsi prie žalios ir saugios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:

  • Organizuojant paslaugų pardavimą ir užtikrinant kokybišką bei efektyvų klientų aptarnavimą Panevėžio kontaktų centro komandoje;
  • Vykdant darbuotojų paiešką ir atranką, organizuojant naujų darbuotojų įvedimą, rūpinantis jų kompetencijų stiprinimu ir motyvuojančios darbo aplinkos kūrimu;
  • Analizuojant komandos veiklos efektyvumą, inicijuojant ir įgyvendinant veiklos optimizavimo sprendimus;
  • Dalyvaujant bendrovės inicijuotuose projektuose, teikiant pasiūlymus ir aktyviai prisidedant prie jų įgyvendinimo.
  • Aukštasis išsilavinimas;
  • Bent 3 metų sėkmingo vadovavimo patirtis, ugdant, telkiant ir motyvuojant komandą;
  • Patirtis organizuojant paslaugų pardavimo veiklą ir užtikrinant kokybišką klientų aptarnavimą;
  • Geri analitiniai ir komunikaciniai įgūdžiai;
  • Gebėjimas savarankiškai priimti sprendimus ir bendradarbiauti komandoje;
  • Puikūs lietuvių kalbos ir geri anglų kalbos įgūdžiai;
  • B kategorijos vairuotojo pažymėjimas.
  • Atitinkantį patirtį bei kompetencijas atlygį, bei kintamą finansinį paskatinimą priklausantį nuo pasiektų rezultatų;
  • Hibridinį darbo modelį (3+2) ir lankstų darbo laiko grafiką;
  • Papildomų naudų paketą pasirenkant: pensijų kaupimą, sveikatos draudimą ar kitą naudą iš pasirenkamų naudų sąrašo MELP programėlėje;
  • Vidines karjeros galimybes;
  • Plačias mokymosi, kvalifikacijos kėlimo programas;
  • Galimybę prisidėti prie energetikos transformacijos, siekiant sukurti 100% žalią ir saugią energijos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms.

Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

title: Lead Cloud Architect / PM (프로젝트 팀리더,한국)
description:
About

미국 Bellevue(Seattle)에 본사를 둔 TecAce는 Amazon, Microsoft, Samsung 등 글로벌 테크 기업과의 파트너십을 기반으로 독창적이고 혁신적인 소프트웨어 개발 및 클라우드 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.

지난 20년동안 TecAce는 클라우드와 IT 인프라 분야에서 지속적인 성장을 이어오며, 고객의 비즈니스 환경에 맞춘 Cloud DevOps 및 MSP 엔지니어링 서비스를 제공해왔습니다.
특히 국내 주요 대기업 및 해외 파트너사와 협력하며 최신 기술을 활용하여 고객의 IT 인프라를 보다 안정적이고 효율적인 환경으로 제공하는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.

이번 채용은 당사의 'AI & Cloud 전문 조직'으로의 혁신성장 전략과 함께 개편되는 클라우드 운영 조직에서 핵심 글로벌 프로젝트를 이끌어주실 리더(Team Leader)를 모시기 위해 진행됩니다.

Responsibilities

[담당업무]
• 프로젝트 운영팀 기술 리딩 및 기술 검토 수행
• 글로벌 고객사 및 유관 서비스 운영 및 협업 체계 구축 및 관리
• 대규모 서비스 인프라 구축 및 운영 아키텍처 설계
• 멀티클라우드(AWS/Azure/GCP) 환경 설계 및 최적화
• Kubernetes 기반 컨테이너 플랫폼 구축 및 운영
• CI/CD Pipeline 설계 및 자동화 구축
• Infrastructure as Code(Terraform, CloudFormation) 설계
• 모니터링 체계 구축 및 운영 자동화
• 성능 개선 및 장애 분석/복구 체계 수립

[지원자격]
• 클라우드/인프라 아키텍트 경력 5년 이상
• Linux/Unix 서버 운영 경험
• Apache, Nginx, JBoss, Tomcat, HAProxy 운영 경험
• AWS, Azure, GCP 등 Public Cloud 운영 경험
• Kubernetes 구축 및 운영 경험
• Jenkins, Ansible, Spinnaker 등 DevOps 도구 활용 경험
• Terraform 또는 CloudFormation 활용 경험
• GitHub 기반 형상관리 경험
• Bash, Python, Java, JavaScript 활용 가능자
• 대규모 서비스 장애 분석 및 복구 경험

[우대사항]
• 클라우드 운영(MSP) 조직 경력
• MSA(Micro Service Architecture) 설계 경험
• AWS Solutions Architect, Kubernetes(CKA/CKAD)등 자격 보유자
• DevOps 및 SRE 팀 운영 경험
• 운영센터(Service Operation) 경험

Requirements

[공통 자격 요건]
• 전문학사 이상 학위 소지하신 분
• 해외 여행에 결격 사유가 없는 분
• 원활한 커뮤니케이션 능력을 보유하신 분
• 문제 해결 및 장애 대응 역량을 보유하신 분
• 협업을 통한 서비스 개선에 적극적인 분
• 안정적인 서비스 운영에 책임감을 갖고 업무를 수행하실 분

Preferred

[우대사항]
• 영어 등 외국어 사용 가능자
• 유관 경력/ 관련 자격증 소지자, 업무 관련 전공자

Benefits

[How We Take Care of Our Own]

1. 기본 복지
• 4대보험
• 퇴직연금, 경조금, 인센티브, 스톡옵션 제도 운영

title: TIG-hitsaaja (reissutyö)
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme reissuvalmista TIG-hitsaajaa.

Asiakkaamme toimittaa erilaisia putkistojärjestelmiä asiakkailleen ympäri Suomea. Etsimme TIG-hitsaajaa / kirkkaan putken hitsaajaa, jolla on kokemusta ruostumattoman ja haponkestävän teräksen hitsauksesta ja asennuksista. Ainevahvuudet hitsaustöissä ovat pääasiassa alle 10mm. Eduksi on jos hakijalla on voimassa luokkia kirkkaille materiaaleille, mutta tämä ei ole ehdoton edellytys.

Tuotteet valmistetaan asiakkaamme omalla pajalla ja asennetaan heidän asiakkaidensa tiloissa. Työajasta yli puolet ollaan vaihtuvissa kohteissa eri puolilla Suomea.

Reippaalle tekijälle on tarjolla vakituinen työpaikka oikein kilpailukykyisellä palkalla (n. 20-25 €/h) ja hyvillä eduilla.

Valittu tekijä työllistyy suoraan asiakkaamme kirjoille.

Hakijoilta toivomme:

  • vahvaa osaamista putkihitsauksesta ja kirkkaista materiaaleista
  • joustavaa ja tekevää asennetta sekä
  • reissuvalmiutta.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, valitse seuraavista sinulle sopivin lähestymistapa:

  • Hae paikkaa linkin kautta .
  • Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: teemu.aalto@apuvoima.com.
  • Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä Teemuun soittamalla, viestillä tai WhatsAppilla numeroon 050 525 4627.

APUVOIMA ON REKRYTOINNIN AMMATTILAINEN

Yhdistämme osaavat tekijät ja työnantajat eri aloilla ympäri Suomen.

Tarjoamme monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin – olitpa sitten etsimässä seuraavaa askelta urallasi tai joustavaa työtä muun arjen rinnalle.

Meille on tärkeää, että työnteko on sujuvaa ja mutkatonta.

Meillä arki toimii ja Apuvoima on lähellä silloin kun sitä tarvitset.

title: Operations Executive (JSY)
description:
About DHL Blue Dart Express India:

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.

Position Overview:

The Service Centre Incharge – Operations (Non Metro / BDO) is responsible for managing end-to-end operational activities across one or more assigned Non Metro Branches, Business Development Offices (BDOs) or Service Centres. The role oversees inbound and outbound shipment processing, pickup and delivery coordination, customer service support, manpower deployment and operational governance to ensure seamless day-to-day operations.

Reporting to the Assistant Manager – Operations (Area Operations), the incumbent provides frontline leadership to operational teams, ensuring adherence to service commitments, operational productivity, safety, compliance and Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures while delivering consistent customer experience and supporting business continuity across the assigned locations.

Job Purpose:

To lead and manage end-to-end shift operations across assigned Non Metro Branches and BDO locations by ensuring efficient shipment processing, timely pickups and dispatches, optimal workforce utilisation, operational discipline and consistent service delivery while maintaining safety, compliance and customer satisfaction.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

End-to-End Shift Operations

  • Lead and supervise all inbound, outbound, pickup and dispatch activities during the assigned shift.

  • Ensure timely receipt, processing, sorting, scanning, loading and dispatch of shipments in line with operational timelines.

  • Monitor operational workflow across assigned BDOs and Service Centres to ensure seamless shipment movement.

  • Ensure operational readiness to manage daily volumes, peak periods and contingency situations.

Shipment Processing & Service Quality

  • Ensure accurate scanning, sorting, bagging, routing and reconciliation of all shipments.

  • Minimise shipment exceptions, operational delays and service failures through proactive monitoring.

  • Ensure adherence to network cut-off timelines and service commitments.

  • Escalate damaged, short, discrepant or delayed shipments promptly and ensure timely resolution.

Pickup & Delivery Operations

  • Coordinate daily pickup and delivery activities to achieve defined service levels.

  • Monitor route readiness and shipment movement to ensure timely customer service.

  • Support resolution of operational issues impacting deliveries and pickups.

  • Coordinate with transport, network and customer service teams to ensure smooth operational execution.

People Leadership & Shift Management

  • Plan and deploy manpower effectively across operational activities and assigned locations.

  • Lead, coach and guide Ops Staff, Senior Ops Staff and Territory Service Representatives during the shift.

  • Conduct daily shift briefings covering operational priorities, safety and productivity expectations.

  • Monitor attendance, punctuality, discipline and workforce productivity while promoting teamwork and accountability.

Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline

  • Ensure adherence to Blue Dart Standard Operating Procedures, operational guidelines and statutory requirements.

  • Promote a safe working environment by ensuring compliance with safety standards and security procedures.

  • Ensure prescribed uniform, identity card and personal protective equipment are used wherever applicable.

  • Maintain high standards of housekeeping, operational discipline and ethical conduct across all assigned locations.

Operational Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor daily operational performance and productivity against defined targets.

  • Ensure timely completion of operational documentation, system updates and shift reports.

  • Conduct effective shift handovers and escalate operational risks or service issues promptly.

  • Support implementation of operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Service, Fleet, Security, Network Operations and Area Operations teams to ensure seamless service delivery.

  • Build effective working relationships across internal teams and operational partners.

  • Support implementation of new operational initiatives, business priorities and process improvements.

  • Act as the primary operational contact for assigned locations during the shift.

Qualifications & Experience:

Education:

  • Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.

Experience:

  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, warehousing, distribution or supply chain operations.

  • Experience in managing end-to-end Service Centre operations, including inbound, outbound, pickup and delivery activities.

  • Proven experience in leading frontline operational teams and coordinating shift operations.

  • Exposure to shipment processing, scanning, sorting, reconciliation, dispatch and customer service operations.

  • Experience working with operational systems, handheld scanners and operational reporting will be an advantage.

Skills & Capabilities:

Technical Skills:

  • End-to-End Shift Operations Management

  • Service Centre Operations

  • Shipment Processing & Dispatch Management

  • Pickup & Delivery Coordination

  • Workforce Planning & Shift Management

  • Productivity & Resource Utilization

  • Operational Reporting & MIS

  • Operational Systems & Scanner Usage

  • Safety & Regulatory Compliance

  • Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

Key Competencies:

  • Operational Leadership

  • Planning & Organising

  • Decision Making

  • Customer Focus

  • Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Problem Solving

  • Accountability & Ownership

  • Communication & Collaboration

  • Integrity & Ethical Conduct

  • Operational Discipline

  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

Key Performance Indicators:

KRAs

KPIs

Operational Performance

Inbound & Outbound SLA adherence; On-time shipment processing; Dispatch timeliness

Service Quality

Shipment accuracy; Scanning compliance; Reduction in shipment exceptions and operational errors

Pickup & Delivery Performance

Pickup & Delivery SLA adherence; Timely vehicle turnaround; Customer service support

Productivity

Shift productivity; Manpower utilization; Resource optimization

Safety & Compliance

SOP adherence; Audit compliance; Safety & security compliance; Housekeeping standards

Operational Governance

Shift reporting accuracy; Timely documentation; Effective shift handover; Timely escalation of operational issues

People Leadership

Team productivity; Coaching & capability development; Attendance & workforce discipline

Continuous Improvement

Participation in process improvement initiatives; Productivity and service enhancement

Why join DHL Blue Dart?

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

Here’s what makes us stand out:

  • Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well-being.

  • Competitive pay and performance-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.

  • Structured learning, global exposure, and on-the-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.

  • Best-in-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.

  • A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.

  • Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220+ countries and territories.

  • The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

title: Junior Data Scientist
location: Jakarta, Jakarta, Indonesia; Kuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description:
We are looking for our future Junior Data Scientist to join our team in Jakarta or Kuala Lumpur and kick-start an exciting journey in Data & AI, working on high-impact projects for local and international clients.

Who Are We?

Artefact is a new-generation consulting firm fully dedicated to Data and AI transformation. With more than 2,000 talents across 24 countries, we help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to accelerate business performance.

Our mission? To transform data into measurable business impact.

We work across the entire data value chain, including:

  • Automating critical business processes through AI

  • Optimizing and personalizing customer experiences

  • Data strategy & digital marketing

  • Media activation, measurement & advanced analytics

  • Building and deploying robust and scalable data solutions

Our expertise is trusted by more than 1,000 clients worldwide, including AccorHotels, Orange, Carrefour, Engie, Emirates, Deutsche Telekom, Monoprix, and many more.

To support our continued growth in Southeast Asia, our Jakarta and Kuala Lumpur offices are looking for curious and motivated Junior Data Scientists who are eager to learn, grow, and develop alongside an experienced team.

Our Mission

At Artefact, our mission is to help organizations become AI champions by unlocking the full value of their data.

We believe in a unique approach that combines business expertise, cutting-edge technology, and responsible AI practices. We strive to create an environment where continuous learning, initiative, collaboration, and knowledge sharing drive our collective success.

Your Role

As a Junior Data Scientist, you will join a supportive yet challenging environment where experienced team members will help you develop your technical and consulting capabilities.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Collecting, cleaning, and preparing datasets required for analytical and Data Science projects.

  • Conducting exploratory data analysis and developing visualizations to identify trends, patterns, and insights.

  • Implementing and testing Machine Learning models under the guidance of Senior Data Scientists.

  • Supporting feature engineering and variable selection in collaboration with the wider project team.

  • Preparing concise reports and presentations to communicate findings and results to internal teams and clients.

  • Properly documenting scripts, models, methodologies, and data pipelines.

  • Keeping up to date with emerging Data Science methodologies, technologies, and tools.

  • Collaborating with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Analysts, and Consultants to deliver data-driven solutions that create measurable business impact.

To show that you have read this job posting carefully, please include the word "curiosity" in your application.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another relevant quantitative field. Final-year students may also be considered.

  • 1–2 years of experience in Data Science. Relevant internships, academic projects, research, or practical Data Science experience will also be considered.

  • Solid foundation in Python, including libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and matplotlib.

  • Understanding of fundamental Machine Learning algorithms, including regression, classification, and clustering.

  • Basic understanding of descriptive and inferential statistics.

  • Intermediate SQL skills, including queries, joins, and aggregations.

  • Familiarity with Git and notebook environments such as Jupyter or Google Colab.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Curiosity, attention to detail, and a genuine desire to learn and grow in a challenging environment.

  • Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

  • Comfortable working in an international and fast-paced consulting environment.

Why Join Us?

Joining Artefact in Jakarta or Kuala Lumpur means much more than just starting a new job. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Kick-start and accelerate your career at a fast-growing global Data & AI consulting company.

  • Learn directly from and be mentored by experienced Data Science and AI professionals.

  • Work on real-world, high-impact Data & AI projects.

  • Gain exposure to a wide variety of industries, business challenges, and technologies.

  • Grow quickly in an international, agile, and intellectually stimulating environment.

  • Collaborate with colleagues and experts across Artefact's global network.

  • Create tangible business impact for clients across industries such as financial services, telecommunications, retail, consumer goods, technology, and energy.

What We Offer

  • A full-time position based in Jakarta, Indonesia or Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

  • Opportunities to work on high-impact projects for leading local, regional, and international clients.

  • Access to Artefact's learning and development ecosystem, including MOOCs, internal knowledge-sharing sessions, technical training, certifications, and mentoring.

  • Exposure to a global network of Data, AI, and consulting professionals.

  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial, and fast-growing working environment.

  • Opportunities for accelerated career development based on performance and capabilities.

Our Recruitment Process

1. Initial HR Discussion
A phone or video conversation to learn more about your background, experience, projects, and motivations, while giving you the opportunity to learn more about Artefact and the role.

2. Technical Challenge
A practical Data Science exercise designed to understand how you approach data, solve problems, and structure your analysis.

3. Manager Interview & Meet the Team
You will meet your potential manager and members of the team to discuss your technical experience, problem-solving approach, and how you could contribute to Artefact.

4. Offer
If everything goes well, we will proceed with an employment offer.

📩 Ready to join the adventure? Click Apply and start your journey with Artefact!

P.S. We hire people, not just profiles. Be yourself and show us what makes you unique!

title: 💚 Myyjiä (6–15h/vko) – EUROSPAR Järvenpää
description:
Haemme Järvenpään EUROSPAR-myymälään reippaita myyjiä vakituisiin 6–15h/vko työsuhteeseen!

Ruokakaupassa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen ja juuri siksi työ onkin niin monipuolista! Päiväsi rytmittyvät saapuvien kuormien, hyllyjen ja esillepanojen sekä sujuvan asiakaspalvelun ympärille. Tässä työssä pääset tekemään näkyvää jälkeä joka päivä. Reipas ote, valmius fyysiseen tekemiseen ja halu oppia vievät pitkälle.

EUROSPARissa rakennamme yhdessä myymälää, jossa hyvä asiakaskokemus syntyy tuoreudesta, sujuvasta tekemisestä ja siitä, että jokainen tekee oman osansa. Meillä tehdään töitä hyvällä fiiliksellä, toisiamme tukien ja yhdessä onnistuen.

• Asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälän eri osastoilla
• Kuormien vastaanottoa, purkua ja hyllytystä
• Hevi-, leipä- ja muiden osastojen tuotteiden esillelaittoa
• Päiväysvalvontaa ja tuotteiden laadusta huolehtimista
• Myymälän siisteyden, saatavuuden ja toimivuuden varmistamista

✨ Menestyt tässä työssä, jos:

• Nautit vauhdikkaasta ja fyysisestä työstä
• Tartut toimeen ripeästi ja oma-aloitteisesti
• Haluat oppia uutta ja kehittyä
• Sinulla on hyvä asiakaspalveluasenne
• Tykkäät tehdä töitä osana tiimiä

Aiempi kokemus kaupasta tai tuoreruoasta on plussaa, mutta tärkeintä on oikea asenne, hyvä energia ja halu oppia!

Työskentelemme asiakkaiden arjessa joka päivä, joten toivomme sinulta iloista palveluasennetta, reipasta työotetta ja halua olla hyvä työkaveri. Työ on vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä, myös iltaisin, viikonloppuisin ja juhlapyhinä.

📩 Innostuitko ajatuksesta omannäköisestä urapolusta Tokmannilla ja EUROSPARissa?

Haluamme kuulla sinusta pian lisää! Haethan tehtävää viimeistään 25.08.2026. Täytämme tehtävät heti sopivien työkavereiden löydyttyä.

Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.

title: Lääkäri osastotyöhön - Sastamala, Pirkanmaa
description:
Hei yleislääkäri, tule osaksi Solon kaveriporukkaa!

Etsimme Pirkanmaalle Sastamalan kampussairaalaan osastotyöhön yleislääkäriä ajalle 19.–31.8.2026.

Työyksikkö ja työtehtävät
Sastamalan kampussairaalan osasto on perustason osasto, tarkempi sijoitus tarkentuu lähempänä. Potilastietojärjestelmänä OMNI360.

Edellytämme sinulta
- Yleislääkärin pätevyyttä
- Vähintään vuoden työkokemusta valmistumisen jälkeen
- Tartuntatautilain 48§ mukaista rokotussuojaa
- Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa

Työaika ja korvaus
Työaika on arkisin ma–pe klo 8–15.30, työ ei sisällä päivystysvelvoitetta. Kokonaiskorvaus määräytyy kokemuksesi perusteella.

Miksi tämä on loistava tilaisuus?
ePassi etu 400 €/vuosi – Käytettävissä liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointipalveluihin (työsuhteissa, jotka kestävät vähintään 60 työvuoroa)
Työterveys – Hyvinvointiasi tukevat työterveyspalvelut
Vahva tuki ja yhteisö – Et jää yksin! Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, vastuulääkärien tuen sekä kannustavan ja osaavan työyhteisön ympärillesi
Hyvä ja motivoiva palkka – Panostamme reiluun ja motivoivaan palkkaukseen
Mahdollisuus kehittyä – Tarjoamme koulutusrahan, joka kasvaa tehtyjen työtuntiesi myötä
Uusia ovia urallesi – Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia

Mikä on Solo Health?
Olemme suomalainen, mutkattomasti toimiva porukka. Meillä hommat etenevät nopeasti ja ilman turhia välikäsiä – yhteyshenkilösi tuntee sinut nimeltä ja vastaa kysymyksiisi selkeästi. Tunnemme sote-alan arjen ja ymmärrämme, että elämässäsi on muutakin kuin työ: välillä haluat tehdä töitä enemmän, joskus vähemmän. Olemme mukana joustavasti silloin, kun sinulle sopii.

Työllistämme lääkäreitä, hoitajia, psykologeja ja sosiaalityöntekijöitä moninaisiin sosiaali- ja terveysalan tehtäviin ympäri Suomen – myös hiljaisessa haussa oleviin työpaikkoihin, joita et löydä muualta. Vuonna 2019 perustettu Solo Health on Suomen nopeimmin kasvava sote-alan toimija. Vuonna 2025 lähes 800 sote-ammattilaista toimi erilaisissa tehtävissä Solon kautta.

Olemme luotettava ja joustava kumppani julkiselle sektorille sekä pienissä palvelukokonaisuuksissa että laajoissa ulkoistuksissa. Panostamme palveluidemme laatuun, vaikuttavuuteen ja henkilöstömme ammattitaitoon.

Ihmiset ovat toimintamme ydin. Tarjoamme säännöllistä koulutusta ja tukea työhyvinvointiin, mistä kertoo poikkeuksellisen korkea henkilöstötyytyväisyytemme (NPS 70). Meillä ammattilaiset viihtyvät ja voivat työskennellä eettisesti sekä laadukkaasti.

Solo Health on terveydenhuollon paras työkaveri, joka tuntee alan haasteet ja pitää huolta ihmisistä.

Kiinnostuitko? Hae viimeistään 7.8.2026

Aluepäällikkö, Jaana Varsamäki
050 560 6978 (myös whatsapp)
jaana.varsamaki@solohealth.fi

title: Bakery Cake Designer (Part Time)
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

Must be 18+

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Bakery Cake Designer

Department: Bakery

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

At Hy-Vee, our bakery department helps customers celebrate life's biggest moments, and our Bakery Cake Designers are at the heart of making those moments special. In this role, you'll use your creativity and decorating skills to bring customer visions to life, from birthday cakes and everyday treats to wedding cakes delivered and set up on site. You'll also serve as a lead for part-time employees and collaborate closely with the bakery team to keep production running smoothly.

If you have a passion for decorating, an eye for detail, and enjoy working with customers to create something memorable, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting every customer with a smile, taking orders at the bakery counter, and assisting them with their needs throughout the store

  • Check orders for the day, set up a timeline and production schedule, and check cake orders daily for details including size, deco pack, icing needs, and dates

  • Decorate bakery items in a timely manner, keeping current on new designs and trends

  • Develop daily bakery orders for bakers including cakes and sizes needed

  • Track daily retail production and identify tasks to be completed with co-workers

  • Check product dates, pull cases for work, and list items to fill or replace

  • Order supplies for the decorating area and check off the order upon receipt

  • Deliver product and set up wedding cakes on site outside the store

  • Communicate with the Bakery Manager daily regarding displays, weekly ads, and special needs

  • Operate as a lead with part-time and other employees by instructing and reviewing their work

  • Participate in employee cross-training

  • Practice proper sanitation procedures and keep the work area clean, neat, and safe at all times

  • Answer the phone promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers who call, including taking product orders

  • Follow Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all department and company guidelines

  • Pitch in with other tasks or special projects as they come up

Your Skills

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be able to:

  • Bring commitment to Hy-Vee's mission and a genuine passion for delivering an outstanding customer experience

  • Apply strong decorating skills and stay current on cake design trends and techniques

  • Solve practical problems and follow instructions carefully in a fast-paced environment

  • Apply math skills including fractions, decimals, and percentages in day-to-day tasks

  • Lead and guide part-time employees, providing instruction and reviewing their work

  • Communicate clearly with customers, co-workers, and the Bakery Manager

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Perishables, Store Operations, Health Wellness Home; Bakery Department Manager

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent experience

  • Six months or less of similar or related work experience; we'll provide all the training you need to succeed

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

​

Working Environment

This is a fast-moving role with significant pressure to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities. You'll work in the bakery department and can expect exposure to flour dust, noise, temperature extremes, cleaning chemicals and solvents, and residual fumes. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Grocery Associate - Oulu
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Calling all team-players - are you looking for a flexible role that could shape the future of retail? If so, then let’s talk!

We are looking for part-time 15h/week Grocery Associates fixed-term contract 6 months to join our Wolt Market team in Oulu! 🤩

What you’ll be doing

  • Taking in orders through our Merchant app
  • Picking and packing groceries, and handing them to customers and courier partners
  • Unloading food and supplies that we receive from vendors
  • Managing our internal systems which include precise information about nutrients and allergens
  • Maintaining order and cleanliness of the store

Our humble expectations

  • You are proactive and a fast learner with the ability to multitask
  • Flexibility with working in shifts in the mornings and evenings, including weekends and holidays.
  • You have professional working proficiency in English.
  • Experience from working in a grocery store is a plus!
  • You have the right to work in Finland.

What we can offer

  • Wolt credits cashback benefit
  • Occupational healthcare

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an on-going basis, so send through your application along with your CV as soon as possible! 💙

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Genopslag. Cellolærer til Middelfart Musikskole
description:
Middelfart Musikskole søger en cellolærer med relevant uddannelse og erfaring til en 22% stilling med tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt.
Vi oplever, at vores elevgruppe bliver stadig yngre, og stillingen forudsætter derfor kompetencer og interesse for undervisning af børn helt ned til ca. 6-års-alderen.

Stillingen indeholder:
  • Soloundervisning i cello
  • Fast ugentligt stryger-sammenspilshold
  • Skolehold i Brenderup
  • Timer til ad hoc-projekter
Sammenspilsholdene afvikles i samarbejde med gode kolleger, og strygerfaggruppen arbejder løbende med egne faste projekter, som du bliver en del af. På sigt kan stillingen også indeholde talentelever.

Undervisningen er pt. skemalagt torsdage i Brenderup (skolehold), Baaring (elever fra den østlige del af kommunen) og Middelfart by (sammenspilshold, stryger-sammenspil og elever). Det er derfor en fordel, at ansøger har bil.

Om dig

Vi forventer, at du:
  • har relevant uddannelse, fx konservatorie- eller tilsvarende baggrund
  • har gode pædagogiske kompetencer og lyst til at undervise børn og unge
  • kan undervise elever fra ca. 6 år og opefter
  • har interesse for sammenspil og projektarbejde
  • trives med samarbejde og faglig sparring i en mindre faggruppe

Om Middelfart Musikskole

Middelfart Musikskole er beliggende i den gamle bydel i Middelfart. Skolen er derudover decentral med undervisning på 14 af kommunens folkeskoler.
Vi har ca. 400 elever og 22 engagerede undervisere, som arbejder tæt sammen om skolens udvikling, fælles elever og mange tværgående projekter. Du bliver en del af strygerfaggruppen, som aktuelt består af to lærere.

Skolen er kendetegnet ved et højt aktivitetsniveau med årligt tilbagevendende projekter, talentlinje, et tæt samarbejde med folkeskolerne og en fasttømret sammenspilstradition.

Vi har fokus på at tilbyde vores elever en rød tråd i deres musikalske udvikling med sammenspil, projektforløb og deltagelse i skolens mange aktiviteter, herunder projekter, musical og koncerter. Samtidig arbejder vi løbende med undervisningsformer, hvor fællesskab og samarbejde har en fremtrædende plads.

Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med god sammenhængskraft og høj medarbejdertrivsel, hvor det kollegiale fællesskab prioriteres højt, og hvor der er mulighed for – i dialog med ledelsen – at være med til at forme egen stilling over tid.

Ansættelsesvilkår
  • Tiltrædelse: 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt
  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst
  • Straffe- og børneattest indhentes ved ansættelse
  • Aften- og weekendarbejde må påregnes (koncerter, projekter m.m.)
  • To årlige pædagogiske dage og syv lærerrådsmøder (fredage)
  • Pålagte opgaver skemalægges inden normperioden

Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfrist: torsdag d. 13. august 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført tirsdag d. 18. august eller torsdag d. 20. august

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes elektronisk via link på denne side.

Yderligere oplysninger fås ved henvendelse til musikskoleleder Morten Andersen, tlf. 29 40 17 83.

Bliv en del af vores engagerede team og vær med til at gøre en forskel!
Middelfart Kommune vil gerne kendes for en attraktiv og fleksibel arbejdsplads med et sundt arbejdsmiljø, god ledelse og mange muligheder for udvikling. Med afsæt i vores livsfasepolitik vil vi gøre vores for at imødekomme dine ønsker og behov. Vi er en kommune, hvor der ikke er langt fra ide til handling. Du kan læse mere om vores arbejdsplads på
