title: CEO Office - AI Neobank App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for strong operators to join the CEO Office for BJAK's AI Neobank app expansion.

This role is for someone who can help turn CEO priorities into execution across product, hiring, licensing, partnerships, market launch and daily operating rhythm.

What You'll Own

  • Drive CEO-level priorities from problem definition to execution. 

  • Track OKRs, decisions, blockers, owners and deadlines across teams. 

  • Support licensing applications, country expansion, hiring, partnerships and strategic projects. 

  • Prepare clear briefs, updates, research notes, meeting follow-ups and action trackers.

  • Work across product, engineering, finance, legal, compliance, operations and country teams. 

  • Identify execution gaps and push teams to close them. 

  • Own urgent business problems that do not fit neatly into one department.


What We're Looking For 

  • High-ownership business generalist with strong execution discipline. 

  • Clear writer, structured thinker and strong follow-through operator. 

  • Able to work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. 

  • Comfortable handling ambiguity, urgent problems and shifting priorities. 

  • Strong judgement on what matters, what is blocked and what needs escalation. 

  • Able to keep teams moving without creating unnecessary process. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, operations, strategy, fintech or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Turns unclear priorities into clear actions. 

  • Can chase, unblock and execute without being chased. 

  • Writes updates that make decisions easier. 

  • Stays calm when many things are moving at once. 

  • Cares about outcomes more than visibility.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings. 

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Ireland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Ireland.


Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Butikschef till Charlottenberg
description:
Brinner du för försäljning samtidigt som du älskar att leda ditt team till att nå sina mål och känna motivation på jobbet? Älskar du dessutom skönhet och att ge dina kunder magisk service och rådgivning? Härligt! Läs då vidare då vi kan ha drömjobbet för dig. Nu söker vi nämligen en butikschef till vår butik i Charlottenberg! 💄 En gränshandelsbutik där beauty inte känner några gränser – bara möjligheter!

Vad du kommer att fokusera på
Som Butikschef på Lyko är det inte bara resultat i siffror som räknas. Förvisso arbetar du för att butiken ska nå sina mål och nyckeltal, men vi är otroligt måna om våra fantastiska medarbetare och lägger stor vikt vid att du i rollen som ledare drivs av att ge varje enskild individ möjligheten att ta ansvar och utvecklas!

Som butikschef kommer du utöver detta även arbeta med att:

  • Arbeta aktivt med försäljning och vara kundens personliga rådgivare och skönhetsexpert.
  • Ansvara för att butiken är rätt bemannad genom att lägga schema och rekrytera nya medarbetare vid behov.
  • Ha full koll på våra kampanjer och se till att skyltning såväl som merchandising är spot on.

Vi arbetar enligt “Let´s WOW! The Lyko Way" i mötet med våra kunder, något du också utbildar dina medarbetare i. Här är det extra viktigt att du är en förebild och en sann ambassadör som lever våra värderingar fullt ut. Vi uppmanar nytänkande och är säkra på att du har en hel rad spännande idéer som kan bidra till att förbättra butiken. Vill du bolla idéer så finns vår superhärliga Butikschefsgrupp, en plattform där kunniga och drivna butikschefskollegor delar med sig av både erfarenhet, kunskap och idéer.

Vem du är
För att trivas i den här rollen tror vi att du är en engagerad energispridare som brinner för ledarskap och försäljning. Dessutom fullkomligt älskar du allt som rör skönhet och trivs som bäst när du får dela med dig av din kunskap ✨

Bakgrund/skills du behöver ha:

  • Du är erfaren ledare och har erfarenhet av butiksdrift
  • Genuint intresse av att coacha dina medarbetare och finner glädje i att se andra utvecklas.
  • Strukturerad och bra på att hantera olika arbetsuppgifter parallellt.
  • Prestigelös och jobbar gärna såväl högt som lågt med allt från att planera bemanningen till att hänga upp skyltar i butiken.
  • Förmåga att på ett rakt och tydligt sätt kommunicera ditt budskap.
  • Van vid att arbeta mot uppsatta mål och bekväm med att regelbundet följa upp dessa tillsammans med dina medarbetare.

Dessutom är det ett plus i kanten om du tidigare har:

  • Kunskap om detaljhandelsavtalet och/eller frisörsavtalet.
  • Byggt kampanjer eller har visual merchandiser erfarenhet.

Övrig information
Tillträde: enligt överenskommelse
Anställningsgrad: heltid.
Anställningsform: en tillsvidaretjänst med sex månaders provanställning
Lön: Fast månadslön + bonus. Vi har kollektivavtal med Handelsanställdas Förbund

Lyko är en energifylld och varm arbetsplats som har utsetts till en av Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare. Vill du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta på Lyko? – besök våra karriärsidor.

Är du norsk medborgare?
Om du är norsk medborgare och söker arbete hos oss i Sverige, är du varmt välkommen att söka. För att allt ska fungera smidigt med lön, skatt, pension och försäkringar finns några saker som är viktiga att känna till – och att sätta igång i tid.

För att arbeta och få lön i Sverige behöver du:

✅ Samordningsnummer (krav)

✅ Svenskt bankkonto (krav)

➕ Svenskt skattebeslut (SINK) – rekommenderas (25% skatt)

Vi rekommenderar att du påbörjar ansökan om samordningsnummer och svenskt bankkonto redan när du skickar din ansökan. Handläggningstiden kan vara upp till 2 månader, så sätt igång processen i god tid så att allt är klart OM du får anställning. Det kostar inget att ansöka och innebär ingen ekonomisk risk.

Sök snabbt och enkelt utan CV eller personligt brev!
På Lyko tror vi att vem du är och vad du har för förmågor är viktigare än din tidigare erfarenhet. Därför har vi skrotat kravet på CV och personligt brev och använder oss i stället av urvalsfrågor och tester när vi rekryterar. Vi hoppas att det ger dig en bättre möjlighet att visa vad du går för inom de områden som är viktiga för oss och vet att det även ger objektivare, schystare och mer rättvisa rekryteringar! ⭐

Så vad väntar du på?! Om det här låter som rätt utmaning för dig, ansök redan idag men senast 31 augusti 2026. Vid frågor om tjänsten kontakta Jonas Wennberg på jonas.wennberg@lyko.com. Urval sker löpande!

Psst! Eftersom vi inte vill att några personuppgifter ska riskera att hamna på vift så tar vi inte emot ansökningar via mail utan ansöker gör du enkelt genom att klicka dig vidare nedan. Lycka till!

title: Shift Lead Taco Bell Seinäjoki, Restel
description:
Haluatko vastuuta ja vauhtia samaan pakettiin, ripauksella Live Más -asennetta? Taco Bell Seinäjoki etsii Shift Leadia, jolla pysyy vuoro kasassa ja tiimi liikkeessä kiireessäkin.Tässä roolissa johdat tekemistä, varmistat sujuvan arjen ja pidät asiakaskokemuksen hyvänä paineenkin alla.Saat vaihtelevat päivät, selkeät pelisäännöt ja aidon mahdollisuuden kasvaa esihenkilöuralla kansainvälisessä brändissä. Hae ja testaa, oletko valmis ottamaan vuoron haltuun!

Haluatko duunin, jossa vedät vuoroa, pidät fiiliksen korkealla ja varmistat, että laatu pysyy kasassa myös kovassa vauhdissa?

Taco Bell Seinäjoki etsii Shift Leadia tiimiin. Tarjolla 63-90 h / 3 vko, ja työsuhde on vakituinen. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan, ja vuoroja on ravintolan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti arjesta viikonloppuun, myös iltaisin.

Työssäsi johdat vuoroa käytännössä. Ohjaat tiimiä, pidät tekemisen rytmin kasassa ja varmistat, että asiakkaat saavat laadukkaat tacot ja muut tuotteet nopeasti myös silloin, kun ravintola käy kuumana. Olet mukana tekemisessä tiimin kanssa, mutta samalla vastaat siitä, että kokonaisuus toimii.

Meillä arki rullaa Live Más -asenteella. Se tarkoittaa, että tehdään täysillä, pidetään tempo yllä ja tuetaan toisiamme. Vuoropäällikkönä vaikutat tähän suoraan omalla tekemiselläsi: varmistat, että vuoro toimii, tiimi tietää mitä tekee ja hyvä fiilis pysyy mukana myös kiireessä.

Tässä roolissa ei riitä, että hoidat oman tonttisi hyvin. Sinun pitää pystyä johtamaan muita.

Tässä työssä pärjäät, kun:

- uskallat ottaa tilaa ja johtaa tiimiä arjen tilanteissa
- kommunikoit selkeästi ja sujuvasti sekä tiimin että asiakkaiden kanssa
- annat palautetta rakentavasti ja puutut tilanteisiin tarvittaessa
- teet päätöksiä etkä jää odottamaan valmiita ratkaisuja
- pidät kiinni pelisäännöistä ja varmistat, että muutkin toimivat niiden mukaan
- pysyt rauhallisena kiireessä ja hahmotat kokonaisuuden
Toivomme, että sinulla on jo kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta, ja pikaruokaravintola-alan kokemus on eduksi. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen, jossa pääset harjoittelemaan käytännössä niin esihenkilötyötä kuin konseptia. Kommunikoit sujuvasti suomeksi tai englanniksi; arjessa pärjäät, kun pystyt hoitamaan vuoron perusjutut molemmilla kielillä. Palkkaus määräytyy matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevan esimiesten työehtosopimuksen mukaan.

Jos tekeminen lähtee rullaamaan ja kiinnostusta löytyy, sinulla on mahdollisuus edetä esimerkiksi apulaisravintolapäälliköksi.

Hae ja testaa, oletko valmis ottamaan vuoron haltuun Live Más -asenteella.

Barona toimii rekrytoinnin yhteistyökumppanina, ja työllistyt Restel Mexican Food Oy:n palvelukseen.

Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. Täytät profiilisi vain kerran, minkä jälkeen voit hakea kaikkia Baronan työpaikkoja samalla profiililla. Suosittelemme sinulle sopivia työpaikkoja työkokemuksesi, koulutustaustasi ja taitojesi perusteella. Barona Careers tekee työnhaustasi helpompaa kuin koskaan!

Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (L5) - Core trading
description:
About Us

OpenFX is on a mission to move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems. We are building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of cross-border payment systems for institutions. The team's execution has been exceptional, and we're scaling at a remarkable pace. Our stellar early team comes with experience in companies like J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, FalconX, Paypal, Affirm, Polygon, Kraken, Nium & others. We're backed by Accel, Lightspeed, NfX and other top-tier investors.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to own the architecture of OpenFX's trading and hedging core — the systems that price a client's trade, execute it, and manage the risk we take on as a result.

Two teams sit inside this scope:

  • Trading owns the client's entire trade experience — quote generation, pricing strategy, the spread engine, and the trade lifecycle across GUI, API, and soon conversational AI. Its north star is Total Payment Volume, with Gross Revenue as the control metric.
  • Hedging owns inventory and exposure management, risk management, hedging across venues through smart routing, market making, and WAC / PnL / net revenue calculation.

You will be the senior-most individual contributor across both, responsible for the Client Trading Engine, Pricing Engine, Risk Management Engine, and Smart Hedging. This is a hands-on role. You will write code, set architectural direction, and be the person the organisation trusts to get the trade and risk path right.

The problems here are genuinely hard and often under-defined. You'll take large architectural bets in a domain where correctness is measured in real money and latency is measured on a live client trade.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture of the Client Trading Engine, Pricing Engine, Risk Management Engine, and Smart Hedging.
  • Break complex, ambiguous systems into smaller components with clear contracts, clear scope, and independent deliverability.
  • Set and drive the architectural vision for trading and hedging, and take large architectural bets through to completion.
  • Build for scale — design systems that hold up as volume, venues, and currency corridors grow.
  • Own the observability standard across all components, so the behaviour of the trade and risk path is legible when it matters.
  • Design meaningful alerting, fallback, and recovery strategies across systems.
  • Coach and mentor engineers on the team, and raise the technical bar through design reviews and feedback.
  • Partner with product, risk, and the two pod EMs to connect architectural decisions to TPV, gross revenue, and net revenue outcomes.

What we are looking for

Must-haves:

  • 7–12 years of experience building and operating production backend systems.
  • Deep experience with distributed systems — consistency, failure modes, and the trade-offs between them.
  • Experience building orchestrators and complex, long-running workflows that must be durable and recoverable.
  • Strong command of databases at scale — sharding, multi-region deployments, and the data protection constraints that shape them.
  • Track record on high-scale systems, including the observability and operational tooling that keeps them healthy.
  • Comfort with abstract, ambiguous problems — you're the person who turns a vague mandate into scoped, sequenced deliverables.
  • Hands-on. You still write code, and your architectural judgment comes from building.
  • Heavy AI user. You use AI coding tools with real technique and get materially more done because of it.
  • Influential and collaborative. You set direction by inspiring and persuading people, not by relying on authority.
  • Data-driven, and you operate with high agency — you find the important problem and go solve it.

What helps you stand out:

  • Background in fintech, trading, or cryptocurrencies.
  • Experience handling financial data — pricing, positions, PnL, or market data.
  • Experience with pricing, spread, or hedging systems specifically.
  • Experience with market microstructure or multi-venue execution and smart order routing.

What Success Looks Like

  • The trading and hedging systems you own are correct, observable, and resilient — failures are contained, detected early, and recoverable.
  • Architectural decisions hold up without fundamental rework within 12 to 18 months.
  • Engineers across both pods ship faster because of the abstractions, tooling, and standards you've built.
  • Systemic risks are anticipated and addressed before they become incidents or PnL surprises.
  • You've raised the technical ceiling of trading and hedging engineering at OpenFX, not just delivered individual projects.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Equity in a rapidly growing company.
  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced startup at the forefront of fintech innovation.
  • Opportunity to make a significant impact on global financial infrastructure.
  • Collaborative work culture with emphasis on personal and professional growth.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Technical Advisor (STA), Health Systems Strengthening and Demand Planning - Dar Es Salaam
description:
Job Summary:

The Senior Technical Advisor (STA), Systems Strengthening and Demand Planning, provides technical and operational leadership for supply chain activities aimed at strengthening national demand planning, forecasting, and supply planning systems across HIV/AIDS, TB, MNCH, NTDs, and essential medicines. The role oversees technical staff and project implementation, ensuring alignment with work plans, budgets, and donor requirements. The STA leads the development of supply chain best practices, supports project reporting and knowledge dissemination, and collaborates closely with the Ministry of Health and other stakeholders to build sustainable capacity and institutionalize evidence-based forecasting and supply planning practices.

Accountabilities:

Technical Requirements:

  • Experience working on problems of a complex scope that requires evaluation of variable factors.
  • Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining solutions, with little supervision.
  • Networks with key internal and external personnel in the supply chain ecosystem.
  • Provides input to senior technical leadership on national guidelines and normative policies for supply chain activities.
  • Interprets findings and makes recommendations for improvements.
  • Planning, Implementation and monitoring of project activities.
  • Leads the development of the national demand creation, forecasting and supply planning activities across health programs within the given budgets.
  • Oversees all day to day technical and operational elements of demand planning & quantification activities.
  • Coordinates with technical and programmatic staff members to ensure that activities are performed as per award requirements and consistent with relevant policies.
  • Oversees staff members’ assignments.
  • Provides technical support to MoH, Pharmaceutical Services Unit (PSU), Medical Stores department (MSD), NASHCoP, National Malaria Control Program (NMCT), Reproductive & Child Health (RCH), in conducting national essential medicines quantifications.
  • Oversees the annual work planning and budgeting process for demand planning activities.
  • Strengthens partners’ capacity in commodity budgeting and resource planning to meet the financing need of commodities. Mentors MoH in pipeline analysis and in monitoring in country supply levels.
  • Contributes to planning and making recommendations for project concepts, operations, and/or implementation.
  • Influences design and scope of demand planning related initiatives and programs.
  • Develops strategies and tools for the design and implementation of supply chain components.
  • Ensures technical implementation is consistent with best practices in the industry / subject and meet MoH / funder contractual obligations for moderately complex technical units of demand planning, directing other professional staff members.
  • Stakeholder Engagement, Donor Relations, and Business Development
  • Participating in funder and stakeholder meetings and providing technical input.
  • Developing donor reports and presentations.
  • Representing the project at professional meetings and conferences.
  • Maintaining relationships with donors, government agencies, NGOs, and partners.
  • Providing technical inputs to proposals.
  • Contributing supply chain data and technical information for business development efforts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Applied Knowledge & Skills:

  • Proven ability to lead and manage complex technical projects, establish strategic priorities, and plan for the successful implementation and monitoring of activities within agreed timelines and budgets.
  • Advanced technical expertise in supply chain management, demand planning, forecasting, health systems strengthening, and related disciplines, with strong understanding of interconnected functional areas.
  • Strong understanding of the external operating environment and its impact on public health chains, including political, legal, environmental, financial, and social factors.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the organization’s structure, policies and procedures, and operational practices, and the ability to apply this knowledge to achieve project objectives.
  • Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify risks, and develop practical, evidence-based solutions.
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical information, present findings and recommendations, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, senior leadership, government counterparts, donors, and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence decision making, build consensus, and drive adoption of evidence-based approaches among diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Strong negotiation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to build partnerships and achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to strengthen institutional capacity and mentor technical staff and counterparts in forecasting, demand planning, and supply planning methodologies.
  • Proficiency in the use of supply chain data, analytics, and relevant forecasting and planning tools to support strategic decision-making and continuous improvement.

Problem Solving & Impact:

  • Recognized as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor, providing technical guidance and solutions to complex challenges within their area of specialization.
  • Maintains current knowledge of emerging trends, best practices, innovations, and policy developments relevant to their technical area and applies this knowledge to strengthen program outcomes.
  • Works under broad direction with considerable latitude for independent action.
  • Specific actions are guided primarily by professional standards and expected outcomes of the project.
  • Decisions and recommendations directly influence the quality, effectiveness, and timely delivery of unit and project objectives, with broader implications for organizational performance, stakeholder relationships, and program success.
  • Problems encountered are complex and may involve unprecedented circumstances; resolution requires investigation, analysis, and review of professional/organizational standards.

Supervision Given/Received:

  • Supervises Senior level staff members.
  • Work is reviewed in terms of meeting the organization’s objectives and schedules.
  • Accomplish results through managers or senior members of a team.
  • Manages technical area staff and function area within the organization.
  • Plays a coaching and mentoring role for others; may assist in team management as necessary, although has no formal management responsibility.
  • Typically reports to an Associate Director – Supply Chain.

Education: **

  • Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, Supply Chain management, logistics or related fields.
  • Master’s degree or international equivalent in Public Health, Pharmacy, Laboratory sciences, supply chain management Is preferred.

Experience: **

  • 14+ years of progressively responsible professional experience in public health supply chain management, demand planning, quantification, forecasting, commodity security or a related technical field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading national quantifications for malaria, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis (TB) and maternal, newborn and child health (MNCH).
  • Experience in and knowledge of leading practices related to strategic planning, strategic plan implementation, logistics/supply chain management and/or public health commodities management desirable.
  • Experience working with the Government of Tanzania and other NGOs is preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal English.
  • Ability to prepare and present information related to commodity availability.
  • Ability to coach and mentor public sector stakeholders to develop strategies and manage implementation of projects.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Previous work experience with USG-funded projects is desirable.
  • Proficiency in common computer packages (eg. Word, PowerPoint, Excel) relevant to the work.
  • Ability to work within a team.
  • Ability to travel for extended periods in-country to support technical activities.

Typical Physical Demands:

  • Typical office environment.
  • Ability to spend long hours looking at computer screen and doing repetitive work on a keyboard.
  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time.

Technology to be Used:

  • Personal Computer/Laptop, Microsoft applications (i.e., Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams), cell phone/mobile technology, and standard office equipment.

Travel Requirements:

  • 10% - 25%

How to Apply:

FHI 360 has a competitive compensation package. Interested candidates may apply online by uploading their Application Letter, Curriculum Vitae (CV)/Resume, Photocopies of Certificates and Names and Addresses of three (3) referees

FHI 360 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Closing Date: 21 August 2026. Only short listed candidates will be contacted

The expected hiring salary range for this role is TZS 90,000,000 - 130,000,000 for annual basic salary. When determining an offer amount, FHI 360 factors in multiple considerations, including but not limited to: relevant years of experience and education possessed by the applicant, internal equity, market pay, and budget. For internal candidates, salary placement will also follow FHI 360’s current promotional increase guidelines.


This job posting summarizes the main duties of the job. It neither prescribes nor restricts the exact tasks that may be assigned to carry out these duties. This document should not be construed in any way to represent a contract of employment. Management reserves the right to review and revise this document at any time.


FHI 360 is an equal opportunity employer whereby we do not engage in practices that discriminate against any person employed or seeking employment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.


Our values and commitments to safeguarding: FHI 360 is committed to preventing any type of abuse, exploitation and harassment in our work environments and programs, including sexual abuse, exploitation and harassment. FHI 360 takes steps to safeguard the welfare of everyone who engages with our organization and programs and requires that all personnel, including staff members and volunteers, share this commitment and sign our code of conduct. All offers of employment will be subject to appropriate screening checks, including reference, criminal record and terrorism finance checks. FHI 360 also participates in the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS), facilitated by the Steering Committee for Humanitarian Response. In line with the MDS, we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any substantiated findings of sexual abuse, exploitation and/or harassment during the applicant’s tenure with previous employers. By applying, job applicants confirm their understanding of these recruitment procedures and consent to these screening checks.


FHI 360 will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.


FHI 360 will never ask you for your career site username or password, and we will never request money, goods or services during the application, recruitment or employment process. If you have questions or concerns about correspondence from us, please email CareerCenterSupport@fhi360.org.

title: Lead Fashion Product Handler
description:
About The Role

PHOTO & RECEIVING: The Lead Product Handler is an non-management role, who will help oversee all
support staff in designated areas and act as a liaison between product handlers, inbound and outbound
management.

AUTHENTICATION: The Lead Product Handler is a non-management position, who will help oversee all product handlers and act as a liaison between product handlers and inbound management to ensure product is flowing into Authentication quickly and in date order.

What You Get To Do Everyday

PHOTO/RECEIVING:

  • Lead team of product handlers and support staff to ensure all daily tasks are complete.

  • Conduct daily huddles with the team, flex goals and product pick up category as needed.

  • Work closely with the outbound team and/or management to help ensure flow of inbound consignment and supply is consistent.

  • Assist the manager with monitoring supply levels and adjusting workload based on supply.

  • Oversee end of night closing procedures and send daily recaps.

  • Responsible for keeping the Fashion Product Handling area organized by condensing and organizing consignments in the staging areas.

RECEIVING:

  • Ensure product flow going to copywriting is consistent and filled in a timely manner.

AUTHENTICATION:

  • Lead team of product handlers to ensure all daily tasks are complete and they are staying on task.

  • Conduct daily huddles with the team, flex goals and product flow tasks as needed.

  • Work closely with management to help ensure flow of consignments is consistent in all categories.

  • Oversee end of night closing procedures and send daily recaps.

  • Oversee and support product transfers when needed.

  • Responsible for keeping the queues and product handler area organized by condensing and organizing consignments in the staging areas.

  • Ensure product flow to authenticators is consistent and filled in a timely manner and racks are accurately scanned to the Authenticator’s desk.

  • Ensure all authentication exception items are brought to correlating departments within a timely manner.

  • Ensure completed product is collected and taken to the putaway area to be collected by the Outbound team.

  • Support the Authentication team leads as needed and maintains constant communication.

  • Anticipate the needs of the team so production goals and SLA are met daily.

  • Support other team leads as needed and maintain constant communication.

  • Anticipate the needs of the products of the designated area so production goals and SLA are met daily.

  • Work with assistant managers of product to ensure VIP consignments are executed properly.

What You Bring To The Role

Minimum Requirements:

  • Excellent time management and follow up skills

  • Strong team player with leadership ability

  • Comfortable in fast-paced work environment where multitasking is required

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Ability to do on the spot troubleshooting and problem solving

  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills are a must

title: In-store Mortgage Broker - Figtree

title: Bussförare till Jönköping
description:
Vill du bli en del av vårt glada gäng?

Vi söker dig som önskar en fast anställning på heltid. Som bussförare hos oss har du varierande arbetstider – perfekt för dig som gillar flexibilitet och variation. Du utgår från vår depå i Jönköping, där erfarna gruppledare finns vid din sida och där stämningen är lika varm som kaffet i fikarummet. Det du behöver för att rulla igång är ett D-körkort och giltigt YKB. Vi ser även att du tycker om att leverera god service där du ser till att varje resa blir säker, smidig och trivsam.

Kort om oss

Vy Buss AB driver stadstrafiken i Jönköping för Jönköpings Länstrafik (JLT). Kollektivtrafiken utvecklas med stadens tillväxt, och många centrala busslinjer är elektrifierade med fordon som går på el eller biogas. En expressbusslinje mellan Huskvarna och Jönköping är också tillgänglig. För att stödja expansionen har JLT byggt en bussdepå på Ljungarum, inklusive nya hållplatser och bussar med USB-laddare och hjärtstartare.

Dagliga arbetsuppgifter

  • Få våra resenärer att känna sig så välkomna att de vill ta bussen igen
  • Köra säkert och ansvarsfullt
  • Vara en hjälpande hand, både för dina kollegor och våra resenärer
  • Se till att bussen är i tid –även om vi såklart prioriterar säkerhet i första hand

Vem är du?

  • Du gillar att träffa människor och ser varje möte som en chans att göra någons dag lite ljusare
  • Du har ett giltigt D-körkort och godkänt YKB
  • Du är ansvarsfull, noggrann och kör säkert- som om det vore ditt eget liv på spel
  • Hälsar glatt och ler (även innan kaffet kickat in)
  • Kan hålla tider – eller i alla fall försöker så gott du kan med fokus på säkerhet
  • Kan prata och förstå svenska så att du kan ge information, säga till när något händer och småprata med resenärer när det passar
  • Är flexibel – jobbet har varierande arbetstider, både tidiga morgnar, sena kvällar och helger. Vi planerar i god tid, men du behöver trivas med att dagarna kan se olika ut.
  • Erfarenhet av busskörning är meriterande men inte ett krav

Det här får du av oss

En trivsam arbetsplats med glada kollegor och fräscha lokaler. Vy Buss erbjuder flera förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag, förmånliga försäkringar och rabatter på produkter. Efter en väl anpassad introduktion får du ett arbete med varierande körningar. Tillsammans skapar vi en positiv arbetsmiljö där alla hjälps åt i det dagliga arbetet. Fast lön enligt Bussbranschavtalet. Provanställning tillämpas.

Bra att veta

  • Säkerhet är viktigt för oss! Som en del av vårt säkerhetsarbete genomförs drogtester både vid anställning och slumpvis under anställning. Vi kan även komma att be om ett utdrag från polisens belastningsregister

Känns detta som din nästa hållplats? Tveka inte och skicka in din ansökan snabbast möjligt! Urval sker löpande och ansökning sker enbart via vårt rekryteringssystem.

Kontaktinformation

Linda Petrini, Gruppchef, linda.petrini@vy.se

Arbetsplats

Industrigatan 16

553 02 Jönköping

Viktig information:

Arbetsgivare: Vy Buss AB

Ref.nr: 5161718943

Tjänstens omfattning: 100%

title: Insights Program Manager
description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

The Insights Program Manager sits at the intersection of LinkedIn product expertise, proprietary datasets, and go-to-market strategy. This role combines programme management, analytical problem-solving, and stakeholder leadership to deliver insights and recommendations that help drive customer value, business impact, and scalable solutions across the Talent Solutions organisation.

As an Insights Program Manager, you will lead high-impact initiatives, partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders to transform LinkedIn data into actionable insights, scalable programmes, and measurable business outcomes. You will help identify opportunities, influence business decisions, and drive adoption through data-driven recommendations and strong programme execution.

Responsibilities

Data-Driven Insights Development

  • Leverage LinkedIn's proprietary datasets to design and deliver impactful, scalable insights that support product, customer success, and go-to-market priorities.

  • Write and optimise SQL queries to extract, analyse, and interpret data.

  • Partner with technical and analytics teams to build scalable reporting and insight solutions.

  • Translate complex data into actionable recommendations that drive customer and business outcomes.

Programme Management & Strategic Execution

  • Define and execute programme roadmaps aligned to business priorities, ensuring clear success metrics, stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.

  • Identify gaps in existing tools, programmes, and go-to-market motions, prioritise opportunities, and drive alignment on strategic initiatives across stakeholder groups.

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of programmes, ensuring priorities, timelines, risks, and dependencies are effectively managed.

  • Translate performance data into actionable recommendations on where to scale, optimise, refine, or retire initiatives.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, Product, and Analytics teams to solve business challenges through insights and scalable programmes.

  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and serve as a trusted advisor on programme strategy and business priorities.

  • Drive alignment across multiple teams and influence decision-making without direct authority.

  • Ensure insights, recommendations, and programmes are aligned to customer needs and business objectives.

Visualisation & Business Storytelling

  • Develop compelling reporting, and narratives.

  • Present findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Create executive-ready insights that clearly articulate opportunities, risks, and business impact.

Data Quality & Operational Excellence

  • Implement data quality checks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of reporting and insights.

  • Document best practices, methodologies, and scalable approaches to insight generation and programme execution.

  • Help establish repeatable processes that improve efficiency, adoption, and business impact across teams.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in programme management, consulting, strategy, business operations, analytics, or related fields.

  • 3+ years of experience using SQL to analyse large datasets and generate insights.

  • 3+ years of experience creating data visualisations and translating data into actionable business recommendations.

  • 3 + years experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholder groups.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in Statistics, Data Science, Business, or a related field.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

  • Experience working in Customer Success, Sales Strategy, Operations, Consulting, Analytics, or Go-to-Market organisations.

  • Experience building relationships with senior stakeholders and serving as a trusted advisor.

  • Experience with Python, Tableau, or similar analytical tools.

  • Exccellent problem-solving skills and business acumen.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

Suggest Skills:

  • SQL
  • Program Management
  • Cross functional inativies
  • Data visualisation

title: Security Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Overview

The Cyber Fusion Center (CFC) is seeking a motivated Security Engineer to join the Infrastructure Security team. This role is ideal for Linux Administrators with 1–3 years of hands-on experience who are passionate about cybersecurity and looking to build a career in Infrastructure Security. As part of the Infrastructure Security team, you will support the administration, maintenance, and operation of the critical security platforms that protect the Qualys production environment. Working alongside senior engineers, you will gain hands-on experience with enterprise technologies including Identity & Access Management (IAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Secrets Management, Secure Remote Access, and Infrastructure Automation while building a strong foundation in enterprise Infrastructure Security.


Key Responsibilities


Linux Infrastructure Administration

  • Administer and maintain Linux servers supporting Infrastructure Security platforms.
  • Perform operating system installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management.
  • Monitor system health, availability, capacity, and performance.
  • Perform Linux operating system hardening following enterprise security standards.
  • Manage users, groups, permissions, storage, networking, and system services.
  • Troubleshoot Linux operating system, application, and infrastructure issues.
  • Maintain operational documentation, standard operating procedures, and technical runbooks.


Infrastructure Security Platforms

  • Support the administration and maintenance of Identity & Access Management (IAM) platforms.
  • Assist in managing LDAP/LDAPS authentication services.
  • Support Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) services and certificate lifecycle management.
  • Assist in managing Privileged Access Management (PAM) platforms.
  • Support Secrets Management platforms and secure credential management.
  • Assist in managing secure remote access platforms such as Teleport.
  • Perform routine health checks, upgrades, patching, and maintenance activities for Infrastructure Security platforms.

Automation

  • Develop automation scripts using Bash and Python.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining Ansible playbooks.
  • Support Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives.
  • Automate routine operational and administrative tasks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation.

Production Operations

  • Participate in day-to-day production support activities.
  • Monitor Infrastructure Security services to ensure high availability and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot production incidents and restore services within defined SLAs.
  • Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) activities and implement corrective actions.
  • Support planned maintenance windows, upgrades, and platform lifecycle activities.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call support rotation after completing required training.

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Work closely with senior Infrastructure Security engineers on operational and strategic initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Cloud Operations, DevOps, and Platform teams.
  • Create and maintain operational documentation, deployment guides, and technical runbooks.
  • Follow established security standards, operational procedures, and best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1–3 years of hands-on Linux Administration experience supporting enterprise production environments.
  • Experience administering Linux distributions such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Oracle Linux, Ubuntu, or CentOS.
  • Good understanding of Linux system administration, including user and group management, package management, storage management, networking, system services, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience performing Linux patching, upgrades, and operating system hardening.
  • Basic scripting experience using Bash and/or Python.
  • Good understanding of TCP/IP networking, DNS, SSH, SSL/TLS, and Linux security fundamentals.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong willingness to learn enterprise Infrastructure Security technologies.
  • Willingness to participate in a 24x7 on-call support rotation after completing training.

Preferred Certifications

  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
  • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)
  • CompTIA Linux+
  • CompTIA Security+
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner

What You'll Work On

As part of the Infrastructure Security team, you will contribute to strategic initiatives including:

  • Supporting enterprise Linux infrastructure for critical security platforms.
  • Managing and maintaining Infrastructure Security services across production environments.
  • Learning and supporting enterprise technologies including IAM, PKI, PAM, Secrets Management, Secure Remote Access, and Certificate Management.
  • Building automation to improve operational efficiency and platform reliability.
  • Supporting production operations, platform upgrades, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Working alongside senior engineers on enterprise Infrastructure Security initiatives.
  • Developing the technical expertise required to progress into a Senior Security Engineer within the Infrastructure Security team.

title: Grid Converter Control Engineer
description:
Grid Converter Control Engineer

We are looking for an experienced Grid Converter Control Engineer to support the development, modeling, and validation of advanced converter control solutions for renewable energy and power electronics applications.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and optimize grid-forming and grid-following converter control algorithms.

  • Build and validate converter and grid models in MATLAB/Simulink.

  • Perform stability analysis, transient simulations, and converter-grid interaction studies.

  • Execute real-time validation and HIL testing under various grid disturbance scenarios.

  • Analyze weak-grid challenges and develop solutions to improve stability and robustness.

  • Support system integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and technical documentation

Requirements:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in converter control, power electronics, or grid integration engineering.

  • Strong knowledge of grid-forming (GFM) and grid-following (GFL) control strategies.

  • Experience with grid-connected converters, renewable energy integration, and power system dynamics.

  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink model development, simulation, and control algorithm validation.

  • Experience with real-time testing and HIL/CHIL platforms such as dSPACE, RTDS, Typhoon HIL, or OPAL-RT.

  • Understanding of dq0-based current control, voltage-forming control, PLL systems, harmonic behavior, and weak-grid dynamics.

  • Knowledge of grid-code requirements and converter-grid interaction analysis is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and ability to work with multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluent English communication skills are required.

Offer :

  • Opportunity to work on advanced power electronics and renewable energy technologies.

  • Challenging and innovative engineering projects.

  • Professional development and knowledge-sharing environment.

Why apply for an Antal job offer?

When your application is successful, you will be supported by a dedicated Consultant who will stay in regular contact with you (via email or phone), help you prepare for interviews with your future employer, and ensure a smooth and professional recruitment process.

About Antal

Antal is a leading recruitment and HR advisory company, present in Poland since 1996 and later expanded to the Czech Republic and Hungary. Across the CEE region, we employ around 150 professionals who deliver a full range of services – from specialist and executive recruitment, employee outsourcing and HR consulting, to employer branding and market research.

Our division-based structure combines deep industry expertise with functional specialisation, enabling us to provide tailored solutions for companies in every sector. We act as a trusted partner for both employers and candidates, sharing our knowledge and guiding them through every stage of the talent journey. We connect exceptional people with the right opportunities and help organisations build successful teams.

title: Checker
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

Night & Weekend Shifts Required

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Checker

Department: Grocery

FLSA: Non-Exempt

General Function:

As a cashier you'll be part of a growing innovative brand that prides itself on providing best in class customer service. We are looking for helpful smiles who enjoy working in a fast paced, customer focused environment.

The cashier provides fast and friendly service to customers, assists them with questions and request. Operates a cash register and the duties which correspond. Package product, work with drive-up and/or carry-out. Replenishes product as needed.

Core Competencies:

  • Partnerships
  • Growth mindset
  • Results oriented
  • Customer focused
  • Professionalism

Reporting Relations:

Accountable and Reports to: District Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of GM, Perishables, and Store Operations; Service Managers

Positions that Report to you: None

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provides prompt, efficient and friendly customer service by exhibiting caring, concern and patience in all customer interactions and treating customers as the most important people in the store.
  • Smiles and greets customers in a friendly manner, whether the encounter takes place in the employee’s designated department or elsewhere in the store.
  • Makes an effort to learn customers’ names and to address them by name whenever possible.
  • Assists customers by:
    • escorting them to the products they’re looking for
    • securing products that are out of reach
    • loading or unloading heavy items
    • making note of and passing along customer suggestions or requests
    • performing other tasks in every way possible to enhance the shopping experience.
  • Answers the telephone promptly when called upon and provides friendly, helpful service to customers who call.
  • Works with co-workers as a team to ensure customer satisfaction and a pleasant work environment.
  • Operates cash register accurately and scans product, (where applicable).
  • Redeems promotional coupons, food stamps, WIC checks, issues rain checks, receives cash, checks, completes credit-card charge transactions, in-store charges and figures discounts, as well as, counts back change and issues receipts.
  • Places merchandise in bags or boxes, gives packages to customers, and assists courtesy personnel as needed.
  • Answers customer questions and concerns and follows-up with appropriate personnel.
  • Understands and follows local, state, and company policies on sales of tobacco, liquor, and lottery tickets.
  • Ensures compliance with local, state, and federal guidelines regarding WIC and food stamps.
  • Required to know value, look-up numbers, department numbers, and features of items for which money is received.
  • Stocks, faces, rotates merchandise, cleans shelves, understands shelf tags, knows location of merchandise in the store and also in the back room, and takes customers to an item when requested.
  • Perceives immediate surroundings for customer needs and problems for store safety and security.
  • Communicates clearly and distinctly on the intercom or telephone system.
  • Reviews weekly store ad to note price changes and sale items.
  • Keeps register area clean, ensures adequate supplies are ready and available, reports improper cash levels in cash drawer, and helps maintain the store appearance.
  • Compares totals on cash register with amount of currency in register to verify balances at the beginning and end of work shift, (where applicable).
  • May give cash refunds or issue credit memorandums to customers for returned merchandise or know where to direct the customer.
  • Understands and practices proper sanitation procedures and ensures the work area is always clean and neat.
  • Maintains strict adherence to department and company guidelines related to personal hygiene and dress.
  • Adheres to company policies and individual store guidelines.
  • Reports to work when scheduled and on time.

Secondary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assists store management as required (i.e., store displays, decorations for special promotion/events).
  • Knows code dates on perishable items and can explain to customers.
  • Changes register tape and ribbons as necessary.
  • Assists in other areas of store as needed.
  • Performs other job related duties and special projects as required.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Worker Characteristics:

  • Must be able to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or verbal instructions; deal with a few concrete variables.
  • Must have the ability to do arithmetic calculations involving fractions, decimals, and percentages.
  • Have the ability to understand and follow verbal or demonstrated instructions; write identifying information; request supplies verbally or in writing.

Education and Experience:

title: Senior Transactions Analyst - Retail

title: Founding Research Engineer - Audio Intelligence
description:
This Role

You will set Uplift’s applied research agenda for bringing advanced audio intelligence to regional languages, owning each problem from the first experiment through production.

You will scale Uplift’s R&D capacity by building partnerships with leading university labs and turning promising academic research into production systems.

The problems you tackle will come directly from customers, and success will be measured by real-world impact—not just benchmark scores.

What we do

We build voice models and voice applications for regional languages — Urdu, Bengali, Pashto, Greek, and more — so people around the world can use technology by simply speaking.

We gather our own data, build our own labeling tools, train our own models, and design our own voice infrastructure. This fully integrated approach is what lets us deliver the highest-quality models, and the best developer experience, for regional languages.

Why our work matters

Over 60% of the world's population only speaks a regional language. Today voice models aren’t good enough in their languages.
Large tech companies are unable to give this work tier1 priority because they are busy defending their primary business. In fact, in all big labs regional languages are funded by Marketing/PR budgets.
If UpliftAI doesn’t do its work, a large part of the world may continue to experience significant AI technical lag — further worsening the income divide between countries.

But also, it’s very cool making machine speak soooo well (check out our homepage).

The story of how we started

Hammad left Apple and took a year off to figure out what to do in the next phase of his career. During this time, he started a side project gathering data for Pakistani languages so people could talk to ChatGPT by speaking (this was before they supported voice mode).

To gather this data, he traveled to factories and rural areas in Pakistan. While speaking with business owners there, he learned that many businesses are not using digital tools (like HR software or inventory management) simply because their workforce cannot read or write. (Btw, Pakistan is the 5th most populous country in the world, but 42% of all adults there cannot read).

That is when the idea first emerged: what if everyone could use technology by speaking? Voice interfaces can finally digitizing businesses that currently cannot. This would increase worker productivity — which at scale lifts the entire GDP of developing countries. Globally, 1 billion people cannot read, and voice interfaces will finally give them access to digital services… often for the first time.

What we offer you

  • A mission worthy of being your life’s work.
  • True ownership of work.
  • Top-tier teammates that are ambitious, smart and fun.
  • Top percentile equity and pay that truly value your talent and opportunity cost.

What we expect from you

  • Proof of exceptional talent through past accomplishments. Ask yourself: “What have I done that none of my peers did?”
  • Demonstrated ability to advance the state of AI, even in a small way. This could be through research, open-source work, or a model or system you built.
  • Strong research and engineering ability. You can read papers, design rigorous experiments, train models, and make them fast and reliable enough for production.
  • The ability to move 3× faster than your peers through creative problem-solving.

Who are we

Hammad - CEO: ex Apple, ex Amazon, Cornell alumnus. Previously developed voice technology at Apple Siri and Amazon Alexa for about 9 years.
I created my first website at age 13 to sell wallpapers & software. This was year 2003 before even wordpress existed. It was hosted over dialup from home.
Zaid - CTO: Zaid previously designed and launched an entire AWS service: Bedrock Guardrails. Before that, at Amazon, Zaid wrote a paper on how to optimally plan and pack products in containers to minimize transportation and destination distribution cost in Amazon’s global import supply chain. This work led to $100m/year saving.

Your first 90 days

Below is one possible plan. We expect you to improve it once you understand the problems.

  • First 30 days: Study real customer calls and identify the most valuable audio problems that existing models do not solve. Choose one, build the eval set, and establish the strongest available baseline.
  • First 60 days: Develop a solution that clearly beats the baseline and test it with a real customer. In parallel, launch a research collaboration with a university lab on another important problem.
  • First 90 days: Ship your first new audio capability into production and demonstrate that it improves a real customer outcome—not merely a benchmark. Have at least one university lab actively expanding UpliftAI’s research capacity.

We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best-in-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in.

We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused Associate System Administrator to join our IT Associate Experience team. This role is ideal for an early-career IT professional looking to build expertise in Microsoft 365 technologies, collaboration platforms, and enterprise systems administration. The primary focus of this position is supporting and administering Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Outlook, and SharePoint environments, while also providing occasional support for platforms such as Smartsheet and Airtable. The successful candidate will gain hands-on experience supporting enterprise-level technologies, troubleshooting sophisticated issues, and contributing to ongoing modernization initiatives.

In the role of a Junior System Administrator, you'll develop your technical expertise. You will support critical collaboration and efficiency platforms used across the company. You'll work alongside experienced infrastructure professionals, gain exposure to enterprise-scale environments, and build a solid foundation for future growth within systems administration and cloud technologies.

Location: This is a remote position for candidates located within the Hampton Roads area, with occasional onsite support required in the Newport News, VA office approximately once every 8-12 weeks for maintenance activities, project work, team collaboration, or other business needs.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Team, Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, and SharePoint environments.
  • Support user account administration, mailbox management, distribution groups, shared mailboxes, and Microsoft 365 permissions.
  • Assist with administration and support of hybrid Exchange environments and Microsoft 365 services.
  • Investigate and resolve email delivery, calendar, collaboration, and access-related issues.
  • Provide occasional support for enterprise collaboration tools including Smartsheet and Airtable.
  • Monitor, prioritize, and resolve support requests while maintaining accurate documentation within ticketing systems.
  • Assist with system upgrades, migrations, platform enhancements, and technology rollouts.
  • Support routine system maintenance, backup processes, and operational health checks.
  • Partner with other IT teams to identify root causes and implement long-term solutions.
  • Document procedures, troubleshooting steps, and support knowledge for internal users and IT staff.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and occasional weekend maintenance activities, typically no more than two weekends per year.

Required Qualifications:

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 1-2 years of experience in IT support, systems administration, help desk, or infrastructure support.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, or Exchange Online.
  • Basic understanding of Microsoft Exchange administration and email systems.
  • Familiarity with Active Directory user and group management.
  • Exposure to PowerShell scripting and automation concepts.
  • Good ability to fix, analyze, and solve problems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mentality.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Must reside in the Hampton Roads area and be able to travel periodically to the Newport News office for onsite support.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange environments.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint Online administration and permissions management.
  • Understanding of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and identity management concepts.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or other enterprise ticketing systems.
  • Exposure to Smartsheet, Airtable, or similar low-code/no-code business platforms.
  • Knowledge of ITIL concepts and incident management practices.
  • Experience with phone and contact center technologies such as Genesys or Cisco.
  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Fundamentals, Microsoft 365 Certified, Azure Fundamentals, or related credentials.

title: Software QA Engineer/Intern (AI-Powered)
description:
Finishing your degree and not sure what's next? Turn your CS education into a real engineering career - starting now.

You've spent years studying algorithms, data structures, and software design. You've written code for coursework and side projects. Now you need a way into the industry that actually values what you've learned - without requiring years of experience you don't have yet.

This is that way in. Not manual testing, not "click around and file tickets" - a full-spectrum QA Engineer role where you write real automation code, work in real repositories, go through real code review, and apply the CS fundamentals you already have to a discipline that's still hungry for technical talent. You'll also work with AI daily - for writing code, generating test data, and analyzing requirements - while learning where it gets things wrong, because it will.

What You Need

  • A degree (or final year of study) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

  • JavaScript/Java knowledge at a junior developer level

  • Solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) fundamentals

  • English level B1 or higher

  • 40 hours/week available for training, internship, and the role that follows

  • Based in Baku

Why This Path Makes Sense for CS/Engineering Grads

  • Your coursework in programming, OOP, and problem-solving translates directly - this isn't a career change, it's a launch point

  • A structured, 4-5 month mentoring program that turns academic knowledge into professional engineering skills

  • A real bridge into full-time employment, not a temporary gig

  • AI-first workflow from day one, learning both its power and its limits

What You'll Learn

  • Automation with Playwright/Selenium - real code, real repos, real review

  • API testing, databases, logs, CI/CD pipelines

  • Test design, requirements analysis, exploratory testing of complex business logic

  • Where AI tooling helps in QA - and where it can't be trusted

What Happens After
Successfully complete the program and join our team full-time, working on projects for international clients across eCommerce, Gaming, consumer goods, and other industries.

Who We Are
A leading player in the QA market with 1000+ specialists - many of whom started their careers exactly where you are now: fresh out of a technical degree program, ready to apply what they learned.

Ready to apply? Tell us about your degree/field of study, your programming language experience, and your English level.

title: Junior Sports Quantitative Analyst
description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

In Superbet, the Quant team is responsible for developing the models and tools required for trading a wide range of sports. We aim to provide the best betting experience to our current customers and those we will acquire during our expansion across the globe. This means producing prices for the full range of markets that our customers expect, same-game accumulators, high betting availability, and a great cash out experience.

As a Junior Sports Quantitative Analyst, you’ll work alongside senior quants, traders, and engineers to help research, build, validate, and deploy models and tooling that power our sportsbook. This is a hands-on role that combines mathematics, statistics, programming, and product curiosity. You’ll be supported to develop into an independent model owner over time.

What you’ll be doing

  • Support the development, testing, and maintenance of mathematical and statistical models for core and derivative markets across multiple sports
  • Assist with contingency / correlation modelling required for bet builder and same-game accumulators
  • Collect, clean, and analyse large sports, trading, and market datasets and feeds
  • Run backtests, investigate model performance, and help iterate on model parameters and methodology
  • Build and improve internal tools that help traders operate efficiently and safely
  • Collaborate with engineering to integrate models and analytics into production systems (reliability, performance, observability)
  • Document analysis, assumptions, and changes; communicate findings clearly to the team

We are looking for someone who

  • Has a strong foundation in probability, statistics, and applied mathematics
  • Has solid programming skills in Python (or similar), and is comfortable working with data (pandas / SQL or equivalent)
  • Can reason clearly about modelling assumptions, bias, and validation
  • Is curious and proactive, with a willingness to learn and take ownership over time
  • Communicates technical work clearly
  • Has a strong work ethic with a drive for completing high-quality work

Bonus points if you have

  • Exposure to sports analytics or sports betting markets
  • Experience working with large datasets and/or real-time data feeds
  • Familiarity with statistical learning / optimisation techniques
  • Golang experience

About Super

We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

Shaping the Future of Play

Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page:

Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA).

At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance.

 Vil du have et studiejob, hvor du kommer tæt på produkter, kampagner, data og indkøb i en af Danmarks største retailvirksomheder?
 
 I Commercial arbejder vi med de produkter, priser, kampagner og sortimenter, som kunderne møder i vores kæder. Her omsætter vi data, kundeindsigter og leverandørsamarbejder til konkrete beslutninger i blandt andet Netto, føtex og Bilka.
 
 Vi søger to studentermedhjælpere - én til Dry Food-teamet og én til Canned Food-teamet. Begge teams arbejder med food-kategorier og har en bred kontaktflade til category buyers, coordinators, leverandører og interne samarbejdspartnere.

 Canned Food, Coffee & tea
 Teamet arbejder med kategorier som blandt andet kaffe, konserves, canned fish og canned ready meals.
 
 Dine opgaver
 Du vil blandt andet komme til at arbejde med:

 Opgaverne vil variere afhængigt af team, kategori og periode, men fælles for begge roller er, at du får en tæt kobling til det daglige kategoriarbejde.
 
 Hvem du er

 Du er i gang med en uddannelse 

 Du kan arbejde ca. 15 timer om ugen fordelt på 2 dage 

 Du arbejder struktureret og følger op på dine opgaver 

 Du har god talforståelse og interesse for data

 Du kommunikerer tydeligt på dansk og engelsk 

 Du har lyst til at lære mere om indkøb, category management og retail

 Vi tilbyder dig:

 mulighed for at opbygge et professionelt netværk i Salling Group

title: Personal Financial Consultant
description:
Here's a job description for a Personal Financial Consultant at RHB Bank Berhad:

Personal Financial Consultant

Company:** RHB Bank Berhad

---

Job Summary

The Personal Financial Consultant at RHB Bank Berhad is responsible for building and nurturing client relationships, providing expert financial advice, and offering tailored banking and investment solutions to help individuals achieve their financial goals.

---

Job Responsibilities

* Proactively identify and engage with potential and existing clients to understand their financial needs and objectives.
* Conduct comprehensive financial needs analysis, including assessing risk tolerance, investment horizons, and financial aspirations.
* Develop and present personalized financial plans and recommendations covering areas such as savings, investments, insurance, retirement planning, and wealth management.
* Advise clients on a range of RHB Bank's products and services, including deposits, loans, unit trusts, insurance products, and other investment instruments.
* Achieve individual and team sales targets and key performance indicators (KPIs) for product penetration and client acquisition.
* Regularly review and update client portfolios to ensure alignment with their evolving financial situation and market conditions.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records and comply with all regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Stay informed about market trends, economic conditions, and new product offerings to provide relevant and timely advice.
* Collaborate with other departments within RHB Bank to ensure a seamless client experience and cross-selling opportunities.
* Participate in ongoing training and development programs to enhance product knowledge and advisory skills.

---

Job Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Banking, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in financial services, preferably in a client-facing role such as financial advisory, wealth management, or retail banking.
* Possession of relevant industry certifications (e.g., FIMM, PCE, CUTE) is highly advantageous.
* Strong understanding of financial products, investment principles, and wealth management strategies.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills with the ability to build rapport and trust with clients.
* Demonstrated sales acumen with a proven track record of achieving targets.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* High level of integrity and commitment to ethical conduct.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Fluency in English and Bahasa Malaysia is required; proficiency in other local languages is an added advantage.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst at MSD
description:
MSD Sweden is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to play a critical role in driving data-driven decision-making across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly analytical professional to work at the intersection of commercial strategy, market intelligence, customer analytics, and business performance. The role partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders across local Commercial, Marketing, Medical, Finance, and regional and global teams to deliver actionable insights that support growth, enhanced customer engagement, and strategic decision-making.

The Business Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for analyzing market, customer, and competitive data to identify opportunities and trends that inform business strategy. The role will lead the development and maintenance of dashboards, reporting solutions, and centralized data platforms that provide stakeholders with timely and meaningful insights. In addition, the position will support product launches, sales force effectiveness initiatives, omnichannel performance analysis, and forecasting activities through advanced analytics and predictive modeling.

Acting as MSD Sweden's local Data & Analytics point of contact, the successful candidate will drive the adoption of analytics capabilities and help build data literacy across the organization. The role requires strong analytical skills, expertise in business intelligence and visualization tools, and the ability to communicate complex findings to a diverse range of stakeholders.

Success in this position will depend on the ability to lead complex projects, influence cross-functional teams, and translate data into actionable recommendations that support MSD Sweden's commercial and organizational objectives.
